title: New York in One Day Guided Sightseeing Tour
description: Combine New York City’s top attractions in a guided tour via bus and the Staten Island Ferry. With insider commentary from your guide, visit Rockefeller Center, South Street Seaport, 9/11 Memorial, and Wall Street. Take a Staten Island ferry ride, with views of Ellis Island, the Statue of Liberty, and Brooklyn Bridge. Back on land, hit Lincoln Center and Central Park before wrapping up this whirlwind tour.

reviews.usertext:
This was our first time in New York and so we wanted to book a tour that would allow us to see as much as possible, with a knowledgable tour guide to explain the sights. We were not disappointed!

We booked the open air/glass roof mini bus and would thoroughly recommend, it allows you so see so much more of the amazing skyline!

The itinerary had to change due to there being a parade on the day we booked, so lots of road closures. They handled this really well, changing up the route and giving us the opportunity to visit Highline Park and Chelsea Market instead!

A really enjoyable trip and a great way to see lots of the most famous sights all in one day!

A good tour that was made great by our guide Steve. His knowledge was extensive but he also had great tips for best places to stand/view etc. He worked hard all day and if you get him you will have a great time.

Pay extra for the open top bus, as you can see the streets better and there are only 15 people so a small group. Bus was driven by Betty who has a smooth driving style and did a great job in the NYC traffic

I recommend this tour especially with Steve and Betty.

I’ve been to NYC quite a few times, but it was my husbands first trip, and since it was just a 3 day stay we decided to do a tour to make the most of our time in the city. We had such a great experience! Our tour guide, Buster Freeze, was a delight!! Born in Londen but a true New Yorker at heart, he was an endless book of knowledge and adoration for the city and the people. The tour hit most of the major landmarks, with short stops at places like Central Park, Rockefeller Center and the World Trade Center. By taking the bus, we were able to cover so much of Manhattan in such a short time. We took the Ferry to Staten Island, which really gives you a “true New York feel” just being among the commuters, and it gives you a pretty sweet shot of the Statue of Liberty. Our driver, Izzy, was cool + calm, and if you’ve ever been in a car in NYC can you even imagine driving a bus? No, thanks. But, I felt safe the whole trip with him behind the wheel.
Long story short: I ABSOLUTELY recommend spending the $100ish bucks to to take this tour, and if you do it near the beginning of your trip it’ll give you loads of help planning what you want to do next.

We had Dana as our tour guide and she was sooooo much fun! She made sure we were all accounted for the entire time, provided fun facts throughout the whole trip especially when stuck in traffic which kept us very engaged. 10/10 would recommend this tour to start off your NY trip with first-timers. There is a bit of walking/getting on and off the bus for those with impaired mobility, just a heads up!

We took the upgraded tour with the smaller glass top bus (which did convert to open air later in the day) & small group of 13 tourists, SO worth the price! The glass top vehicle made it easy to see all the buildings & scenery so much better than the big bus with 30 visitors plus you can hear the tour guide easier. Gil was our tour guide & he’s fantastic. He knew so much about every single building we passed & clearly loves NYC & loves sharing the history. Took my teenager age 15, who enjoyed it too. It was our first time ever to NYC and this is the best way to see all the highlights. Gil was very efficient, he knew exactly where to have Carlos drop us & pick us up, and knew which stops to stay longer, he was a pro. Many of the stops are short as there is so much to visit in a 6 hour day. Then you can decide later if you want to come back & see more on your own another day. Gil was full of interesting tidbits about everything we passed, he was so entertaining & engaging. We saw so much on the bus portion of the tour, and then the Straten Island Ferry was wonderful seeing the NY skyline and views. The last stop was the 911 reflection ponds & Gil shared so many interesting facts about the memorial, it was very moving. We saw all of the must sees of NYC & learned so many interesting things along the way as Gil was full of fun facts & observations.

This is the first thing you are going to say when you sit down in the plush comfort of the bus and realize that there are charging outlets in every seat. Oh well, we survived this 6 hour excursion without them and had a great time, the weather being unseasonable warm at 70°. Raymond navigated the beast of a bus through such tight spaces, I felt like we were on the Night Bus from Harry Potter. And Gil, which he spelled for us because there may be more than one way to spell pronounce Gil I guess, is like the Ellis island registry of celebs in NYC. He knows who lives where and who used to and how much they paid and who their neighbors are and what kind of dog they have and if they showered this morning. . . You get my drift. His brand of facts and sarcasm were appreciated, being that I have been accused of dabbling in the art of smartassery a time or two. My favorite was the lady who obviously booked the tour and didn’t read the itinerary, and each time she asked about if we would see something he said, “Sure, you should go see that on your own.” The tour was fast for 6 hours and if you are slow, you better step it up cause Gil’s gonna call you out for taking too long to get your Atlas picture right. We saw more than we ever imagined ( no Gil, we do not want to stand in line to touch a bull’s sack) we would and when they stop for lunch, don’t guess, hit Little Italy Pizzeria and grab a slice or three. (Just kidding, nobody on that bus wants you to down 3 pieces, stick with 1 or 2.) They totally need to offer an 8 or 10 hour version as a sequel to the original tour. Well worth every penny. TN

What a wonderful day!! Saw and learned so much! Our guide, Don, was the best. A true New Yorker with so much to share! Highly recommend this tour to get a great overview of the City and cover so much more than you could ever do on your own. Also, Don was always read to answer questions and provide insight into how to make the most of our remaining time in the city.

My husband and I got to see so much of NYC on our full day tour with Steve. We spent almost $100 on taxis and Uber getting around for 1/2 day on our own just the day before. With the tour, we just sat back and relaxed while Steve pointed out all the landmarks of the city and gave us history and insights into living in the city. We were able to get out and walk through a part of Central Park, visit John Lennon’s Imagine memorial, walk by the Dakota, visit Rockefeller Center, visit the World Trade Center Memorial, and take a ride on the Staten Island Ferry. It was a busy day but we were able to cover so much ground..much more than we could on our own. I highly recommend this tour.

I would highly recommend this bus trip early in the NYC experience as it gives a great preview of many iconic sights in the city. All in our party of 8, ranging from 8 to 74, loved this trip. We had a wonderful guide who provided us with history of the city!

This was a great tour to see an overview of New York city! We took this tour on the first full day we were there and it was great to see a little bit of everything so we'd know where we'd want to go and spend more time in the following days. We also got some great information about the history of the city from our tour guide! A few things to keep in mind
1) Saturdays/Sundays there's more road construction so you may spend more time in traffic than during the weekdays which means there's slightly less time to see the sights (although you still see everything).
2) For the ferry, you take the public ferry to Staten Island and once you get to Staten Island, you quickly get off and get right back on a ferry to go back to the city. It was a bit stressful to make sure we got the ferry back, especially because we had kids so just be prepared.
3) Also on the ferry to Staten Island, try to be on the right hand side of the ferry on the way to Staten Island so you can see the Statue of Liberty and on the way back, try to be on the left hand side of the ferry. The best views in my opinion are from the front of the boat.

There was a lot we saw on this tour for sure. If you like driving past things or being RAN around by your guide. Gill was our guide and was rude, was very irritated because we had slow-walking people in our group, and chastised two French speaking women for quietly translating to each other once in a while. He constantly reminded us that if we aren't back at the time he says he will leave without us and that this was his tour and to mind his rules. We heard more about celebrities living in apartments and where movies were filmed than history of the city. Yes, you got to glance at lots of different places, but you for sure didn't get to experience a lot of it. And what you did you felt pressured to stay close to the guide or be left behind.

This was the first time my wife and I have ever visited New York City but I would highly recommend this tour even if you've been to NYC before. Rachel was our knowledgeable guide and Manny was our skilled bus driver when we took this tour... and I would take any tour either had a part of in the future. Our bus was full and Rachel did a great job of creating a friendly and comfortable environment in which everyone felt welcome and comfortable. Not only did she give some great information about the sites we saw, but she educated the entire bus on how to best enjoy their time in the Big Apple with everything from shopping the stores fronts and getting the best deals from street vendors. I know I can't speak for everyone else, but I had the strong impression that everyone else on the bus enjoyed the tour as much as my wife and I,

We had an amazing time on this tour with Vinny our guide and Juan as our driver. We opted for the open top bus and it was a beautiful day hopping on and off seeing some gorgeous sights. The 9/11 monument was so moving, I got a little upset when reading the names on the plaque 💔. The ferry over to Staton Island was fun with Vinny holding us all back so we had the best views of the Statue Of Liberty( which we though would have been a lot bigger). For lunch Vinny and Juan took us to their favourite pizza place Joes, and it was worth it. Our only down fall was that we should have down the tour on our first day as we could have seen a lot more places that Vinny had pointed out but we didn’t have the time to go to on the rest of our stay😩. This tour is well worth the money and your time 👍🏼🥰

We had an awesome experience with Tim as our guide and Miguel as our driver. We paid for the open/glass top bus and scored by ending up with a group of 11 in a 15 seat van. Having the small group made it way more enjoyable. We got to enjoy almost an entire day of sun with the top off and the windows down. Near the end of the 6+ hour tour, as we were leaving the Staten Island Ferry and making our way to the 9/11 Memorial, we encountered rain so Miguel got the bus all covered and ready for us and we did the return trip in an air conditioned vehicle, which wasn't great for pictures but was awesome to escape the heat and humidity.

Tim was very knowledgeable and pleasant, and wasn't trying to do too much or be cute like some tour guides do. He even threw in a couple perfectly timed dad jokes here and there, for good measure. He gave some great tips on places to people watch, shop and restaurants that we are already using to improve the rest of our trip. Miguel was very nice and navigated the city safely.

Definitely book this tour (the Sunday at 10 a.m. trip was perfect at every stop) because you'll never get to see all of the sites and actually know what they are and their history on your own. Also be sure to pay the extra for the open/glass top tour, it's worth every extra dime. Definitely tip them well when you're departing as they did just give you an entire day of fun and facts. This was the perfect crash course on NYC, even for people who have been to the city before.

It was a comprehensive tour in 6-6.5 hours for a day in New York City. Our Guide... forgetting his name... was a cool looking guy who lives in the Midtown area. He lead us along through the crowds with his red umbrella. He was extremely knowledgeble about everything in the city and had many recommendations along his tour for other activities or restaurants that we could also enjoy. Only regret is that we didn't sign up in enough time to get the glass top or open top bus. I think it would have really enhanced the tour. I would recommend this tour to anyone who has a limited amount of time in the city and wants to get some great photos and overview of the city.

We selected and paid extra for the open air bus with a small group which was fabulous. The people checking us in to the tour and the bus driver were dressed very professionally and the bus was very clean and well stocked with water. Unfortunately our guide started out having a bad day which we felt affected the tour. He arrived with a bloody hand and spent time dumping bottles of water over his bleeding finger, so may have been in pain. Most tours start out with the guide introducing him/herself and asking where people are from, which would have been nice. We did end up finding this out, but had to ask as were were walking. Our guide, Chris, did finally get into his "script", but we felt we missed historical information about some of the stops. For example, he did not know who designed Central Park when we asked, so we had to look up as we went. Also he lost his flag at the first stop so picked up a stick and taped a dollar bill and red card to it, which we found amusing, but out of character with the tour professionalism. (When we were in the crowds boarding and off boarding the Staten Island Ferry it was useful to look for the dollar bill stick because he walked so fast through the crowd, we were very concerned we would not be able to keep up and make the Ferry. ) It also would have been nice to know how far we needed to walk at each stop since it was a hot, humid afternoon and the end of the tour became a physical endurance test.

This was my first trip to NYC ... recommend if you want to get a quick overview of the city, cultural insight, and suggestions for individual exploration. Tour guide provided great historial perspective Driver Manny was awesome navigating those narrow, double parked streets like the matrix. My only suggestion would be for tour guide to avoid inserting personal perspectives as sometimes they were not positive and took away from the tour.

We had a great day in the company of our guide Martin and driver Raymond. Both went above and beyond to make this tour and it seemed to flyby. Martin gave us much more information about the city than was even in the tour description. Having an experienced guide from the area was great, every question you asked was answered and he has a passion for New York and was giving us information nonstop for the entire tour. I would recommend this tour to anyone with an interest in knowing the stories and history behind the buildings and city to take this tour

Brooklyn Jim and Driver Betty made our experience of seeing NYC just fabulous! Jim's knowledge of the hirlsotry of the area, great ways to save cash on where to eat, and personal stories that make the city's personality vibrant were just a few of the reasons I highly recommend d this tour. Additionally, since there are only 13 people total on a single. Us, there is the added benefit of getting to meet travellers from all parts of the world.

Steve made this tour a very enjoyable 5 STAR experience! He was high energy, entertaining, informative and was very attentive with the whole group, especially one guest who had difficult walking. He gave us insider tips and made the time fly by. We always knew what was coming and what to look for. He wore an easy to spot vest and even carried a stick on the ferry to help guide us. A good tour guide can make or break or a tour. I highly recommend Steve!

This tour is definitely not for the faint of heart.
I literally thought I had seen it all until I seen what I saw. Eversince returning from my solo trip to the big apple back in1989 my family & friends still refuse to believe me.
I know I'm not the only one that witnessed the statue of liberty wading through the new york harbor to the tune of higher & higher by jackie wilson that night.

Great, informative tour from Walter and excellent driving from Alex.
Was ideal for getting our bearings round the city, and to give an insight to all that is available. Walter was extremely helpful and unflustered in keeping our group altogether when taking us on little walkabouts from the bus; Alex always then reappeared as if by magic!

I looked for tours online and this was the most popular tour I found and now I know why! I knew it would be a lot of walking and prior to going on it I know that some things we just drove by. I would have liked to take pictures of the things we drove by, but the bus was pretty rocky so getting good pictures were not very likely. I think that would be helpful for people to know, but other than that it have me everything promised.

Brendon was the tour guide and Manny was the driver and they both were respectful. Brendon answered any questions he could and was patient with people asking questions. The history of New York was fascinating and he told us so much, I wish we could have had a pamphlet with all the information provided. That’s no complaint, just a nice addition to the tour.

It was fun to see where famous scenes from my favorite shows and movies were filmed. And it was a lot of information, again a commemorative pamphlet would have been nice, but that information could also be Googled. So, again not a complaint, just a nice to have.

It was a lot of walking, but also great information! I would recommend this tour to anyone that would like to see the best places but don’t have a lot of time to spend in New York. One of the things that I appreciated was that Brendon told us where to find tickets for shows at the best prices. He also gave us some good tips on finding the best good while there.

It was a very full day packed with a ton of new information. The guide was extremely knowledgeable. He kept us at a great pace when off the bus all the while giving ample time to discover. Despite having a rainy and cold day we were able to visit and see great sites such as the Rockefeller Center, 9/11 memorial, Staten Island etc. He was full of great stories about the city and its famous residents. Highly recommend this tour.

As first time visitors to NYC we decided to have a guided tour and we were absolutely delighted with this one. Our driver Leonard and our guide Steve were excellent. Super friendly, professional and knowledgeable. We noticed several tours from the same company leaving at the same time from the same location but ours was in a smaller vehicle that had an open top. This made our experience so much better as the smaller tour group made things a lot less crowded and we felt like we got a closer experience with the guide. The vehicle was clean and comfortable. Bottled water and maps / guides provided throughout. Steve made sure we had an excellent experience and made little adjustments to the schedule to make sure we avoid heavy crowds and needing to rush. The Staten Island ferry in particular was very good as Steve had a little hack to avoid the crowds on the top deck without compromising the views / photo opps.

Overall, this is a fantastic way to see most of the key sites NYC has to offer and we would highly recommend this tour in particular as the driver and guide were wonderful and the smaller group size made the tour significantly better.

I had Jimmy (Brooklyn) and AnTONY (driver) and this was a great day. Saw all the sights and then went back later to explore on my own. Jimmy loves his city with a well earned cynicism and humour that had the guests laughing all day. He was very knowledgeable and made sure everyone on the tour was enjoying themselves.

The bus was clean and they had plenty of free water. There was a screen at the front of the bus so you could view 360 degrees as you drove in air conditioned bus. Plenty of stops to get out and walk around.

This may appear a bit more expensive than some of the other tours but I thought it was well worth it. My thoughts were solidified later in the evening when I heard another company guide telling a Dad with some tired children the next hop on was an hour wait in the heat......

Great tour.

This is the second time we have done the One Day tour. The first time was three years ago when it was my wife's first time in NYC; we thought such a tour would be a good introductory experience to the city. And, it was. The guide then was knowledgeable, friendly, relaxed, and we had ample time to explore the various stops.

Based on that experience, we readily booked the same tour this past Saturday when it was our daughter's first time in NYC. While our guide was again highly informative, we were rushed from place to place, his personality and non-stop presentation style allowed no opportunity for interaction. We were dismayed that we spent longer on a bathroom break than the less than two minutes at the WTC site. Granted it was the NYC Marathon weekend and a 5k race in Central Park; yet that was a minor snag in uptown that did not put us behind at all. In fact , we finished our tour with fifteen minutes to spare.

As a side point, the bus was extremely overcrowded and a crying infant didn't help such a challenging tour.

I am not a stranger to NYC, having visited here at least yearly since the mid-1970s, and I know it is impossible to get much more than the general greatest hits in a six hour tour, but the needless hurry and the uninterrupted lecture made a rather relentless and overwhelming day for a new visitor.

The “New York in One Day Guided Sightseeing Tour” covered much real estate, in a very nice “closed top luxury bus”, with an excellent, experienced, NYC driver (Anthony). The tour was booked to share with my daughter and granddaughter the many NYC sights & glad we saw them.
However, we had the most curious tour guide ever, leading our tour (Brooklyn Jim). No doubt as a licensed tour guide, he knows the city, but he spent so much time on banal jokes that it felt like he was auditioning for a grade C comedy club. Many historic sights were passed with nary a word while he was working on a laugh from the guy next to him on the bus. And no, seeing photos of your family & home on your cellphone are not interesting to anyone 3’ beyond you. I began point out numerous sights along the way, ignored by Brooklyn Jim. Boredom of the same sights day after day must have set in for him.
It’s a crapshoot as to who you get for a tour guide. Management should jump on his bus to witness his foolish guiding and then give direction as to how an excellent guide conducts tours. A+ on the bus & driver. C for the tour guide!

If you’re in NYC for just a short amount of time (maybe less than 4 or 5 days), I would definitely recommend this tour—a ton of sites and info is crammed into the six hour time slot. That being said, it does start to feel quite long. It’s broken into helpful segments with a good lunch and bathroom break, and the Staten Island ferry ride section of the tour is really refreshing. Our driver, Juan, did a great job at safely navigating the traffic, though if you struggle with motion sickness like I do, taking a Bonine or something similar beforehand might be helpful because New York traffic is necessarily a bit jerky. Our guide, Esther, did well at sharing the information and keeping our group together. I think if I was going to be in New York for a week or longer, I probably wouldn’t do this tour and would try to hit the individual spots on my own. That being said, my wife and I were only in town for about 3.5 days, and I was glad we did the tour because it was my only chance to see certain sites and neighborhoods. Overall, a worthwhile and reasonably priced experience for getting a lot of sightseeing done in a relatively concise way.

The bus lower step was broken in our bus and caused a women with weak knees to fall. Your equipment should have been fixed . I also need that step but I was able to maneuver when getting on and off the bus.

Disappointed that our ride to Statue of Liberty was a free ferry ride that goes Staten Island. For the price i was expected to get closer to the Statue of Liberty. For the cost of 99.00 it should include a closer ride by of the Statue of Liberty and not a free ferry ride that passes by.

The redeeming factor was that our tour guide was excellent. Polite and patience person. He went his way to make user the lady who had some physical issues able to use elevator instead of the stairs when we stopped.

He showed us New York as a native.
He was very informed about the history and the beauty of the city. His planned bathroom break were in excellent clean public bathrooms!
He also helped me to get to the marathon finish line to greet my daughter using the subway which was so awesome since this was my first trip to New York.

I did the hop off and on bus the next day which was tour guide was a recording and kept missing up.

Overall this all day tour is well worth it if it is your first time in New York. Use the hop on and off only after you take the all day tour. Your experience with this company is rewarding and an experience that you will never forget!!!

My wife and I had never been to NYC before and we loved this tour with Arlis, our driver and Tim, our tour guide. Arlis did a fantastic job of navigating the bus through chaotic traffic congestion while pausing at important spots on the tour, so Tim could provide insightful comments about the sights we were looking at and also so we could get quick photos before the bus continued down the road.

Tim is an AWESOME tour guide. He is the perfect blend of knowledge, charisma, ENTHUSIASM and entertaining. There were approximately 20 passengers on this tour and through Tim’s leadership and engaging personality the passengers soon had a great time interacted with each other on the tour. Tim called most everyone by the name of the city or state where they lived and in its own way, was a charming for people to get to know each other. Tim’s excitement was contagious and his “fun facts” and storytelling was captivating. At the end of this fun 6 hour tour, we kept talking about all the fun we had and wishing it wasn’t over yet

This summer, My wife and I are traveling on the East Coast and we have taken three other Sightseeing tours in Philadelphia and Boston, and they were very good but NOTHING like this tour with Tim. We strongly recommend this tour.

One final comment, after taking this tour, we traveled to Boston, where we took a very good “Hop on/Hop off” bus tour to see/drive by the major sights of Boston. While we were waiting in line to climb on board the bus before the tour started , we heard a voice from the person behind us in line as she made a reference to our tour with Tim. We turned around and we happy to greet our “old friends” (Hawaii) that we met 5 days before on Tim’s tour. It was fun to see and briefly visit with 2 complete strangers who we got to know only because of Tim’s tour guide style and his friendliness.

Brendan (tour guide) and Betty (driver) were excellent.
If you are in NYC and want to hit up the famous tourist sites without dealing with logistics of transportation or schedule, I highly recommend this tour. We were in NYC for 4 days, and the USA tour was our best experience
Brendan was extremely knowledgeable about facts around each site on tour. He answered multiple questions about historical sites, had patience for the crew and gave us additional suggestions on traveling within the city. 5/5
Bus was clean, had bottled water and followed a timely schedule.
We visited Rockefeller Center, Central Park, 911 memorial, Fulton Market among a few other locations.
Perfect mixture of sitting in a bus and listening to facts coupled with walking around the city.

This is an amazing 6 hour tour where you see the highlights of the Big Apple. There is a good mix of get off the bus and drive by sights. Our guide Nathan was a wealth of knowledge, and our driver Manny was great in NYC traffic. A definite must do for first time visitors and returning guests. We did the open top mini bus and it was well worth the extra $20 per person.

Going on the Staten Island ferry coming away from Manhattan the views were stunning. It was my first time in NYC.. I would definitely recommend this tour for anyone in the same position. We wouldnt have seen everything if we travelled around ourselves. Our tour guide was Wallace, he was so helpful and full of useful knowledge of the city from restaurant recommendations to advising the best way and time to travel to different locations. He was also very funny.. thanks Wallace for making our trip so enjoyable!!

Our tour guide Rachel (and our driver Juan) were great! The January weather and the traffic ended up being terrible the day we went but they still managed to get in all the sights on the itinerary with their savvy NYC navigation skills. And I was SO thankful I booked a heated bus tour on a cold wet day! Learned so much about the history of NY and some tips to get around efficiently while visiting and other local knowledge & tips that we found really helpful. My favorite part was the Staten Island Ferry! There would’ve been no way I would’ve attempted that without Rachel! Had great views of the Statue of Liberty without having to book an extra Statue of Liberty specific tour. All-in-all I read through MANY tour options and decided on this one and it worked out better than I could have imagined! Great way to spend a day in NYC!

We chose this tour having done the 9 hour version about 7 years ago, ( which they no longer offer). I think we had the same tour guide, Steve. The tour itself is a great concept if you are new to the city and want to not only see the main sites but also get a feel for the geographical layout of the city to then follow up in the next few days with your own tours. For us as it is our teens first trip to NYC we decided to take the tour and it did not disappoint. Steve is immensely knowledgeable, (or does a good job of making out he is :) ). Steve has a story for every road and every building as he talks non stop for almost 6 hours, which goes so fast because it is so enjoyable and informative. Even better as our group were ready 15 minutes early, Steve left early and with us getting back half an hour late as well, Steve adapted the tour to allow us to see and experience more, which is a true professional tour guide. Shoutout to Betty the driver, who kept us on time and supplying the ice cold water from the cool box (included).

We travelled on a spacious air conditioned bus carrying 30 people approx . The Tour Guide,Tyler, was par excellence. She had an encyclopaedic knowledge of New York. She had many quirky little facts and figures which kept all her passengers fully interested. There were also free bottles of cold water for the passengers.
I’d wholeheartedly recommend this company for a guided tour of NY.
I should also add that we were delayed in arriving in NY and as a result would have missed the scheduled tour date. However the company changed our booking at very short notice to the following day. We can’t thank them enough for being so understanding.
Lovely experience 😀👍

My husband and I just took the tour on July 10, 2021. Our guide Gil and driver Jose were wonderful. Gil was very entertaining and informative about all the areas of the city. He had a great mix of information about architecture, movie and TV trivia shot around the city and historical facts from the founding of the city and country. The bus was a very comfortable ride. The tour was a good mix of site seeing and departing the bus to see things up close and to take photos. I highly recommend this tour! You get to see a ton of the city. I recommend you take this tour early in your trip to the city because they do a great job of pointing out things that may be of interest to see after you are done. We took the tour on our last full day. Based on their recommendations there would have been places we would have visited as a result of the tour if we'd done it early on. Thanks for a great experience!

An amazing 8-hour sight-seeing tour of some of NY's greatest highlights, ideal for people who only have a few days to see the city. Most of the tour took place in a bus, but it also included a lot of walking as well as a ferry to see the Statue of Liberty.
Many compliments and thanks go to our incredibly engaging guide, Rachel, whose information, insights and expressiveness made the experience even greater!

Our family was very disappointed with this bus tour of NYC for several reasons. First, the tour bus was not as seen in the pictures. This tour bus appeared to be older. It was squeaky when riding which was very irritating, the AC did not work (the fan was also noisy), and the view was not good from the window. Second, our tour guide provided very little information that we could take away from this that was educational. Information was construed with dates he was not sure about, mention of his mother/friends, and miscellaneous information. It was very hard to follow him and stay interested in what he was saying when the conversation was all over the place. He also missed landmarks like Chinatown and a Vietnam Memorial, but several dog parks were pointed out throughout the day. We have been to NYC twice and this time we brought our grandchildren. They were bored and did not get what they should have out of this tour for the money we paid. I would not recommend this tour. I would have requested a partial refund, but instead will take it as a learning experience. I believe the hop on and off bus would have been better with taking a chance that we may have needed an Uber to get back to the train station.

This was our first visit to NYC. With only a couple of days in the city, we wanted to learn the lay of the land and get a feel for places we might want to further explore. This tour was PERFECT!
Tyler, our tour guide, was terrific! She has a true love for New York. Her knowledge and passion are apparent, and she made the experience absolutely wonderful! Our driver was awesome as well!
The tour includes a ride all over the city in a very comfortable bus, during which we learned about the sights and the neighborhoods. There are several stops, where we got off the bus and were able to walk around with our guide and take photos.
The description of the tour online gives all the details … but, what it doesn’t tell you is just how fantastic the experience is. Tyler and our driver knocked it out of the park! They gave me and my mom an unforgettable day - I absolutely recommend this tour - THANK YOU, USA Guided Tours! #usagt

Truly enjoyable tour of the city of New York with a local guide (Steve) who put the flavor of a New Yorker in all of his narrative. We learned so much about the city, the history, the good and the bad, how it functions and why New Yorkers love it.

Steve covered every interesting thing about the city in a comfortable pace making sure we were all together at all times. We were on time at every location and the driver was always there to meet us at the designated location.

We would definitely recommend this tour to everyone and special with Steve.

We booked this tour with the idea it would give us an overview of the basic New York sights. We are very impressed with both the driver and the guide. Our small group made it easy to move through the crowds and the audio information pertinent. We were given lots of instruction as to where we were going and times to be at the van. Our lunch time stop was perfect - lots of choice for food, places to sit and time to eat. We are very satisfied and would recommend this tour (especially the upgraded open top) to any first timer.

We dedicated one of our days in NYC to thus Tour and paid for the Glass Top bus. Upon arrival to our pickup site, we were told there wasn't a Glass top available so we could get in a van for half off or cancel so 12 of us were put in a Van for our tour.
I'm sure we saw the same sights but this was a major disappointment in the experience we hoped to have.
Our Tour Guide was knowledgeable but bring enclosed in a small van with a guide in need of a shower caused us to have to use our masks and not for Covid.
The Tour was great but not the experience we planned for our NYC vacation.

This was such an amazing experience and I’m so glad we did it! Rachel was our amazing tour guide and Juan was our driver—the man is a driving genius. He navigated the streets of NYC seamlessly and his timing was perfect every time we were headed to board for our next stop. Rachel’s expert and in-depth knowledge of SO many places, events, buildings, etc was incredible. I had read the reviews previously and many mentioned how great she was, so I was glad we got her for ours—but now I’m incredibly grateful we had her. There is so much more to this tour than the destinations mentioned in the description. The NY insider info and tips are super helpful! This is something someone should book anytime they visit the city but it would be especially helpful to book it at the beginning of a stay in NYC—the tips alone are wonderful knowledge to have. I would do it agin and I highly recommend it! The bus was super comfy and there are electrical outlets for your devices to charge them throughout the day. Water is provided as well as a mandatory restroom break and lunch. Wear comfy shoes because there is a fair amount of walking but not super-crazy. My step count for the entire day was around 8k (3 miles) and that was the entire day and not just the tour. Go ahead and book it—you won’t regret it. It will be a great experience!

Not a great tour for the money. Super disappointing. We go on tours in almost every city we go to, and have been on tours in New York before. This tour guide did not give very much information and appeared to want to quickly get done with the tour. Lunch spot was ridiculous, stopped in a back street at fast food restaurants like Taco Bell. It was so confusing with so many good places to eat and see in New York. My husband and I were with our daughter and we ended up getting a slice of pizza and standing in a corner and eating it and getting back on the bus. Seems like a lunch stop at Chelsea market or some thing really cool like that would have been much better. On most tours the tour guide fills time in the bus and in traffic with information about the city but there was a lot of quiet time with this tour guide. Also, did not stop at many spots to take pictures. Last time we were in New York we stopped at lots of different landmarks to take pictures. This one was much different and basically just drove by all the landmarks. Not sure if it was a result of Covid or the tour guide being in a hurry to get done. The first thing he stated when he got on the bus is that he hopes to be done by 2:30 PM.

Amazing tour. Our tour guide Alberto Veloz was the best, very knowledgeable, he gave us a tour that didn’t feel like a tour, it felt like friends hanging out around the city. Our stops were not just a photo spot it came with a detailed explanation of the landmarks. He took his time around the city, we didn’t feel rushed at all. The tour bus was super nice, very comfortable sits and only about 14 of us which made the experience feel more personal and dedicated. Thank you for such an amazing day!

I truly enjoyed all the stops and information on this tour. Gabby was an excellent tour guide, very knowledgeable and helpful. Betty, our driver, got us from place to place easily even though there was so much traffic. We enjoyed all aspects of the tour and would recommend it to people to get the lay of New York City.

Our guide Nate was awesome, very informative and so funny....even made voice impressions and real funny jokes. Definitely enjoyed his tour and would highly recommend him. He even went back to look for someone that got distracted and did not dare leave them. Loved his Star Wars light saver he used to keep us up with him. Enjoyed every moment of his tour!!!

Jerry, our tour guide was very helpful & knowledgeable regarding the landmarks & other surrounding areas of interest. Jerry always had questions for us to make sure we retained information & maintained the best sense of humor. Jim was a courteous & safe friendly driver in this congested nerve wracking traffic.

Steve our tour guide was informative, helpful and humorous. Got to learn a lot of history about NYC. Tour was all at a good pace, glass top bus was a great way to view the city and we covered a lot of major tourist attractions, Rockefeller Centre, Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island viewed whilst on Stanton island Ferry, 9/11 Memorial to name a view. It was a 6 hour tour but because it was so interesting it felt way shorter. I would highly recommend this tour and once again a big shout out to Steve, he was just brilliant.

Personal didn’t really feel that the tour hold the value for which it charges you. Needs more stop at important locations. Barely 4-5 stops throughout the trip.

Paid extra for open bus sightseeing experience but the bus top was open only post lunch sighting bad weather (personally I didn’t feel the weather was too bad for a open top experience).

Felt more like history lesson tour than that of a sightseeing tour.

Our guide Rachel and driver Jimmy put a ton of effort to make the most of our tour. The van was very comfortable and the glass top was especially helpful as Rachel pointed out some of the architecture around the city

Rachel constantly educated us on the culture of NYC and provided helpful personal insights in the customs and interactions with the people we may come into contact

Rachel demonstrated in-depth knowledge on many aspects of the tour interwoven with a great sense of humor

This was the best tour of six that we experienced this week. Highly recommend

Rachel was our guide and she was phenomenal. She knew the best places to see, the right times for us to be there, and even the best photo opportunities. Her tour was rich with history of the locations we visited, plus she gave us a wealth of culture and tips on how to navigate New York City. Next time we're in town, I'd love to try her evening tour.

This was the most amazing day! The tour guide “Buster Freeze” did a phenomenal job. He was so knowledgeable and funny. What a personality he has! I would definitely recommend this trip to anyone wanting to see the sites and wanting to know more about the city itself. Our driver Antony was fabulous too! It definitely was a fun filled day.

My mom, dad, and I visited New York City for the first time. We had seen a lot of the city on our own throughout the week, so when we went on the tour with Walter, we got to learn about a lot of what we had already seen. That was nice.
Walter had a lot of history to share and it was an enjoyable tour.
Thank you, Walter for sharing your city with us.

Rachel was an amazing tour guide. She really goes the extra mile to make your experience perfect! One thing she did that really put it over the top was to give everyone handout with affordable restaurant and experience recommendations. Now we get the benefit of her experience for our whole trip!

The One Day Guided Tour is a must if you visit the NYC area. Our tour guide, Rachel was phenomenal! She was very knowledgeable about the city, took the time to learn something about each passenger. She kept the tour fun and engaging and was able to work around a challenge related to a major event happening in the city the same weekend. We never would have been able to explore as much on our own being unfamiliar with the area.

Our driver, Hosea was great as well! He helped to keep the tour on schedule and maneuvered the bus through the narrow, crowded streets of NYC like a champ.

Great job Rachel & Hosea! Hope to see you again one day.

My daughter and I met Steve, our tour guide in Times Square at 9am and spent the most amazing day with him in an open topped, small bus. He talked nonstop as the bus drove us from one destination to the next, describing in detail our surroundings and the history of the sights. At each stop, not only did he give us yet another colorful and entertaining story of the place, but he offered to take our photos, of which he was the most expert in terms of positioning our photo spot and taking our photo. His recommendations for eating and shopping were spot on, and most especially the perfectly timed bathroom breaks. He knew all the tricks to insure we were first on and off the ferry. His directions, times, and meeting place were clear and easy to understand. This latter piece is especially appreciated because we have taken numerous tours all over the US and abroad, and this was by far the most expert and enjoyable for all the above reasons. Thank you, Steve!!! Have a great rest of the summer with your grateful tourists.

We had the open top tour with Rhonda, the mini bus was great. Our tour guide could of been much more informative . Have taken other tours before in many city’s and love guided tours , felt our guide either lacked knowledge about all the wonderful sites around us or just lacked the energy. Fortunately we had another tour on our trip and got all the insights and info on many landmarks we were looking for from another tour guide!

Dana has a wealth of knowledge & a passion & love for New York that made this a really enjoyable tour. Arliss our bus driver showed off his skills navigating tight turns & finding parking spaces.

This was a good look at the different aspects of New York & I highly recommend this tour!

I took 90 year old mom on this tour.
Our tour guide was amazing!!! Her pic is below in yellow shirt. She provided an expert and fluid articulation of current/historical events for Manhattan and NYC. We did part of the tour open top and part closed. What flexibility. Please attach her name and tell her thanks.

A fantastic way to see all the sights if you’re short on time. We had the closed bus rather than open too which was fantastic in the hot weather. I must say that our guide Nathan made this trip for us. There is absolutely nothing this man does not know about his fabulous city and had some historical knowledge about something on every single street we drove down, not just the main ‘sights’. A brilliant value for money trip which we would most definitely recommend.

If you have never been to New York and want a fun, safe way to get around and see all the major sights definitely take this tour! It is a long one (around 4-6 hours) but definitely worth it if you only have a few days in the city and want to see the coolest stuff.

Tour guides are peppy and knowledgeable as well as give good NYC advice for safety, food, bars etc. it does not stop at Liberty or Ellis but you do see them from the ferry which is a super fun ride for the first time if you have never been. If going in summer make sure to get on the covered bus it has very good AC they provided cold water bottles which was great.

Don’t forget to bring cash to tip your tour guide! If staying in time square start of tour is within walking distance very convenient.

highly recommend for any first-time to the Big Apple.
our guide, Nathan, was terrific! he was funny, knowledgeable, easy to understand, and very patient. most importantly, he carried a blue light saber so that when we walked around, we could find him in the crowds.
the bus was comfortable (packed, no bathroom), and the driver was good.
my lone suggestion is that you arrive at least 30 minutes prior to your departure time so that you can get a seat, and the bus can leave. the trip advertised as 6 hours, but took us 9 hours (left at 9:30am and got back at 5:30pm) - this was most likely due to traffic. otherwise, the tour kept a pretty good schedule. so keep in mind whatever plans you have afterwards.
this tour sets apart from others as it is more thorough, and we get a lot to walk around. Nathan covered much of NY's rich history and culture.
the ferry boat ride was nice as well.
i recommend to request Nathan if you book a tour with this group.

This tour was worth every penny and Rachel was THE best tour guide i have ever had! First of all we were running late due to traffic and subway confusions. I called an spoke to a dispatcher who said we could get picked up at the 2nd stop. I had to call a couple times to make sure they were on the way but the bus arrived with no issues. We saw everything we wanted on the tour. Rachel was amazing getting us on and off the Staten Island Ferry, telling us the history and even gave us a list of her inside favorite places as well as tips for getting around the city. I highly recomend this tour and all the reviews are accurate! This is a must when visiting NYC for the first time!

fantastic tour! We were on the smaller convertible bus tour with Steve as our guide. The bus itself was great because we could see up! Totally worth any extra cost. Steve was very interesting and knew the city's ins and outs, including where the clean bathrooms were. He was very entertaining and we learned a lot about the city's past and present. If you are going to do a day tour of NYC this is the way to go, and hopefully you'll get Steve as your guide. Thanks very much for an unforgettable tour.

One word . . . TYLER!!!! This fabulous and hilarious woman is everything an excellent tour guide should be and more. Highly engaged, quick witted and kind spirited; Tyler is a New York native, an unbelievable wealth of knowledge and an absolute NECESSITY for all first time New York tourists. We felt safe with her the entire time. There was not a single dull moment to be had. With every twist and every turn up and down the Manhattan grid-scape, Tyler was ready with an interesting fact and/or story about something on every single block. She answered every single question the group had about New York, it's past and it's present, with quickness, clarity and ease. Its actually kind of scary when you think about how much information her brain must hold. Since 2012, she's been leading guided tours and her experience is on full display. She doesnt read from any notes, and you can tell she isn't just reciting from a rehearsed script. It is beyond evident that she eats, breathes and sleeps "NEW YORK". New York is Tyler, and Tyler is New York. Her attitude is cooler than ice and her enthusiasm is infectious. She cultivated such a genuine air of community within the group that we genuinely dreaded having to eventually go our separate ways. At the end, she hugged us and sent us on our way with a few pro tips on how to get around town like a true New Yorker. The tour itself is insane too: We saw literally everything there is to see in Manhattan, took an ridiculous amount of pictures and videos, ate amazing food, road the staten island ferry, adventured through underground cityscapes, and so much more. But by far, the absolute best thing about it was our unbelievable luck in having Tyler as our guide the whole way through. Thanks to her, we have fallen in love with this city in just one day. We head home in the morning but we are already planning our next trip back will definitely be booking this again. If you only have one day to spend in New York, book this tour and ask for Tyler by name! You can thank me later!

Excellent tour of major areas of interest. Steve was a wealth of knowledge about the city’s history, neighborhoods and attractions. Steve gave us many insights and tips that will focus our activities for the remaining days of our visit

We took this tour on our first full day in NYC, and we loved it. It was a great way to get a broad overview of the most popular tourist and sightseeing stops in the city. Our tour guide, Rachel, was AMAZING! She was incredibly knowledgable and friendly. She was so awesome that we decided to stay for Rachel's night time tour of the city which hit different locations we hadn't seen earlier. Rachel also gave us lots of directions and guidance for riding the subway in Manhattan, what foods to eat while in NYC, and how to avoid swindlers in the city. If you are only going to do one tour, this is the one to do! You won't regret it!

The open-top bus is the best! Make sure you dress for the weather and it will be an experience you will never forget!! To be able to look up at Time Square and all the tall buildings plus all the amazing sites around New York was amazing! But the best part of our tour was our tour guide - Steve. He was always engaging, funny and incredibly knowledgeable about the City (including knowing where famous people lived!). We learned so much about the City from Steve.

The tour was good covering key places of NY and providing a lot of info. Out tour guide, Steve, made it an enjoyable trip. His clear communication, local connects and his ability to take diverse folks in a group together were commendable. The arrangements, including the space in the bus and providing water, were good and easy for even the elderly folks. A stop around Wall-street would've been nice. Highly recommended!

Martin Kelly and Betty were the best! Martin was so informative and enthusiastic and made the tour we took with him safe and fun. We had a really good time getting inside knowledge on all of New York and it is clear that Martin knows a lot about the history of New York given his experience in the city. Thank you for providing such a wonderful tour!

We took the tour with USA Guided tours in Washington DC which was so amazing we had to take the new york one as well. For anyone who wants to really get to know New york, I highly recommend this tour. Gil and Raymond were excellent every step of the way. Gil's knowledge of the city, its rich history and relevance helped make the tour an immersive experience. It lasts about 6 hours but it was so loaded with sights and tours, that it is the best way to truly discover New York.

Our tour guide, Rachel was amazing! We learned so much about the city. You can see so much on this tour that you would not have had time to on your own! The guides were super helpful and knowledgeable. Even gave us helpful shopping tips and how to navigate the subway

I would recommend taking this tour the first day you are in town so you can then make plans around areas, things that you want to see more in depth or things you did not know existed.

The bus was small in size which makes for a more intimate tour. We had 10 people, so much better than the large bus tours.

We had a fantastic day of sight seeing with Gill and Betsy. He has a seemingly endless knowledge of the city and kept us entertained the whole time! It was the perfect way to introduce the city and he helped us know where we wanted to go back and spend more time visiting as well as awesome suggestions of places to eat and what was going on in the city while we’re here. We were a few minutes late and they called to make sure we were coming so we didn’t get left behind. The bus was clean, quiet and comfortable and I’d definitely recommend this tour!

Fantastic experience! Jerry was our tour guide and was very knowledgeable in the history and architecture of NYC. This tour gives you an introduction to multiple sites, buildings and areas of Manhattan. You don’t spend a lot of time at the stops but it’s OK because there is so much you get to see and hear about. I don’t think a person could see this much on their own in the same amount of time. Ride was comfortable with a special Thanks to our driver, Tony, who provided a smooth ride and was skilled at maneuvering through traffic and tight squeezes. I would definitely recommend this tour unless you have mobility issues. Parts of it are small walking tours with changing levels and crossing streets. Also the Staten Island ferry crowd moves fast! The Staten Island ferry ride offers a beautiful view of the harbor with the Statue of Liberty, Brooklyn Bridge, Verrazano-Narrows Bridge, Governors Island and the Manhattan southern skyline in the distance. Highly recommended!!

This was my first time to New York, which inspired the guided tour. There is so much to see and where to begin? The tour definitely was one of my favorite parts of my trip simply on the amount of sites and monuments we were able to cover; with plenty of photos to take. Rachel (tour guide) and Juan (driver) were fantastic! “This is not their first rodeo!” They knew exactly what they were doing! Rachel is very knowledgeable about New York and its history. She helped to bring the city alive with good insights, suggestions, stories and background. She is very organized and structured which assisted in maximizing the tour. Juan navigated effortlessly. A helpful tip to this tour is to be ready to go on and off the bus during the tour. You will see a lot! Be ready to fall in love with New York in a fun and exciting environment.

I was pleasantly surprised at how much territory we covered in six hours. I can’t say enough about what a great guide Rachel was. She absolutely regaled our small group with history, facts and interesting stories that made New York City come alive. She was entertaining and full of energy. I loved her “how to be a New Yorker” tips and how she sprinkled “foods everyone must eat in NYC” recommendations throughout the day. She watched over our group like a mother hen and made sure we had plenty of photo ops from prime locations. I’d recommend USA Tour Guide to anyone.

I HIGHLY recommend this tour. Rachel and Anthony the driver were absolutely fantastic. They really put a lot of effort into making sure you get the best info, photos, and tips on this tour. Anthony the driver was excellent! Made driving around NYC look like a breeze. Really good about slowing down for pics at the perfect time. Love it. Rachel is the best. Thanks to her we got to know so much about this impressive city. Also the tips she will give you are PRICELESS! Book this tour on your first day or two in town and get all the goods you need to know to save time and money. I feel like a true New Yorker thanks to Rachel. Saw all the best stuff and she would help us find and take the best pics. We got so much more out of this tour than expected. The bus was warm and comfy. It also had USB charging ports which I really appreciated and they provide water as well. Also, if your prompt getting back to the bus after stops, you may get a little extra, if there's time. If you are coming to NYC, BOOK IT (early in your trip)! Worth every single penny. Request Rachel.

We had an amazing time on our tour. This is a perfect way to see all the main places. Out tour guide Mike was excellent he is very knowledgeable about NYC and surrounding areas. He made suggestions on places toneat and visit that were not part of the tour and gave advice on what to avoid so you dont get ripped off. It is very apparent that he truly loves his city. Our bus driver Betty was amazing in the way she can manuver that bus through those busy crowded streets. The only reason I gave 4 stars and not 5 is because its difficult to find the location as there is not a building with the name of the company you just have to look for the buses. If you want to see alot of NYC in a day then this tour is for you!

All parts were exceptional.Gio, our Tour Guide, and the driver, made sure every minute of the tour delighted us with historical background of buildings, and parts of the city. Gio was very accommodating, knows his stuff and came prepared. Both gentlemen exceeded our expectations. I hope that when I bring overseas guests to NY, Gio and his partner will be our guide again.

Highly recommend this tour, and and the service was second to none.

Submitted by:

The Filipinos in Denmark.

Our experience on this tour was such a miss! First our guide showed up 45 minutes late! A full busload of guests had to sit on the bus waiting for him to show up. Then when he showed up, he was terrible! He provided very little narration. And, when he did actually provide some information he did not seem to know how to use the audio system. Everyone on the bus kept telling him that we could not hear him much of the time but this did not seem to help. Often he would end sentences mid-sentence....we weren't sure if this was due to the audio system or his poor narration! At one point in the tour he started slowly reading some prepared history of NY....most of which no one could hear.

My only guess of what happened here is that the real guide got Covid and they scrambled last minute to find a replacement who was not really a guide? I don't know if that was the case, but it's the only explanation I can think of for the complete disconnect between the good reviews of this tour and our terrible experience!

We visited NY on a conference and had one day to do a tour. We had paid the extra few bucks to get an open/glass top bus since the weather was pretty nice still. We had missed the first stop and called the company to let them know and they had told us where the second stop was so we could join from there. When the bus showed, they had no room for us - not sure if they miscalculated people or what. So we were told to jump on the next bus that was available - which was not open/glass top. I had informed the sales rep who did not return my call. This was really disappointing and we should have been refunded the difference.
As for the tour - Rachel was great! She took us under her wing no problem. She was funny, knowledgeable and taught us a thing or two about getting around the city.

This tour was a wonderful experience. Our guide Steve and Driver Gustavo were excellent. Steve was able to offer great insights to the city. My son and I only had one full day in the city and wanted to get the most out of our time in New York. This was a great trip seeing all the highlights of New York. We took the open top tour, limited to 15 guests. This definitely the way to go, The trip was small, personalized and never felt rushed. When walking around New York you are constantly being offered trips to ride the big bus tours. Avoid these and take the small group tour. The big bus tour as lined up for three blocks waiting to board, and buses would pass by because they were full. Book this trip, it will get you the best one day experience in New York City.

Steve was our guide, Betty was our driver. Wonderful tour. We only had 2 days in the city and needed to see as much as possible. Was the perfect tour for it. The group was about 15 people, had an open top van (don't be mistaken, not the double decker bus, it was a van and we could see everything. Steve was very knowledgeable about the city and help us with tips and suggestions of things to see and do that were not on the trip. Great tour for wanting to see a little of everything.

Very nice tour, all that we expected. I had my daughter and granddaughter with me and wanted them to have this " overview" of the city before we dive not particular plans and visits. And it was. We only had 4 days for New York and this tour really let us see a lot of the city major attractions, too many to name all but ferry to see Statue of Liberty was there and 9/11 memorials site with a visit to Oculus. The driver was excellent, very skilled navigating the traffic. The guide, Rachel told us many stories and certainly managed numerous extras. There were unexpected obstacles during our tour which threatened to possibly cut it short but she managed it skillfully with the help of the driver and our tour was saved. We finished happily.

This was the highlight of our 5 day trip to NYC made AWESOME by our guide Buster ! It was endearing as a mom of teen daughters to see them engaged by Buster’s (guide) wealth of knowledge of all that is NYC, Broadway, acting/performers, and beyond! Buster was not only engaging, he was kind, funny, and personable.
Manny, our driver, is skilled, calm, and safe at navigating the traffic in NYC. Overall these gentleman give 1000% to making this an incredible experience! We very much appreciate them, thank you for making our trip!

Robert, our tour guide, is incredibly knowledgable and friendly.
His knowledge of New York history is second to none. Any questions where answered without any hesitation. Robert’s own experience of 9/11 was heart felt and emotional.
Our driver was fantastic, negotiating the New York traffic as quick as possible, whilst Robert provided a very informative narration.
The whole trip was well organised throughout.
I wholeheartedly recommend this tour, if you want to learn about New York in one day.

This was a do nothing tour. It drove thru the city with no major stop at any landmark. The tour spent more time at a restroom stop than anything else. There was no stop at Wall Street or Lincoln Center. The stop at the 911 Memorial & Museum was 10 minutes. The stop at Central Park was only at the spot of "Imagine" at Strawberry Fields. If you enjoy riding on a bus where the tour guide points out all the buildings, this is the one for you. Otherwise, you are better off doing the hop on/hop off or walk around the City on your own.

Amazing day to experience so many highlights of the Big Apple. Very much enjoyed the large number of stops, which really feels like we ticked off some important highlights and got a real favour of the city. Very much enjoyed and recommended!

Excellent 6 hour open top bus tour with Rhonda as our guide & Miguel as our driver both did an excellent job. Visited all the major sights some which you got off to take a look or drove past all explained by a very relaxed & personable Rhonda, we then visited at our own leisure later in the week. Lunch stop and toilet breaks on the way, with the Staten Island ferry finishing of the day which goes passed the Statue of Liberty but doesn’t stop at, which can be done as a separate tour. Plenty of water on board and we were glad we did the open top tour as you get a great feel & view of the city. We would definitely recommend.

The best part of this tour was the tour guide Martin! He was absolutely amazing. Martin was very knowledgeable and kept us moving quickly as there was a lot to cover. He even recommended my friend and I some cool places to go after the tour. Also, we had the opportunity to meet his lovely wife who he spoke highly of at the end of the tour and I wish them all the happiness and success they deserve! The bus itself was a bit disappointing. It seemed pretty old and dusty. Riding the ferry was fabulous and was an amazing experience for me. Bus upgrades would make this experience that much better but overall I’d recommend it.

I am local, living in CT. A good friend who lives out of town invited me to join her and her boyfriend for a day tour. I have been going to NYC since I was a teenager, and am very familiar with it, but this tour was fun and informative. I learned a lot about NYC and visited places that I had never had the occasion to go. Our tour guide Dana was wonderful, funny and very patient with a passenger who was in a wheelchair. There is a lot of getting on and off the bus, so it was challenging for the family with the member in a wheelchair, but I think it was a great experience for all.
If you are thinking of taking this tour I would do it at the beginning of your stay. Our tour guide gave highlights of the many places we passed and the few we stopped at, but she also recommended going back to certain places if you have a greater interest. If you take the tour at the beginning of your stay, you might have time to go back to some of these places.

Rachel was THE BEST!!!! She was very knowledgeable everything about New York, knew exactly at what point and where it would be the best place to take pictures. Special parade was scheduled so roads were blocked off and Rachel knew exactly how to go around it. Definitely loved the entire tour with Rachel, she was absolutely perfect!!!! Made the experience extra special and memorable, my kids are ranged from 8-14 and they all said Rachel was awesome!

This is a very easy way to see most of the big attractions and get a summary of the city. Do this at the beginning of your trip! That way you can get ideas and recommendations. Our guide, Gil, was great. He’s super knowledgeable and leads really well. And shout out to Betty our bus driver! Our stops are fast pace, so If you have mobility issues you might have to just stay behind on the bus while everyone gets off. Definitely recommend this tour!

Rachel was awesome- she has a friendly manner and enjoyed sharing her wealth of knowledge. She was very organized -she had a system which very efficiently maximized quality time spent at the various sites. She was very helpful (especially with photo taking). Overall, a very enjoyable experience and highly recommended!

We loved our tour with our guide Jim and our driver Manny. The tour took us to many of the places we had already decided we wanted to see. Jim kept the tour lively and interesting. The only downside was that because it was cold, we ate lunch at the Staten Island ferry terminal instead of the more outdoor dining area market. There was little to no seating there and no dining area available to us, and we were constantly panhandled while eating. Other than that, it was one of the best tours I’ve taken.

This tour description is misleading & incorrect. There is no luxury boat tour with views of the Statue of Liberty, Ellis island & Brooklyn bridge, which I frlt was an important selling point.There is a Staten island ferry trip but that’s already free to all. 100 dollars for this bus tour—-very expensive poor value & a misrepresentation of what you get. I wouldn’t advise any family or tourist to take it.

Tim was our tour guide. We had a great time. The best part of the trip was riding the ferry. Tim was very knowledgeable about the history and architecture of the city. I really liked that he kept track of all 33 people no matter where we went. I felt safe that he wasn’t going to leave anyone behind. Definitely worth the money but it was pretty camped on the bus. I would spring a some extra bucks for the open top bus. That’s the only reason I took off a star.

We had a great time. Steve was our tour guide. He worked hard to keep us all together. He also has a great deal of knowledge about the city as a life long resident. We enjoyed his personality and experience. We were greater immediately upon arrival. Water was available throughout the day and we rode on an air conditioned bus. We covered a lot of the city and learned so much. Highly recommend.

Good way to see a large part of NYC in one day. Highly advise the glass/open top bus (closed when cool or raining but open when nice) so you can see the tops of the buildings the guide is talking about. Brooklyn Jim was our guide and added some authentic NYC attitude and accent to the trip. Note that this is mostly a driving tour, but there are a few stops where you can get out and take pictures. He also provided tips and tricks for being in NYC in addition to pointing out all of the landmarks. And Betty was a great driver. No issues, great experience!

Our guide,Tyler, was incredibly knowledgeable about the sites, the history of NYC and lots of trivia about this great city all along the way. Her passion and pride for the subject matter was so apparent. We have been on other bus tours in other busy locations and Sam navigated the streets beautifully. Great teamwork = great experience!

Our family enjoyed the Staten Island Ferry around the Statue of Liberty the most. Other highlights were China Town, Central Park, and driving around famous landmarks. The stop at the 911 Memorial and the reflection pools were lovely and especially meaningful. Rachel, our tour guide, was exceptionally knowledgeable about the city's history, architecture, landmarks, and cultures. She gave us many tips to get the most out of our trip. We enjoyed her tremendously.

Rachel was a great tour guide! Very informative and personable. She knows the city extremely well and shared a lot of useful tips about navigating the city, as well the usual historical and pop culture tidbits. Kudos to the driver, Christian, as well! Highly recommend!

Planned my visit to NYC for 3 days and booked this tour for my 2nd day.

Basically the tour was perfect.

The company was organized and the buses were comfortable. They have already pre-assigned us to buses prior the start of the trip, ensuring that we go in small groups.

Our tour guide, Steve/Steven was really nice, perky and entertaining. He made jokes and was knowledgeable with the area. He even took pictures for us. And one good part is that he was particularly looking after the solo travelers, so we don't get lost.

It was a quick tour as we are trying to squeeze the whole NY in 6hrs. But he gives very good detailed information on how to visit the city on our own. He explains how to best go about an area and noting points of interest if we will further roam around later on.

Additional information:
Drinking water is provided.
Don't be shy to inform the tour guide if you need to go to the washroom.
The stop for the lunch break is in an area with varioous choices.

It was a fun and entertaining tour. More than enough for a short visitor like me.

Your was excellent, but think the Staten Island Ferry was the best. So neat to see the Statue of Liberty up close, the NY skyline. Our tour guide, Brooklyn Jim was very knowledgeable & personable. Our driver, Ray, navigated the city traffic very well, & made it look easy! We were able to see everything we wanted to see in one day & the tour price was very reasonable. No way we could have done all this on our own.

Had a great tour with our guide Gil. Even my teenagers had a great time and learned a good amount from our tour. Not only was our tour fantastic and informative, Gil gave us some great pointers while in NY. Tour bus was nice and clean (not your open air buses you see all over NY) Would highly recommend this tour

Amazing tour of NYC. Our guide Mike, a native New Yorker, was fabulous. He shared his love of NYC with us. He shared so much from the iconic sites to recommended places to eat to avoid being scammed. Our driver Betty maneuvered the streets like an expert.

Tour included stops at Strawberry Fields in Central Park, Staten Island Ferry, Rockefeller Center and 9/11 Memorial. Mike was so knowledgeable and provided insight to so much of NYC.

The bus was comfortable and had a huge video monitor at the front that had a feed from a camera mounted on the roof. We were able to see exactly what the driver saw.

Highly recommend.

This was, by far, the highlight of our trip to New York City! We selected the glass top bus--which I would strongly recommend as you have a smaller group and a sensational view everywhere you go. Brooklyn Jim and driver Juan made the whole day amazing! We learned so much about everything from a guide with roots in this great city. You could tell he absolutely loves this place! I feel almost like a native now. He even took us to the original Joe’s Pizza in the Village (seriously the best!). We really couldn’t have asked for more. Brooklyn Jim for the win! Thank you for a great day!

The One Day Guided Sightseeing Tour of New York was an amazing experience. I highly recommend taking this tour if you ever plan to come to NYC. After you get on the tour bus the tour bus driver drives all over the city while the tour guide points out and talks about all the popular spots throughout the city. They even make stops at some of these areas including Central Park, Rockefeller Center, and the 9/11 Memorial. Plus you'll get to take a boat ride on the Staten Island Ferry and get awesome views of the city as well as go past the Statue of Liberty. You'll get to take plenty of pictures and videos while taking this tour. Our tour guide Gil and our bus driver Raymond did an excellent job of giving us the best tour possible. Definitely highly recommended!

We had a great time and learned so much about the city. Our tour guide was absolutely amazing and had so much knowledge. Definitely a great way to hit all the top spots of the city in one day. At the end of our tour, our guide gave us tips on how to understand the city and the grid system, which helped us better navigate the subway system.

The BEST tour to learn about NYC and see all the Sites in one day! I travelled with two teenage boys and they loved it!! Tyler , our guide , was so friendly and knowledgeable and fun! She made sure everyone on the tour was well taken care of and even helped us to take perfect pictures! She really made the tour perfect! I highly recommend this tour to any one especially if you have limited time in the city. The tour helped us to learn our way around the city for the next few days and what locations to spend more time afterwards. Pick up and drop off was easy and convenient. Our driver was also very kind.

Our guide, Mike, was an excellent source of information! Mike was well informed with many aspects of the New York City area. We were very impressed with his knowledge and his ability to share his own personal experiences to enhance our tour.

Our driver, Betty was ready with fresh, cold water bottles at each stop and we felt safe with her driving abilities.

Due to Covid , we were required to wear a face mask while on the bus, understandably.

Over all, we are very pleased taking the New York in One Day Guided Sightseeing Tour. The value of the cost was well worth the cost!

This trip does a great job of visiting the highlights of the city. Our tour guide Sean was very knowledgeable & provided excellent backgrounds on the various places. It is about six hours long, so plan on on being done about 3-4 PM.

Planned this tour when my brother and his wife visited NY for 1st time It was perfect introduction to the city, the highlights over Manhattan. I enjoyed it myself even after several visits to NY I learned a lot The guide "J" Alan was fantastic, extremely knowledgeable had so many anecdotes I recommend the tour despite the price. I had a very bad experience with the Hop on Hop off bus tour in the past so this was perfect

We enjoyed our bus tour, but we were VERY disappointed that there was no boat ride, as advertised. I see now on this site that it's listed as only April-Dec 31, but we do not remember that from when we booked via CheapTickets.com. The view of the Statue of Liberty from the shore (on non-boat months) is very disappointing. I feel like we did not get what we paid for.

That being said, our guide, Rachel, was nice. Very scripted, not a lot of time to ask questions but she gave LOTS of info. This would be a great starter tour for those who are staying the city for 1-2 weeks and don't have any idea where they want to visit. It's not a lot of time to explore anything, most stops were just 15 minutes. But we got pictures of some cool landmarks.
