We had the best time on this tour. Steve our tour guide was so knowledgeable about the city and had great tips on getting around in the city. We are glad that we did the first day we where in town. It helped us navigate the city better and things we wanted to see more of. Manny our driver was great by dropping us off and picking us up quickly with little to no wait time. A must do tour.

This tour was the best part of our NYC trip. I took my 5 year old and my parents. We were all able to enjoy parts of it. We covered A LOT of ground with minimal walking (a plus for my elderly parents). Mike, our tour guide was full of knowledge and gave us history on every part of the tour. As a New Yorker himself, you could see and feel his passion for his beloved city. This was my 3rd time in NYC and with this tour, I was able to see parts of the city I had not seen before. It is 6 hours long and well worth the price. Raymond, our driver, was also excellent in getting us safely through the city. There was not one part of this tour that we did not enjoy. Mike and Raymond had complimentary water on board for us. **Note, there is a sign on the bus that says "NO FOOD OR DRINK** Please respect that and take only the water that is provided.

A-MAZ-ING! Worth every single penny. A brilliant and entertaining way to see a lot of the must do NYC sites. Our tour guide, Rachel, was brilliant, engaging, funny and extremely knowledgeable, by the end of the trip turning us all into New Yorkers! Loved it!

"Hey! I'm walking here!"

Amazing!!! Our guide Was so knowledgeable and made such a large city become manageable to understand. Truly one of the best times that I’ve ever visited New York city. Highly recommend this tour. We did so many different things and traveled all over the city. It was a pleasure to relax and let the driver take us places and not have to worry about parking the vehicle.

We absolutely loved our tour with Rachel and driver Roy! So informative, lots of helpful hints for our stay, a fantastic taste of the major tourist attractions in NYC. Roy was a skilled and patient driver. Rachel was fun and shared lots of personal anecdotes. I would not recommend this for young (ages 2-5) families however - it’s 6 hours with 2 scheduled potty breaks.

Very comfortable and luxurious bus taking us expertly from sight to sight with stops at Central Park, 9/11 Memorial and 55 Fulton Market for lunch. Due to traffic on the day of our tour we weren’t able to stop at the Rockefeller Center; but did drive by and that was more than suitable.
This tour allowed us to briefly sample a number of key sights all in one day and was a great starting point for our trip to New York so then we knew what other sights we wanted to see on our own.
We enjoyed the Hornblower boat cruise with breathtaking views of the New York skyline and seeing the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island from the water, although no reserved seating for the tour group – need to join the line along with everyone else and then hope you get a good spot on the boat.
I would recommend this tour as you cover more ground than you possibly could on your own and ticks some sights of your Must Do list in the comfort of a luxury air conditioned bus.

Great way to see NYC in a day. Saw most of the major sites and learned about the history of the city, and its architecture and neighborhoods, from Martin, our dynamic guide who’s lived in the city all his life. Gary was an excellent driver. We loved the tour. Highly recommended.

Great way to see the city in a day. Dana and Raymond were excellent guide and driver. Dana was particularly good…she loves New York which was obvious from her narration and energy. It was a hot day and the a/c of the bus did not work well, besides this was a great day out. Fully recommend and great value!

This was a wonderful way to hit the highlights of New York in one day. Our tour guide, Tyler, was very knowledgeable, personable and entertaining. She had a lot of information that made the tour very interesting. The tour was in a small bus with about 16 passengers and was partially open air which made photos easy to do. We were only in New York for one day and this tour allowed us to see everything we wanted to see without a great deal of walking.

Steve our guide and Walter our driver navigated us expertly through the city. Steve was extremely knowledgeable and well informed and gave us a great overview of the city and its highlights. A great way to see the sights even with young children and teens. We had a great day!

If u are looking for a guided tour of New York City highlights this is the one u need. We thoroughly enjoyed our tour 8/27 with Steve. He’s knowledgeable and personable. This was a small group and he would stop and show us the best of nyc including our ride on the Staten island ferry. This was our first visit but hopefully not our last. We met our wonderful guide and driver a couple blocks from our hotel and our tour was from 10am to about 3pm. If u want a truly guided tour of t nyc this is the one u need and Steve for your guide.

What a blessing to schedule this and get a great guide and driver! Second mile members 'Brooklyn Jim and Driver Roy" were great guides/drivers for our group. We enjoyed the dynamics of a smaller group as each stop provided another opportunity to get to know our neighbors and new friends. We had some small children on our bus and by the end, we were all watching to make certain the children were taken care of. Absolutely one should schedule this first which highlights the main attractions of the city. Loved listening to our great guide, "Brooklyn Jim" give tidbits of history and meaning to the city and where to go for great margaritas! I would give the duo a 10 star rating if there was one and a high five for the comfort of the bus and it's amenities! Cold water and air conditioning was a joy when getting back on the bus after seeing the stop.

Gil our tour guide was excellent. He was very informative and pleasant. Even gave us tips on how to get around on our own in New York. I would definitely recommend doing a guided tour before exploring on your own. You get a nice taste of the city enough to help you feel comfortable and ready to venture out on different sites on your own. Manuel the driver was great smooth ride the whole tour. Thanks so much will do again!

This is the best tour if you want to see the most popular places. I recommend taking this tour first, then deciding afterwards where you might want to go back for a better experience. Our tour guide Brenden was very good and we felt safe with Jose behind the wheel. The buses are fairly new and very comfortable with A/C. Beware though, you do get out to walk at some of the stops so if walking is out of the question don’t take this tour. I think we walked a total of 3+ miles with about 6 stops. I really enjoyed the staten island ferry portion.

Rachel is an absolute boss. She was our tour guide and she’s like a walking history book on NYC. You’ll learn SO much from her, and you’ll hit all the highlights of Manhattan in 6 fulfilling hours, taking time to get out and appreciate the best spots (like the 9/11 memorial). You’ll also learn practical tips for her on how to get around in New York, where to eat, how to negotiate with people, what to buy (and not buy), and who NOT to give your money to. Take a tour on your first or second day in New York so you can apply her tips throughout the rest of your visit. Her and driver Manny run a tight ship and managed to offer us a ton of experiences in a short time while still being cognizant of the fact that some of our group had to catch an evening flight back home. The tour was worth EVERY cent - book it. And hope you get Rachel as your guide.

Even dealing with persistently damp and drizzly weather this tour was very good. Our Guide, Jim from Brooklyn, was excellent. His native NY accent and manner were projected in a very enjoyable manner. He was both very knowledgeable and entertaining. Well organized.

This was a great introduction to NY for first timers like us. Our commentator, Jerry was informative, entertaining and organized. He ensured everyone understood the guidelines for the tour and how things would work at each stop. He gave advanced information on sites before we got to them. He kept count of all 30 people which wasn’t easy. He suggest the Squires Diner for lunch which was perfect - good service, food and price ( I had the Cobb salad my husband had the eggs Benedict with salmon). We saw so many great sites and Jerry gave us good information on how Manhattan functions- on money so use cash when you can and set the price prior.

Our tour guide was knowledgeable and pleasant and made sure all passengers were present after each stop. (He told us his name , but I didn’t hear it clearly. I should have asked him to repeat it). Cold bottles of water were provided FOC which was wonderful since the temperature was in the 90’s that day. The driver was excellent. The seats were comfortable and clean. There was much more walking than I expected. Walked down into into Central Park and back up a hill. Walked around Rockefeller Center, and the walk to and from the Stanton Island Ferries were much longer than I expected. I almost skipped the walk to the Ground Zero Memorial Park but knew I would be mad at myself if I did. For anyone who has trouble walking this much, it might not be the tour for you, but if you planned to see these sites on your own, there would probably be far more walking than was required on this tour, so there you go. We were given 40 minutes for lunch in an area that has several options, and we had plenty of time to eat, order, and use the restroom before reboarding the bus. We were required to wear face masks on the bus, but we could take them off during the stops. The bus was comfortably air-conditioned. I am glad we booked this tour.

Better seating needed. The seats in the back are unpadded and kid sized. The seatbelt clips dig into your butt. The seats over the wheel wells force your knees up. If you are 6ft or taller you will be cramped in any seat. If you are overweight, forget it. The ride is very rough. Not pleasant at all. Getting on and off the shuttle is a chore since everything is so cramped, and you have to get off many times.

This tour was exactly what I was hoping for - an overview of all the city highlights! It helped to see how the city is laid out and to make a list of places to visit or spend more time. Gil was our guide and he was amazing! He was incredibly knowledgeable about everything in the city and he did a fantastic job of herding us and keeping us on schedule. He is also a wonderful photographer!! Thanks Gil, from Kentucky & Spain 😉

Rachel was the best! Her energy and enthusiasm really kept us engaged. She went so far above and beyond. We learned history, saw famous movie spots, and learned about architecture while getting around the city to all the top sights. The driver was amazing, very smooth ride! Most of all, it was fun! I have been to NY many times, but this was the first time taking a tour. I was shocked at how much there is to see and learn about this magnificent city. I highly recommend this company and trying to book with Rachel!

I read a lot of reviews before selecting this tour for my family & it did not disappoint. Our witty, extremely knowledgeable guide was Rachel. She was well organized, offered tips/tricks to successfully navigate the city, and really seemed to enjoy her role! The bus was well maintained & comfortable. If you want to see the most popular sights while learning the history of NYC, this is the tour for you.

We had a tour booked with USA Guided Tours and we didn’t know what to expect as you hear many stories of lack of knowledge, to many stops, not enough time and no personality of the tour guide. We were so pleased and had a fabulous time with our tour guide Gil who was without a shadow of a doubt the best tour guide we have ever had on any tour. He was knowledgeable, keen to take questions, very humorous and generous. We were guided on a fabulous journey in extreme comfort on board a private bus, Gil was engaging from the off. He took us to all the places we were eager to see and gave us all the information we could ever have needed. When we were on the way to that Statue of Liberty 🗽 Gil offered to take pictures of all the people on the tour and again this was done at the John Lennon Memorial in Central Park. We also stopped for lunch in Little Italy 🇮🇹 (followed by Dunkin Donuts 🍩) again Gil knew all the places to get a bite to eat, we didn’t feel rushed through lunch which was again brilliant. If you are interested in doing a tour of NYC in a day then I would without a shadow of doubt recommend booking through this tour operator and hopefully you will get Gil as your guide, you won’t be disappointed in any way.

Worth every penny!! A must for first time visiting. Steve was very knowledgeable and was the real deal New Yorker!! Our driver Juan did an excellent job of driving and navigating our drop offs and pick ups.
Steve guided us all the way through, very attentive to us “the customers” answered all questions and needs!!
Loved it!! Takes all the hassle of figuring out where to go and how to get there!!

We had a fabulous time touring Manhattan. Our guide,Tyler, was a wealth of information. She told stories and gave wonderful descriptions of what we were seeing. We hit all the highlights and showed how accessible the city is. Highly recommend

Great one day tour! Rachel our guide turned us into a little army and was able to help us navigate the crowds so we were able to see everything in a short period of time. And not only was she knowledgeable about the sights but was a fount of knowledge about NYC and its culture and atmosphere. Just the right about of time in each stop, too. We thoroughly enjoyed this tour!

The day started off bad with me falling on Broadway and messing up my leg. A man ran down to where the bus was and they waited for us to get there. They let me sit in the front with the guide. They were wonderful to me! Our guide was Rhonda,(aka, Mary Poppins) the absolute best!
We were there during the United Nations meetings so the streets were filled with security and diplomats. At one point we were actually at a standstill in traffic as Homeland Security was trying to get to city hall. This is by far the best tour we have ever had and I highly recommend them!

This was our first day in New York and we thoroughly enjoyed this tour. Rachel was extremely knowledgeable and informative which gave us a really good grounding on what and where we wanted to go and see. I would highly recommend this tour and especially Rachel who was fantastic

We were in NYC for a short time and I wanted to cram as much as I could into a single day. This fit the bill perfectly. There were a couple of hiccups, but this was an enjoyable tour.

The good
We saw most of the major attractions in a six hour time frame. That is probably the limit for a sight-seeing tour before you start getting restless. I also enjoyed the Staten Island Ferry experience and almost felt like a local at times.

The bad
The main issue here was with others on the tour, so I won't ding the guide for this. On multiple stops, some were wandering a little far. This was really problematic when you get to the Staten Island Ferry terminal. We almost missed our ferry, which would have caused a 30 minute delay in the tour because of wanderers. We had to cut our Ground Zero stop a little short, which annoyed me. We also came on the day of a protest, so we weren't able to make a restroom stop at Rockefeller Plaza. This threw off the timing of the driver who wasn't expecting to pick us up so quickly. The guide was great at improvising, so it wasn't a big deal.

Masks: I'm not going to offer opinions one way or the other, but I will say, I didn't run into any issues with mask wearing. Do what makes you comfortable. Even in the terminals, there were many unmasked individuals.

Overall, this is a great stop if you're in NYC for a short time. You will also get some great food recommendations from the guide.

Ray our driver and Martin our tour guide was just awesome. Saw so much in 6 hours. Martin made this fun and entertaining as he told us of all these fun facts he shared about the city. Took my 2 daughters and their boyfriends who never saw NYC and they couldn’t say how much fun they had. I truly say you will not regret taking this tour.

Great tour with Nathan and Jimmy. Nathan is extremely knowledgeable and well spoken. We didn’t have to wait for Jimmy at all, the bus was always where it should be when it should be there.

We saw everything that we wanted to see and were able to decide the places that we would return to the next day. If you only have a couple of days in NYC I highly recommend this tour on day one.

Definitely the best way to see NYC! I don’t believe we missed a thing. I loved that each stop included a short walking tour WITH our guide. Riding the ferry and seeing the Statue of Liberty was just the “icing on the cake!” I would recommend taking this tour and look forward to taking the NYC at Night Tour next time we visit! Good value and great tour!!

My sister and I only had one day in NYC and I’m so glad we booked this tour. Rachel our guide and Carlos the driver were both fantastic. She is very knowledgeable and passionate about all things NYC and made sure we had our pictures taken at all the right spots and is very organized. It included a quick lunch break and ride on the Staten Island Ferry for great view of the city. I have already recommend this tour to several friends! Great value for the price!

Rachel our guide, was very professional and fun. The day went quickly and we saw or had pointed out to us all the main highlights of NY. Rachel was a font of knowledge imparting stories of the history of different sites and buildings.
The only disappointment seemed to be the lack of a trip to see Lady Liberty up close as it couldn’t be worked into our schedule which was unfortunate as I’ve read on here a review that another tour on the same day did have the boat tour.
Rachel thank you, you were brilliant and your sidekick, the driver Anthony, was very good getting to stop where we needed to which in NY is a little tricky!

Excellent tour with Rachel who is so vibrant and knowledgeable. She explains the history and street layouts which are musts to get you started. She directs her group with vigour and loads of humour. She takes the time to have prepared information sheets on all aspects of New York from food to buying. We were 30mins late starting as the a transportation board were inspecting buses. That said she changed the route, got us across to Staten Island on time and even managed to get us in the return boat. Who knew that Eiffel built the main structure for the Statue of Liberty and it’s original purpose was not to symbolise immigration. Rachel was full of detail and also respect in giving information about 9/11. The memorial experience was definitely a must. The trip gave us a complete view of New York and allowed us to then spend more time at key sites. Thanks Rachel.

I have to say this was way more than I thought it was. This tour is jam packed with info and sites of the great city of NY. Gil our guide and Jonny our Driver were fantastic!

We went all over the city and saw so many things from historical sites, cool buildings and so much more. They even fit in a ride on the ferry to Staten island.

Few tips, wear comfy shoes as there is a bit of walking at some of the stops. For lunch you don't have much time so try to get something quick.

All in all, wife and I love it and it was well worth the money!

We only had 3 days in NYC and this was a great way to see the main sights of the city in just 6 hours. However, we did not feel rushed and you were given time to explore and take photos.
Our tour guide Gil and driver Roy, were brilliant. They told us wonderful facts that we would not have heard if we hadn't have been on the tour.
Water was provided throughout and we stopped for lunch in a location where there were a variety of restaurants.
I would definitely recommend to anyone heading to NYC.
Just bear in mind if you are travelling around this time of year, you don't go to see the statue of liberty, but you are taken other places in lieu. However, you can still go if you book it yourself from some of the tour operators in NYC so don't feel like you missing out!

Our guide was Brooklyn Jim. He was incredible! He was able to weave stories and history seamlessly together. Our driver was top notch and made getting around the city look easy but it was anything but easy. We had one day in the city and wanted to cover as much ground as we could and this tour completely met our expectations!

Tour guide Tim was great, New York owes this guy a great deal of gratitude to hold such great knowledge of the city’s rich history to share. We saw pretty much all the iconic buildings and sights we wanted to see for a good moment or at a glance. I recommend this tour if your in the city for a short time. We tried to do it on our own on our first day and we spent more than we would like w/ Uber, lyft, cab etc. You will save money and enjoy your day with this guided tour. Thanks Tim keep up the good work!

Our guide, Brendan, was super knowledgeable of the history of New York and many very interesting details and trivia. He made it a special experience for us, answered questions, and was proactive in planning stops for bathrooms and lunch break. He was a really amazing guide. We enjoyed this tour thoroughly.

Jerry was very informative, learned a lot of good information, Roy (driver) didn’t speak. only thing i would change, is where they stopped to let us eat and bathroom stop, it was nasty ( dead rats laying on the sidewalk) no where to eat or sit. Then we drive to Stanton Ferry Station, it was clean with lots of food choices, clean bathrooms. This would have been a better choice to eat. But it was a good ride.

What an amazing experience! My sisters and I enjoyed our tour with our guide, Rachel. We hopped on and off the bus all over NYC and was wowed by the views and the history. We saw parks, statues, and artists in various places. I fully recommend this tour- we had a blast. - by traveler Yvonne

Gil and Anthony were excellent. Gil is the perfect tour guide. He kept us engaged and provided pertinent information about NY, Manhattan, NJ, and Brooklyn. Anthony was great he provided a safe tour driving experience. He also kept cold drinks for us. Thank you! Lasica and Toya from KY

We had a wonderful time on our tour of NYC! Tony was a fantastic driver and got us everywhere we needed safely and on time. Mike was so knowledgeable and you could tell how much he loves his city. It was definitely a great intro to the city to help you decide what you would like to further explore. Definitely recommend for first timers to the City!

Juan was our bus driver and did a great job. Rachel was the guide and did an outstanding job! She knows her history inside and out and kept the entire trip interesting. She was well organized and helped us get some great pictures! She knew just the angles and times to get the pictures that would be better than others. She did not allow individuals in the group to distract her from giving a great tour to everyone else! Kudos to you, Rachel!

My wife and I had never been to New York and really enjoyed this tour. We are 57 and 61 but could definitely handle the walking and standing. If you have trouble navigating stairs or walking for longer distances (we probably had 8,000 steps??), this might not be for you.

Our kids, who live close, thought that they should now take the tour! You will learn a lot if you want to!

Highly recommend. Great packed day. Nice mix between riding on bus and getting out to walk. We did everything on the list as stated, and we had a perfect day!

Tim was our guide, and he was awesome. Authentic NY accent, very knowledgeable, could tell he enjoyed doing this, funny and down to earth. For a 6-hour tour you need someone with the right personality. We actually passed two other tour guides from other companies, and I listened in thinking - SO happy we have Tim. They were informative but did not have Tim’s personality and no accent. How can you give a NY tour without the accent - "forget about it" hahaha

Dana was the best tour guide and Raymond truly was a magician with his bus driving skills! We had the most wonderful time!!! We are a family of 5 with three teenagers and we all enjoyed our tour. We never could have seen all we did on our own. Dana is someone I could listen to all day! She was so knowledgeable and gave great advice for first time visitors to New York. Raymond was an excellent driver! Both were so friendly. Highly recommend!!

Rachel was a great guide and really knowledgable on New York and gave us tonnes of information throughout the day - it is well worth the money and a great intro to New York. And it enabled us to go back and visit any areas we particularly liked later in the week. And most memorable part of the day was the catchphrase “Hey I’m walking here!”

This was a great experience for us. Even our two teenagers loved it - something for everyone. We got to see so much of the city and it helped take away our reservations about traveling around by ourselves. We even braved the subway after our guide calmed our fears and gave us tips. Great experience - would highly recommend it.

Tim is the man. Thank you so much, brother! We have not stopped talking about how great it was to tour with a local who loves his city so much. And Manny the driver took care of an AC issue quickly. Just perfect all around.

Walter our guide was excellent on the tour, told us lots of interesting stories about the places we stopped at. It’s a great tour to see the landmarks of New York.
There were a couple of things,
We had trouble finding the tour bus, which was a mini bus which was very cramped, also watch out for the scam blokes selling hop on hop off buses, he scammed me out of £180.00 telling me I need a bus to take me to the places on the tour.
Going to try claiming the money back though my credit card insurance.

This was my second tour with USA guided tours, but my first one in NYC. It was amazing from start to finish! Steve was so informative and funny throughout the whole trip and took good care of us. Gustavo was a great driver. Tons of traffic on Saturday morning/early afternoon but he was so good at handling the busy streets. Cant wait until my. Next Usa Guided tour, can’t recommend these enough!

OMG!!! Tho tour was so amazing! Our tour Guide Steve and driver Johnny were so great! Steve was so nice and VERY knowledgeable about New York since he is a true New Yorker. Johnny was great with maneuvering around heavy traffic. This was just 1 of the best tours I’ve been on I will come to New York again and I going to do this tour again and will need Steve and Johnny again they are the best duo. Oh and I love the smaller bus better it much more intimate and personable. Best Day Ever for my birthday weekend. Thanks Steve and Johnny! Much love the 3 Texas Women

Great tour of NYC via bus and ferry. Definitely made the right decision to take the closed bus with air conditioning on a hot July day. Wear comfortable shoes for walking as you hop off the bus for some of the stops. Our guide Don was very knowledgeable about the city and added to the tour with his personal experience. I cannot leave out the driver, Byron as he navigated thru the busy traffic with ease to keep us on schedule.

Mike our tour guide was informative and interesting to listen to. He gave good recommendations on what to do after our tour and places to see. He even helpd give specifics on what subway exits to take on our own later. He asked to take photos of our group etc. He was sure to make sure we were all safe (bike lanes, crossing traffic etc).

On the whole we enjoyed the tour. The bus was beautiful and clean and our guide, Gil, was very knowledgeable and was happy to take photos of people in our party.
However, we were all rushed a lot and it felt like we were being herded from one place to another with no time to enjoy what we were supposed to be looking at.
Also, when we booked this tour last year it was supposed to include a ride on their luxury boat over to Staten Island. What we got was a ride on the Staten Island Ferry. They have now updated their site to say you will be going on the Ferry but we were not expecting that. So, we missed out on a lot of sites. The Statue of Liberty was way way out in the distance. Not sure where our guide was but for us it was just a ride on the ferry, no information about what was onshore way off in the distance. Our group had to run to catch the ferry but we missed it and had to wait another 30 minutes or more for the next one. Our tour actually lasted 7 hours because of this.
All in all though, worth the $99.

We’ve been on tours many places in the world and this tour was one of the best ever. Rachael, our guide, was amazing. Her knowledge and organization were far beyond expectations. She entertained and educated us all on the history as well as insights into how to be New Yorkers.
Really enjoyed this overview of the city. We never could have seen so much in 1 day. I feel like it helped us focus on areas we wanted to see more. Ferry ride was highlight.

Our guide Rachel was amazing, very kind and accommodating. She took pictures for us throughout which was a nice bonus. And she really got to know everyone too. She clearly loves her job and it shows!
I would recommend everyone bring snacks as sometimes the lunch can be a little late. Also didn’t mind but the Staten Island thing was the least favorite part- no reason to go over there? Thanks!

We have been to NY many times and decided to take a guided bus tour this time. It was a very informative and enjoyable experience. Our tour guide, Tyler, was exceptional. She had an outstanding personality, very knowledgeable about NY, kept everybody engaged and her delivery was top notch. We had several stops and she got off the bus and guided us on each one, answering all questions. There was just enough time to take in the site, but didn’t feel rushed. It was one of the best tours we have ever taken.

An excellent tour to see all the sites in New York and get an introduction to the city. We had Nathan as our guide who was informative and provided a good idea of the overall city. He also provided information regarding some of the hidden gems in the city. Overall great way to see New York if you are there for short stay. Once you get an idea of all the sites you can re-visit at your convenience.

Took the guided one day tour of New York with tour guide Tim and driver Tony. The bus was comfortable and clean with bottled water for the guest. Group was small and managed well by the driver and tour guide. They work together to give you a great overview of the city as well as provide excellent recommendations outside the tour to visit on your own. Would recommend any first timer to New York City take this Manhattan tour the first possible day you can!

I enjoyed this tour very much! Rachel was great. She had so much knowledge and made an effort to speak to everyone on the tour. She took the time to make sure we got good pictures and she was always checking to make sure no one was left behind. As a solo traveler, this meant so much to me. She actually asked at one point "where is my solo traveler?" which made me feel safe and secure! The tour itself was awesome. I spent 2 days in NYC and this allowed me to see all the major signs in such a limited amount of time. Rachel gave tidbits on each location that you just can't get if you were to do it on your own. I would definitely recommend this tour for a first-time visit to NYC!

We took the tour with Nathan and it was very informative and great. He was kind to our elderly mother and made sure to take his time to help us on and off the bus.

The reason I am giving this company a 2 star is because of the blatantly profiling done by another tour guide at the pick up location. My family and I overheard a bigger man who I believe was a tour guide say “if I get this family we’re definitely not making tips tonight” this was beyond shocking to me which is why I asked to go with the other tour guide.

This man should be a shame of himself and the company shouldn’t allow racist and profiling remarks. We were on vacation for the holiday from India and it was not a welcome we expected.

Amazing! We had the best day on this tour. Steve & Betty were just fabulous. Steve was so informative, and Betty the driver was friendly, drove sensibly and got us where we needed to be efficiently even though a large area was closed due to the Pride march. I would definitely recommend the tour to anyone who’s looking. We were in a small group of 13 in an open top bus, comfortable seats, cold bottled water available. Betty parked where she could in the shade to avoid the seats getting too hot whilst we were sightseeing. Due to the pride march we couldn’t go to madison square gardens but we went to Grand central instead, which was great!

We really did have a great day exploring! We were torn between this tour and a hop on hop off bus, the tour was far better!

I have been to NYC many times and left this tour with a whole new appreciation of the city. Tyler was our guide and could not have been any better! You could tell she loves the city and presented each area with enthusiasm. She was beyond patient and courteous to everyone on the tour and even took the time to pleasantly interact with passers by to ensure we weren’t disrupting them as well. She was fun, entertaining and sooo knowledgeable! She seemed to know everyone in the city also.. shop owners, food cart vendors , etc. We encountered a long line at a market we were all grabbing lunch in that threatened our return on time.. she was able to speak to management and they opened a lane just for our group! So professional.. a true asset to this company!

Excellent tour guide! Excellent tour of key points to see in New York City. Provided time to see sites in addition to guide providing information. Her love of New York and information regarding the city was very informative. Learned a lot.

We went on this on our first full day in NYC as a family of five with teens and a pre teen.
Tim and Roy were excellent, we saw EVERYTHING got the best photo ops and had the best food from Fulton Market on way round.
Really helped us get our bearings and decide what we wanted to see more of.
The narrative was amusing and kept us entertained for the whole trip.
Great fun.
If you are looking to see a lot of New York City highlights in one entertaining day, this is a great tour. Gil was a great tour guide. My husband and I really enjoyed this tour.

This was my 17-year old sons first visit to New York. Taking this tour on the first day was a perfect introduction to the different parts of Manhattan. We selected the glass-roof bus and this was great - a fairly small group of about 10 people. The guide, Walter, was very relaxed, friendly and knowledgeable. He told us both about important history as well as simple things like where to buy a great NYC bagel. Walt also made sure that we had the possibility to visit a public restroom a few time during the tour. Both me and my son really liked this tour. One thing that we missed from the tour was a walk in the southern parts of Manhattan (Wall Street, China Town, Little Italy, Soho, the Village), but we did on our own the day after.

Dana and Raymond where our tour guides and my family and i really recommend this tour its amazing all the info that was giving to us and picture they took for us and tips, food to try and we saw so much and got off to sightseeing and to take pictures. We learned so much we saw so much thank you guys yall rock keep up the good work..Thank You from the Veloz family Dallas Texas August 3,2022

Rachel was an amazing tour guide. Very intelligent, well versed in all things NYC and even gives her self curated and color printed guide to all of us on the tour. She knew the perfect spot to take pics and had us use her 'systems' to save time and get the best spots in crowded areas like the SI ferry.
Sam was a good driver as well.

I took my 2 energetic boys (ages 7 & 12) on the open/glass top NY in One Day Guided Sightseeing Tour. Steve, our guide was so patient and knowledgeable about the city. He effortlessly included information that would interest them, including information on unique parks to play soccer as well as filming locations for Ghostbusters (one of their favorite movies). Our driver, Gustavo, kept us on track throughout the 6 hours, which was a perfect amount of time to tour. The stops were spaced well apart where nothing felt rushed. I will be recommending this tour to anyone I know visiting NYC. As my 12 year old stated, “I’d rate it 5 1/2 stars!”

What a great introduction to Manhattan. We had guide Rachel and driver Jimmy for an excellent tour. Rachel was knowledgeable and entertaining and kept the group organized and on time. The info she gave us made the rest of our time in the city enjoyable as we knew where we wanted to visit again and how to navigate the subway system. Highly recommend.

The tour was good and informative. The tour guide was knowledgeable and up beat. Our lunch stop was terrible. In a city of outstanding restaurants our lunch choices were taco bell, a hot dog place; a pizza place and a high end food store with a buffet Tour was 6 and one half hours but no time was allowed to go into St. Patricks cathedral or Radio city music hall. No time available to wander China town.

Our guide was excellent. On the road, he pointed out interesting buildings and told their history in an easy to understand way. The bus stopped at many worthwhile sightseeing points in New York where we could debark and walk for short distances. The most impressive part was "Ground Zero". Great way to see a small part of New York!

Brooklyn Jim and driver Betty were great! He was knowledgeable and entertaining. It was a small group and a beautiful day. The time flew by and we got to see so much more than we would if we went on our own! Be advised: when you take the ferry to Staten Island you will be RUSHING to the return ferry to get back to Manhattan! It was fine, but if you have trouble walking out little kids, it might be hard. Also, the food choices fire lunch were just ok. This being said, my daughter and I thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and would recommend it to anyone!

A fabulous trip around NYC with Rachel as our tour guide. Wow! She is phenomenal.
What a wealth of information; history, culture, people, shopping. She even provided everyone with a sheet of info to take with us for discounts, where to eat, etc. And, when we had to take the ferry she was like a maniac getting us to where we had to be safely and efficiently. If you have ever have been in the crowd trying to take the ferry you know how much this was appreciated.
We can't say enough about this company and if you book them be sure to try to get Rachel.

Great value, informative and enjoyable.

This is an approx 6 hour tour where you will visit many of the must see sights and with the knowledge of a guide.

Brendan was fantastic. At almost every block he gave us facts, history and local speculation about buildings and areas of Manhattan.

We spent time on the bus and off to learn about the areas of NY. Facts at every turn and way better than trying to make your own way and read a guide book!

Even the rain couldn’t dampen our enthusiasm.

The memorials to 9/11 were the highlight for us, so poignant and a perfect reminder of the lives lost.

The glass top bus is definitely worth it. The views of the skyline are incredible as you drive along.

We all agreed this was the perfect start to our visit. A must for anyone coming to NY!

This was my first trip to New York City with my friends coming from Hawaii and this was an amazing tour! Our guide Gil was funny, informative, and helpful, especially when it came to small tips and recommendations. The overall tour was great since we didn’t have long here and we’re able to hit all the major sights in one day. Anyone coming especially if it’s your first time, do this tour.

This tour allowed us to see the "hotspots" that we otherwise would not have seen. GILL was our guide and was very knowledgable about all things New York. We had two teenagers with us and they enjoyed PARTS of the tour. This tour was a bit long (6 hours) but we knew that before we took the tour. Actually, one of our family members got sick before the tour was complete so we had to depart the bus and take the subway home. Gill was very understanding. Bus was small but very nice, clean and comfortable and they always had water at the ready. Something that might have made this tour a little more interesting is less facts about who used to (or still does) live in what building or what movies they played in. I would have loved to hear more unique or humorous facts about the people, places or things we visited. We loved Gill but felt sometimes he needed to "liven" up the conversation a little bit (especially for the teenagers).

My 2 sisters and I did a "sister trip" to Boston but spend one day in New York City (Manhattan). This was an excellent way to see the main sights of the city, which we could have never done on our own. We were late getting to the pick-up sight because the plane from Boston left 45 minutes late which meant we would miss the bus. Pedro, from the main office, went out of his way to direct us to where the bus would be waiting for us. And it was there. Our guide kept us al in tow and on schedule.

This was our first trip to NYC. We have two children (12 & 10) and wanted to see as much as we could. We figured if there was something we absolutely loved, we could return the next day after our tour. The tour takes you through so much that you probably wouldn't be able to see on your own no matter how well you planned. Our tour guide was Steve and we absolutely loved him. A true New York native. He had all the history down, his NY pop culture was also very savvy and he answered every question we had. There were elderly people on our tour as well and he was very considerate with them in the walking sections of the tour. For lunch he provided us with different options and the place our family picked was delicious. We were in NYC for 5 days and although we did a lot of research, I have to say, this was a great way to see a lot, get situated with all the locations of the city and learn a lot. Extremely happy we picked this excursion. Thank you Steve for your wit, your amazing knowledge of the city and your consideration. Oh and great memory! He remembered everyone's home states.

I highly recommend doing this tour first when you arrive in NYC . This Tour will take you through all the Uptown/Downtown must-see places in NYC. I am originally from Brooklyn, NY and let me tell you Rachel (our tour guide) was phenomenal!! I haven’t lived here for quite some time and she gave so us much history and information about places, buildings and the land that I never knew. My daughter is still talking about the places to her friends back home.
I HIGHLY recommended taking the tour with Rachel. You will end the tour with a little “New Yorka” pep in your step . (Lol)
I will definitely recommend Rachel to my friends back in Las Vegas for future visits.

- Donna Z

We got to see a multitude of sights and sounds. Our tour guide, Nathan, was knowledgeable, engaging and friendly. Many on the tour appreciate ls his knowledge of the area and his ability to have memorized so much for a 6-hour tour. Our driver, Walter, was filling in, but you couldn’t tell it by the way he navigated the tour. I fully recommend this activity.

This tour is a great way to see new York in one day! Our tour guide, Nathan, was very knowledgable and entertaining! We enjoyed hearing the history of the buildings and neighbourhoods we passed through. The tour had a good balance between riding on the bus and getting out at various key areas for a look around. We would definitely recommend this tour.

This was well worth the money. We were only staying for 3 days and this tour got so much crammed into the 6 hours it took. Our tour guide Rachel was unbelievable her knowledge about New York was amazing. Johnny her driver was unbelievable as well. There was a conference on at the UN at the time and the traffic was bonkers. He got us around no problem. Great value for money 💰

We just finished the New York one day Guided Sight Seeing tour with Rhonda and Artis as tour guide and bus driver. Because of a nation-wide flight snafu, we ended up in NY 28 hours later than we wanted to be and were only able to spend 1 full day in NY. Thus, we wanted to make the most of our trip and see as many sights we possibly could. Enter the Guided Sight seeing tour of NY city and boy did they deliver!!! We went on a whirlwind tour of such famous sights as: Rockefeller Center, Times Square, the Financial District, Staten Island and the 911 Memorial. At each location, Rhonda was able to give us all kinds of interesting factoids about each site we visited and kept all of us engaged and together when it was very easy for us to get separated. At the end of tour, Rhonda saved us from an Uber ride and explained to us it would be just as fast to walk to our hotel as drive to it and sure enough it was!!! Thanks so much to both of you for such a great tour!!!

We were in NYC for 2 days and booked this to max out the sights. I'm up in the air as to whether it was overpriced but the true value of the tour was from our tour guide Brendan. His knowledge of the sights and locations was amazing. The historical background and significance of the sights made the tour worth the price. But keep in mind, you will not enter anything. Your ticket does not include entry into any sights, exhibits or attractions.

I booked the bus tour for our first full day in New York as I felt it would be a good way to get an overview and perhaps see places we would want to explore further later in the week. Our guide was Gil and we were driven around by Juan, both of who were friendly and helpful. Gil’s knowledge of the area was fantastic and it was interesting to learn various things about the different parts of New York that we otherwise wouldn’t have known, particularly some information about the 9/11 memorial. If you haven’t done it before, I would definitely recommend you book the tour.

t was very disappointing. The tour guide was clearly not well informed and even communicated wrong facts. All and all it was a use disappointment. Wallstreet was stated on the booking, however, we didn’t even cover Wallstreet. We couldn’t make a picture. I wish I had taken one of the red busses promoted outside on the street, which would’ve been cheaper, more informative and more convenient. The bus was very small and crowded. You couldn’t enjoy the architecture nor could you see the buildings, because of the traffic. The screen was not functional and visible. The tour guide also had a drawling accent, which made it difficult to understand. I will not recommend this tour to anyone.

We were so glad we decided to take this tour and with this company. It was a beautiful day to have the top down and to not be cramped in one of the big buses. Our tour guide, Steve is a local and knew his NY facts. If you happen to ask a question he didn’t know, he would find out the answer for you! Steve is fun, knowledgeable, and you could tell how much he loves and respects his city. We highly recommend!

This was by far one of the best city tours I have ever done, it was well put together and probably the best six hours I ever had. It allowed me to see things in one day that probably would’ve taken me over a week. I enjoyed the tour guide he was amazing, informative, and funny. The trip itself was just great. I would definitely do it again and I definitely recommend doing this tour.

We finished this tour today, and it was awesome! Our tour guide was named Gil. He really new his stuff. There was so much to see, and Gil had so much information about the city's points of interest. The tour was a nice mix of riding in the bus, hearing about the places we were driving by, and on-foot excursions. Also included was a ferry ride past the Statue of Liberty. Gil also provided many good tourist tips, and recommendations on local cuisine. The tour lasted about 6 hours, including a stop for lunch. We thoroughly enjoyed this tour, and would highly recommend it.

Our guide, Jerry was awesome, funny and knowledgeable - each stop was meaningful with great tidbits. I really enjoyed the Staten Island Ferry and 911 Memorial stops. The weather was cold 40°F, so the bus was a better alternative than the walking tour.

We took the tour with Rachel and she was really great. Learned a ton! She was respectful, funny and never boring throughout the tour. We stopped at all the main attractions and enjoyed them both in the comfort of the bus and via quick excursions on foot. Highly recommend!

This tours was great for ideas as to 'what to go back to'. Our tour guide kept us together and moving along a good pace. Rachel was very aware of group safety and time. She not only told us historical facts about NYC, she gave us practical tips to get by on our own. We felt like we were cubs learning our way in the world and she was momma bear. The ferry portion of the tour was the best, as she knew just what to do to get us on quickly and to the best vantage point. My husband and I needed to catch a train before the tour was completed. Rachel helped us get on the right subway and filled us in on what we would miss (mostly info on how to do NYC). I would recommend this tour for first timers to NYC. Do it early in your stay as it will give you ideas and strategies to make the most of the rest of your stay. Rachel made the tour fun.

Really glad we chose this tour for our first full day. Rachel the tour guide was so informative and helpful it felt like you had seen everything in one trip and it gives you a great start to your holiday in New York.
Very well organised and fantastic tour bus.
Very highly recommend this trip.

We went on the One Day Guided tour yesterday. Our driver Raymond and tour guide Gil were wonderful! We started out on 7th Ave in Manhattan. We went in to tour Rockefeller Center, Empire State building area, Wall Street area, Brooklyn Bridge area, Battery Park, saw the Statue of Liberty and the 9/11 Memorial. Gil was a fountain of information and Raymond was awesome! Felt very safe! We saw so much more on this tour than we ever could have on our own! Great tour!

Rhonda was excellent! I'm a public speaking instructor and have been on many tours - Rhonda was informative and fun - it was the perfect way to spend our day. She was very attentive to the various needs of our group. It was a very hot day and we loved getting to relax in the AC bus between stops.

We wanted a tour that would give us an overview of new York prior to visiting specific attractions. This tour, with guide Dina and Driver Manuel, did the job! The tour was well-paced and covered a wide selection of sights as well as orienting us to manhattan. Dina was very helpful with photographs of us both at all the main stops and overall it was a very pleasant and informative six-hours. I highly recommend this tour as a way of becoming oriented to New York, especially for first-time visitors.

Brooklyn Jim & lovely Anthony made the experience for us. Lots of local history and knowledge. EPIC! Loved the whole trip gave us a really good o review of NYC,do the trip early on an pick the places you you want to go back to and spend more time...

I grew up in Jersey and spent a lot of time in NY but yet I still enjoyed the guided bus tour. The booking agents were incredibly helpful! The bus was very clean and comfortable and the guide Steve was welcoming, informative and accommodating. Our driver was fantastic as well! The tour was a great overview of the city and perfect for my visiting friend from western PA.

We enjoyed the history of each of our stops and buildings as we drove by. That was our favorite part! Seeing the Statue of Liberty from the ferry was also wonderful.
Rachel, our Tour Guide is great! She kept our large group together when off the bus and kept us "on time" throughout, which is tough with so many people. She was full of insights and historical knowledge that your typical NY'er would never know. Book this trip if you've never been to Manhattan, or even if you've visited before.
You won't be sorry!

Brilliant day. Great guide. Loved the small group of 11 and the small bus which the roof slid forward so it was open topped. Saw queues of people waiting for the hop on/off buses and was really glad we’d opted for our tour. Couldn’t recommend highly enough.

A fantastic way to see as much as New York’s famous landmarks as possible in one day. I did a lot of research before booking and this had the best reviews and really lived up to the reviews I read. The tour guide was knowledgable and happy to answer any questions as well as give fantastic recommendations on where to visit and eat for the rest of your trip. I had my 13 year old son with me and he was engaged throughout the day, so pitched for all the family!

This was a reasonable tour for a first visit to New York. Unfortunately our guide was not overly interested in the guests just gave the usual spiel about sights. I actually listened in on the guide for the other group she was brilliant Rachel I believe much for interactive. I would also drop the strawberry field and Madison park sections. A waste of time all we did at Madison Park was cross the road and take a photo of the Empire State building. 6 hours is a long time and would be better seeing a few more sights. All up a reasonable day but could be improved.

This was just what we were looking for! A great overview of Manhattan. Our guide Gil was authentic New York. He was knowledgeable and funny! Our driver Arliss made driving in NY look easy! We would recommend this tour first and then go back to the places you want to visit in depth.

We loved our city tour! For our first visit to NYC, this was a perfect way to see and get acquainted with the city. We were only in town for 2 days, so didn't have time to do in-depth tours and wanted to maximize our time, seeing as many key sights as possible. Our tour guide, Steve, was knowledgeable and had a great personality. We enjoyed spending the day with him and our other pleasant tour guests from all over the world. Truly a wonderful day with perfect weather. HIGHLY recommend the open top/glass top tour bus! It was easy to see all the sights and tall buildings with this added visibility. Our driver for the day did a great job managing the crowded streets and traffic.

Dana was our tour guide. She’s personable, funny, super informative and bottom line we just truly enjoyed the tour. This was our first time in NYC, and a tour was totally worth it. After you’re done, you have a much better idea on where to go explore.
The driver was great and timely (but I can’t remember his name). They also had cold water for us throughout the tour!
Wear comfy shoes, a great attitude and deodorant 😂 and you’ll have a great time.
From
Grandpa, daughter and granddaughter

Rachel our guide and Gustavo the driver were amazing. She was very informative and I appreciated her attention to staying on time. I think my favorite part of the tour was the ferry ride, and seeing the skyline from the boat. Definitely recommend this tour to anyone wanting to experience the city in a day.

Participated on the Thursday, 07/21/2022 morning tour with Rachel. She was great! Provided so much information at each stop and made sure we became a "New Yorker" for the day. Provided page of helpful links for shows, shopping and food.
If you are booked for a tour with this company, i HIGHLY recommend Rachel as your tour guide.

Whole-heartedly recommend this tour for a whirlwind experience of New York in one day. Our guide Dana was very knowledgeable (really made it wonderful) and our driver was magic! Dana even assisted us with sorting out timings with another excursion afterwards due to an unavoidable delay. Couldn’t have wished for better!

A really well organised tour of NYC. Our tour guide (Walter) was so knowledgeable and made this a brilliant experience. We see and learnt so much about New York in six hours. It was a hot day on board a open top bus, but ice cold water was always available. We really enjoyed this experience from the start (Times Square) right through to the end (9/11 Memorial).
Well worth the money we paid.

This was a very informative and quick tour if you want to see lots in about 5 hours. Jim our tour guide and Manny our driver were fantastic. Jim is a typical New Yorker and had us laughing all the way. He was very knowledgeable of the city, it’s history and all the attractions. I would highly recommend this to anyone lone who only has one day to see everything in New York.

Our tour guide Jim was great! Shared so much information with us. He offered to take pictures for us and pointed out things we wouldn’t of known on our own. Saw so much of the city that wouldn’t of been able to see on our own on a limited time schedule.Would highly recommend this tour

I have been to many Guided tours all over the world, but I think this tour I will always remember because of one thing - Our Tour guide Tyler.
She was amazing, very energetic, knowledgeable and friendly. I hope she reads this review. We loved her and she gave an emotional presentation at the 9/11 memorial and it brought tears into my eyes. I have been to NYC many times but our Guide Tyler we will always remember for a long time. Tyler is a person who definitely loves what she does. Keep it up Tyler and Don't ever change. Thank you for being our tour guide and put effort in :)

Thoroughly enjoyed our Discover NYC day tour! Walter was awesome and entertaining, learned a lot of cool nuggets throughout the day. Am glad we chose the open top bus, for while it was a little too chilly for it to be open that day (we all agreed), it was still nice having the glass top for better viewing. Bus had comfy seats, too.

Would recommend to anyone, saw plenty!

Details you never knew about New York. After several trips to the Big Apple, my friends and I were skeptical about a guided tour.
This was $ well spent and I recommend for anyone who has never had the full frontal of NY. Rachel was engaging, informative, hitting all the hot spots, good tips for eating, shopping, sight seeing, the whole enchilada. You must do this once!!!!
And come home with great handbags!!

Nathan (Guide) and Carlos (Driver) were fantastic! It was a really great way to see the city. We learned a lot of rich history and got to stop at so many places. It would have been impossible to see all of the sites on our own and we would have missed out on Nathan's jokes and singing! Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see the city in a day.

Enjoyable, informative. Our tour guide Steve was very knowledgeable, informative & willingly shared his expertise with us. It was a Comprehensive tour of Manhattan and included return ferry ride to Staten Island. He kept up the commentary all day - made a huge effort. The mini van was open a top which facilitated great views enabling clear photos.

Absolutely brilliant day out.
Met up at the back of the Winter Garden Theatre and boarded an air conditioned bus. Steve led our tour. He was friendly and knowledgeable and ensured we were all rounded up and got everywhere on time. Great tour and great guide. Well worth the money. Saw all of the sights listed and plenty of time for photo ops and lunch. Added bonus when we got off we saw Hugh Jackson who had come out of the theatre from his show.
After the tour we were able to get our bearings in New York and even braved the subway. Thanks for a great day!

The tour vehicle was a Mercedes Sprinter 15 passenger that was pristine. Rachel the tour guide was awesome and her tour gave info on architecture, movies & celebrities, history & facts and LOTS of photo opportunities. Arles, the driver was on time, a safe driver and was always right there when we exited tour stops. Felt extremely safe during covid times.

Gil was Amazing! He was very knowledgeable about this city. He was humorous but thorough. We came to NYC for the 1st time for my 50th birthday and this was definitely something I’m glad we booked for our 1st event of the week. You will be in an out of the bus a good bit. Anthony the driver was also amazing and they made a great team. Don’t forget to tip them at the end they were well worth it!

A perfect trip to do at the beginning of our holiday. As our guide Rachel said, it offers an appetiser of the main NY sights, you can then decide what you want to visit again during your stay. The open top bus was fabulous, Rachel was really knowledgeable and gave us lots of information which really added to the trip. The ferry over to Staton Island was a highlight, Rachel took us to a quiet part of the ferry to make sure we got the best uninterrupted views. Our driver, Manny was also really friendly. I’d have no problem recommend this trip, it’s really worth the money!

This was the first trip to NYC for our 3 sons (21, 20, &14). We booked this tour to show them as much as we could in a short amount of time. This tour was excellent! Our guide, Steve, was knowledgeable and entertaining. The tour has a good balance of time on the bus and walking. We all loved the ferry and got some amazing pictures. Highly recommend this tour!

This tour was Great! My partner and I were visiting from Chicago. We’ve done several other NY Tours, but this was by far the best. Our Tour Guide Rachel was fantastic! She navigated around the city like a Seasoned Pro. Rachel has a wealth of knowledge about the city, points of interest and best places to visit for the full NYC Experience! Six hours wasn’t enough, every stop was an educational adventure. Rachel shared some valuable information on how to navigate the city and even left us with a sheet of tips, links and apps, of which we used the next day for some great shopping and our first subway adventure. Manny our driver was wonderful, he gave us a safe, smooth beautiful ride on a sunny afternoon..always there to pick us up with cold water on our comfortable bus. Thanks Rachel and Manny we will be back soon. Rose and Anthony 😊

Brilliant way to get your bearings upon arrival to New York City. Our tour guide Gil was particularly good - super knowledgeable, incredibly informative, friendly, happy to take lots of photos and answer questions. Definitely recommend.

Sean our tour guide was excellent. He was knowledgeable about NY and was always concerned about keeping us safe. For example, at crosswalks he would make sure we were always safe to go and he always reminded us to stay off of the bikes lanes. He was clear in his expectations of us (ie: time to be back at the bus after lunch ect.) Sean is funny to so that’s always a good thing. Our driver Jimmy kept us safe with his driving skills in busy Manhattan. I’m glad I booked this trip for my daughter and I. We both felt it was well worth the money. Very reasonably price.

This tour was worth every penny! Our guide Rachel was so entertaining and knowledgeable. We drove by so many places and she explained so much about the buildings and neighborhoods, about famous people and movie and film locations. And tips about how to get about in New York city. She had great photo stops and made sure we all got our pictures taken. There are a lot of stops where we get off the bus to see and experience things. We could never have done this on our own. Great way to learn about the city. I highly recommend going when you first get to NY.

The seats were uncomfortable, we sat in the back and I am a large man. The seat belt was poking my butt the whole time. the driver hit a car and a tree at separate times. Tour guide was good and it was worth the money to see various sites quickly. Just don’t get stuck in the back seat of the bus!

We opted for the full day tour of New York City on the open top bus. It was a mini van and only 14 of us. Well worth paying the extra as you see more with a smaller group. Steve the guide was a New Yorker and gave us so much information as well as having a brilliant sense of humour.
It was a really great day and we saw so much. Thank you USA Guided Tours we will have no hesitation in using you again and recommending you to others!

Our tour guide was rude, and gave us barely any information about the landmarks we were going to see. He only gave poor 'jokes' the entire time!

Also, we felt the free Staten Island ferry was a bit of a joke. When we got to Staten Island we went straight back! We could have done this ourselves, as it is a free ferry. Not exactly sure what we are paid for with this tour?

Intensely disappointed, and will tell my family and friends not to waste their money, and more importantly their time in amazing NYC with this tour.

Perfect way to see New York and learn so much more! Took our granddaughter as a first visit for her to see NYC. We are seasoned travelers and have been to NYC many times . This was a perfect outing for her as they breezed through the city sharing so many highlights and history . We learned so much. She was totally intrigued. Dana , the tour guide was so much fun , well informed , interesting and made for a perfect day. Jerry the driver was amazing and navigated us perfectly. Plan for the entire day and bring a few snacks. The tour stops several times for restroom breaks and also a great lunch in a food court with many options . Wear comfortable shoes as you do get out and explore with your guide.

It was awesome to see and learn so much about NYC in 6 hours. Tyler (she), the tour guide is what made the whole days so enjoyable. She was great and you guys at USA Tours need to hang on to her! Will definitely do this again next time we come back. 9/11 memorial was very emotional and Tyler talked about what we would see while we were off the property in order to preserve the honor and sanctuary of the site. A class act.

This was one of the best things we did in NYC! It hit all the hot spots we wanted to see and our tour guide was fantastic! He gave us so much interesting info and facts and took us to the best pizza place, Joe's, for authentic NY pizza, which we enjoyed in a park across the street. The ferry ride past the Statue of Liberty was wonderful as well as the 9/11 Memorial. Plenty of bathroom breaks and not too much walking. Nice air conditioned bus that only holds about 30 people so it's easy to stick together as a group with your guide. Highly recommend this tour! We were ages 16-69 and we all loved it,

We went on this tour today and thoroughly enjoyed it. It was a great introduction to our first visit to NYC. Our tour guide, Don, and driver, Jimmy, were amazing. We loved listening to Don narrate the history and background of all the sights we passed by and stopped at, we learned so much from him. The tour included a nice mix of locations. Our fellow guests were a great crew to spend the day with. After the tour we stopped at Juniors Cheesecake and Bonchon for Korean Fried Chicken, both recommended by Don, and it was a great ending to our day.

We couldn’t believe all we got yo see and do and yet it was never rushed. Our guide, Joe, was not extremely well informed and also very funny and engaging. He added to our experience by showing us pictures from the past of the things we were seeing. He had endless anecdotes and stories about everything.

We decided to book the day tour to see all that we could in a day and we were not disappointed! We started out near Rockefeller Center and made our way down the island of Manhattan and back by sundown.
Our guide, Rachel, was AMAZING! Not only did she seem to know everything there was to know about NYC (history, architecture, people, culture, sites & sounds), but she explained it all with flare and personality that captured and kept everyone’s attention. She shared her personal experiences, tips on how to survive in NYC, and great stories about historical NYC people such as Emily Warren Roebling, the bad ass woman who completed the Brooklyn Bridge after the passing of her husband. I won’t ruin the experience of hearing this story from Rachel herself. ;)
If you have the time to take this tour, I HIGHLY recommend it AND Rachel!

Informative, relaxed, fun day. Gil was a fabulous tour director and Arliss did
an amazing job navigating the streets and picking us up at various locations.
We took the 6 hour day tour of NY for my grandaughters' birthdays (13, 10).
Due to Covid-19 restrictions the 8 of us had the van to ourselves.. We were 3 adults
and 5 children 13, 10, 8, 7, 4. Although the tour is more beneficial for adults, the kids
did ok. Gil "customized " our tour so the grandchildren could go to the children's
part of Central Park and get the wiggles out. The tour balanced lots of
wonderful information(Gil is an encyclopedia of NYC info) and walking time at
the various stops. Since the boat wasn't available, we went on the Staten Island ferry
so we could see the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline plus Brooklyn and
New Jersey. The kids loved that. Gil was extremely accomadating, taking our pictures everywhere. Thanks for a memorable, fun birthday.

Really great way to see most of Manhattan. Get your camera ready as you'll take a lot of pictures from inside the air conditioned bus and even more outside. Our tour was 2 full buses of people. The tour guide was great and very knowledgeable about every spot; she was a Brooklyn native with a great accent and sense of humor. She warned us about Canal St scams and told us about all the places we didn't have time to see. There's no way you could do it all in a single day and this is just one borough. Lunch was right next to a great pizza place so you can get an authentic experience. Our tour ended at 4:30pm so plan a whole day for this. Most of it was from the bus, but you do get to walk and take pictures at a few locations. Still can't believe the real estate prices especially on the Upper East Side.

This tour was awesome from start to finish. Anthony was an excellent driver and Gil was an amazing tour guide. He was very knowledgeable of each site and in between. He made sure the group stayed together and were safe and was also our personal photographer in some locations. Each time we returned to the bus Gil was waiting with ice cold water for us. I definitely recommend anyone take this tour and request the dynamic duo Gil and Anthony. This tour made my first trip to New York very memorable.

We really enjoyed our tour. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable about the history of the sights and made it very interesting. It was also just a good way to get around and see things. Absolutely a great deal for the money!

We had a great time on the tour. Esther was our guide and she was very knowledgeable about the city and had a real passion. She made suggestions where to come back and spend extra time on. I would highly recommend this as soon as you get to NYC, helped us figure out the rest of our trip. Only thing to know, the bus seats are not assigned and if you don’t get there early, you may not be able to sit together.

Robert was an excellent tour guide. It rained most of the day, so we were glad to be in the enclosed bus. This was a great way to get a quick overview and have a good idea what we might like to go back to.
My only criticism was lunch. The market/deli we stopped at had good food selections. However, there was no inside seating (the upper balcony was closed), so we ended up at a wet metal table outside, huddled under the awning.

Gil was an amazing tour guide! We took this trip 9-23-20. These businesses and tour guides are doing an A+ job for just the few of us visiting the city. There were 0 lines, not crowded and everyone was taking precautions but we still had a wonderful experience! If you are considering do it your first day! He gave us tips on where to eat, how to travel and such. Made our week so amazing by doing this first! Gil was very energetic & full of information! Exceeded our expectations!

This tour was an amazing way to see as much of the city in a short amount of time. Glad I found it! If you are able, take the 'open' bus tour with Gil. He was the best and extremely knowledgeable. Manual was a great driver.

We could not hear the guide while on the bus portion of the tour even after asking the guide early on to turn up his microphone. The tour was unorganized (missed a ferry due to lack of communication with patrons) and our guide was not interactive at all. We have been on so many good tours and we were extremely disappointed in this experience.

Awesome tour guide, Walter and driver/traffic negitiator, Alex looked after our small group for the day. Loved Walter's rolling observations of the city in which he was born and raised. Glad to get a wider appreciation of NYC before taking a deeper dive into specific areas of interest such as 9/11 Memorial, Museum and World Trade Centre buildings, which we'll do tomorrow. Daughter and I arrived in the city on Saturday night and took the tour Monday morning to get our bearings. Highly recommended... You do a bit of walking and the weather was a bit miserable for our tour. But Alex kept the bus warm and readily available to our group when we were ready for the next part of our adventure. Thank you both Walter and Alex for an awesome day. Five stars.

Our tour guide Rachel was outstanding. Great knowledge of the city and it’s history. She also offered several tips that will make our time in NYC truly amazing.
Our driver Carlos is an absolute wizard behind the wheel.
I highly recommend this tour and if you can get a Rachel as your guide and Carlos as your wheel man, you’re sure have to have a great experience.

This is the best tour I’ve had of New York. Don’t waste time on the open deck busses - THIS is the tour you want. Our guide, Gil, was informative and passionate about New York and he shares a wealth of information about eating and activities. You won’t be disappointed.

I never leave reviews for things, but just wanted to say this tour was excellent. Half my party had never been to NYC so they got to see a lot they ordinarily wouldn't, and those who had been to NYC, saw parts we'd never seen before and learned some really interesting stuff. Our tour guide Walter was exceptional. Really fun and knew his stuff, and made our experience special. Can't speak highly enough for him. We did the early morning tour and made it back in time to catch our flight just as predicted. Great tour

We really enjoyed this private small tour . Tyler was our fabulous enthusiastic knowledgeable guide. We covered many of the key attractions where the bus driver would drop us off and Tyler would walk and talk at each attraction . If you don’t have much time or you just don’t want the hassle of taking the sub and walking this is perfect for you. I highly recommend this trip and it was amazing value for money

This is the second time we’ve taken this tour of New York City. We loved it the first time and were fortunate enough to have Rachel as our guide for the second time. The sights are fantastic, but Rachel MAKES the tour with her personal anecdotes. She kept everyone comfortable while keeping things moving so we could fit it all in.
Thanks Rachel and USA Guided Tours!!

Everything was great. Steve was an awesome tour guide. Very knowledgeable on the history of NY which made the tour very interesting. His colorful language and creativity was enjoyable. He kept our attention. Thanks to Betty (driver) as well. I would only ask that she have the bus on and air conditioning on at least 5 minutes before everyone is due back on the bus to ensure passengers are comfortable after each tour. It was hot at times getting back on the bus. Thanks!

Great tour! It gave us a kaleidoscope glimpse of Manhattan (upper West Side, Times Square, 911 memorial, Statue of Liberty, etc). We got a taste of the city to give us an idea of where we wanted to do a deeper dive. Rhonda was friendly and very knowledgeable. We’ll worth the money and time (6 hrs!)

Great tour guide and driver. The tour was well organized. Good focus on the key iconic locations. Bathroom breaks were well planned. The pace could be a bit intense esp if you had a guide like ours that wanted to ensure we saw everything the tour promised. I chose this tour because of the excellent reviews and it did not disappoint. I could not remember our guides name I just remember she worked a lot with horses in the past. Please share our thanks to her and driver guermo.

The tour was great, as were our guide Gil and driver Gustavo. We appreciated the sights that were included and the information Gil constantly provided in an entertaining way. A tip: allow plenty of time to get to the starting point of the tour. We got delayed by traffic and missed the first sight on the tour. Thankfully, the tour staff suggested we meet the tour at an upcoming stop. We're glad that worked out because we thoroughly enjoyed the tour. It also would have been helpful in the tour information to mention the pick up point was the back of the Winter Garden Theatre instead of just providing the address.

The tour guide was just his natural self and character. What I call him a typical New Yorker: funny, rough. He shared his “street smart” personality and tips with us. He was real. We went sat comfortably on the bus and he and the driver took us around the must to see places. He, the guide, also had time to take us good photos !!
To see the Statue of Liberty we took a public huge bote and he took us to the back, so nobody bothered us while there. He also took us for lunch at the World trade center, a food court where there were food varieties for all tastes. The tour took about 6 hours and We enjoyed a lot.

Gil and Arlis arr great guide and driver combo. Profesaional guide and driver. Great lunch spot. The tour hit many great spots to give our family a insight where we are going the next couple of days. 10 out of 10 tour. We took two adults, a 13,12,10,&6 yr old, and was perfect for the family.

Best tour - highly recommend!! We did this tour on our first full day in New York and I'm so glad we did. It was a great way to see lots of different parts of New York and figure out where we wanted to go back and spend more time. It was a nice blend of time on the bus and off the bus getting to explore a little more. I was a little bummed at first that the convertible bus wasn't available but I ended up being so glad we weren't on that bus because it was so hot! The air conditioning was much needed!

Tyler was our tour guide and we absolutely LOVED her! She was super, super knowledgeable, funny, helpful - just really made for a great day spent with her. And our driver, Betty, was amazing! Her navigation in the craziness that is New York driving was phenomenal!

One consideration: you get to see so much on this tour that I wondered if we should still do the other tours we had scheduled later in the week.
