We did end up doing them and learned more details with each one. But...if you are trying to decide how many to do you could get away with this one and feel like you saw a lot and learned a lot.

Highly recommend this tour and do it early in your trip - you won't be disappointed!

There were no signs for the tour. There were busses from several companies. Nobody we asked could lead us in the right direction. We finally found someone who knew the tricks of the bus trade, he kindly walked us to where the bus WAS. We were early, just trying so hard to find the right bus. Looking back on it I do believe I asked the bus driver of the bus that we should have been on and sent us on….. I then called to try to get my money back. No way Jose, not even a consideration. I had scheduled another trip for today. Because of the trouble finding this bus, I cancelled todays trip weary of same issue. We were SO excited about both trips. I booked through Trip Advisor because of reputation. Lesson learned.

A four hour bus trip for a day to NY was a long trip, a long day, but walking to stores doing shopping, eating, looking a people, seeing styles, and so much more was great. I’d love to stay in one of those Golden hotels and go see Kelly and Ryan show, maybe one day, but I’m getting older. Everyone enjoy all the great things you can do.

We thought the tour covered a lot of area and it was great to get off and on at different landmarks. Our guide Steve always checked if we had questions at each point. Very enjoyable, interesting and my whole family enjoyed it. Appreciated the unlimited free water on such a hot day.

Everything about the NY in 1 Day was great except for ONE thing. One of the best things about NYC is the amazing and reasonable food that you can find all over the place, which is why I couldn’t believe that the tour’s lunch hour was …. the Staten Island Ferry terminal. Could there be a worse place to plan a lunch stop? The choices were Subway or a hotdog. It was a very cold day and there was no eateries within walking distance. Not even food trucks. So disappointing and unnecessary.

Favorite part of the experience was the boat fairy to Staten Island. The views were amazing. Our tour guide Steve was very helpful and helped us take photos as well. Since I was only in NYC for a short time this tour helped me see and learn a lot to maximize my time.

Thoroughly enjoyable tour of the city. Tour guide was very knowledgeable of the city. Shared interesting information on the history, geography and layout of NYC. Tour included stops in Central Park, Rockefeller Plaza, World Trade Memorial, and a ride to Statendan island on the Ferry. The tour was very interesting and a great introduction to this dynamic city. As a 1st time visitors to NYC my husband and I highly recommend this tour!

What a great tour and only made even better by our guide Tyler and driver Anthony. Tyler is a great historian and shared such interesting facts about the history of the city. My husband and I enjoyed it so much. We also enjoyed the get out and walk the city part as well. We recommend the tour to anyone visiting. ❤️🗽🌆

Really informative trip, great to do on your first day as it gives you an overview of the city and ideas of where to go next. Best way to do it and worth paying the extra than the hop on hop off bus. Guide was full of knowledge (could have just have done with a bit of banter!)

Rhonda was an excellent tour guide, was very knowledgeable, and gave helpful tips and advice throughout the tour. It was my boyfriend’s first time in New York and he thoroughly enjoyed his experience. Thank you for the amazing time!

We loved Steve and his knowledge of NY. We learned so much and saw so much in just one day! It was the perfect tour for couples and families. The AC between stops in the hot August weather was perfect! So glad we were in an ac clean luxury bus. The poor people in the open tops got drenched during an afternoon shower. My 14 year old daughter still talks about all the cool things Steve taught us on the tour!

Phenomenal experience! Brooklyn Jim was our tour guide and he was excellent ... he's lived there his whole life and so he had a lot of city insight that we wouldn't have learned otherwise ... it was like hanging out with family all day!

We had a wonderful tour with guide Rachel. She was extremely informative and it was a lot of fun to learn about New York. She was very helpful in taking pictures at every stop. She kept us all moving and was very organized, we didn't lose anyone.

Rachel also had lots of helpful tips about navigating New York City. Thank you for teaching us about the subway system, how not to get swindled, how to get cheap Broadway tickets, and how to barter! Very useful information for someone who is Minnesota nice and would probably get suckered.

Rachel will make sure you get plenty of quality pictures of you and your trip mates.

I am 35 and I took my 62 year old mom and she really enjoyed it too. A bit of walking, nothing too strenuous. Just note that the tour starts at 10a and the first bathroom break isn't until noon, so plan accordingly! Skip the morning coffee.

We took this tour on our first day of our visit and we really got a good overview over Manhattan, including a boat trip with views of the Statue of Liberty and the Brooklyn Bridge. Our nice and knowledgeable guide Steve and driver Eduardo managed to get the very best out of this day for us and we got a lot of useful tips. The group was just right in size. Highly recommended as a starting point for your vacation.
Regards,
Jonatan & Ellen

Our tour with Gil was amazing....the best! I was with my son, his fiance' and her parents! What a wonderful way to see all of the major sites in the city but also learning a lot of history thanks to you, Gil! You were so kind and always concerned about each of us! You helped me on and off the bus so many times due to leg issues and I am so grateful! You were so knowledgeable about "everything" and what we experienced in 6 hours was so much more than expected. If you are going to New York, you need to take this tour your first day so that you get a perspective of all of the famous locations and then some.....just be sure to ask for GIL!

Gil was a great guide with many fun facts along the way. It was nice of him to help in taking pictures of us along the tour. My selfie's usually cut someone out. We enjoyed the tour very much. The large flat screen at the front of the bus was very helpful to see a great street scene.

We saw a lot more sights than we could on our own. Our driver Roy was very skillful navigating the traffic. Martin was our guide and he was very knowledgeable and friendly. He made sure the group was together and safe. We would definitely recommend this tour.

Rachel was an EXCELLENT tour guide! Funny, super knowledgeable and kept everyone on task. We were only in NYC for that one day and we saw it all! We hit all the major tourist sights and I highly recommend this tour! We had a group of 8 family members from Chicago and the youngest was 10 years old. Every one had a fantastic time.

Excellent tour to see NYC in one day. The weather was perfect for the open-air tour bus. It was very organized and Nathan had tons of informationa and facts to tells us about his city. We saw many great sites including Times Square, Central Park, Rockefellar center, The 9/11 memorial, the Statue of Liberty and many other places. Nathan was always willing to take photos of our family. The tour was very faced paced with just enough time to grab a picture at the different sites. Plenty of bottled water was provided on the trip. I would have liked a better opportunity to take a photo with the Statue of Liberty. However, it was crowded on the ferry and a little too far away. Overall a great experience.

The tour certainly gives you an overview of Manhatten. The Staton Island ferry allows views of the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island. As it was a very rainy day and the windows were steamed up, hard to see things. Tour guide very informative and lots of history given of the city.

I booked this tour because I was gonna be in New York for a short period of time. I wanted to make sure I hit the hotspots before I left. Our tour guide was Brooklyn Jim and he was awesome. How they are able to cram all the stuff we did into 6 hours with New York traffic is beyond me. I loved that we were able to get good views of everything without having to be around a bunch of people trying to see the same things. Brooklyn Jim sure knows his stuff. He was fun and was able to keep the large crowd engaged. Even gave us good advice about navigating around the city being a tourist lol. My favorite part was the ferry ride. Very beautiful.

I'm only in New York City for a few days (it's my first time here) and I booked this as a way to see a lot of popular locations, and the tour definitely lived up to my expectations. Our tour guide (Rachael) was great, had a very gregarious personality, and knew her stuff. She also often th took pictures of us using our phones. (I am traveling alone but thanks to her I got a lot of pictures of me with landmarks). And our driver Manuel got the tour bus through some ridiculously tight spaces and got us everywhere we needed to go. I recommend this tour, especially for any first time visitors.

This tour is the best city tour we have ever been on in any city! It’s the best way to see New York City in a short period of time. I would like to extend a BIG THANK YOU to our tour guide Rhonda who was so kind and made our trip extra special! She gave so much extra TLC to helping my disabled sister be able to enjoy and see NYC in a way I would never be able to do without her. XOXO

Definitely a must do if it’s your first time in NYC. Our tour guide was amazing, made sure to have a conversation with every single guest before the tour and got to know everyone on a personal level. She was extremely attentive and made sure everyone on the tour had the best experience possible. We loved that she was also from California. Everything about this tour was amazing, but the tour guide really made it a memorable experience. If you ever get the chance to do this tour make sure you ask for the lady with short blonde hair to be your guide. Thank you so much!!!!

We spent 2 days in NYC prior to a cruise, and wanted to see a little of everything, and this tour did just that! Our guide, Steve, was very good - funny, informative, and clear with directions and expectations. It was a small, closed-top van, which was fine. We enjoyed hearing about everything New York and seeing various parts of town. Loved the ferry ride, Rockefeller Center, Central Park, and especially the 9/11 memorial site. Lunch stop worked very well - quick but enough time to grab a bite. We would highly recommend this one day tour!

We did the Spanish Tour. My Wife and Son are Spanish speakers and I am English. Robert was great if there was something I didn't understand he'd take the time to explain it in English. He was very informative and always willing to help with photos. The Vehicle was a nice custom Van for tours with a window top which was nice since we were traveling with an infant. We saw all the major sites. I would recommend if you have one day to do the city take a tour.

I highly recommend this tour. Today was possibly our only day ever to visit NYC and I'm glad we did this tour. Jerry was an excellent guide, I don't think he could've given us anymore information than he did, he packed it in. The driver was also excellent. If there was a down side it would be that you couldn't always see out the windows very good, especially if you were sitting on the opposite side of what the guide was talking about. But still a fabulous tour.

Rachel was an excellent tour guide (with Christian an amazing driver!). I took the tour on 15/03, although I was a solo traveller, I felt incredibly welcomed and at home. Rachel was funny and kept spirits up throughout the entire day. The bus was clean and we were provided water upon request too. The best thing about the tour was the visit to Fulton Market. I had already been in New York for 3 days, but the food sold there was some of the best I have had since being in NY. My only regret is not taking her tour on my first or second day! Thank you so much Rachel and for suggesting some great photo images! Love from London 🇬🇧

We had a wonderful time! Mike was very knowledgeable; making our first trip to New York that much better.
Would like to give 5 stars alone to Mike our tour guide. Absolutely amazing, would highly recommend the tour to anyone visiting NYC

What a wonderful NYC experience! Our tour guide, Rachel, was amazing. She was very informative about all of the sites, architecture and history of NY. She had a great sense of humor which made the tour so much fun. Also, she took our picture at all of the sites. Our driver, Manny, got us everywhere we needed to be on time. Very much appreciated the cold bottled water on the bus. I would recommend this tour to everyone!

We were unable to make it on time due to not knowing the transportation system. I wish the company would post information on how to get to their beginning destination online or atleast converse with you a little more. We asked if we could catch up with it at a stop down the route and was told no. We did make it to New York and there are tour people on everywhere. We were able to do a different tour with no problem and no reservation. I wouldn't recommend this company as they were very unhelpful and somewhat rude.

First time in NYC and have to say that this tour totally set the scene for our three night stay. My son and I, 56 + 30 thought the tour and the way it was delivered was awesome. We did this tour on day 1 and thought that we would revisit any sites that we felt we needed to return to. By the end of the tour we decided that enough time was spent at each location that gave us back time to do other things. Our guide Ronda was a barrel of laughs and very knowledgeable. Highly recommend this tour.

Mike was our tour guide and was extremely knowledgeable regarding New York City, it’s history, architecture, and all its beauty. His passion of the city shows through on the entire tour. Great bang for your buck to see the city in 6 hours.

This is a great way to see all the main attractions in one tour. Our guide was very knowledgeable and entertaining. The weather was terrible (unseasonably cold and raining) but aside from that we still really enjoyed the tour. Thanks to our guide Steve and our driver Emmanuel!

Amazing! SO glad we did this and early on in our trip so we could hit the highlights and see diverse areas of town with an experienced guide. Loved Mike’s commentary and knowledge of the city. Incredibly moving to hear from a New Yorker who experienced 9/11 and the death of John Lennon first hand. Gave us a better understanding of NYC to help figure out where to spend the rest of our trip. Highly recommend!!

If you have limited time in the city, this is certainly a tour you should not missed. I learned so much about the city and its history from our tour guide Gabby - from street signs to sky scrappers. I don’t normally do tours when visiting new places but this one was exceptional.

Totally enjoyed the guided tour with Rachel, not forgetting the polite and friendly driver ( wish I could remember his lovely name). Rachel was super organised ( my group called her the headmistress!!) but this was needed as we managed to tour so many places in one day, compared to another tour we had which was a bit disorganised and caused delays of about 2 hours in the end. This wouldn’t happen on Rachel’s tour , I don’t think . Rachel also gave great advice and boosted our confidence on riding the subway and getting around in general . Thank you also for the China town recommendation and contact, really grateful for all of your advice and knowledge.

Steve ( Tour guide ) very knowledgeable. Only 15 people per open air bus. Good speaker system on the bus, we could hear everything Steve was explaining. Driver ( Betty ), excellent job. Went everywhere listed on the tour description, and then some. Steve knew a lot of history behind every stop. Very friendly, helpful, fun, and was glad to answer any questions. We walked around Central Park, entered from strawberry fields; walked around Rockefeller center; walked around the 911 memorial. Do this on 1st day in NYC, you’ll get lots of ideas of where to go for rest of your vacation.

The tour was quite comprehensive and gave us what we were hoping for, which was a one-day whip around to the must-see New York sites and gave us our bearings. The tour guide, Tyler, was unbelievably knowledgeable and gave us all the info we were hoping for. It was on the more expensive side though.

Had a great time on the tour!! Steve was an awesome guide. He was fun and gave great info about the sites and NYC in general. If you get there on time and read what's included/not included, there is no reason you won't enjoy yourself. Definitely a 5 star tour!!

Wonderful tour with a very knowledgeable tour guide who was very patient, nice and enjoyable to listen to. He answered all our questions and took his time explaining everything to us. It was a beautiful day we will always cherish.Thank you!

Highly recommend doing this tour! It has a personal touch due to guided tour. Our tour guide was Tyler and our driver was Manny. They were exceptional! We had an amazing day exploring all the tourist hot spots of Manhattan. It started at 10am and ended around 3.30/4pm and we felt we had time to explore all the different locations along the route, which also includes a ferry trip to Staten Island. We stopped for a tasty lunch break and the tour also provides cool water bottles all day. All the details off the tour, the history and information provided really help you become acquainted with NYC.

We had one day in New York, and this was the best way to spend it! There really is too much to see, but this tour does a GREAT job of hitting as much as possible. Plus, Steve was AMAZING. We got to learn about all the famous stuff, but from the perspective of a local. Priceless. Plus, if we were staying in NY longer, he told us all the best stuff to do and the best ways to do it.

Great time, would definitely do it again. I didn’t give 5 stars because some places were missed because of the many festivals going on that day. The tour operator should give out streets to avoid to all the guides to avoid the chaos. Our tour guide was great! I would do it again.

The tour guide was wonderful - well informed and a great personality. The tour itself was mediocre and should have allowed for more time to do some additional exploration. For example, a quick walk through St. Patrick’s Cathedral would have been appreciated. The tour did not include a big part of what was advertised and no price adjustment was made. Specifically, there was no ferry ride because of the time of year but the substitute tour of Grand Central never took place.

Tyler was our guide and she was wonderful! Extremely knowledgeable, personable and professional. Tony was the driver and he was top notch. The tour was well-paced, chose a goodly number of highlights with ample time at each stop. Definitely worth doing, we highly recommend!

Fantastic tour for anybody new to the city and crunched on time! Manuel Brendan was our tour guide and he was very knowledgeable about the area. It didn't feel rushed at all, in fact we got to spend some time in each spot for photos and asking questions. Highly recommend!!

A bit late in leaving a review as we were here in June. One of the best decisions we made to take this tour. Our tour guide was amazing and had such knowledge about the city. We took the tour the day after we arrived - would highly recommend

Started off great with history and parts of the city. However it was mostly viewing buildings from outside. Wasn’t something my husband and I would have liked. It would be better to cover less places with more time spent at each.

Simce we were 1st timers in New York,, We figured taking this tour would help us to see a little more of the city that we would have probably notdone on our own. We were glad we did it. It took us to so many different sights. Because we did not spend a lot of time in one area we just made it a point to go back on our own to the sights that interested us.. Rachel our tour guide and Ray the driver were very informative. I would recommend tour to any 1st timers going to New York.

This tour was excellent. The tour guide was very knowledgeable and entertaining. We got to see all the major sites including taking a ferry to Staten Island to see the Statue of Liberty. The tour was very safe and well organized.

Such a great experience! Our driver, Roy, was exceptional at getting us to where we needed to be, and our tour guide, Buster, was amazing! He is very knowledgable with lots of great stories and jokes. Just a lovely human being who will start your New York City trip off on the right foot.

There will be some walking (my Apple Watch says about 2-3 miles) but it is broken up by rides on the bus and ferry. I think most people will be able to manage it. Have fun!

We loved our tour with Tim! He was kind and funny and taught us so much about the city. The bus tour helped my grandma and I see more of the city than we ever could have on foot/using Uber. It was worth every penny for us to be able to see the city easily and safely. And I was really able to enjoy the tour instead of staring at my phone/trying to navigate with Google maps. We loved it!

Fun and informative.
Dana and Carlos were a great combo. Unfortunately it was oversold and we were unable to see the screen at the front of the bus. Our bus had a roof so when Dana stood in front it took away from the tour.

I had to think hard about any downside or needed area of improvement. Carlos was a talented and artful driver. Dana was enthusiastic and knowledgeable.

What a great tour! Gill was an amazing guide, and Rachel superbly drove our luxury van through narrow streets all across the city. We hit so many neighborhoods snd learned so much. The boat cruise was probably the highlight, though our Central Park tour was right up there. This tour is a MUST - great way to combine like three tours into one!

Gil was fantastic!! Everyone visiting NYC for the first time should take this tour. It came highly recommended from the concierge at our hotel. Gil's depth of knowledge of the city was impressive and his personality was great! He not only knew in the history of the spots we visited, but he also had great cultural and entertainment insights that made the trip especially enjoyable. Also, being a "foodie" he knows a TON of great NY diners, deli's, restaurants and fine dining.
Gil did not disappoint. Would do this again.

We’ve taken tours all over the US but this was by far the best!! Rachael was incredible! She was so assertive, guiding us effortlessly through an intimidating city. We saw and learned about everything from uptown to downtown. The only bad part of the tour was when it was over. We could have kept going all day long. She really gave us a love for this city!
Top tip: Book the open top bus! The small group and amazing views are worth the extra money.

Comfortable coach. Tour guide was uninspired and dull. Could have been more enthusiastic and knowledgeable. Kept checking his phone for facts and would often have long periods of nothing to say even though we were travelling past interesting looking places. Places visited during the tour gave us a fairly good idea of the main attractions in NYC that we then revisited and found much more interesting given further details about the places by other tour guides.

We took the NYC all day tour (english). Rachel was our tour guide. She was excellent!! Gave lots of good information of all the sights. Had her perfect picture spots picked out for us. She was very organized and made sure we got to see everything. We enjoyed her tour so much we booked the night-time tour the next evening with her!!

Great tour! Tyler was full of energy and was a lot of fun while also making it interesting.
Saw a ton of great sites and spent a good amount of time at all. Tyler also gave us a ton of inside info and places to go.

Steve and Betty were the best. Interesting and entertaining. Loved the NY no-nonsense tour with great history and super helpful tips for tourists. Most comfortable bus ever. Even the member of our group who had been to NYC many times came away learning a lot. Highly recommend this tour.

Gil was friendly, knowledgeable and attentive throughout the tour. He squeezed as much information into 6 hours as he could, but made it fun and interesting. I had older children with me and they both thoroughly enjoyed the day. There was enough time for photo ops. Plenty of walking, so bring supportive shoes. Lunch was a bit rushed as we were scheduled to get on the Staten Island Ferry. Otherwise, enough time to see the sights without hurrying too much. Well worth the money!

Excellent tour and had a great guide. The clear roof bus was worth the extra cost. There is no building or kiosk for check in though, not even a sign. You just wait on sidewalk for the bus to come pick you up. It's my only complaint as I like to arrive early and I want sure I was in by the right place until the bus came.

Fantastic! This was the best tour I have ever been on. Gil, the tour guide was AMAZING! His memory and knowledge of NY is top notch. Juan, the driver, was right on and did a great job moving us from place to place. We saw all of the major and minor tourist sites of NY as well as unknown places. If you want the best tour, book this one and ask for Gil and Juan!

Great way to spend our first day in New York. Rachel was amazing. She treated our group like family. She's very knowledgeable about NYC and her tips for getting around the city were invaluable. Thanks for a great day.

Fantastic and informative tour, our guide Gil has so much knowledge and passion for NYC. All the major sites were covered and a couple of stops along the way (Rockefeller, Central Park, Ground Zero, lunch). Gil made the trip and is one of the best tour guides I have come across. 10 out of 10 for both Gil and the bus driver Juan. Highly recommend doing this tour.

The travel guide had a very funny American accent which all my fellow American tourists understood but my wife and I coming from UK struggled to understand. In my opinion he is a great guide for only Americans.
We were expecting a close view of the statue of Liberty through a boat ride which did not happen and bit disappointed

Simply put: A first class tour. Not crowded, comfortable van, great guide with relevant but relatable facts as well as human interest stories about each visited site. Nothing hurried , but still on time to meet scheduled program. Finally, I left my small shoulder bag on the van and they delivered it later to our hotel!

I usually don't write reviews, but this tour was good. The guide talked non-stop with interesting facts covering the entire city. It also included a ride on the Ferry to Stanton Island which is free anyway. The guide was very friendly and gave it 110% percent. I would recommend it.

Tyler & Pedro were amazing! Tyler is a walking encyclopedia of New York. If you have a question about New York History, she definitely has an answer, back to colonization (and I’d consider myself a history buff lol). Our 4yr old loved her and was sad to part ways when the tour was over. Pedro was informative as well and it made the tour worth every penny. My husband and I have been to New York a couple times before, but this is the best way to experience the city in one day. Now we know where we want to go for the last few days of our trip. You’ve got to do the tour in the beginning of your trip, to save you time, money and see where you want to revisit.

We had a great time. Rachel was our tour guide, and she knew all kinds of interesting information about the city. Arlos was our driver, and he was a pro. He got us everywhere efficiently and safely. I would recommend this tour for anyone wanting a snapshot of the city.

We went on this tour as it was our first trip to New York and it was really fun and informative. It’s a quality experience as you see so many sights with a knowledgeable tour guide and driver ( Anthony is fab!) . We enjoyed every minute - thoroughly recommended.

Last weekend, we had a fabulous trip to New York City! Our guide Ms. Rachel was simply awesome, she is knowledgeable and sweet in nature. I will highly recommend this sightseeing company, and if possible ask for Rachel, she is truly an outstanding personality. After this trip now I know a lot of facts and history of New York City only because of her. My sincere thanks go to Ms. Rachel for an unforgettable noon. :)

The guide did an excellent job. The criticism is that some of the places in description are glossed over on the tour. I would hardly call the Staten Island Ferry as a “Luxury boat” for the harbor cruise. Lincoln Center was just a drive by. Central Park consisted of seeing the “Imagine” tile memorial or John Lennon.
They should have allowed more time to roam the 911 Memorial as well as time for lunch. Overall I thought it was just an ok tour.

Went on this tour with my 10 year old son and wow!! This is just what we needed! Tyler was so nice and very knowledgeable. She did an awesome job keeping everyone together and even took some pics for me. I really loved this experience and so did my son!! We will definitely book with USA Guided tours again. Our driver did an amazing job as well. We got to keep the top of the bus open for the most part which was another great feature! It rained a little but still enjoyed the tour and bus. Highly recommend if you want to see some key landmarks in NYC in one day.

Hands down the best experience we had in New York! Our tour guide Rachel was very knowledgeable. We learned so much about New York. I wish we would have done this tour on our first day so we could have visited all the sites and areas that she talked about. Definitely the best way to see the city.

We came in New York for only 4 days. We had so much fun in our city tour! We’ve enjoy our tour guide and even our driver. We had Martin as our tour guide which he has sense of humor and highly informative. Juan was a good driver by ensuring that everyone saw those attractions. They are beyond my expectations. Thank You alot! From - Missouri

This tour was perfect for us. We were only going to be in NYC for one day and wanted a tour that hits all the sites we were interested in. We never would have seen all these things on our own.
Our tour guide was amazing. She was so knowledgeable about all things NY! She was also friendly and funny. Had lots of patience with the older folks. Answered everyone's questions. Bravo!!

We had a great time on this tour. Our tour guide Michael was a human encyclopedia, and our driver manwell didn't miss a beat on picking us up and navigating through new York traffic. Very international and saw most of Manhattan in this time. Didnt care for Fulton 55 for lunch. It is a supermarket with a food on the inside. Recommended going to other restaurants nearby. Would definitely recommend to friends and family!

Wow what a great first day in New York! Tyler was our guide and she was Amazing! My kids (17-22) and I are only in town for 3.5 days and spent our first full day on the tour. Not o my did we see most major sites, but the narrative was wonderful. We learned about the landmarks and she also gave us tips as we went. I now understand the street system, subway, food, and will se. An extra show while here thanks to Tyler’s tips. This trip was worth every penny and I can’t recommend it highly enough.

Better late than never! I took a tour back in October with Gil all through New York City.It was FABULOUS!!!😀 I have been to New York about eight times. I never had a tour as fun as the one we went on with Gail. He was so-o-o knowledgeable about the city! His personality was perfect for this job. There was a little kid on this long tour. Gil kept him interested by engaging him in conversation about several sites along the way. As thorough as this tour was, I would take it again just because it was such an enjoyable day! Thank you - Cathy Dettore

This tour was fabulous and worth every penny! Our tour guide, Rachel, was extremely knowledgeable and a take charge kind of person. These qualities served the tour group well. I will definitely take this tour again during my next visit to New York!

I like that we were able to see a little bit of the highlights in NYC, at a reasonable cost. We did not spend much time in any one area except for the central park, and 9/11 memorial which was very special. The ferry boat ride was great and appreciate that it was at no additional cost, but would have been nice to get on a boat that was a little closer to the Statue of Liberty. It is a good price for the experience in one day.

A wonderful way to see all the attractions at a glance and then decide which ones to go back and see for longer. Our guide Rhonda was so knowledgeable and has a wonderful and easy way of sharing all the history and all that's current. The driver was so accomodating too.

Tim was an awesome tour guide. So knowledgeable. Shared so many interesting facts about NYC. Worth the extra funds to be in the Glass/Open Top Van (seats 15 but we only had 11 on our tour). And being in a smaller group just makes the tour that much better. Very clear instructions on where to go and what to do during the tour. Miguel was our awesome driver that took good care taking us around the city. I cannot recommend this tour highly enough! Tim and Miguel, thanks for a lovely and informative day from your friends from CANADA!

It was an amazing day to experience so many highlights of the Big Apple. Don't want to exaggerate but Rachel was the best tour guide I've ever experienced. She gave great information while being engaging and fun to listen to! Everything was well organized.

Would highly recommend this tour!

Tim was great! Clearly knew his history! He had so much knowledge. Learnt so much! Thank you :) lots of stops off the bus too which was great. It’s hard to see everything in a short trip so this was a great way to see a bit of everything.

We were determined to enjoy NYC even though just before we got on a plane Broadway was shut down for coronavirus. As we were here other things..stores, gyms, museums began to close. Our tour didn’t cancel and it was amazing. We got to see so much since there were less people and our tour guides were informed and knew how to get more in. Dina and Tony our driver added small fun things in and made my 15 year old daughters first visit memorable..and up til then it was memorable for the closures only. Thank you Dina and Tony for the extra special attention and time. I highly recommend this tour ..and go early in your visit ..there will be things you want to go back to!!

Brooklyn Jim made the tour very enjoyable with a ton of facts and always kept the group entertained. He taught us a lot that I would have never known just traveling to New York. Manie our driver was very impressive with his driving skills and maneuverability with the luxury bus. Definitely the best tour I’ve ever had!

Rachel was our guide and she did a phenomenal job showing us NY in one day. Her personality is not for everyone cause she’s ALL business, but she wants you to have the best experience and will throw her weight around to get you the best scenic
Sights so we were very pleased with her. She hands out a paper with all her “favorites” listed and we took her advice and she was spot on! Thanks Rachel! 😘
Fast pace tour, which you learn up front and you better be in shape!🥴
Lots of walking and information thrown at you at one time but the best way to see NY in one day or discover things you wanna see while visiting.
Rachel also was a huge help in maneuvering the subway, learning the street directions and handling panhandlers.Like I said before, she was all business but soooo helpful in every aspect of your trip!

Our tour guide was knowledgeable and enthusiastic. He did a great job! The only problem was that we were left behind on Staten Island! We were supposed to follow him after arriving. We were following for a bit then could no longer see him. Four of us missed the return ferry and had to take the one 30 minutes later. After that, we never found the tour again. It would have been helpful to have an emergency phone number to call.

Our favorite part of the tour was our guide Steve! Definitely one of the best tour guides we’ve ever had. He was so knowledgeable! You could tell he has a passion for his job and loves the city he lives in. Steve went out of his way to make sure everyone had an enjoyable tour and day. He was so friendly and happy to answer any questions people had, whether on the tour or not. Would highly recommend it to any and everyone! Juan was a wonderful driver as well. They make a great team.

First time in New York for our family. I highly recommend this for new visitors. Do it early on during your visit and you will learn so much about the city. Rachel was fantastic—very knowledgeable and she has a strategy at every stop to make the trip safe, efficient, and enjoyable.

This was an amazing and very informative trip through Manhattan! Tim was very engaging, he is very knowledgeable about NYC, we had a great time and saw so many interesting places. Thank you Rachael for driving us too. If you want an intimate tour, this is it.

Seeing all the memorable sights in nyc from Central Park to The Statue of Liberty. An excellent way to see the city and learn its history. Rachel was knowledgeable, helpful and willing to take photos whenever she was asked. We would not have learnt anywhere near the history and interesting facts of the city had we not done this tour. Even explaining how to use the subway was an added bonus which we would not have been able to do without her advice. Many thanks to Rachel for an excellent day.

Highly recommend this tour, great way to cover the sights in one day.
Manny was a great driver and and our guide Joey was very knowledgable and entertaining.
The bus was very comfortable and tour was well organised.

Rachael was our guide and Anthony our driver and they were both first class. A 6 hour tour which took in a vast majority of the sites for a tourist just having arrived in nyc.
Next time we come back with our son we will book this your again and if Rachel is the guide it will be fab
Thanks

We did the 6 hour open bus and boat tour. We got off and on the bus at several locations and took the Staten Island Ferry across the river to see The Statue of Liberty. Got to see a lot of popular sites in our short time in NY City. Nice views from the bus and good opportunities for pictures. Hard to hear the tour guide, at times, from the back of the bus.

Overall, this tour was very pleasant, thanks to our guide, Vinny. He was knowledgeable, personable, and very amusing. In addition, he was very caring. When he found out I was in need of a bandaid, he actually went on his lunch to get me some. He was a godsend; talk about service! It was a beautiful day and I was glad I picked the open-top bus, as it is the best way to see the sites. The only downside was the Staten Island ferry portion of the trip. You are herded onto the ferry only to get to Staten Island and turn right around and come back. There must be a better way as there was no narration or explanation of what we were seeing. Not the best use of our time. The ground portion of the trip was much better, thanks to Vinny.

This is a trip worth doing if this is your first time in NYC. Not only do you get to see all the attractions Rachel and jhonny gave us some great tips on how to survive in new york and given the best places to eat. I felt more confident in this city after the trip. Just bear in mind that the tour will be closed top and you won't get too long at each bit. This never bothered me but may bother others

Awesome tour! Brandon (a native New Yorker) was our guide and a wealth of information! The tour was a great way to see a lot of the city. Can't say enough about Brandon's knowledge. He literally knew something about every corner of the city. Juan was our driver, expertly manuevering through the crazy traffic. Thanks to both Brandon and Juan for a great experience and tour!

Overall, we had a great day touring New York with our guide Rachel. She was knowledgeable and extremely friendly and helpful. I would recommend this tour to anyone wanting to see the best parts of New York in one day.

A relaxed and very informative and entertaining tour! So many highlights, I never would have been able to see it all and get the depth of knowledge left to my own devices. Comfortable bus with several stops for sights and stretching and breaks, perfect balance of sitting and walking! I am recommending this tour to everyone even if you have more than one day. Do this on your FIRST day and you will have a great picture of where you want to explore more thoroughly.

Saw most of New York's iconic landmarks. It was a good mixer of walking and riding. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and friendly and made sure we got all of our pictures. The last part of the tour takes a ferry to and from Staten Island and PASSES the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island. A 30 min ride each way. So if you wanted to stop at the Statue of Liberty this doesn't do that.

Rachel was an AMAZING guide. I’m not sure how long she’s been doing this but she and the driver were so well coordinated. I’d recommend Rachel specifically to all of my friends. This is my third time to NYC and I learned more now than ever thanks to Rachel.

A great day very informative Rachael was an excellent guide, friendly and with a good sense of humour. We went to many of the iconic New York City sights. Rachael was a entertaining guide. It was my travelling companions first visit to New York and she loved the tour

Excellent Tour. The best way to see Manhattan in 1 day. My 10 year old daughter was with me and also enjoyed the day. Our tour guide Gil was exceptional, easy to listen to and very informative. Highly recommend.

The best way to see much of the city in a short amount of time. This tour allowed us to pin down where we wanted to send time during the rest of our trip. The bus was comfortable and the tour guide was knowledgeable and fun.

Perfect way to hit the highlights and learn some history along the way. The combination of riding and walking is great. The 6 hours go by in a flash. Our tour guide was friendly and knowledgeable, and our driver didn’t scare me half to death. 👍👍

A great experience made even better by "Brooklyn Jim." My son and I (12 yrs old) took this tour and we both had an awesome time. The experience was certainly enhanced by our guide "Brooklyn Jim" who had personality for days.

If you can get him as your guide I would highly recommend him. Overall a good value for money trip and we're glad we took it.

Excellent day. Tour covered a large section of Manhattan and gave a good overview of the area. Helped to inform is of sights we wanted to explore further. Good level of interesting information given by the guide. Bus was comfortable and clean.

Tyler was our tour guide, she was so fun and knowledgeable!! Our driver was Manny and he was terrific too. The tour gave us a wonderful overview of the many facets of New York City. Tyler gave us great tips on how to navigate the city on our own too! I will definitely I rely recommend this tour to others. Thank you for a great day!

What a great way to introduce you to NYC! Very very informative. You get a very small taste in this 6 hour tour of what NYC has to offer. Our tour guide was FANTASTIC!!!! He kept things moving and gave a tons of information places, people, and the many things to do. We stopped several times to see some sights —Central Park, Rockafeller Center, And Staten Is. the tour bus was comfortable and water is offered. Gave lots of tips on getting around, places to eat, and certain places to make sire to see . Roy was the driver, and I think the guide was Daniel?? Sorry! This is a GREAT TOUR—a must if your new , or not new to NYC!

Good information. Very polite guides. Would have been nice to see the Brooklyn bridge since it was close by. Spending less time at Staten Island and more at some other stops would have been great. But still good value at the start of a trip to get to know your way around.

This is a great way to get a look at some of the top places to see in the area. You then can go back at your own pace and spend more time later. Our guide was fantastic and so knowledgeable of the history and facts. It was a small group and very easy to follow and hear the guide when we were off the bus. I would highly recommend this tour!

My family very much enjoyed this tour. Lots of NYC historical facts with tidbits of information about current life in the city. Our tour guide Rachel and driver Manny were fantastic!! Highly recommend.

Never having been to New York before, this is a great way to initially experience the city. Mike, our tour guide was very knowledgeable and made everything very interesting! We saw all the sights that you would expect, all in a timely manner! We only had the day, so this worked well for us! The driver, Pedro, and Mike coordinated well together for the drop offs and pick ups on the way round. We were never left waiting for more than a minute or so before we got back on the bus! I would highly recommend this tour as an introduction to New York!

Rachel was a charming and knowledgeable guide to nyc highpoints. Lots of history and also tourist tips. Great way to have an overview of the city...in a New York "minute"....rushed but worth it to cover key points... recommend it!

(Note: rest stops and brief lunch stop included!)
A great way to do New York in a day! Tim and Manny were awesome! We learned so much history and trivia. They made sure we could get all of the pictures we wanted also. 100% recommend this tour!

I highly recommend this tour. Carlos was our driver and Gil was our tour guide. Carlos was great at navigating the narrow streets and traffic. Gil was so knowledgeable about everything New York. The 6 hour tour covered a lot of sights. We would have never been able to see and do all we did on our own.

Highly recommend this tour. Even though I’ve been to NYC multiple times I still learned a lot!! Tour guide Tim was informative and gave plenty of suggestions and bathroom breaks! Our driver Manuel was great and navigated us safely to each destination. They provided masks and cold water on the bus.

Gil was our tour guide. This company needs to understand what a valuable asset he is. His knowledge and passion for the city was contagious. Wonderful energy and enthusiasm. Answered any questions very personable. Anthony the driver was a true professional amazing how he navigated the chaotic city. Highly recommend.

Took this tour on the Saturday after Thanksgiving. It was my first time to NYC and I loved all that we saw on the tour. Our guide Mike was great...born and raised there and so knowledgeable. Our driver Jose was also a great guy. felt it was great value for the money spent. Thank you Mike and Jose for a great tour!!!

Truly worth every penny. Very informative, interesting, and VERY FUN. Rachel is THE BEST!!! She kept everything and everyone moving along, but I still didn't feel rushed. She makes sure everyone gets the best pictures. Lunch stop and bathroom breaks are well managed.

Tyler was amazing! Full of interesting facts. So glad we booked this tour rather than to try and navigate on our own. If you’re short on time and want to see the major attractions, book this tour! Worth every penny.

The best way to see New York in a day!! The guide Rachel was fantastic- sooo much interesting information given through every step of the day. I can’t believe how much we saw and learnt about in a short space of time. The route is well thought out and good pace. I don’t usually take tours but so glad I did as I would never have known all the cool facts and seen so much of the city!! I would 100% recommend.

Our tour with Walter and Manny was amazing! Fun yet informative and completely worth the money. It was personalized to fit the group’s interests and absolutely did not feel like 6 hours. It was extremely hot outside but Manny kept the bus cool and Walter always found us shade. The tour was very much a high level overview of the city. He gave us recommendations if we want to come back though and do a more in depth tour of the areas. The ferry was very scenic and even though you literally get on, off and back on again it was nice especially in the heat. There’s a bit of walking but nothing crazy. Lunch was just a pit stop so you should schedule any local NY experience eateries outside this tour. Probably not ideal for super young kids. Plenty of bathroom breaks in clean areas as well! If you liked history tours and field trips in school you’ll like this!

Highly recommended! It is worth the price. We literally got to see pretty much everything possible in NY. Our tour guide Don and Driver was awesome. They not only had a lot of information about all the sights we saw today. But, Don was very funny too!
Mahalo 🤙🏼from Hawaii ❤️

Brilliant experience! We saw so much in one day it was incredible. Steve and Betty our tour guide and driver were excellent. So, good at their jobs and made the day so much fun. Highly enjoyed and definitely recommend to anyone doing a short stay in NYC

Bus was one hour and half late! Tour guide was good but we had to stand there and wait on bus for nearly 2 hours. Tour felt rushed because we were so behind schedule. Requested refund because we missed out on another event we had scheduled next. Sent email and didn't get a response.

Steve was an excellent tour guide that was enthusiastic about his role. He made a great impression on our team and ensured that we all stayed together and on track. Highly recommend he and his partner, Juan, when visiting the city.

Six hours passed so quickly. So much wonderful information, a fabulous convertible van, a small group of friendly tour companions and tour guide Brooklyn Jim with Anthony driving to lead the way. What a great experience. If you can go, then go. It's worth every penny; what a great way to see NYC.

Gil was an excellent guide with a library of nyc knowledge. His local anecdotes added a whole dimension to the tour. We had a beautiful day for the tour which you just can't plan for. Our driver was professional and we were always on time. Great tour.

Our leader was Dina. She managed to hit all the advertised hot spots despite the traffic ten days before Christmas. We’ve been to NYC before, but due to colder weather we decided to do a tour. It was five stars!

Our guide, Steve, was very knowledgeable about the different buildings. I especially enjoyed the history behind the architecture.

Steve did a very good job of instilling the sacred nature of Ground Zero, teaching our group what was considered respectful and disrespectful.

The thing our tour struggled with was the unexpected delays.

There was a protest march over Brooklyn Bridge and down Broadway that was planned and put into place overnight. We had specifically chosen this tour because it took us to the Brooklyn Bridge, a bridge my wife’s great-grandfather had helped build.

Another unexpected delay was a traffic accident. Another NYC driver rear-ended us at a stop light. It happens. Life goes on. Nothing we can do about it, but just keep smiling and be thankful nobody got injured.

If you are considering this tour, I highly recommend it. My tour guide Rachel, gave so much interesting information throughout the tour that you never get bored! She was very entertaining and kept the trip exciting. With all the stops and different sights you pass, it feels like you get to see all of NY in this one tour. If possible ask for Rachel!! You won't regret it!!

Great overview of must see spots in NYC. Fit a lot in , within given time without feeling rushed. Nice bus, comfortable and make water available. Guide knew his history and had everything planed out in perfect timing

Had 1 day to plan a tour of the city.
This was perfect. It was a speed tour and Rhonda & Miguel were great. Rhonda was very informative and had great knowledge of NYC. We would recommend if you are looking for a quick but great tour. BTW the closed bus help with the unexpected heat.

I extremely enjoyed the tour. We got to all of the things we want to see and more. Our tour guide Brooklyn Jim very knowledgeable and delightfully entertaining. Moreover, the tour was a very efficient use of our limited vacation time. You should definitely add this to list of things to do if you are vacationing in New York City!

Don, our tour guide was wonderful; very knowledgeable & fun. I wish I could've got an open top ticket though, to be able to take pics that weren't blurry with windows, that's my fault of course. I feel bad I didn't carry cash for a tip, definitely worth it! The only downside was I wish the tour included some time on Staten Island. Overall though, very good experience.

This tour was a fantastic way to see many sights at one time! Of course the sights were great to see but what was even better was the history, stories and information that Rachel provided throughout the tour. I’m so glad that Rachel was our guide. Not only did we see a lot, we learned a lot!

Had an amazing day on the tour. We were able to see so many of the things I was excited about-Times Square, Statue of Liberty, Central Park, 9/11, Broadway…our guide, Rachael, was excellent. She provided structure with historical knowledge, appreciation for architecture and humor. So lucky we were able to navigate all the traffic and enjoy every minute of the day.

Gil and Jose make an amazing team. Gil our tour guide was informative, organized and kept us moving. We never felt rushed. We learned so many things we never even knew before and we live in NY. Jose never kept us waiting , he was always at the ready. Excellent driver .I felt very safe . I would definitely recommend a tour with Gil as your guide and José at the helm. P.S. Gil was right about the pizza. Amazing. A+ tour!!

My mother and I went on the all day sightseeing tour. It was excellent! We saw all the important places in NYC. Our guide, Don was so informative. He shared lots of interesting history and tidbits that we will remember. The driver, Juan did an excellent job maneuvering through the crowded streets. We went on a Saturday which was excellent as it was less busy. There was more walking than expected but we felt like you couldn’t have had the same experience without it. And the walking was broken up throughout the tour. ‘Y only suggestion would be to have lunch in the Staten Island Ferry terminal rather than at the market. Overall, highly recommend this tour!

Our guide, Rachel was amazing, very knowledgeable and funny too. Just been to see Wicked, on Rachel’s recommendation to join the evening lottery. Wonderful show. She gave us lots of hints and advice to make the most of our stay here in New York.

Would recommend the tour to anyone, particularly, if you are a first time visitor.

Steve was the best tour guide. He showed everything we wanted to see in New York on the tour. Time went by so fast and my group enjoyed every minute of it. Absolutely wonderful, delightful and funny. Steve keep us laughing and entertained with the history of New York the whole six hours.
From the Texas Group a big thanks!

Money will spent! We knocked out pretty much everything we wanted to see on a WARM bus. It was so cold the day we went, this was perfect for us! Martin Kelly was a great tour guide. He is genuinely happy person and you can tell he loves his job. He was very knowledgeable about everything. I can't say enough good things about him. Betty was our driver and she was amazing. You have to have quick reflexes driving in the city.i was so excited to ride on the ferry. I thought it was seasonal so I'm glad we got to do it! It was a great experience. You will not regret this tour!

Our tour guide, Steve, and driver, Alex, were really great!! Steve had the best sense of humor and has a wealth of knowledge. We learned more than we could have imagined. Not only was he a great guy, he has a massive amount of empathy. He helped an elderly woman throughout the tour get around and his respect at the 9/11 memorials was very appreciated. Alex also made sure we got around safely. Upgrade to the open top - it’s worth it! Highly recommend you do this on your first day of your NYC trip. Loved it!!

Rachel was our guide, and she was so informative! I've taken this tour a few times, and she was by far the best I've ever had. Very friendly, helpful, and was easy to understand with the microphone on. Saw an amazing amount of the city in just a few hours. I loved the small group setting vs. large double decker bus. My only suggestion would be to get the shocks on the van fixed. Very squeaky, and somewhat distracting. Otherwise, I highly recommend this tour!

Martin Kelly is a *fantastic* guide! He is so full of energy and joy and enthusiasm, for both his city and the people under his care. Martin, you were the highlight of our trip. From Lowell and Carol, the folks from Manhattan, Kansas, the Little Apple.

My family of 4 took this tour on July 4, 2021 and had a great time. Our guide Rachel and driver Ray were wonderful. Rachel was very knowledgeable and entertaining. We had our kids age 8 and 11 and this was a good way to see a lot of NYC with them. They loved some of the stories and tips Rachel had to share with us. I would recommend this tour 100%, for anyone that wants to see it all, but doesn't know how.

It was our first time in NYC and we would never have seen everything we did if we tried to go out on our own. We had a party of 7, including kids and we were able to get out at quite a few places, it was awesome! We felt safe and informed. Rachel is a great tour guide!

If you are looking for a comfortable tour with the opportunity to see many of the popular sites in NYC this is it! This tour allowed us to see and learn about many of the popular places in NYC. From the Central Park, to the 9/11 Museum and Memorial, and cruising on the Ferry to the Statue of Liberty and back, and way more in between this was the best tour I have taken in NYC. Our tour guide Mike was the BEST! Very knowledgeable and even gave us directions for taking the subway to our next stop after the tour. Both Mike and our driver Betty were the epitome of professional and friendly. We could of rode around with them more!

Our tour guide was awesome! Friendly, very informative with a wonderful sense of humor. Loved the tour.

Disappointed we couldn't get closer to Ellis Island and the Statue of Liberty.

Would have liked an hour for lunch instead of 30 minutes and did not like where we were taken...there were no table and chairs. You had to find an outdoor bench in the area to sit on with your plate on your lap and your drink sitting on the ground. Area was not very nice...somewhat trashy.

Really enjoyed this tour. Great overview of New York City. Our guide Steve was exceptional. Funny, informative, and extremely knowledgeable he made the tour really enjoyable. Especially liked the reverence he showed for the 9/11 memorial. Highly recommend this tour and Steve.

Amazing time! Gil and Manuel were excellent, cannot say enough good things about them.

Only complaint, the bus that we had, the a/c was not working properly, but.... things happen, and that would not discourage me from using them again.

This was the best tour ever! Our tour guide Tyler is very knowledgeable and knows New York history inside and out. She told us things about New York that you wouldn’t read in a book. Great experience and my favorite part of New York! Our driver Manny and she made a great team! Would do it again in a heartbeat!

The van was completely full, not one empty seat, so no social distancing. The guides mask was never covering his nose. Unless you were sitting right next to the window you couldn’t see anything. It was really boring. We ended up getting off the van after an hour and leaving the tour. It was as a huge waste of time and money.

Our trip was small and absolutely brilliant from start to finish.
Our guide Rhonda was a such a lovely lady, lots of fun and a beautiful soul.
I can’t fault the trip in any way and can’t recommend it enough.
We even managed to see Hugh Jakeman at the end of the trip!
Thank you

Vinny, our tour guide, and Carlos, our driver, were a great duo! We splurged for the upgrade of open top, and I’m glad we did. It is a separate small van, and by the end our group was like family. Highly recommend this tour! We saw all of the big things to see in New York in a few hours!

We felt the tour was too rushed but our tour guide Rachel was excellent. She gave us detailed indo about the history of the places we saw. She gave us tips on where to eat and where to buy the items we wanted/needed. Rachel gets five stars!

First our tour guide Rachel was incredible. She knew times when we would arrive when we needed to leave for the next event or stop. She talked the whole time. Just full of so much history great adventure and how to handle everything from subway the different of uptown and downtown & east vs west. I loved all the movie references and the TV shows where they were filmed. Just awesome. So much information and sites.

Steve was an absolutely fantastic tour guide with facts and tidbits every block. It was so enjoyable to hear his experiences and knowledge about New York.

For a first timer outside of my home state of California, I greatly appreciate the superb customer service and detailed expectations of the trip.

It’s hard to give something a 10/10, but this definitely was one. Thank you Steve! This is definitely a memory to keep forever.

The bus was freezing cold. Traffic slowed every down do no lunch by 1:30. Didn’t do Staten Island Ferry to get lunch for seniors with us. Waited 2+ hours to rejoin group. When they hadn’t come we bailed after calling the office to alert the guide of our departure. Other things interesting

I took this tour with my daughter in September 2021 and really enjoyed it. But I took it last week with a friend who had never been to NYC before and I was a little disappointed. Our guide, Brendon or Brandon…something like that, was kind of a jerk. He was really just going through the motions of the tour and I felt like it was a chore to him. I saw the guide we had last year with another group and I was jealous. I knew they were getting a good tour. We saw the same main sites as last year, as well as some new ones since we took a different route through town. So that was nice. I wouldn’t say to not take this tour, but just hope you get one of the good guides mentioned in other reviews.

Just got back from a great tour with Rachel and Manny. Glass top bus with approx 14 passengers. Done the hop on off buses previously but with this the guide gets off and continues with the info. Just short stops but you get to see a lot of New York so you can decide where to visit another time. As we were only here for 2 days it suited us perfectly.
Rachel’s knowledge and passion for her city is infectious. You won’t be disappointed

We truly enjoyed our 6 hour tour of NYC with Tyler as our guide. She was extremely knowledgeable and made our trip a 5 star experience. The history and architecture was fascinating. I would highly recommend this tour company and in particular Tyler as a guide. Her recommendation of Ben's Kosher Deli on 38th street was spot on also.

Our tour guide was excellent!
Our driver Manny and our guide Brendan were great They made our tour so interesting. Brendan is so knowledgeable about all the history of NYC. We were so glad we took this tour as we were limited for time and would never have seen all the things that we did.

Would highly recommend this tour to anyone.

The only thing I wish was done differently. I wish we would have had more time at the 911 memorial. Maybe cutting out the ferry ride. It was nice but it didn't give us much time. Or maybe shortened the Central Park tour.

A confused start of the day when the meeting place was occupied with the theater rebuild crew. A new York minute recovery had us boarding around the corner. A very comfortable bus for the day with air-conditioning and water ready at all times. Many stops for off bus experience. Guide was fairly knowledgeable about the city.
Great day. Brenden, our tour guide, did a super job. Very informative. Would recommend. The sites were well chosen and spent the perfect amount of time at each. Kudos to our driver as well.

Tim was a great tour guide. This was a perfect one-day introduction to NYC and hit the highlights tour. I only wish it could have been a double decker open air bus. It was a smaller van type experience. Well air conditioned with big windows.

Tim Douglas was our guide for this extensive and awesome tour. Not sure the tour would've been so great w/o Tim. He did a fabulous job of educating us on so much NYC history and activities. So happy we did this tour with our 20-year-old son. This was our first leisure trip to NYC and we did the tour early in our stay. It was 6 hours that flew by and we could've stayed for more. That’s how much we enjoyed it. Thanks Tim!!

Our guide, Jerry, was amazing. We learned so many interesting facts and history of New York. I could have used another bathroom stop after lunch. There needs to be some sign or something to let people know where to check in. There was another bus company in the same place and we got all confused with them. The only way I knew where you were was the guy from the other bus company said maybe I was with that group down there.

This was a comprehensive and interesting tour...our tour guide (Rob) was wonderful and knew the City well! It was a long day...but, happily, we got to see a lot of the City with a wonderful narrative. This tour included lots of walking...so be prepared. Stops were well timed and well managed. Bathrooms were available at two locations. I highly recommend.
We covered so much ground and thanks to Rachel and Johnny for taking extra special care of our tour experience. Highly recommend Scythia tour as your first stop in NYC. Thank you

Wonderful day with Brooklyn Jim and our driver, Gustavo. Our whole family had a wonderful time and saw so much. Guide gave us great tips and amazing info about the city and took us to try amazing NY pizza. I have already recommended to others planning a trip

My mom and I really loved this tour with Rachel and Arlis. We learned a lot about the city. She got a lot of pictures of us and kept us out of traffic. She gave us some specific helpful information about saving money on shows, etc, which was helpful. We especially liked the part when she took is through 9/11. Some of the areas that were listed on the tour we didn't go to because the traffic was too bad. Overall, I wasn't upset about that because I didn't really want to sit in the crazy New York traffic. I think it was better that we got to see more. Overall, we are very happy with this tour.

Our guide, Tyler was a fantastic host for our tour. So informative and a great story teller. This trip, of all our excursions in NYC was by far, the best. Hit all the top destinations all from the comfort of our seats. The open air bus was the perfect way to experience the city. Worth every penny and would do it again in a heartbeat!! Reserve with Tyler if you are able!!!

We saw everything in 6 hours. Our tour was so comfortable. We had the luxury bus with the clear top. Our guide was totally awesome. Very informative and great personality. Her name was Rachael and no-one could have done a better job!!
Thank you so much for a wonderful tour in NY!!
Jacque M.

Very good tour, comfortable mini bus, saw areas we would never have seen. Tyler our guide was lovely and extremely knowledgable about New York, you can tell she loves where she lives. We learnt a lot about this wonderful city. The only disappointment was that we didn't get to go to grand central as stated in the itinerary, this was in place of boat trip, but didn't get either. Would recommend this tour if it's your 1st time in New York.

Pack in the most you can in this tour! Gabby was an excellent tour guide. I appreciate that the tour bus had bottled water on the hot summer day. There was much more walking than I expected. Wear walking shoes.(Hit well over 10,000 steps).

The tour was amazing! We got to see everything we wanted and more. Brooklyn Jim and Manuel were wonderful and made our experience unforgettable. Our daughter hasn't stopped talking about the ferry ride, Statue of Liberty, ice cream, and pizza - but best of all, the Macy's store! So grateful that we were able to use the remaining tour time to see it. We really appreciated not only the knowledge of our guide, but also the friendliness. He was willing to take pictures for us at every spot. Highly recommend!

Rachel was a fantastic tour guide. If you're wondering if this tour is worth the cost (like I was), DO IT. We learned so much and saw so many more things than we would've on our own. It's meant to give you just a taste of NYC - and then you can figure out where you want to go back to. Even my teenage kids liked it - and they're hard to please. I would recommend this to any tourist to NYC!

We had a great experience with our 6-hour guided tour of Manhattan with Gil leading the way. He was knowledgeable, personable, and accommodating. He kept up the energy level, and we learned so much from him. It was a great way to experience all the best spots in Manhattan in one day in a comfortable, air-conditioned van.

Tyler was the best tour guide. There is no better way to see so much of New York at this price and in such a short yet not too short of time. We had about 23 people on our tour from all over the globe. We loved every minute.

Jim was the best tour guide!!! Made it an amazing day! Highly recommend. Great stories and historical facts. Very funny and witty. All delivered with old school NY charm. Our 2 kids, 10 and 13, loved it. Nice all glass top Mercedes Benz bus, smaller bus and felt like a private tour.

A wonderful experience of New York for our first visit. Dana was very informative and an enjoyable host. Jimmy was our driver and amazing at navigating the crowded streets.
It definitely makes us want to return to see more.

Took a 14 year old for her 1st trip to NYC. She never complained that she was bored or tired, which anyone with a teenager knows is huge! Just the right amount of riding & walking. Covered the major sites with interesting & informative back stories. Would definitely do this again!

I have been to New York several times but decided to do a city tour this time. I am so glad I did. The tour was absolutely amazing. I learned so much and saw so many new things. Our tour guide, Rachel, was MAGNIFICENT. I literally felt so sorry for the other people I saw on different tours. I 100% recommend this tour - at least with Rachel!!

Very informative. Jerry was entertaining and knowledgeable. He gave some good insight to how New York is layed out and the history. Reccomend this tour if you want to see many place in a short amount of time. Good picture opportunities.

Loved the tour! Our guide, Rachel, was amazing. More than a tour…it was a learning experience on how the city developed. Her knowledge on every part of tour was amazing and she made sure we took pictures at the most memorable spots. Very highly recommend, especially if you can get on Rachel’s bus.

The ride was fun, comfortable and the guide very polite. I just consider it was too fast when it came to see the iconic stops of New York. Just a brief passing and very little time for pictures. Basically it was here is this and that and we recommend you come back on your own.
Everything. Joey (tour guide) and Carlos (luxury tour bus driver) were fantastic. Very comprehensive. There isn't much Joey doesn't know about the history of New York, and the sites we visited.

The weather was wet and misty as we set out on this tour. But Tim made sure that we made the most of our time despite the weather. We found especially moving Tim's tour of the 9/11 site.

Good choice of lunch options - something for everyone at Fulton.

All in all it was a great scene setter for our long weekend in the Big Apple

What an amazing tour this turned out to be! Martin Kelly was our tour guide and Betty was our driver. They were an excellent team! Martin went above and beyond to show us everything there is to see in our 6 hours together. You can tell he’s lived here all his life! My family and I enjoyed ourselves. I’m so glad I booked this tour. You will not be disappointed if you do!

Took this tour on October 7, 2021 and it was wonderful thanks to our tour guide Rachel. She was entertaining, organized, flexible and knowledgeable. I learned and saw so many things about NY. I highly recommend this tour with Rachel if possible.

Central Park in the rain, statue of liberty, everything. Would prefer not so much ancient history and more current history. Very little info or guidance at ground zero. Was not the best tour the last 2 hours.Nathan is very knowledgeable but got tired of the history class.

Perhaps the best tour that I have ever taken. Great driver. Great guide. I had never been to NYC before and this tour was an outstanding way to see some of the main sights in Manhattan all in one day. Our guide, Mike, was the best guide that I have ever had for any attraction at any location. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Our guide Steve and driver Carlos were the best! This was my first time in NYC. Steve was very informative and knew MYC like the back of his hand. If you have never been to NYC, I would highly recommend this tour! I can't wait to go back!

Rachel was the best tour guide. The tour Raines the entire time, but Rachel kept the group engaged and made the whole day awesome. As first time visitors, this tour was perfect. We saw so many fantastic sites and places in NYC. Would recommend this tour to all our friends.

GIL WAS GREAT!!
Full of energy, loaded with fun facts about all things New York! He was personable, funny and insightful. As entertaining as he is informative, I've gotta say he's the best tour guide out there. Ya can't beat Gil!
With Love from Chicago and PA!!

My wife and I have been to NYC many times but never did a tour. We had a great time. Definitely money well spent. Our Tour Guide, Martin, was AWESOME!!! He definitely has a passion for his job and his city!!

Nathan was our tour guide and was awesome! The tour was very good! So glad we signed up for this. Just wonderful in the glass topped van with only 13 of us tourists . Way better than those big bus tours with too many people to keep track of. Thank you, Nathan!! Loved it!

This was our first trip to New York City. We decided on this tour because of the great reviews on Trip Advisor. So glad we did. Brooklyn Jim was a great tour guide. He explained the ins & outs of the city & was a great guide. Got to see many things within the city in one day. Would highly recommend taking this tour. The bus was very comfortable. The driver & guide were very accommodating.

Jose was great driver and kept us moving along. Mike was informative and interactive, and kept us all together. The tour was just as described and gave us great suggestions for our next time in NYC. We learned a lot more about NYC in this tour.

Was looking for a city tour on our last day in NY. Found this on the RCI website. A 6 hour tour ending with a ride on the Staten Island ferry. Turned out to be excellent! Nathan was a great guide; native New Yorker and fully versed on everything NY. Stopped at Central Park, Rock Ctr, Mad Square Park, lunch at Fulton Market. Juan was an excellent driver. Would recommend highly.

Terrific tour guide and driver. Our tour guide Gil was very well through and in details; and drive was smooth and very convenient with Anthony. It absolutely worth the time and I will definitely book again. It was tom of wonderful information and oriented me to the areas we visited greatly. Thank you guys!
An amazing tour. Thank you Steve for everything. We learned so much and made us feel so much more comfortable in the city!! Best part of the trip per my 17 year old daughter.

Our tour guide was great! We got to see so much in such a quick amount of time. I never would have been able to pack all that into a single day on my own. And our guide gave us bits of backstory and history all through the day.

Tyler was our guide. Best guide and tour we have ever taken, and we have done many. She was knowledgable, entertaining, and loves her city. She went above and beyond to include how to get around the city. Great tour to start your trip in NY with a few stops for pictures. Gives you great perspective of the city, so you can plan where to go next. We also used the subway per her suggestions, to save us time and money.

We took the Discovery NY Tour on the Glass-Top Bus with Gil as our guide. Couldn't recommend it enough. Our guide was very knowledgeable and we got to see everything on our list plus a whole lot more.

Such an informative and fun tour. Our guide, Tyler was so fun and knowledgeable. Most importantly, I require the use of a cane and walk slower than most. Tyler was always so kind and accommodating to my needs. She really took care of me and never made me feel like a burden. As a matter of fact she went beyond what I ever expected. I cannot thank her enough. If Tyler is you guide, you will be blessed. Our driver, Anthony did a great job maneuvering us through the city safely.. The cold water was a nice touch too. It was over 90 degrees on the day of our tour.Take this tour! You won't regret it!

My sister, her teenager and I joined Steve for an open top guided day tour around NYC and had the best time. He was funny and told us lots of interesting fun facts. It was the best way to learn and see NYC in a limited time frame. Will totally take my family back on the same tour when I return next time. Thank you!

Our tour guide was Gil. He was wonderful. He has an incredible knowledge bank of New York City. I would totally recommend this tour. We did it on our first day so we would know where we want to go back & visit later in the week. It also helped us understand the set up of the city. Plus the glass top van/bus gave us amazing views. Thanks Gil!!

Me and my boyfriend went. It wasn’t my first time though. I wanted to take my boyfriend on a tour guide around NYC and I chose this one! Soooo glad I did! Our tour guide did the best job! He was sooo knowledgeable about New York! We did the glass top bus and it was sooo cool! If I can give it a 10/10. I would! My boyfriend loved it!
Good job!

This really was a wonderful tour and our guide, Rachel, was excellent. My complaint is they do not tell you how much walking is involved. I left just before Staten Island and the ferry ride and had 5000 steps. My husband completed
The tour and had 10000. Again a great tour. If you have physical limitations please be advised.
