The tour was worth every cent. Our driver Betty guided us safely through the crazy streets of New York. Our guide Gill with so much knowledge of the history of New York. He also had great tips about taking a cab, getting cheap theatre tickets, areas to eat and paying the street buskers. We stopped for lunch at the Trade Centre downstairs. All in all a great day.

This was such a great tour! Great use of our time and the best way to see New York when we have such a short stay here. The energy from our tour guide Rachel was amazing. Very informative and entertaining! Worth every penny!

Rachel our guide was too good and she gave us so Much information on everything.. Great a for 1st time New yorkers! She knew everything and gave us lotsa tops on surviving n enjoying new york! Things to. Eat.. Places must visit,.. Gustav our driver was v good too.. All. In all a lovely day and v hospitable nmko8 welcomed feeling.. Not a typical boring bus tour. 5/5 for the experience.

Great tour. I would recommend doing this on the first of your visit. It touches all of the hot spots in NYC. Well worth it. Bus was comfortable and water bottles were provided. Tour guide was very knowledgeable .

Our tour guide, Joey was informative and delightful to listen to. Joey was the best part of the tour. The actual tour was just ok. Wanted more time at the Statue of Liberty and The Empire State Building. The pass by just wasn’t enough.
This trip was fantastic tour guide Rachel made the day a great way to see New York . It was just the right mix of walking and riding in a comfortable tour bus . This was our best day in New York.

Great way to see New York. Mike was an awesome host. Truly enjoyed every minute! Manuel did a great job navigating and keeping us safe. We even had a brief rain shower right before visiting ground zero. Mike pulled out rain ponchos for us. An amazing day! Thank you!

Loved it! Great Price! It’s a must do on FIRST day to plan your visit or get more out of NY.
Our bus tour guide Rachel was fantastic!
Keep up with time schedule if you want to do more!
She absolutely was knowledgeable and informative.
My favorite part, the stories surrounding NY of famous people and landmarks.

We crammed in SO many necessary sights into this tour! From 10a to 4p. Tour guide Rachel was PHENOMENAL. So funny and so knowledgeable. She even took photos for all the tour guests near certain sights. Wish we would have done the night tour too! Next time! Thank you Rachel for an unforgettable journey!
Had a spectacular time with our tour guide, Rachel!!! She was the best ever and SUPER knowledgeable about NY! Amazing bus, photo ops, and you learn so much! Three words: Do. This. Tour. :)

Great tour guide, Rhonda, and driver, Juan. Saw lots of great sites and learned a ton about the city. One of my favorite things to do in a new town is take a tour, and this didn’t disappoint. One tip - be sure you’re in good walking shoes. There was much more walking than I expected, but it meant you could see a lot close up.

The entire tour was planned as a surprise for my stepdaughter. I wanted her to experience NYC for the 1st time in a guided professional manner. We had taken this tour before so we knew and expected high hopes and lots of celebratory information. Rachel our tour guide was amazing. The knowledge she shared and her own personal experiences made for a delightful day. I believe that my daughter had a memorable 16th birthday.

This was a great tour. We would have never ever been able to fit in all of the places that we did on our own. Our guide Tyler was the best. She was so personable and knowledgeable. Always offered to take pictures of us at great photo sights so nobody got left out. Also gave us good recommendations for after. We would recommend this tour to everyone.
Wonderful tour, it was a great way to see the city. Steve was fun and knowledgeable. Schedule this tour early so you’ll know where you want to go back to and spend more time at.

Excellent!! And this is coming from a person who lived in NYC most of my life. Everyone enjoyed this tour!! You see so much in one day on a nice tour bus. As you drive you learn about all the different neighborhoods. Each stop is at a landmark and you learn so much! Ended with a quick trip on the Staten Island Ferry. Not sure if you can ask for a particular tour guide but if you can ask for RACHEL!! She is wonderful.

Our tour guide Jerry and Manny were wonderful. They worked very hard to make sure we were informed and entertained. Recommend this tour completely. It was air conditioned and comfortable. Keep in mind it’s just an introduction to the city.

This tour was money well spent.
Our guide Rachel was knowledgeable and skilled. She made the tour fun and informative. If you want to get familiar with NYC take this tour with Rachel. Thanks Fla.

We had the best tour, the guide Steve was excellent. It was great way to get a taste of New York! Lunch in Little Italy, sooo good! Ferry ride and lots of interesting information about the city. Loved all the stops!

We took the bus and ferry tour around NYC. Our tour guide, Rhonda, was very knowledgeable and funny. She made the tour interesting and fun. We were able to see and do more in one day than if we ventured out on our own. One of our favorite things we did was the tour. It was definitely worth it!

We had an amazing tour of NYC with USA Guided Tours NYC. Our tour guide Brooklyn Jim and driver were the best. Very knowledgeable and our family enjoyed every minute of the tour. We were a large family (party of 16) and had the luxury van all to ourselves. I would defiantly recommend this tour.

The tour was excellent and Robert was a great tour guide. I only give four stars because they left us behind at St. Patrick's cathedral. We had to call the main office and get them to come back for us and three other women.

We took this tour on our first day in New York and it set us up for the rest of the trip. Our guide Rachel was AMAZING !! She gave us such great tips on how to get the best out of New York and she was very knowledgeable and entertaining. I would advise anybody visiting to take this tour, thank you Rachel

My husband and I took a quick summer getaway to NYC. This tour was the perfect way to see a lot in a short amount of time. Our tour guide Tim and driver Arliss provided a great experience. It was a 95 degree day and the air conditioned bus was awesome. I would highly recommend this for anyone!

Brenden was a great tour guide along with our driver Arles. I don’t know how Arles navigated the traffic and narrow streets. Brenden led us all over Manhattan. His knowledge brought a lot of history to life. Lots of films and TV shows have been shot in New York. Brenden knew them all! It was a wonderful, fun loving day. Kathy

I loved the Open-Top Bus experience! It allowed easy opportunities to take photos. The tour guide was fun, informative and efficient. I was impressed with all the neighborhoods of NYC that we were able to cover. Our guide located convenient washrooms at most stops. She selected a lunch place that offered a variety of dishes (not included in tour cost), and my paella was delicious. I especially enjoyed going past the Statue of Liberty on the Staten Island ferry.

Absolute brilliant.got to see all the main sites as well as a ferry to Staten island. An Rachel the tour guide was fantastic. Very informative and helpful. An she made sure we could all get our pics done by the best parts. Loved it would highly recommend this

Rachel was one of the best tour guides I’ve ever had. She was fun and informative. She took some great pictures of us to show friends and family as well. I was impressed by the different sites chosen to visit and even enjoyed the spot we stopped for lunch - a few choices and a nice grocery type store that had premade reasonably priced dishes for purchase that were delicious. She even taught us the simple way to use the subway system. Highly recommend her and this tour.

I thought that the 6 hr tour was going to be too long, but it went fast. Tour is so good-Rachel our guide was excellent & informative. Tour highlights the best of NYC. Highly recommend especially at the start of your visit.

Brooklyn jim & manny were amazing. So cool to get a tour from a REAL New Yorker. The pizza stop was amazing and Jim had so many facts that I as a 22 year resident had no idea about. The only down side is he encouraged us to shop at EMPIRE GIFTS for souvenirs w/ a promised discount and once there they had no idea what we were talking about and treated us rudely

Rachel was our tour guide and she did an excellent job! She was so knowledgeable and offered great information about all the sites we visited. She even gave us tips on how to be a true New Yorker. This tour gave you a nice taste of the city.

11/14/21, New York City never looked so good. Thank you Gil and Jose. The information Gil imparted is us was priceless; he was informative and interacted positively with all the guests. Take this tour you will not be disappointed.

We really enjoyed hearing about some of the architecture, fun facts about the people who live in NY and of course seeing all the different neighborhoods. The Statton island ferry is a great way to see NY in a different fashion. Our tour guide, Vinnie, was hilarious and gave us a taste of the NY attitude. Great way to see all elements of NY in a short amount of time.

Good overall exposure to manhattan. Liked Central Park stop and world trade memorial. Guide helpful with photos and local knowledge.
Would have liked it more if included Harlem and U.N.

This is not tour is nothing but a walking tour you can do yourself and doesn’t provide access to the 911 museum as advertised. I tried to get a refund but the customer service will not provide one. They expected to do a walking tour in pouring rain

Wow what a tour ! Team Rachel & Arlis were awesome. We saw & learnt so much in 6 hours. From Central Park to Rockefeller, 9/11 to Statue of Liberty & much much more this was a fabulous way to learn about and explore NYC.

This tour gives you some great information and a sneak peek at making a game plan to explore. It hits so many things but can’t spend much time at any. That’s not a complaint it’s just what you give up to cover so much ground. We really enjoyed it.

Great tour. Well planned and comfortable. Saw all the big spots. We had seen most before but never with the exceptional TYLER. She was like a shepherd with a herd of sheep and never got mad when some of us wandered a bit. Unbelievable knowledge and affection for her town, she is the best ever. Started on the dot and ended same

I was able to see so many iconic New York landmarks and must see attractions. If you don’t have a lot of time but want to make the MOST out of your trip. THIS is the tour for you. Granted get ready to walk, but don’t been too intimidated. You have a bus to take you places and breaks on.

I would encourage everyone to do this when they first get to New York. This was our first time and it allowed us to see nearly everywhere and then decide where we wanted to go back to. The history, facts and pace of the tour were superb and Rachel was an excellent guide and her knowledge was second to none and she kept up the same pace from start to finish...wonderful day.
Punctual clean transport saw lots of sights and landmarks we wanted to see. Our guide Mike was a local and very informative. Great way to spend a day when only I'm.the great city of NYC for 5 days.

Rachel was amazing! Knowledgeable and personable. We felt like this was the tour to do to get your bearing and navigate NYC when you are done. She gave us a sheet with websites, phone numbers and amazing suggestions on things to do in NYC. Great job Rachel and our driver Arles.
Great experience! Our tour guide, Tim, knew NYC amazingly well and had a story for every building and location. The tour was well organized and well worth doing. Definitely recommend.

Our guide, Gil, was very knowledgeable and pleasant. He gave us a wealth of knowledge about NY and our nation's beginnings. Our driver, Juan, was awesome, too! We would not have seen and learned nearly as much. If you REALLY want to SEE NY (Manhattan), this tour is a must!! We took the open-top bus! It was a very beautiful day.

This was a great tour! Definitely should take this tour first if this is your first time in NYC! It takes you to many places that you could come back to the next day to explore some more on your own.

We have the best tour guide Rachel. She knew lots of great and interesting facts. She is also very helpful with pictures!

Excellent tour. Highly recommend. I am from NYC and brought family for a first trip bucket list visit to NYC. They loved the tour with all the history and sites and the boat ride. Mike was our tour guide and Arliss our driver. Kudos to them both for navigating NYC traffic on a holiday week, and providing a fun and informative tour. Very educational as well - mike is a wealth of NYC knowledge

Really good tour, Vinny was the tour guide on the day and he was funny and knowledgeable. We saw some nice sites along the way and stopped at some interesting photo opportunities. The only negative was not seeing Madison square garden.

Excellent tour with very knowledgeable guide, we were taken to all of the top attractions. I would suggest you do this on your first day to give you ideas of what and where you’d like to go back to and explore further. The Statton island ferry is free to ride all day and gives you great views on both the Manhattan skyline and the Statue of Liberty.

The tour was ride with a Little walking on several highlights of New York. You will see several key areas of NY, a great tour for first timers. The real bright spot was Tyler our tour guide. She is worth the price of admission!

Steve was a great tour guide. His love for New York was obvious. He not only gave us great information on everything we saw but tips on navigating NYC on our own as well. We thoroughly enjoyed our day with him.

This was the perfect tour for our quick girls’ weekend. Gil was knowledgeable and fun. We were able to see so many things all in one day. The pizza for lunch across from the Market was amazing. Ferry ride was great for photos. Definitely would recommend

Worth every penny!!!! Our guide tour was excellent and well knowledgeable. This was my anniversary and my husband and I chose NY. We enjoyed the ferry ride. We got to ride down 5th Ave and boy what a history lesson!! We got a chance to see where the rich and famous lived and how they spent their money 🤑

Tyler was a fantastic tour guide. We loved every minute. Water was available and the stop for lunch had plenty of options for all tastes. Loved the ferry ride and Tyler was so knowledgeable. Had a great time!

This tour was amazing. The guide Gil from USA guided tours was amazing. He was very knowledgeable and very easy to talk to. Anthony was the driver. He was very safe and rite where he was at all times. Was very informative and made our first trip to New York fun and exciting. Would definitely do a tour with this company again. We now know of lots of places to eat and visit on our next trip.

Fun time seeing all the sights but wish we had more time at individual places. Enjoyed the WTC memorial stop and Central Park. Maybe another part of the park would be nice to have seen. The lunch area could have had a better selection, maybe more ethnic area with a wider variety of choices.

The best guided bus tour I ever had. I would do it again. I highly recommend it. Great value for your money. Tour guide was very knowledgeable. She was fantastic. You will get the real experience of NYC. You will learn about the history of NYC and see many sites. My only recommendation for improvement is to not have the tour guides block the tv screen when they're talking.

This was the perfect tour for the amount of free time we had on our work trip! We saw so much and learned so much in the five hours of the tour. Our guide, Tyler, was amazing! She was so knowledgeable about every aspect of NYC. We loved all of the historical information! She made the tour perfect!

Fantastic tour that gave a thorough historical and cultural overview. Rachel was very knowledgeable and gave all kinds of insider tips and tricks. It was a long day with the boat ride, but we’ll worth it! So much better than a hop on hop off type of tour.

Rachael was our tour guide and she was great! She knew everything you need to know about New York. My boyfriend and I spent Valentine's day taking the tour and enjoy every piece of it. Rachael gave us an information sheet with information of places to eat, visit and buy cheap souvenirs. Thanks to her we went on our own to a couple of spots and ate phenomenal food!

We had a very poor experience with the commentator. He yelled at us in public using his micro because he did not want us to speak a SINGLE word. He abused at us knowing we didn't speak English well. Extremely rude attitude, clearly racist, dictator kind of. He seems to care about himself only and want everyone to care about him and give no interest to his audience at all. If you are not from the US, do NOT take this tour. If you are from the US, think twice. The commentator became suddenly nice again at the end because he was expecting tips. Sorry, but unfortunately racist do not deserve tips. RUN AWAY. TOTAL SCAM!

This tour was worth it! Jack our guide was interesting and informative and kept us entertained for the entire trip. His knowledge of NY is impressive. The ferry ride was just as interesting left one with a deeper understanding of how NY came into being. A big thumbs to the organisers.

As the heading of my review indicates this trip is not at all suitable for family with small kids. For me, it was worse when it comes to non-accommodating guide. I believe his name is Mr. Steve. They have covered bus where it is difficult to see what guide is talking about. Overall not a great trip, in fact, pathetic to me.

We took the tour 6/21/2018. The tour guide Gil did a great job and deserves five stars. He was extremely professional and full of wonderful information. I was really amazed at his knowledge of every facet of the trip. Our driver Anthony was also great. We never felt that his driving was careless or unprofessional. However, we were extremely disappointed with the bus we had to ride on - more of a glorified school bus - no oversized passenger windows and no front window for us to look through. The driver sat at a lower level than the passengers so we couldn’t even look out of his windshield - at least from our seats. Also the tour was too large for one “nice” tour bus so the first group left in it, and the rest of us waited and waited for the second “not so nice bus”. We finally started about twenty minutes late. We were rushed the rest of the day. USA Guided Tours needs to get their act together.

Looking very much forward to this day trip and sadly this tour was so appalling with Tim, our tour guide from Buffalo , That we left the tour at the first stop. Tim remarked that when got this gig he thought that he should know something about New York. He certainly knew his rights when it came to a disabled fellow tour member. Tim would not help her nor her female helper with the wheelchair.We helped and I was very discomfited by the rudeness of Tim to her. Rather than stating -to the right or to the left - in his poor commentary , Tim would say "Over there...." ( where is over there ???) and continually talked about rich people. An Indian woman kept asking for water, and she was continually fobbed of... the tour bus had darkened windows and was filthy with used lunch wrappers on the seat, with empty plastic bottles underneath. It was late to pick us up. Having hurried to the collection point and not having had breakfast I asked about the lunch stop. Tim said that there was everything on offer - "Pizza, MacDonalds, Hotdogs".
AVOID whether you have a disability or not.

Upon arriving at the pick up location, back door of the School of Rock play, we were shortly greeted by a person checking us in and lining us up for our bus that would arrive. The bus came and 45 or so of us entered the bus and then waited 30 minutes for a tour guide who we were told was delayed on a train. This is the only bad part of what became an outstanding day and tour.
We traveled the streets of New York being informed of buildings, history, architecture, and stories side by side with hundreds of cabs whizzing by and cramming against the bus. The driver was wonderful never slamming the breaks or causing worry. We saw the Madison Square Gardens, Empire State building, Got out at Madison Park, for pictures as well as 911 Memorial. We continued yhrough yhe good, bad, and ugly of New Yorks different areas until arriving to board a ship to view the Statue of Liberty, Ellis Island, and Brooklyn Bridge (we tipped this tour guide on the boat who was great with setting up pictures for everyone).
We had a brief lunch break but we choose wrong with the buffet place which was 9.99 a pound and not very good. There was also a hot dog, or McDonald's choice.
The trip then continued thtpugh more crowded streets until its return to our starting point.
Great way to see New York and then decide where you want to go another day. All places looked very busy so you can decide this way what you really want to do another time.

It was to my amazement that the Tour Guide Tim/Jim (not too sure whether Tim or Jim), skipped myself and my son on the coach when enquiring about where we come from. He started this exercise from the front of the bus asking everyone from left to right where they are from. When he got to our turn he skipped us. He came across he did that purposefully because we are from African descent. I was so upset to be treated this way, so I waited until the bus stopped at Central Park then I went up to him to ask why he skipped us and we should be treated the same as everyone on the bus because we have paid for it. He was so rude and abusive pointing his finger at me. I insisted that he would not stop me from saying the way he has treated my son and I, it was so obvious and it's so embarrassing that I have come all the way from England and this is the welcome I've received from him. He never apologised throughout the tour. He wanted me to leave the tour but I told him that I wasn't going to. He realised that I wasn't going to be bullied by him so he had to choice but to find a way to get on with me during the remaining trip. I hope someone responsible deals with this issue and no one from the African descent should be treated this way in the future.

The tour started at 10am and ended about 5pm. The tour guide Mr. Gil, was so knowledgeable about his city. You could let he had done his job many times before, but was just as entertaining as if it was his first. He made the tour. We went all over the city including a boat ride to see lady Liberty and the Brooklyn bridge from the bottom. We enjoyed the tour immensely and do recommend it.

I did this tour in September with my best friend. Checking was on time and easy to find. Our guide was Tyler she was very polite and informative giving insight into the history, real estate and fun facts throughout the tour. Being in an enclosed bus, was comfortable and the tour guide had a microphone so we could hear her clearly. There were walk abouts at Central Park, Rockefeller center and more. The highlight towards the end was the ferry to the Statue of Liberty!! Although It doesn’t stop at the island, it was perfect!
The only downside was the shocks on the bus made it a bumpy ride but I was distracted by he city! Definitely wear comfortable shoes for walking and bring snacks if you get hungry quickly. Oh and make sure your camera has lots of space for photos!

We arrived for our tour and were informed due to weather they had to cancel. We could refund or try another day so we chose to come back next day. We should have been at the top of the list for the next day but were at the bottom and we were assigned a run down bus with an inexperienced driver. If it wasn't for Mike being so great (he gets a 5 rating for sure!) the day would have been a bust. The boat tour was fun but certainly not a luxury boat tour as the website claims.

Just got back from a whirlwind of New York touring. Fantastic day filled with so many iconic sights. Tim was easily the best tour guide I’ve ever had! Driver, Gabby, was a pro at navigating the area & never making us wait. We learned so much on the trip & enjoyed our experience. Would highly recommend to anyone!

We booked this for based on the excellent reviews on TripAdvisor, and we're not disappointed. There are many companies offering tours of NYC and we wanted to make sure we got a good one. This certainly was. A smaller bus than many made for a manageable tour size. Lots of opportunities to get off the bus and take photos and see sights. The boat trip was extremely worthwhile. Our tour guide, Gil, and driver Raymond were both excellent. Gil clearly has passion for his city and fountains of knowledge. Great option to see the best of NYC in one day, and came away inspired with things to return and see at a later date. Thanks!
I've never spent so much money to be put down so much. Jake was very rude and spent too much time criticizing the group to point out all the sites.

Booked this trip before we left the UK, because we were only spending two nights in NYC but returning for six nights a week later and felt it would be a good overview, and also help us decide where we wanted to spend more time on our return.
It fulfilled all our wishes, and the guide was a great character who breathed life into the 6-hour trip

We recently did this tour with two adults and two teenagers. It was a whirlwind tour. We saw a lot in the few hours we on it. The tour was conducted on a small bus, not the double-decker type. That was kind of a bummer, but the bus was comfortable. We got off on several occasions and looked at things. It was great because we would walk a while and then magically, the bus was there waiting for us, we didn't have to walk back to where we disembarked. Obviously you can't see all that New York has to offer in one day, but we got a nice overall look at the city. The boat ride was fun as well. Our guides were informative and our driver was friendly and brave. I would highly recommend this tour in you want a quick peek at New York. We purchased our tickets via Groupon and saved a lot.

This tour was very excellent. Our driver Johnny was a safe driver amidst the NYC traffic. Our tour guide Rachel was extremely knowledgeable. She gave so many tips on what to eat, see, do, not to be taken advantage of as a tourist, NYC transportation, and most importantly how to not provoke New Yorkers. Rachel knew the good places to take pics for the Instagram. I recommend booking this tour at the beginning of your trip so you can revisit the various sites. The bus was air conditioned!!! The tour is a hybrid of walking and sitting on the bus. Many movie references were made and enjoyed!

I grew up on Long Island, but now live in VA, and for this trip I brought 2 friends with me who have never been to NY. This tour was an awesome way to see most of the city in one day. Gil our tour guide was great! He kept us on schedule, was very knowledgeable, and made sure we were having a good time. Gary the bus driver sure can navigate through the chaotic traffic, it was impressive. Even if you are from NY, this is an amazing tour to learn about NYC. I was completely recommend this versus one of the hop on/hop off tours because you can actually learn more. It was a great day!

We had just a couple days in NYC before heading out on a cruise and are so happy that we booked this tour. We got to see all of the hot spots of the city and learn about them, too. Our guide, Jay, was fabulous. It was an intimate tour and very well-organized. You’ll feel like a friend is showing you around, with all of the juicy insider info. Traffic on the way back can be a little hairy, so leave yourself a cushion of time if you make plans afterwards.

I recently visited NYC with my 21 year old gdaughter. She absolutely loved this tour as I did. We were fortunate to have Tyler as a guide: she is outstanding and entertaining. Detailed history of area, tips on navigating the city on foot, taxi and uber and public transport. It was 91 the day we took the tour; bus had AC and comfortable. We were on foot at Central Park, 9-11, John Lennon neighborhood and more. Perfect weather for the cruise with close up views of Lady Liberty, Ellis Island and views of the city. We began at 10Am and finished at 4PM. Easy location in front of Winter Garden Theatre. Highly recommend.

We took this tour on our 1st full day in NYC, which was also our 1st trip to NYC, & because we had only 2 full days in the city. It takes you to the main spots/areas in Manhatten in about 6 hours. There is alot covered in that time & it helps you to aquaint yourself to NYC & it gives you an idea of places that you would like to return to at another time. After the tour, we had no problem neogotiating our way around & we returned to a some of the spots that we had visited on the tour so we could spend more time at them. The cruise around the Statue of Liberty & Brooklyn Bridge is what really what sets this tour apart from others. It is great having the logistics of the tour & the cruise taken care of for you. This really helps maximize your time, more "bang for your buck". Also, having bottled water provided was a nice touch. Our guide was knowledgeable about NYC & our driver, Arliss, had driving skills that were impressive. Our guide made sure that everyone had their picture taken at all of the sites that we stopped at. Our tour was rather fast paced with a bit of walking but everyone, young & older, seemed to be able to keep up. It has to be somewhat quick in order to cover every site that you get to see or visit. Several times, I couldn't believe I was actually looking at something that I had only seen on the television or in a picture. I would highly recommend this tour to any first time visitor to NYC, given all of the information & site seeing that this tour provides.

We went on this trip just today, our tour guide was Gil and driver was Rob, fantastic knowledge of Manhattan, great tour and showed us everything in one day, fast paced but excellent, well worth it...

This trip had it all! Worth every penny! We saw more in a couple of hours than expected and GIL had an abundance of knowledge of famous people, memorable places and the history behind it! I would recommend GIL and the touring company to everyone! GIL you were great!

Our tour guide Jack and driver Ray were brilliant. Jack was really knowledgeable and informative about New York. The order of the tour changed slightly on the day to accomodate a charity run in Central Park, but we visited there at the end of the day rather than the beginning. We saw all the major sights and got a great insight in to what was worth re-visiting over the following few days. The weather was poor on the day of our tour, but this didn’t spoil the day or upset the itinary - we just put on the plastic ponchos and enjoyed the day. Would highly recommend to those who only have a limited time in the city - you can view lots of the major attractions in a short time. Great day and fantastic hosts.

Our tour guide, Tim, and driver, Gary, were both fantastic. Tim was very knowledgeable about the history of the city. His humor was an added bonus. He gave us tips and tricks for navigating the city along with good places to eat. This tour hits all the highlights. Highly reccomend!

If you are looking for a tour that hits the highlights of New York without a lot of walking, this is the perfect tour. Gil, our tour guide, and Raymond, the bus driver, were absolutely the best! We met up in middle of a block, and a hint: you are suppose to be there 15 min prior to departure time, but if you have more than 2 people in your group, go earlier if you want to sit next to each other. Bottled water is provided on the bus, and rain ponchos (which we did briefly need). Gil had so many extra tidbits of info and gave us lots of recommendations for restaurants all over Manhattan. There is a little walking involved: we got out at Rockefeller Center, at Strawberry Fields by the Dakota, at the 9-11 Memorial, and then the walk to the Ferry to see the Statue of Liberty (and no, you do not get off the ferry but you get a fantastic close view). We also stopped for a brief 30-min lunch. Restroom not on bus, but there were restrooms at the Rockefeller stop, lunch, and on the ferry. On our off-bus excursions we came across other "walking" tours, and it seemed difficult to stick together, stand in one spot, and hear what the tour guides were saying because this city is BUSY and NOISY. But having a nice, air-conditioned bus, cold water, and a fun guide like Gil was so worth it! Having a covered bus did limit some of the views, but on a hot, humid day that did have some light showers, an open bus would have been miserable. This was an excellent way to start our visit!

We really enjoyed having the combo bus/ferry tour all in one inclusive tour. The bus, with our tour guide Jack, took us up to Central Park, where we got out and walked to the Strawberry Fields site, then drove down 5th Ave. with Jack pointing out different sites and providing background information. We got out and walked around Rockefeller Center and had time to take photos (and go to the restrooms.). Then we went down to Wall Street and got out to visit the 9/11 memorial pools. We then stopped to get our own lunch. We had a choice of going to three restaurants on one block---McDonalds, a pizza shop, and a grocery with a buffet of fresh and cooked meals/salads. We ate on the bus and then went to the ferry, where another tour guide provided information as we sailed by the Statue of Liberty and New York Harbor. Then it was back on the bus to drive up the west side of Manhattan and back to our starting site.
Great way to get a taste of all there is to see in Manhattan!

This is our 3rd time to visit NYC but took the tour last week as we brought my parents who are visiting for the first time. Purchased tickets thru Groupon so we saved a lot. The tour was good - covered pretty much, but not all I expected. Lunch was OK; bring your own food if you can/want to. Water was provided. The one downside for me is that, it is not disabled-friendly. You cannot bring your own wheelchair, and the tour was kinda rushed so my mom (who had limited mobility) had a hard time keeping up. She stayed in the bus half the time & wasn't able to enjoy because of this.

Brilliant tour led by Tim and driver Tony. Really gave a flavour of what there is to see and do in NYC. The missing star is because while the other members of the tour managed to find the start location I didn’t. There are 4 possible locations at the given intersection and I didn’t manage to find the right one until too late. However following a phone call to the company’s office I was able to pick up the tour having not missed much. Perhaps even more detailed joining instructions would help those of us non Americans to find the right side of the intersection. Then again perhaps it’s just me.

Thanks guys for a great tour. I met some lovely people.

This was a whirlwind, fast-paced introductory NY City bus tour. All the major stops mentioned in the description were covered. Do not expect to spend any meaningful time at the individual stops...there is simply no time as so much is jammed packed into the tour.
It was wonderful to see the Statue of Liberty on the boat tour but the "Captain" was pushy, obnoxious and generally inappropriate. When getting off the boat, I overheard this captain stating,"Yeah... a real sh---- tour" in response to people not tipping him.
Our tour guide was well informed but spent too much time talking about herself. She made a grossly inappropriate comment stating that the boat was owned by a Chinese company and there will be many "Asians" on board who tend to be very pushy. We found this to be very offensive. The last 30 minutes of the tour were spent with Rachael advising tourist who not to tip in town. She made is cleared, though, that tips were appreciated from us at the conclusion of the tour.

The tour was everything we needed to see the main places and to orientate ourselves for the rest of our time in NY. Gil the guide was excellent , with lots of interesting and funny stories and useful ideas for places to go and see.

I live locally but had never done the NYC "tourist" experience. We booked a tour and then learned it would be nasty weather that day. We were able to change to a day with a better forecast and really appreciated that flexibility. We met the small tour bus and it was organized and waiting for us. We loved our guide Gil and driver Gio. Gil was informative and funny and kept the tour moving. We were able to see so many things in one day without feeling rushed. They allowed for bathroom and lunch breaks and it was a lot of fun to see and hear about the history of many of the buildings, areas, neighborhoods and fun celebrity stories. We got a good sense of each area and it was wonderful hearing about all of it and not having to worry about the traffic. When there were delays they were able to maneuver around without sacrificing anything. It goes from 10:00 to about 4:00. It was nice to see NYC from the van, by foot and by boat. It was well organized and informative. Got some great tips on what to do, where to eat and how to get around easily. Definitely would recommend for anyone wanting to see a lot in a short amount of time without feeling rushed.

For a first time in New York, we wanted to start our stay there with a tour in order to get bearings on the city and a bit of historical background. This tour didn't disappoint us: our guide Gil had an amazing knowledge of historical facts but also the key people who made New York such an iconic place. The tour itself was very well organised. I highly recommend it.

We checked out several tours but decided on this one and were very pleased. We had a terrific overview of the city and harbour with several unrushed stops in places of interest with a very informative and friendly guide, Gil. Thank you!

First trip to NYC, my bf and I bought tickets for this tour and it was the highlight of our vacation. Gill was so knowledgeable about the city, you felt like you went through time with him, not to mention he is Hilarious!! Gee was so kind always welcoming us back with waters and drove us safely to each stop and was always conveniently located at the end of each site. Highly recommend this duo for a first time to the city , or anytime trip for that matter... truly a remarkable experience that we are forever grateful for.

Rachel was awesome!! She was very knowledgeable about NYC and provided great information from beginning to end of tour. My family of 6, 4 kids (16,14,11, and 9) did the tour. The teens loved it, the 2 younger ones felt it to be a bit long, but they still enjoyed it. We were able to see all the "hot spots". There was no way my family could cover all that ground/sights ourselves. An important note: you do not go into any of the sites. You will see Statue of Liberty via ferry, but you don't go into the Statue of Liberty, you will see Empire State Building, but not go inside or to the observation deck, you will see the 9/11 memorial, but not go into the 9-11 museum. For some people, this may be a deal breaker, but not going into any of the places was perfect for us. The tour lasted between 5-6 hours. The bus was clean and comfortable. They even offered water which was perfect. I would recommend taking tour at beginning of trip to NYC because Rachel provided some really great info that would have been useful during our stay in NYC.
Only thing I would recommend to be done differently is at tour pick up, the instructions were to meet behind the Winter Garden Theater. A bunch of us were looking for a bus vs an individual person, we kept walking looking for a bus. The check in guy needs to have some type of sign to annotate he is with tour. A group of us must have walked past him a dozen times looking for a bus.

What a GREAT tour! Learned lots of tidbits about Manhattan that I wouldn't have learned if I had not been on tour with Gil! He did an awesome job! The tour van was very clean and everyone respected safety guidelines(mask, sanitizing, distance...)! I would highly recommend this tour! As a matter of fact, when I bring family back next year, I plan on doing it again with them!

We had Gil (guide) and Anthony (driver) for this tour and they were exceptional. We spent 7 days in New York and started the trip off with this tour to get oriented and it was definitely worth the extra money versus a hop on hop off. Can't say enough about Gil in particular, just a fountain of knowledge. He gave specific suggestions on great places to eat, things to do, etc. His insight was invaluable. He took a number of photos for the group at various stops too. They gave us bottled water, the coach was very clean and modern (note: the keeners get there pretty early for good seats, we were there more than 1/2 hour ahead of time and lots of people were there already). We also found the directions to be a little confusing. The meet point is actually the bus parked out front of Beetlejuice Theatre right on 7th Avenue.

Definitely do this tour, you won't regret it. We had our 15 year old twins and they thought it was great too. Lunch was at a market, and it was kinda late actually - maybe 1:30pm or so, so plan accordingly. My son and I loved the pizza joint, fairly inexpensive too. Healthier options in the market, make your own salad, etc.

Again, I read good reviews about all of the guides for this tour, but Gil really is terrific (and he wasn't pressuring us to write reviews, this is just another way to say thanks!).

Lastly, tips are pooled and shared equally between driver and guide.

We booked this USA bus tour of NYC based on the reviews from trip advisor. We figured we could see more and get more info than riding those hop on and hop off buses. So glad we did this was the best tour hands down. Our tour guy was Tim and he was fabulous. Gave us so much information about each site/ building we visited. The day we took the tour of course it was raining and cold at the start. Tim offered anyone that wanted them rain ponchos. We visited Central Park , The Dakota where John Lennon was shot, Rockefeller center, Empire State Building, Grand Central Station, Stature of Liberty, SoJo, China town, Manhattan and 911 memorial. Would highly recommend this tour!

Please watch out that you don’t subscribe to Viator by mistake.

I thought I had paid just the $89.99 but checked my PayPal account and a subscription had been initiated.

It looks like I was going to be billed again until I cancelled the subscription.

Having been to New York before, this time I thought I would look at the city differently with a few trips.

We started the tour behind the Winter Garden Theatre - once booked, you receive information regarding departure points and inclusions/exclusions of the trip.
It is up to you to make your way to the departure point.
These tours advise you to arrive quite some time before departure to ensure everybody gets there on time.

The tour bus is a single decker, about the size of a mini van. No need to worry about open topped buses, you will be nice and warm on this bus!

Our tour guide was Mike and our driver was Tony.
Mike was fantastic! He made sure everybody was included in the tour, it was very personal and his information was extremely thorough.
We had roughly 18 people on our tour, and not once did Mike leave anybody out. He made sure everybody was okay and that nobody got lost. He was also very witty.

The tour stops at certain sights where you are able to get off the bus for some photo opportunities and detailed information regarding that sight.
Some sights require you to walk a little bit but it's not strenuous.

Water is provided on the bus and you can also leave any belongings on your seat as Tony stayed with the bus at all times.

We stopped for lunch, which was a self-serve, buffet style lunch within a food store where we had about 30 minutes of free time.

Shortly after lunch is the boat tour - depending on the time of year you visit, this can get quite cold if you're sat on the top deck. Not only this, but people with motion sickness may not do so well as when the boat is docked, it can get quite rocky.

Food and drink are served on the lower deck throughout the boat tour - roughly 1 hour long.
The tour allows both sides of the boat to get good views of the sights - Manhattan & Brooklyn Bridge, Statue of Liberty, Ellis Island.
There is also a photo opportunity before boarding which you can buy when you disembark if you wish.
The tour guide for the boat isn't the same as the overall tour, you join other visitors on the boat as it is the public water taxi, but still very informative.

After the boat tour, you are dropped back off at your departure point.

I would highly recommend this tour!

What a day! What an experience! A whistle stop, non-stop commentated tour that takes you from the tranquility of Strawberry fields, Central Park to the hustle and bustle of the Rockefeller centre and heck yes, we did go back to Saks to see that whole floor of shoes!
We were only in New York for 2 complete days and found this an excellent way of seeing all of the main sites and boy, did we get our moneys worth! It was great fun to Ooh and Aah at the commentary "of which famous person was living in what apartment" and to recognise film locations or have them pointed out!
The cruise out to Ellis Island and the photos that were taken of us by the guide were brilliant. It was lovely to take an hour and just chill, listening to the boat guide's commentary and admiring the glorious views of Manhattan from the water.
Lunch was amazing, first time I have ever bought dinner by the pound! My son and I bought way to much, wanting to try all these different American foods! Luckily we could leave it in the air-con bus and keep it for supper!
Set aside a full day, it went from 10 am to after 5 pm. You see all the main and some off the beaten track sites! You get some great advice and some fun facts. If you thinking of the cost, it was well worth it, even with the lousy AUD/USD exchange rate at the time of purchase!

If you are looking at all the trips and wondering should you?/shouldn't you? Then let me reassure you that this is a good trip. Our Guide - Gil - a New Yorker - was very funny, incredibly knowledgeable and appeared genuinely keen to impart his extensive New York knowledge on to us. I don't know how often these guides do these trips but you didn't feel like this was Gil's 4 or 5th trip of the week. We travelled all over Manhattan and enjoyed several stop offs along the way as well as lovely little lunch stop off the beaten track. We then took a boat ride across the Hudson River, close to the Statue of Liberty before ending up under the Brooklyn Bridge. The boat is large with a bar, cafe and toilets. There is a running commentary onboard - he was great too - very funny - also about the local history. The 911 Memorial was our last stop when back on the bus and Gil was very sensitive, asking us to keep close as he would not be raising his voice as it is a place of reflection and contemplation. We all thoroughly enjoyed the tour and our Bus driver was very much part of the team as well. Would definitely recommend. Very good value for money.

We had two full days in New York before our cruise. I had visited New York 20 years ago, it was my husband’s first visit. We therefore booked this tour as it covered the major landmarks and also gave a good insight into the layout of the city and excellent information for us novice tourists. The day we did the tour it was wet and windy so we felt grateful to be on a comfortable bus touring the city. Despite the rain we did get off the bus at the iconic landmarks for photographs. We also had an excellent lunch stop at a food market offering loads of choices of food and was good value. The tour also included a boat trip around the harbour so we got to see the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island. Definitely recommend this trip for the novice tourisf

This tour covers a lot of Manhattan, starting with Central Park and going south from there. Although the park is lovely, this stop could be shortened as much time was wasted looking at the John Lennon memorial, put there by his widow but for most of us 'who cares?'. Or we could have seen more of the park itself. Due to heavy traffic that day, most stops were shortened and many stops had only one working toilet for several women. Our guide was quite knowledgeable and entertaining and pointed out various landmarks as well as places related to many celebrities. He took photos of some of us in front of monuments or buildings. The boat ride to the Statue of Liberty was nice.

Great tour and a way to see the highlights of NYC. Our guide was fantastic! I think it would have been helpful to find the tour if the instructions could have said to meet in front of or by the Winter Garden Theatre. I also enjoyed learning a lot about the history of NYC.

Wonderful tour. We loved Rachel and our driver Raymond .Even with street closings, we saw most of what was scheduled .Loved the boat ride around the harbor .Rachel was great with her history knowledge and telling us how to be New Yorkers. I would recommend this tour.

I'm the type that doesn't always sign up for a tour. I usually like to discover things on my own timeline, but with this being my first visit to NYC, my wife talked me into signing up for this tour. As usual, she was right. What an excellent way to get to know NYC. Our tour guide (Taylor) was the best, she was knowledgeable, up-to-date, and very passionate about the city and was genuinely interested that all in the group had a great experience. Learned so much about the who, what why, where, and when of all thing NYC. The bus was just the right size to get through traffic. We had plenty of time at all the stops to get out and be tourist (take pictures). The boat tour at the end of the day was the cherry on top of a great day. The Hornblower Boat guide was just as knowledgeable and was an expert pointing out the various buildings and places along the skyline. I now feel very confident for my next adventure Manhattan. A must do, recommend that you try to schedule on your first full day in the City in order to use the great information and recommendations you'll get during the remainder of your visit.

We picked this for our last full day in New York. Our tour guide Gil and his driver Tony were excellent with full of knowledge and fun all at same time. We were lucky to have great day for the boat trip and got to see another part of city due to traffic which normally does not happen. Next visit we will explore the places we toured today more. Thanks for great day and help with getting photos together.thanks again Gil.

I chose this activity because everyone had given it five stars, but this was not my experience. First of all, it’s definitely not for children because it gets boring for them. Even the teenager with me wasn’t really interested. It is very good for adults coming to NYC for their very first time because a lot of information is given, and the tourist can go back later to spend more time at the sites. The boat part is really a waste. You go around the Statue of Liberty, under the Brooklyn Bridge, and back to port. You can go by the Statue of Liberty for free riding the Staten Island Ferry, and you’ll see the Brooklyn Bridge also. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable, but he was also short-tempered. We were joking among ourselves to obey every rule or we’d be in “big trouble.” Also, this tour is very rushed.

My family and I enjoyed our tour very much. The six hour tour has stops that include Central Park, the 9/11 memorial and a cruise by Ellis Island and the Statue of Liberty.
Alberto was a good, safe driver and Tyler was an outstanding guide. She was both funny and informative and made the day very entertaining. Thank you, Tyler!

My family wholeheartedly recommends this tour.

This was our first time in New York and we were so lucky to get a strong guide that made everything seem interesting. The history of the city is stunning and we had plenty of time to get to each attraction. It just scratches the surface of each of the stops, because each stop could turn into a couple hours if you wanted to. Again - wanted to say GIL IS THE MAN TO GET! He knows his stuff and is passionate about making the tour a great time. Highly recommended.

With a limited one-day opportunity to do a broad-brush overview of New York City, we found USA Guided Tours to fill our need. The tour runs from 10:00 am to 4:30 pm. Our tour guide, Tim, was great. Tim gives a “New Yorker’s” view of the highlights along the way. We thoroughly enjoyed his candid and witty comments. His personal anecdotes and knowledge of history and celebrities were wonderful. Navigating the New York City traffic was a challenge exquisitely performed by our driver. The trip was punctuated by short walking tours of highlights to include the World Trade Center memorial, Dakota and Strawberry Field in Central Park, Rockefeller Plaza ending with a boat trip around the Statute of Liberty. Would sincerely recommend it!
We had the best day ever. Tim Douglas was the tour guide and John drove the bus. Lots of fun facts and information. I learned a lot. Kimberly

My wife and I took our 15 year old grandson for a trip to New York. Based on the recommendations I read in Trip Advisor, I went with this tour as a way to see the city. A great choice! We had a wonderful time with Tim as our tour guide and Anthony our driver! Tim's personality and knowledge of the city brought touring to a whole new level. Combining the bus tour with a harbor tour by boat is a great value. I highly recommend this tour and Tim in particular. I would give it 10 stars if I could!

from the moment we got on the bus, we were told they were late so everything was a rush - central park tour cut short, etc..etc.. - presumably so we could catch the boat trip on time??? That is perhaps forgivable (though I have no idea why we were late because everyone was there on time to catch the bus) but coming back they had NO good reason to rush but again, they claimed they needed t skip Wall street and rush back. The tour guide may deserve 5 stars but the tour barely deserves half of that.

Much better than a "hop on, hop off" tour and worth the extra cost. We had Tim, a great local tour guide who made Manhattan come alive. You drive through Times Square and then visit Central Park, with emphasis on the Dakota and Strawberry Fields. After a drive through the park, you head downtown to Rockefeller Center. Later you stop at Madison Gardens with wonderful views of the Empire State Building, the Flatiron Building and lower Manhattan. Next stop is the 9/11 Memorial with expert commentary. There isa lunch stop at the South Pier (on your own) before boarding a cruise on the Hudson River with unparalleled views of the Brooklyn Bridge, the Statue of Liberty, Ellis Island and Governors Island. You also get thrilling pictures of the Manhattan skyline the entire voyage. You are then returned to your boarding spot in Midtown Manhattan. Superior vape and in six hours you get a great overview of this magnificent city.

Booked this because my mom has always wanted to go to NYC and wanted to see it all. I’ve been several times but thought she would like an organized tour since she can’t walk very well but wanted to see it all. We were only there for 3 days so I thought this sounded great - and it was AMAZING. Gil our tour director is an absolute expert on the history, architecture and experience of New York. I am so happy I brought my mom because we both learned more about the city than we ever would have. Anthony, the amazing driver, and Gil work together perfectly and made sure the timing of drop offs and pickups and - we’ll just everything- was timed to the minute so we would all get the very best experience possible. I can’t say enough good things about these two - book this trip, it’s worth every penny. If you’ve been there a lot before, I still guarantee Gil will teach you more and the time will go by so quickly. Loved it, and my mom was truly thrilled!!

We thoroughly enjoyed this tour. Our guide Gil was informative and helpful, and our driver Giovanni was a wizard of moving us through traffic swiftly and safely. The tour gave us a chance to see many areas, as well as get off the bus for walkabouts with our guide. He found the best locations for pictures. We even stopped for lunch. The bus is smaller than most, so it can get closer to the venues fro drop off and pickup. We had a good day with this tour.

This was a effective way to introduce my sister to NYC. It was informative. The ability to combine transportation to all areas and a harbor tour was well-planned. The brisk pace is not for those who have trouble walking or standing.

However, the push to tip 20% as well as to flat out ask for five star ratings for the guide and driver was boorish.

We had the BEST guide - Gil. I cannot believe how much we saw. Prepare yourself for a fast paced yet perfect tour of NYC. They had water on the bus, and lunch was in a perfect location with lots of choices - but little time which was OK for us as we wanted to see so much. Do this!
A great tour for first timers in NY (like me). Gil was a wonderful guide, he was very informative and shared valuable recommendations with us.

I was so glad that I booked this through trip advisor. The tour lasted at least 5 hours and included a visit to all historical places and buildings and also a boat trip on the Hudson to the statue of liberty. Gil our tour guide was a wealth of knowledge.

This was the first trip to NYC with my two sons. I could not be happier about my choice to use USAGuided Tours. Our guide, Gil, was amazing - his concern for our experience was obvious. The depth of his knowledge on everything in sight, from many different facets - history, law, biographies - was impressive. He actively insured that everyone on tour got the right pics at the right time.

The scope of the tour itself was very robust. Comparable to multiple individual tours at each of the places that we visited, with a very knowledgeable guide.

Very grateful for a wonderful time. Thank you.

We decided to visit NY for the weekend and didn’t have a lot of time to figure out what to do or see so I did some research on Trip Advisor and came across this tour. I HIGHLY recommend this tour if you don’t have a lot of time in NY and you want to see the major attractions in the city. The tour narrator was excellent very knowledgeable of the city both the current culture and historical culture of the city. My wife and I loved the air conditioned private coach bus. They took us off the bus at various stops to take pictures and it also included a boat ride out on the Hudson where we took pictures of the Statue of Liberty and NY impressive skyline. We stopped for bathroom breaks and they provided complimentary cold water on the bus and we even stopped at a lovely little local market for a delicious lunch. It’s 6hrs long but it was well worth the money.

Guys I swear to God this was the best tour I've ever seen. More than more than enough :) We literally were tired after seeing so many places. Gil,the guide was the best. He lives in Manhattan so who can know more than him? Arles,our driver, was the best. Always on time waiting for us with the doors open and ice cold AC blowing from his bus. If you will enjoy your the tour, leave your guide some tip, I swear they are doing a great job!

This 6h tour was great! It allows you to see the most of New York City in a day.Gill was our tour guide, he was very knowledgeable about the city and helpful during the tour. Raymond was our driver and he was helpful as well. They both seemed to work as a team when he came to what route to take due to street closures. The tour is a must do especially if you have children or elderly people that wants to experience New York City.

We had limited time in New York and really only had one full day to see the sights. This tour was just what we wanted. We saw quite a lot of things and we got out and walked around with the group to see things. We got out to walk the strawberry fields in Central Park, the 911 memorial, Rockefeller Center, to arm a few and then a boat ride to see the Brooklyn bridge & the Statue of Liberty. We had about an hour for lunch at a little food market. We got hotdogs at Papaya and walked to a little beer garden by the water to eat. Our tour guide Dina was fun, sweet, & very knowledgeable, and our driver Betty was great and never kept us waiting. Highly recommended!!

This tour was a definite disappointment. The day was longer than expected, our lunch was cut to 15 minutes, and the boat tour had to be rescheduled for an hour later. We could not hear our guide when we were outside and we had to leave the bus to see a sight and then return and refollow our original steps to get back to the bus. From the bus, we could not see the buildings/monuments or where the guide was indicating.

Our experience is thanks to Tim and Becky. Tim our host was incredible. We booked this just based on reviews on this site and it was better than we expected and we had high hopes! Very personal, so much to take in with Tim's knowledge of the city provided us the best time and ideal start to learning NY. Not just tourist stuff, but history, fun facts on the way even not related to what you saw, and great for tourists like us teaching us the NY way to behave. We think this is truely the best you can get. A comfy bus with a great driver, tinted glass meant window pics on the way were good. The attention to detail is fantastic and really folks, ask to be in Tim's group and chat with him it made the day fantastic. Thank you Tim and Becky from Rob and Mel from Australia, it was the best. Be sure to tip them well!

This was a great day! Gil the tour guide and Ray the bus driver were great, friendly and informative. Gil kept us entertained with little fun facts and do/dont's, he would take photos for us and was really great. The boat trip combined with the bus ride was really great, I would recommend this trip, it was a great way to see the city!

We loved it!!! Our tour guide Tyler was awesome. So knowledgeable and proud of her city. She went over and beyond our expectations. She wad kind and patient with questions and comments. This tour helps you to get oriented to the city. Our boat ride was great with views of the statue of liberty. We highly recommend this tour.

This trip was such an amazing experience. Full of the typical things you would expect from a tour such as this such as building history, and interesting facts. However, what really set this tour apart was that it gave even more in-depth information about tips on getting the best deals on souvenirs, trips in the park best ways to travel as well as things to avoid. Rachel was simply amazing, and Raymond our driver was also very courteous. I highly HIGHLY recommend Rachel for your tour! I am from a very small village in rural Ohio, so I was very apprehensive about coming to the "Big Apple" but with her expert advice, I was able to head out into the city without fear or apprehension and had the confidence to tackle the subway system. TAKE THE TOUR!

We had a great tour last weekend. This is a perfect tour when the weather is chilly because there are no outside seats like on a double-decker bus. Our tour guide, J, was fantastic. He's extremely well-informed as well as very funny. This is an excellent place to start if you've never been to Manhattan. You get to see many sights, hear loads of stories, and there are quite a few stops. All very interesting. Highly recommended!

This tour is a great overview of all the sights of Manhattan. It's best to take it as the first thing you do in Manhattan if you can, so you can get an idea of what you want to go back to see. So much better than trying to get around Manhattan on your own with the traffic. I wish we had been there during the warmer season for the boat tour as we only could see the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island from afar. The subbed stop of Grand Central Station didn't really do much for me personally. Our guide was Tim, very enthusiastic and entertaining. He was earnest in his desire for everyone to get the most out of the tour. We saw Rockefeller Center, the Empire State Building, the Chrysler Building, the Dakota Building, Strawberry Fields in Central Park, Ground Zero, and many other architectural and historical buildings along the drive between each of the featured stops. I would suggest the tour company do some type of ID, perhaps a sticker, for guests so everyone has an easier time keeping up with the tour on the very busy streets of Manhattan. The tour was over 6 hours with a lunch stop at a nice little spot that had a pizza place and a market with an amazing buffet at $9.99 per pound. It was a little late for lunch though (1:15) and people were getting a little over hungry, but I imagine that was to avoid the noon crowd. Overall, I highly recommend this tour and I will be back with any friends that have not taken it.

Professional, well organised, and very informative tour. Our guide, Gill, was brilliant. I don’t think we spent a single minute without Gill intriguing us with knowledgeable commentary. The Tour was well paced without us ever feeling rushed.
The bus was modern and clean. Roy, our driver, did a great job ensuring we had as smooth and comfortable ride as possible.

This was the 2nd time I went on this tour and it was as good as the 1st time. It was different to the time before which was great. The guide had a great sense of humour and a wealth of knowledge. Everything was great, highly recommend to anyone visiting new york. It gives you a head start to know the areas you want to go back and explore! Bug shout out to Tim our guide, he really was great.
Great bus and boat tour of all the key attractions. Tour guide Gil was exceptional. Very knowledgeable and entertaining.

Our tour of NYC was amazing. Our tour guide and driver were so educated and fun while telling us the history and the silly side of NYC. This tour was perfect for my 10 year old son and I. I recommend this tour to everyone.

We are so glad we did this tour on our first day in NY, it gave a nice brief overview of all the great sites in Manhattan. It would have taken us way longer and might have costed more money if we were to organize the tour on our own. Definitely worth the money.

Mike, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable of the city, his stories made the tour even better.

FANTASTIC, cannot speak highly enough of this tour.

Very comfortable coaches for small groups (approx 25), hugely knowledgeable and entertaining local guide (Gil), thoughtful driver (Anthony) and ALL the 'must see' attractions of NYC are included. Plenty of photo stops, a lunch break, a cruise to Statue of Liberty and Brooklyn Bridge.

Ideal if you have only one day in NYC or if you want to check out the city before returning to the attractions of your choice.

The Guide (Gil) took time to ensure everyone on the tour got the best photos ever, no more selfies, he uses your phone/camera and the results were professional.

He even included thoughful and well appointd 'comfort stops' :)

Possibly not the cheapest tour of NYC bur certainly the most detailed, a very slick operation, and certainly the best value.

Highly recommended.

Glad we selected this tour to be introduced to NYC. Our guide Gil was informative, entertaining and took the time to answer our questions. A lot is packed into the tour but it was with ample time to tour the sights. Not a rushed tour. Highly recommended.

Recommended if you're only in New York for a short stay, as we were. Gives you a good overview of the city, with ideas of where you might want to go back to. 9-11 memorial was an emotional stop, but is now an essential part of any tour around New York :-(
Tour guide J IS the best guide in New York! Very informative, full of humour and anecdotes, and we didn't mind being ribbed for being British (honest guv!)
Plenty of stops for comfort breaks, and buffet lunch stop had a varied range of food to suit all tastes.

This tour lasted about 6 hours and the time flew by! The meet up spot was very easy to locate, organized well and bus arrived on time at 10am. Our tour guide Gil, was great! He was so informative and could tell he truly had a love for the city. My mom and I are were pleasantly surprised about all the history we received about each land mark and even streets/restaurants we passed during the drive. It seems everything in New York has a story behind it! There are multiple locations you stop to get off at and are guided through them. The boat ride was an awesome bonus! All and all we couldn't of been happier with our tour. Gil and our driver Johnny were the best!

The meeting point (back of Winter Garden Theatre on 7th Avenue between 50 and 51st street) was easy to find and the local tour representative placed us in groups of about 30 for each bus. Our tour guide, Tyler, was amusing and informative and kept the group together. The tour started at 10:00am and finished at 4:30pm (including boat trip to Statue of Liberty and Brooklyn Bridge) We stopped on 4 or 5 occasions for 5-30 minutes to look more closely at areas of interest. There was plenty of attention to comfort breaks and the lunch time stop had a wide range of food options that would suit anyone. This was a really great one-day tour to introduce the main sites of tourist interest in New York City.

Great introduction and orientation to the city. Brief visits to significantlandmarks,,Timor for photos, practical tips on everything from shopping to getting around to not getting ripped off. The weather was not great but our guide was full of energy and good spirits which were contagious. Everyone had a great time!

This was my first trip to New York and this tour was amazing. By seeing the landmarks and also hearing the history, I learned so much more than I would have if I had visited the sites on my own. Rachel was bubbly, fun and informative. Kudos to Arlis for navigating the streets of New York. I would highly recommend this tour!

Just got back to our hotel room and had to write a review. Rachel (guide) and Raymond (driver) could not have been better. My wife and I have toured all over the world and Rachel is the best by far. She is a people person. She wants to please every person in her group. She guards her group just like they were her very own. She is polite to other people and groups but when it’s her groups time it is HER GROUPS TIME. She is articulate and maybe the most knowledgeable person I have ever seen with diverse facts that leave you fascinated. But ... if you think she will hold up the entire group while she waits on someone that fails to be on time for departure you're wrong. She makes certain you know when and where to be back at the shuttle and she sticks by it. I love that. This tour is a great overview of the city and you get the broad perspective on NYC. And finally, she gives you some common guidelines and money saving tips that will make your stay in NYC much more pleasurable.

My dad is 80, and he has been wanting to visit NYC. He has no problem getting in and out of a bus, but just can't walk long distances without getting pain in his legs. This tour was perfect for him, Tyler did a great job and provided us with a lot of information about the city. I recommend this tour as a great way to see a lot of the city in one day.

Overall, I would not recommend the trip, the bus is without the front view, thus you can actually see only from the side windows, back in the bus is huge noisy air condition, thus I recommend to come early if you want to hear the guide and sit in front of the bus..
the organisation was bit chaotic, always in the hurry, just to see another place, then constantly waiting for bus driver, who was late.
Generally I would say it is much better for american than for foreign tourists, as the info was mostly about buildings and famous movies connected with the buildings.
The best part was the round cruise on the ship at the end, which you can book separately and visit all the interesting other places by taxi or underground and stay there as long as you want...

Just completed a city tour of New York. Our your guide was Tim and he was extremely informative. He explained places, people and buildings from the moment we got on til the moment we got off. If you wanted to know anything, including where to eat and drink, he would advise you. The tour itself is limited due to the horrendous traffic in Manhattan but our driver Gary did a fab job. We saw all the major sights and were allowed to stop get off the bus and take pictures. Water was also included, which was fantastic, considering it was 92° outside.

Tour guide - TIM was absolutely fantastic. He shared personal experiences and was highly knowledgeable about the various attractions including Central Park & celebrities, NBC, boat tour past Ellis Island and Statue of Liberty and 9/11 Memorial, Times Square, etc. Five hour tour lasted about 6 hours, but was truly a treat for the 4 of us in every way possible. Tim made the tour thoroughly enjoyable.

Our tour guide Tyler was fabulous - not just knowledgeable and informative, but generous with tips and advice about being 'street-wise' while in NYC. Her passion for the city really shines through. Our driver was brilliant and there is an endless supply of free water.
BUT... only criticism would be that the bus isn't really ideal for SEEING some of the passing sights. It is NOT a double-decker/open-top. The windows aren't high and you can't see ahead - even the tour guide has to stoop/bend at the front to see ahead, and you're very much at traffic/congestion level. There is no bathroom onboard (which there was on much shorter tours we did). The boat was excellent for viewing the bridges - it goes under them and gets closer to the Statue Of Liberty than the Staten Island Ferry.
If you're on a budget, my advice would be to wait until you get to NY and maybe opt for the cheaper hop-on/hop-off open-top bus tours (weather dependant) and take the free Staten Island ferry to experience the water - or book an organised cruise from Battery Park - depends how close you feel you need to be to Liberty/bridges etc and how much info/commentary you require?

My family of 6 and I took the tour on Saturday June 9th and were lucky enough to get Tim the tour guide and Gary the bus driver, who were phenomenal and made our trip such a memorable one! The pick-up point was easy to find and we left right on time. The tour included all the key places to visit, and we saw and did so much during those 6 hours. Tim was so engaging, enthusiastic and had such a vast wealth of knowledge about the history of all the areas we passed by and visited! It was very informative and entertaining. I felt like he really cared about us and made sure we got good pictures at all our points of interest. By the end of the day he felt like an old friend giving us his personal tips and recommendations about the city. And wow! Gary can really navigate through the chaotic NYC traffic! We were so impressed and had a ton of fun. I highly recommend taking this awesome tour. We were so glad that we did, because it literally was the highlight of our stay in New York! Thank you so much Time and Gary!! 5+ stars from “your people” in Austin Texas!!

We had time and budget for one tour of NYC and picked this one. And we were not disappointed! It was the first time for my Mom and Dad to visit the Big Apple and they raved about the interesting information they learned, the places they got to visit and the experiences they had. This city is way too much to take in on 100 tours like this, but for one day, I felt like we took the pulse of NYC enough to know what we want to do next time we come back (hello blue's clubs in Greenwich Village). Thanks to Tyler who was wonderful, knowledgeable and personable. And thanks to Geo for doing what I'd never want to do - drive a bus through the streets of Manhattan!

Overall, a great tour.

We took the tour on 29th April. The tour included all the key places to visit. Our guide was Rachel who provided excellent information about each of the sites and invaluable tips about getting around NY. The pick up point was easy to find and the Bus was comfortable. We could not have wished for a better tour.

Alan UK

My husband (81) and I (73) visited NYC for the very first time, and had just two days. This was the perfect tour for us. We had an excellent driver Juan (Raymond), and the most fantastic guide ever, 'J '. He was not only very very knowledgeable in historical and modern day NYC, he was extremely entertaining, and made sure that we did not miss seeing a thing. We made several stops to get off the bus and walk around with J, such as Central Park and the 911 Memorial; in addition to a bathroom break and a lunch stop. Part of the tour was a very nice large boat on which we cruised to see the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island. My husband has issues with walking very far, but we were allowed to take his small, foldable transport wheelchair, so he was able to get off at every stop to enjoy all that the tour had to offer. J was very kind and patient in assisting him and others where needed. We were extremely happy that we chose this tour. It was truly one of the highlights of our visit to this wonderful city.

Wonderful tour. Tyler was really knowlegable and friendly. Tour lasted about 6 hrs. We saw all the iconic nyc sites and many more less well known ones. Small group size allowed for time to ask questions and time to get to know lots about living in nyc and its history. Would certainly recommend to anyone who is visiting the city for the first time.

We LOVED our New York in One Day tour! Gil was our tour guide and he did an excellent job. He talked nearly non-stop, giving so many interesting historical and pop culture facts about the city. I liked that the tour shuttle was 'our bus for the day.' We could leave personal belongings on the bus during the walking portions and we never had to worry about long lines to get back on a crowded bus. We stopped for lunch at 1:30 in a quiet part of town that offered some easy and quick food choices (we had 30 minutes for lunch). The boat tour was nice and we were able to see the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island. My daughters (ages 8 and 11) loved the tour as well. I would definitely recommend this tour to others. We only had one day to see New York, so this tour was perfect. I would also recommend the One Day Tour as a great starting point for a longer stay in the city. Gil did a great job of pointing out sites, restaurants, etc where we could return and spend more time. I wish we had the time to see them all. Overall, this tour was well-worth it!
