This tour is a great way to start your sightseeing experience in NYC...from start to finish, the tour takes you through Manhattan stopping for photo moments at Strawberry fields, Rockefeller center, Empire State Building, 9/11 museum, eating lunch near south street seaport and Statue of Liberty on a boat cruise.
Our tour guide, Tim, was an excellent resource for providing historical facts about the city, neighborhoods and restaurants..He even didn’t mind snapping pictures of your group. I highly recommend booking this tour next time you’re in the Big Apple.

Gil and crew were awesome! Gil is so knowledgeable and has great stories. He makes sure everyone is looked after the entire time and remembers where everyone is from. He told us way more than I was expecting and the stops that were chosen were excellent. He was able to address all the questions that customers asked and well worth the money. My son was not to sure about doing a bus tour but afterwards he said that was better than I was thinking it would be - which is high praise for a 16 yr old whose nose is always in a device. LOL

Shout out to Tyler & Gio - not just for their wealth of knowledge of the city but for the general tips & advice - when you’re from Australia, it’s the little tips like restaurant coding that really make a difference. Couldn’t have asked for more. Pick up & drop off heaps easy, destinations we’re on point - literally saw everything. Bring walking shoes & warm clothes as you’ll be outside at times for photos & lunch etc.

We did this tour with Gil(guide) and Gio(driver) on the recommendation of a friend who had done it a couple of months earlier.
The tour was excellent!!
Pick up spot was easy to find, and bus was on time.
We saw SO MUCH in the 6 hours, and absorbed so much information, history and detail from Gil - he was such an enthusiastic and knowledgable guide, and obviously loves his job and his city.
The tour was personal as well as informative and covered such a lot - the time just flew. Gil also gave lots of suggestions regarding activities, sights, restaurants etc that we could follow up during the rest of our stay.
I highly recommend this tour!

Yesterday for my son's 18th birthday we choose to go to New York for the day. This was our first trip as a family and I choose to do a tour. After reviewing the options we choose USA Guided Tours 'Quick Manhattan by Day' tour. I was very nervous about it as we did not know anyone personally that had ever used this service before and you do not meet in a necessarily conventional place (which kind of adds to the mystery). You meet in the middle of the block on 7th Ave. between 50 and 51st street at the Winter Garden theater. The tour busses are the perfect size. You do not get 'lost in the crowd' on this tour. It is pretty darn close to a private tour. The tour last from 10-4 and you see so many interesting sights. It ends with a boat tour that gets you in the best position to take amazing pics of the Statue of Liberty. That as well as the 9/11 memorial was super impressive to my boys! I have to say that all of it was made exponentially better due to our tour guide, Tim. Tim was amazing! He had interesting stories, funny jokes and a way of drawing you in that made you feel like you were all a part of a family. All of this with his outstanding knowledge of the area and the New York accent made the tour, by far, the best part of our day trip to New York! The tour company provides water for you, Tim and Roy (the bus driver) made sure that there were ample bathroom breaks and they were very conscious of the fact that it was FRIGID outside. We did not have to wait ever for the bus. When we finished any of the walking tours or the boat tour, our warm bus and Roy were waiting for us. The tour offers many choices for lunch, we ate at Fulton 55 Market and Papaya Dog. There is also a Dunkin Donuts and Little Italy (name of the Italian pizza place). I could say so much more positive things about this tour! The absolute only thing for me was that I was a little confused about the initial meeting place. I think that was mainly my fault though because I thought the Winter Garden was like a real garden, not a theater. If I would have researched a little better I would have known more what to look for. All in all I would give them 10 stars if I could. Much love from your Maryland group! Thank you for helping to make my son's 18th a very special memory. This is a definite do again, maybe the night tour next time as long as we have Tim to guide us!!

If you want to see as much of New York as possible in a day, then this is the tour for you! I've been to NYC a few times, and saw more in one day than I have seen in the last three visits. Gil was our tour guide. He's a real New Yorker and a real character. I wouldn't say he's overly friendly, but he was genuine and had a no BS attitude. I appreciated that on the tour and somehow it made it even more authentic. Highly recommended.

Any tour is really only as good as the guide and the one we had was terrible. He didnt like anyone asking questions, evident by his frown when anyone dared to ask anything and the fact he didnt know the answer so would just repeat information he had already given half of which was obviously made up! The fact that so much of the information he gave was incorrect left me wondering if anything he said was true. For example the building which is an "exact" copy of Big Ben but "ten times" bigger - really, does he not know Big Ben is a bell! Just because its a square tower with a clock on top does not make it Elizabeth Tower, no resemblance at all! He tended to waffle on e.g. 5 minutes he spent telling us how ridiculously epxensive some womens shoes were, I think he was talking about Louboutins but what the price of french shoes has to do with a New York tour I have no idea! I guess he had to waffle as he knew so little. Do they not audition their guides or check their facts?? Was after 2pm before he took us to a dive supermarket in a grim back street to get some lunch. The water taxi tour at the end was good though and the guide on that interesting and informative but pretty sure you could book that yourself directly. Complete rip off and waste of time.

Gil and Arliss were wonderful, we got so many fun and informational fact that show them to be true New Yorkers! We were just in for the day and had a wonderful experience, my 12 and 9 year old daughter love it! Gil is entertaining and always made sure were safe and didn’t get run over, he also helped take photos so your family or party could get photos together!

This was an outstanding tour. It hits the ball out of the park. The guide was OUTSTANDING. We saw the highlights of the city, got background, there was walking to sites, just the perfect balance. Highly recommend this tour and guide 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
I wish that our tour guide could explain more facts about New York, the places we pass by, the structures/buildings that we visited. There is always room for improvement.

Our tour guide Debbie felt like a good friend by the end of the tour. She was passionate and caring and very educated on the history of her beloved NYC. The rest of our tour my teenage girls were quoting Debbie every day. We will never forget this wonderful day!!

Brought my daughter to celebrate her 16th birthday in NYC. We took this tour our second day in the city and now we are so much more informed of where to go and what to do and not to do in NYC. Our guide Gil filled us with knowledge from the moment we boarded the bus until the end of the trip, all while making us laugh. The driver Raymond was in sync with Gil and no time was wasted. Totally recommend this tour!!

Our tour guide was knowledgeable and entertaining. I loved the boat ride, we got to see great views of the city and never felt rushed. If you have limited time to see the city, this is the tour for you!

Rachel was a fantastic tour guide. She was incredibly knowledgeable about the city and it's history and had a fun, upbeat presentation. She really helped tried to get to know each of the participants, where we were from and what we did, etc. Her system for getting us great pictures and to really see the sites was first rate. We have already recommended her as a tour guide to some friends that are visiting New York in the upcoming month. She gave us great tips on restaurants, shopping, shows and survival in New York. She really went above and beyond for us. I accidently left my walking sticks on the bus and she found us at a restaurant that she had recommended and brought them back to me! Rachel makes this tour absolutely the best!

Tony and Tim should have their own slot on the comedy scene!!!
We were slightly disappointed with the mode of transport. More of a transportation bus than a tour bus.
Having said that Tim was funny and we did have a good day. Seeing the sights, getting Off n on at key points. Covered the basics of NYC and very organised.
Included a ferry trip to Statue of Liberty which was a nice finish to the day.

Our tour guide was Gill, he was very informative and had a lot of information stored up in his head. Very knowledgable of New York, he is a local so knows it like the back of his hand. Great tour and well worth the money to see the sites and attractions. Would recommend this to anyone who doesn't know New York. It was our first visit here and we are happy we spent one of our days doing this. :)

It was a rainy day and still our tour guide, Deanna if I remember well, a latin lady, made the tour so enjoyable. We visited the main attractions and we had a great time. Highly recommended. Groups small enough and personal attention that is hard to find nowadays.

Kudos to USA Tours. Loved the one day tour and to Gil our host. He knows his stuff and comes with a personality! I would do this tour again in a heartbeat and certainly highly recommend it! More time at the September 11th Memorial would have been my highlight vice the ten minutes we had to freely explore.

From beginning to end the USA day tour kept our interest. We were moving throughout the day, but felt absorbed with the sights. Our guide Gil was excellent, providing historical as well as popular culture information. Young and old as well as families and singles were part of the tour. We have been to New York City at least a dozen times, which made it possible for us to enjoy the combination of familiar with new sights.

Met the tour guide and driver at 7th Ave & 50th. The tour bus is hard to miss and is shaped like a typical USA truck with USA tours printed across it. You stop at lots of different destinations on the tour for photo opportunities (Central Park, Rockefeller Building, Empire State Building, 5th Ave) You stop for lunch at a place at the seaport, you pay for lunch yourself and there are a few options to choose from. The boat trip to see the Brooklyn Bridge, Ellis Island and The Statue of liberty is after lunch and takes about an hour. You get can some great pictures of the statue of liberty up close. The tour guide is very knowledgeable and talks about the facts of the city throughout the tour. The tour started at 10am and we were dropped back to 7th Ave around 4pm. It would be best to do this tour at the start of your holiday, as the guide point's out places to visit while on holiday. It was a good day.

I jumped on a tour led by Rachael and driver Roy. I prebooked the tour expecting it to be slightly more in-depth than one of those big bus tours which I have done a few of in different cities.

Man, was I impressed! Best value for money. Rachael is an exceptional guide going above and beyond what a typical tour guide does. She may not come from NYC originally, but she has certainly been here long enough to understand what makes this city tick.

An excellent way to sample NYC, I would recommend doing this tour at the start of your stay in NYC, then you can go back to revisit places in more depth if you want, or try out things Rachael suggest tourists do but there isn’t enough time on the tour to do.

Great comfortable bus to get around in too. Great job from the team
We took the 7 hour tour and it was really good. I suggest doing it the first day you are there so you can go back to any places you’d like to spend longer at.

We enjoyed our tour. Good overview of the city with good stops. Many sites are hard to see from the bus since you have to look up and the people on the aisle can’t really do that. Seemed that the left side had way more to see than the right. I think it’s a good value for the money.
From start to finish Gil was 2nd to none. Driver Johnny 1st rate. What we covered was plus plus & attention to detail without going ott, spot on, worth paying the extra for a really unbeatable trip.

This tour was recommended by a friend. Comfortable and well air conditioned bus. Arliss was our driver, and boy could he drive like a pro in that NYC mess! Arliss got us everywhere safely and timely.
Gil has so much knowledge of the city it’s quite impressive and his delivery is very captivating. He covers it all.
This is a quick paced tour so I wouldn’t recommend it for anyone who has trouble walking briskly.
One part that cracked me up was the little speech Gil gave about climate change and then you get on a boat that’s spewing out huge rolls of black smoke into the atmosphere. Kinda ironic
Gil makes it pretty clear he is anti Trump. That’s your personal right, but keep that to yourself, not everyone is. Just remember, Gil, it’s because of President Trump and this administrations booming economy that ppl can afford the extra luxury of taking your tour and tipping you both as well. That’s how you make your living so be appreciative.
“Kentucky” 7:19:19

We wanted to take this tour our first full day in New York so we could take in all the sights and decide afterwards which ones to return to later. It did not disappoint any of us. Our tour went from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Our tour guide was Dina. She and our driver paired wonderfully. Does the guide make a difference? Absolutely! She has 12 years of experience as a tour guide in New York. Her wealth of knowledge was incredible as was her easy going attitude and presentation. I observed another guide leading a group just ahead of ours and the difference was huge. In fact, I feel so strongly about the way Dina conducted the tour that I would recommend scheduling her trip or delay the trip to another day. Even if it alters your plans, schedule the tour with Dina as the guide.

The tour had the right amount of walking and riding to provide a quick but thoroughly informative overview of everything you could want to see in New York City. It covered everything from Central Park to the 9/11 Memorial and everything in between. Wall Street, Times Square, exclusive shopping area, Rockefeller Center, Broadway, local dining, Statute of Liberty, Brooklyn Bridge, Federal and State Court Houses, Empire State Building just to name a few. The tour included a ferry boat ride around the harbor and Hudson River with the typical sights. The guide/ narrator on the ferry wasn’t bad but compared to Dina - well let’s say it’s not a fair comparison.

My 16 year old was against a “bus tour” however his view was completely changed well before our 6 hour tour was completed. I was concerned about how much and how far we would be required to do fast-paced walking due to an old skiing injury and resulting leg surgery but it wasn’t a problem. Dina was easy to spot and follow as she held a blue and lime green umbrella high while leading our group of 33 around almost like the pied piper. If you needed to “sit out” any of the stops for some reason, remaining on the comfortable bus/tour coach was permitted. A cooler filled with bottled water was also maintained in the front of the bus for our tour participants to grab as needed.

Dina threw in restaurant tips, info on better broadway show tickets, apartment rental costs and qualifications. She knew about the best pizza and even how to avoid “mystery meat” hotdogs.

If you are unfamiliar with New York City and are considering a
tour, do yourself a favor - book this trip with Dina. You will not be disappointed.

I went on the day tour 3 days ago, with my husband and another couple. This was our 4th time visiting NYC, but the first visit for our friends. We all absolutely loved the tour. It had all the sights and stops that we were interested in. The boat cruise at the end was the perfect way to see the NYC skyline. It was a very hot day, so the comfortable, air-conditioned bus was very enjoyable! Our tour guide, Rachael, definitely made the tour for us! She was friendly, and full of knowledge. Even though, it was my 4th trip to NYC, I learned so much from her stories and tips to navigate the city! She is a wealth of information! On my next visit, I plan to do the night tour! This tour is worth the price!

I booked this trip for my fiancé‘s first time in New York City. Tyler was our tour guide and she is absolutely fabulous! The buses that take you around town are comfortable and air-conditioned. Tyler knew everything about anything and it made my New York City experience by far the best of any trip! Even if you’ve been to New York City multiple times this is still a really awesome!!

Gil and Arliss were fun ,extremely courteous,and safety conscious at all times.Gil is a walking talking encyclopedia on NYC and fun to boot.He`s a natural,we were thoroughly impressed and had a great day,MJ,Australia

This tour started at 11am and finished around 4.30pm. Never dull, we had a few stops including one to buy some lunch. The tour guide Dayna was great and very knowledgeable, the boat trip around the Statue of Liberty was perfect, make sure you sit up top in the right hand side if you can. The guide on the boat was also great. I’d definitely recommend this tour, it’s gives a taste of everything and then you can go back at your own pace to see the things that interested you most.

Nathalie showed us the sites and shared some of the experiences and stories with us. Plenty of time for photos, rest breaks and with her happy and personable attitude, it was a great tour of the 911 experience.
Would definitely recommend for anyone wanting a close up feel of world trade centre history.

Our tour guide, Tyler, made this tour for us. She was so professional, but a lot of fun too. Her knowledge of the city was amazing!
The tour itself was great. We got to see so much of the city on our first trip to NYC. The tour was part riding in a comfortable/air conditioned van (very grateful for that), part walking (necessary & fun to really see the sights & how people live) & a boat ride to see the Statue of Liberty & Brooklyn Bridge. Thankfully the rain held off until the end of our tour.
Take this tour the first day of your trip so you can decide what areas you want to see more thoroughly.

Fantastic tour of NYC in a day! Gil the tour guide was so amazing and informative. Betty was an excellent driver. We learned so much about the incredible city. The bus was clean and air conditioned, just wish it had bigger windows to see out. Highly highly recommend this tour.

This was the best tour we have had in any location. It happened to be on a rainy day in New York so we were thankful we were in a covered bus. Only about 20 people. Our tour guide, Gil was terrific and very knowlegable about the city. We saw and learned so much in one day. The kids liked getting off the bus at times for very short walks to get closer to places. The boat tour that was included was also fun and a great end to the day. I would highly recommend this tour. It is worth the money. You can get the hop on hop off tours for less but being enclosed is a plus and you can hear the guide. USA guided tours is the best by far.

We just completed this day tour with our amazing guide, Rachel and our wonderful driver Jonny. Awesome tour hitting highlights of Manhattan. Perfect length and Rachel did great keeping us on track and keeping things interesting. She is very knowledgable about the City and offers several helpful tips for visitors. The boat portion was lots of fun and gives you great up close views of Statue of Liberty, Brooklyn Bridge, and Manhattan sky line. We highly recommend this tour!

I've been to NYC many times but have never done the tour. Guests from the Midwest gave me the opportunity to try this. Gil, our guide, and Antonio, our driver, could not change the truly awful rainy weather, but they did change the tour a bit to save us from a complete drenching. They were outstanding -- plenty of history, art, popular culture. The information was fascinating and Gil was enthusiastic -- he was undaunted by the pouring rain and made all of us feel willing to have an adventure with him. We were all in it together! I was grateful for the comfy bus and the small group. The boat trip would have been a highlight, and we did get very close to the Statue of Liberty, but most of the shoreline was nearly invisible. Even New York's tall buildings were shrouded in fog. ...not a good day for photography! Still, Central Park was a watercolor painting of spring blooms. Rain could not mar the historic art and architecture of Rockefeller Center and Grand Central Station, nor dim the bright lights of Times Square, nor wash away the memory of those whose names are carved in stone at the 9/11 memorial, both innocent and heroic. It's New York.

The whole experience of the one day tour was amazing start to finish, our tour guide Gil and Anthony the driver made it so enjoyable and informative.
We stopped for lunch at Fulton Market, so much choice, lovely fresh food.
We had fantastic weather which made the views on the boat trip around the statue of liberty and Brooklyn bridge even more outstanding.
In the UK when booking trip we thought is was a bit expensive however it was worth every single penny. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this trip to everyone on a visit to NYC.
Big thanks to Gil and Anthony for making the trip more memorable

Our tour guide Gil was fantastic! So knowable and so very interesting. Have been to New York many times over the years and I would say this is one of the best 1 day tours I have been on. Gil was able to answer all questions (large number of people on the tour were foreigners) and give advise for other attractions and places to eat. Excellent value.

Our tour guide, Rachel, was super excellent. She was very informative and entertaining. She covered a lot about New York especially giving little tidbits here and there that made this tour very enjoyable. She also gave lots of suggestions how to live like a New Yorker and survive the Big Apple, including where to eat, go shopping, and what means of transportation to use in the city and back to the airport. She just wanted to make sure that us tourists would enjoy our time here and make the most out of it. I definitely recommend this tour for everyone at the start of their vacation.

We loved our tour. It was not our first visit to NYC, but we wanted to see more than we had in the past. Our group was small which was very nice. Gil and Anthony were both so helpful and professional. We learned so much about this great city!

This is a must do trip if you are in New York. Our guide Jay was so entertaining, he is a walking encyclopedia of facts about this fabulous city. We have been on many bus tours where you hop on and hop off but then you end up spending hours waiting for buses. On this tour everyone gets off at the various points and Jay tells you about the scenic spot, much better way of doing it. We thoroughly enjoyed our trip. Excellent introduction to New York.

Booked this trip through TripAdvisor via Viator, based on the reviews, and the reviews were right on! My friends have never been to Manhattan/NYC and it has been about 15 years since I’ve been. We did this tour the first day we arrived to NYC and it was a perfect primer to get a great overview of the city and how the city is laid out. You meet at a specified location (information provided when you purchase your tickets) and the company conducting the tour I was on was USA Guided Tours (tour bus is labeled with the company name). Tim was the guide and Roy was the driver and they were both great! They provided rain ponchos and water if needed. We just didn’t sit on the bus, and had the opportunity to get out and walk around at key areas as described. Great to hear the history and have plenty of opportunities to take photos. Tim was very gracious in offering to take photos of individuals/groups on our tour as well. Highly recommend this tour. A note about the tour bus: it can be a bumpy ride on those city streets, so if you get car sick easily, sit closer to the front or take whatever you normally do for possible motion sickness.

We visited New York in January 2019 and was lucky enough to choose USA Guided Tours New York for our sightseeing tour of New York. Our guide, Tyler was a local to New York and shared with us her extensive knowledge of her town. Her presentation skills were excellent as well as her friendliness, personality and enthusiasm to please. Our driver Roy was excellent as well. They were both worthy of our tips. The price of the tour was worth every dollar and thoroughly recommend this tour to everyone. Well done Tyler and Roy for a great experience.

Mike was an excellent guide and a wealth of information, very caring and personable. I felt like he was a friend by the end of the day! We learned about so many things and we saw more than one would think is possible in one day! It was New Years Eve Day in NYC, Tony, the driver, and Mike did an excellent job getting us places through the crowds and road closures. They even had ponchos for us for the cruise since it was raining. When you only have a short time in the city or if you want to see what there is before you explore more this is the way to do it!

TAKE THIS TOUR if you have limited time in the City. Really liked that we didn't sit on the bus for long periods. We were able to visit many sites, yet it wasn't an excessive amount of walking. Guide was full of interesting information. This is an excellent way to better understand the layout of the area and determine the sites you want to spend more time at after the tour. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

This was my first trip to New York City. Never having been there, and our trip was only a day trip, I wanted to squeeze in as much as possible. This tour offered a lot to see. It was a great value for the price. Due to going on a Saturday, during Christmas season, the traffic was extremely heavy. Due to traffic there was only a couple of things listed we didn’t get to do, drive through Soho, Greenwich Village & Chinatown and stop by Wall Street. Our guide, Rachael, was very knowledgeable about NYC. Our driver, Gary, was great too! Rachael offered up places to go, food to eat, and other general knowledge about how to get good deals on rides around city, etc. She made sure the group kept up with her when getting off the bus carrying her red, white and blue umbrella and holding it up high so we could always see where she was amongst the masses of sightseers. It was also nice having a small busload of people in our group. The bus was enclosed and not open air which made it nice not having to be in the cold. I do recommend to dress very warm when you take the ferry out to the Statue of Liberty, as it’s very cold when you go out in front of the boat or on top to take pictures. Some stops are rushed, because if not then you wouldn’t get to see as much. I didn’t mind that because I enjoyed getting to see a lot.

We only have 4 days in NY, I want to see as much as possible. I booked One Day Guided tour with Gil and Anthony. They were absolute wonderful team. Gil was a great tour guide who is very knowledgeable and also friendly. He offered to take pictures for everyone which it was a plus since I traveled myself on this tour. He kept on time for every attractions so we don't get behind the schedule. If you are coming to NYC, don't miss this tour.
If you want to get acclimated to NYC or just have a day this is a great way to scratch the surface of the sights and history. Would recommend.

This was the perfect see NYC ina day tour. Some walking , riding and boat tour. Every sight was passed or visited. Fabulous and informational - Jay was very knowledgeable
Book this and you will be thrilled if you have limited time to see NYC

Great way to see the highlights of NYC! I was travelling with both my mom and teenage son, and everyone enjoyed the tour. Our guide, Rachel, was very informative and gave us tips for the rest of our trip. We zipped around the city in our bus and hopped on and off to see the sites. We were very pleased with the tour!

I was a little hesitant to do this tour because of the price, but it was 100% worth it! Our tour guide (Mike) was fantastic. He was very knowledgeable and interesting. You stop at so many places on the tour bus, and I love that the boat tour is also included.

This tour was fantastic!! My parents and my husband and I took this tour in early November 2018. It was absolutely perfect for us because my dad can only walk in short bursts. This tour had the perfect amount of walking vs riding the bus. The tour guide was not just knowledgeable, but was fun to listen to! We all had a great time on this tour and it easily became our favorite "excursion" we took on our vacation that also included Bermuda and Boston! I'd highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting to see as much as you can in 1 day in NYC!

My Grandson and I did a 3 day 18th birthday celebration. We wanted to see as much as we could of the city. It was his first visit. The guided tour with Gil as the narrator and Haywood as our driver made it a true lasting memory. Gil as a historian he knew so much of the past and the now . He made a long day seem to go by. Great experience ! I won’t hesitate to do again. Thank you for a perfect day.

Gil was our tour guide, he was very informative with good information and the tour was comprehensive and informative. The added boat tour of the harbor was spectacular, definitely consider this tour. Only negative is buses that are difficult to see from, they need bigger buses with windows in the roof for such tall buildings.

I’m glad I did this tour. I got to see so much and thought if I did it alone I would have gotten lost for sure! Gill was so knowledgeable and Tony was a great driver. They are both friendly. I’ve not had any bad experiences in New York and New York has the nicest people. It’s a great way to see if you want to go to the attraction and spend longer on your own. I would highly recommend this tour.
Tyler was the best tour guide ever! Her knowledge of the City was incredible, we learned so much. My sisters and enjoyed our visit to New York.

My wife and I took the “New York in One Day” tour on Sat, Set 15, 2018. We were really lucky to get Rachel and her driver, Washington, as our guides. When I say that this tour made our entire trip to NYC worth-while, I am not kidding! Rachel, the tour guide was amazing! She was entertaining, super-passionate about her city and it’s history, and she told us really useful stuff, like how to deal with taxi-cab drivers , how to get a chance to win tickets to Broadway shows, and lots of other useful bits of knowledge about this city. Without this tour, we would never have seen the sights we saw, nor would we have understood their significance.

My husband and I did this tour yesterday with “tour guide Jay”.
It started well with jovial banter but quickly became a rant about the English, people from New Jersey and how much the Irish drank.
I love a bit of banter but after 2 hrs of unrelenting negativity and self promotion from the guide it quickly became uncomfortable
. The bus itself was good clean and not massive.
We saw a lot of the major sights and covered some ground
We did ask if “ The negativity could be toned down a little and his response was “ I haven’t even gotten started yet”.

However he did tone down the rant about the English...(unfortunately he ramped up the negativity about others and continued the self promotion).
The man clearly seems to know the history of New York but his obsession with celebrity and all round cynical attitude made the 5 hrs drag and almost caused us to leave at one point.

We went on the tour to hear about New York- not “tour guide Jay”, his frustration and bigotry. So a good tip would be- take ear plugs or book another tour.
Fortunately we did another tour today of the 9/11 memorial with a guide called Issa Best - who was fantastic and far more engaging.

Excellent tour which started at 10am and finished around 4.30 pm. Easy to find the starting place and we were met by a rep with a clipboard with our name on it. Our guide was Tyler. She was very informative about NYC and we learned a lot from her as she was a local. The only thing I found a bit off putting was her quite ‘theatrical’ style of delivering information at times but nonetheless she was good at her job. We had an, at times, very wet day but we managed to dodge the showers and see everything in dry conditions until we boarded the boat which was quite an entertaining experience trying to stay dry and take pictures of the Statue of Liberty! At the end of the tour we were dropped off at the starting point by our careful driver Ray who negotiated the NYC traffic very well in sometimes awful weather conditions! I would definitely recommend this tour rather than the Hop On/Off tour buses which take forever to get around and also aren’t so personalised as this smaller tour - thanks for a great day out!
Did this tour today. Tim was our guide and he was just great! Knew his facts, very knowledgeable! A few corny jokes to keep everyone on their toes! A long day but very worth the cost! Thanks Tim!

Thanks to Tim the guide for making the tour not only entertaining but informative. I only had a few days in New York so selected this tour because it gave me the opportunity to see many of the attractions all on the same day.

I lived in NYC for 20 years. I never write reviews.I was hosting a 16 year old girl from Ireland who had one day to visit NYC. I wanted to show her as much of the city as possible. I have never done a tour of NYC. I could have done it on my own but didn't and am so glad that we chose this tour. We saw so much and learned a lot along the way. It was so nice to take in the city by bus in a relaxing, clean, comfortable environment. We were guided every step of the way and the boat portion was really great. Recommend this to anyone visiting nyc that wants a guided tour. People on tour were polite and easy going as well. Gil was our guide, two thumbs up. Really, the price per person is totally worth it.

Easy to find pick up area, A nice air conditioned medium sized bus with a great driver (Gary) and Rachel our tour guide was very knowledgeable and funny she made us laugh,she new the best places to stop to get the best photos of the different attractions, and also took pictures of us. She also made bathroom stops, and a lunch stop,Bottled water was supplied free on the bus.Very helpful on the best places to eat and visit.They both made the tour more fun and exciting. Thank you both and USA Tours.

We enjoyed Tyler and her narrative tour. We saw many sites throughout the city including the Hornblower cruise to see Statue of Liberty. Excellent stops for us to walk around. And take photos. Great lunch suggestions for the local market. Food was amazing and affordable... unlike some restaurants in NYC. Great day! Highly recommend if you don’t have a lot of time to site see. Would have loved to spend more time at the 9/11 memorial and see the museum but that is a half day at least.

Our tour guide Tyler was absolutely wonderful! She is very knowledgeable and gave many useful tips to help first timers, like myself, navigate New York! Our driver, Anthony was awesome in his ability to navigate NYC traffic.
Great tour to take at the beginning of your trip to help decide what landmarks you'd like to visit more in-depth.

I have been to New York a few times for work or just to see a Broadway show. This is my first time to join an organized tour and see most of New York (including a great harbor cruise) without having to worry about taxis or parking. And Jay "J" was well informed, funny and entertaining. Highly recommend this tour.

This tour was the best. A great summary of a vibrant,vast,exciting city focussing on Manhattan. Gil our tour guide was / is fabulous. His knowledge of the city is second to none. His humour and wit kept us awake and engaged. Gil had a great way of controlling the few unruly, precocious children onboard ( parents were oblivious to their behavior). It could have turned into one disappointment if it weren't for Gil. I would definitely go again next time I'm back in the Big Apple.

I found this trip to be well worth the price and time. Our tour guide Gil(very knowledgeable) and driver Anthony (very friendly) could not be more accommodating and pleasant. They provided ice cold water on our 90 degree day which helped immensely. We dId not feel rushed and saw plenty of sites and had many photo ops in a short amount of time. The boat ride was just a cruise around the harbor but the views were fantastic!

We are a family of 5, 3 teens from 16-13 planning a 3 week road trip from Texas to New York and everywhere in-between. I did not know what to expect from this tour but knew I wanted to take some sort of tour as we had never been to NY before. I trusted the reviews (thanks everyone) and crossed my fingers... it was worth it! From the minute Tyler (our amazing tour guide) introduced herself I knew it was going to be great! She was confident, happy, enthusiastic, friendly, and absolutely brilliant. It was non stop information. Current events and historical information from social, structural, economic, political...we learned about the layout of the city, how to get around, how to use the subway, how to not get ripped off in Chinatown, where to find the best cheesecake and pizza! When we were done we were more than thankful for the experience. As a mom, trying to plan a huge vacation for 5, take it from me, this was worth every penny. You will not be disappointed. Thank you Tyler for the memorable experience!

My family and I totally enjoyed this tour. We were picked up at 10 a.m. and dropped off around 4:30 p.m. . There is quite a bit of walking around so be prepared. Tim, the tour guide was amazing. He has an excellent, excellent way of telling stories, very knowledgeable and has an awesome personality.

Took the day tour with guide Rachael. Great narrative of the various neighborhoods, insights into history of landmarks and popular stops. So glad our wonderful driver was able to drop us off and pick us up again to make our adventure easy and relaxing. Boat ride was fun. Perfect weather and clear day.
Recommend this tour to SEE LOTS and LEARN LOTS in a short time span.

This is a excellent tour and offers a great value. It covers most of the big tourist spots in a day. Our tour guide Rachel was wonderful and provided a lot of great tips for making the most of New York.

This was a 6-hour trip including a 1-hour boatride. Our guide, Jill, gave a lot of inside tips on how to get by in NYC, ahd lots of info on all the sights. She was also a fierce protector and clever strategist on behalf of our group in contest with loads of other guided groups! I would recommend this tour as early as possible during your stay, becaus you get a good overview of the city, and good tips on where to eat, drink, how to tip properly and so on. The boatride to the Statue of Liberty was of course nice! There was a lunch-break included, and they stopped at a place where there were lots of different affordable options to eat, very nice! Bring your camera and put on a pair of good walking shoes!

If you are ever in NEW YORKthis one day tour is a must please request Rachel as you tour guide she and J were amazing Rachel explained everything to us she was just amazing very very friendly nothing was to much trouble l would definitely reccomend this tour love loved loved it we would not have seen half and a quarter of the places had we not went on this tour EXCELLENT

I found this tour to be light on opportunities to look at the highlights of New York but full of anecdotes from the tour guide. The best highlight was the 9/11 memorial at ground zero. Good also was the short river cruise out by Ellis Island and the Statue of Liberty, but even those were done at a distance from the islands. The other stops were mediocre and probably could have been done yourself with a hop on hop off bus ticket. Tim the guide was knowledgeable and humorous, a real New Yorker!

Rachel was amazing. She got us off that bus quick, snagged the best photos possible and off to see as much as possible on our tour. Do this tour on day one so you can decide where you want to go back when you have time. Should have done the nighttime tour following but regretfully, did not...

Our day trip with Tim was the best day of our holiday, in the USA for a week. We were met on time, 10am, and the tour with lots of relevant information began immediately. Everyone was made aware of the itenary which entailed loads. Many interesting facts and detail were pointed out by a very knowledgeable and funny Tim. All questions, even the most bizzare were answered appropriately. Water was dished out on several occasions. When the traffic got bad Tim suggested we walk a short distance and see as much as possible and meet up with the driver further on. Lunch was GREAT!!! We were given several choices so when in USA, we had Philly steaks and hot dogs. We then took the Boat ride, again lots of interesting facts and points of interest pointed out by Tim. The day was beautiful and the experience of NY was made by to the kindness and knowledge of our tour guide, Tim, A MUST do Tour

If you have limited time in New York, or don't know where to start, this is the ideal introductory tour. It was informative, very friendly and great fun! Our guide Bernice was fantastic: very knowledgeable, efficient, charming and, above all, extremely funny! She created a great atmosphere amongst our group too. We learnt so much about this amazing city, and got lots of ideas for things we'd like to follow-up on. By the way, for anyone worried about these things, there were enough 'comfort breaks' for everyone, and the lunch venue was just right too. Thoroughly recommended!!

If you ever want to do a tour trip in NYC, there is one truly great Tour Guide available- he is "J" Alan- registered guide. We had a great version of 6 hours doing a major tour through NYC. The key is that 'J' truly knows 'everything'. He never stopped talking with insight, real truthful information. The beauty was his 'energy' in seeing that everyone was comfortable, was having their questions accurately responded, and a desire to make everyone truly happy and very 'confident' with the information picked up. If you have some short time in NYC and want to maximize your tour, 'J' is the extraordinary tour guide and if you require transformation on the tour see that Gio is the driver!

While certainly not the all inclusive way to see New York this hits the highlights. We join the tour right in the middle of Times Square. Then we were off to Central Park with a brief stop at Strawberry Field. Then we visited the 911 memorial, Rockefeller Center, 30 Rock, the Empire State building and other spots on our way to a boat ride past the Statue of Liberty. Our tour guide Tim was really informative and friendly. I would highly recommend this tour. I would only warn you that this does not include a visit into the 911 Museum which you should really do. If you decide to take that trip make sure to dedicate at least 2 hours to that stop.

My two friends and I visited NYC this past week. We are so glad we took this tour! Rachel was an awesome tour guide even though the weather was awful! Our driver, Johnny, was a Rockstar at getting us around in the traffic. We saw everything we wanted to see plus a whole lot more. Rachel is very knowledgeable and she had some great tips that she shared in printed form at the end of the tour. We used the helpful hints sheet for the rest of our stay! She saved us a lot of time and money by providing us with so much info. Don't even attempt to "Do NYC" until you take this tour! Worth every penny! Ask for Rachel! She is amazing!!

I had the pleasure of sailing into New York, and going on this well worth while excursion, for the day. Brilliant guide and coach driver. The Rockafellar Tower lift experience, WOW did that lift go fast. Glad I had a light breakfast. Central Park was very interesting. Grand Central Station, well worth going to just for the architecture, had lunch at a near by café. I ordered SMALL, it would have fed a family of four, I repeatedly said SAMLL PLEASE, they do not know what small means over their. Others on our table ordered hot dogs, massive and chips with everything and cheese and mayo, wallop went the diet. Last stop the 9 - 11 memorial garden and centre. Very moving, all those lives. Back to Queen Mary, for journey home. I was tired next day, I did not wake up until lunch time, well it was worth it. ill I go back? Of course I will.

My family of four (2 adults, 2 children ages 11 and 7) had the pleasure of being guided through NYC by Rachel and Gio. Rachel was full of awesome information! We left Time Square promptly and hit the ground running from there. I highly recommend this tour to anyone. We only had a couple of days in NYC, so taking this tour was perfect. My family got to see highlights of lower Manhattan and we were able to pick what we really wanted to see the next day. Do this tour! Itʻs TOTALLY worth it. My favorite highlights - finding out the origin of the ʻRed Carpetʻ... learning about the Survivors Tree at Ground Zero and having someone explain in laymanʻs terms, the grid system of NYC streets. Oh and fun fact - Rachel gives you tips on how to save major $$ in NYC. Do it!!!

This was a wonderful start to our holiday. We arrived late on Saturday evening and we started this tour on Sunday morning 10.00 a.m. It was a easy way of starting our trip. The guide was J Allen but was known as "J" He made us feel right at home and introduced himself and all the other passengers to each other. The trip was light hearted and very interesting. "J" was very amusing and had plenty of knowledge to share with us but in a easy manner. Plenty of facts and figures but not that you felt overwhelmed with it all. The stops we made and the places we visited gave us our bearing for the rest of the trip. If like us it is your first time in New York then this is a great way to get to know the city. I would like to thank "J" for giving us (a party of 5 from Northern Ireland) a great view of New York and a wonderful tour. I hope we will come back some time again.

This tour was terrific. It covered a lot of what I wanted to and hadn't seen in New York City before live in a very reasonable amount of time 5-6 hours total spent were amazing. During the holidays especially NYC is wonderful full of a lively spirit this past December 2017. I enjoyed seeing Central Park, many of the areas in NY such as Greenwich Village, China Town, Times Square, Broadway, Wall Street/Lower Manhattan, the World Trade Center Memorial and sight, Statue of Liberty, Rockafeller Center, many famous apartments and buildings, excellent cuisine, and learned a lot about NYC. I've added some pictures from the tour, but live it was great and I recommend this tour for sure especially if you want to see a lot in a relatively short amount of time in one of the world's greatest cities.

Our driver, I believe Gino and then tour guide Tim locally from NYC were great. His service and dedication to the awesome work and communication with all the guests was awesome.

We were 6 girls from L.A. who Loved, Loved, Loved this tour. Our driver was so great and knew so much about the city, especially where to get the best deals. She is a great driver and always made sure we were super comfortable in the van, perfect temperature. Tim, our guide, was a pleasure and tried to show us as much of the city as possible. He knew so much about the city that we never knew. He really made our trip very special. What a positive, upbeat guy! We're definetly going to book the night tour and request Tim and Rachel when we're back in the city later on this year. Thanks guys! Also, a special thanks to our British friend Calvin for teaching us about elevensies.

We booked this tour before we travelled to New York, not really knowing what to expect. Have to say we were not disappointed. Minibus was driven by Gary, who really did go the extra mile to get You as close to the landmarks as possible, negotiating the yellow taxi madness expertly! Pick up time was 10am And although we got there early, you were able to sit in the warm bus, as it was freezing outside! The tour then dropped us back at about 4.30.

The tour guide was the amazing Gil, who completely knew every fact, figure and trivia there was to know. In fact I think that if there was something he didn’t know, then it really wasn’t worth knowing 😁, And he certainly was able to ensure the sightseers kept on schedule!

You got to see most major landmarks, went out on a 1hr boat trip getting up close to the lady herself. Lunch was in Fulton Street Market, which itself was a great eating experience.

Plenty of opportunity to take photos, Gil helping to capture the moments for everyone who handed him their phone or camera. Including other sightseeing groups.

Was a great tour, which I would thoroughly recommend, and great value for money

We took the this tour on 31st of December. This is my third time visiting the city from Scotland and taking this tour, each time the tour has been with different family members. I feel that it’s a great way to safely, quickly and easily see the bulk of the main attractions/sites. I do this tour on my first whole day in the city as it’s a good way to get to grips with where things are and which places you’d like to return to explore further.

I was unsure if I’d be a little bored this time around having done it twice previously but I needn’t have worried. Our bus guys, Geo the driver and Tim the tour guide ensured we had a memorable day and I enjoyed it just as much as I have done on previous occasions if not more due to Tim’s humour.

Tim was an excellent guide. Very informative, funny and easy to talk to and handled the 9/11 memorial with sensitively. He ensured that he had everyone from the tour with him at all times when we got off the bus at the certain stops, no easy feat I’m sure in sure a busy city on one of the busiest of days. Tim ensured we had time for plenty of bathroom breaks if required and we stopped for a lunch break during the course of the day.

As three females traveling together Tim made us feel very safe on his tour and it felt like he was genuinely looking out for us throughout the day. Especially on the water taxi when he tried his best to find us all seats to sit in and then despite the artic temps outside he stood and offered to take everyone’s photos at the Statue of Liberty.

I have already recommend this highly enjoyable tour to friends and family who are visiting the city later in the year.

Jared was our guide for this very cold, snowy day. He was very helpful with everything & anything we required or asked about & went out of his way to ensure we had stops along the way to warm up before continuing our sightseeing. Jareds knowledge of all our sightseeing was second to none peppered with good humour. Highly recommend this tour especially if newly arrived to the city to get your bearings.

We only had a couple of days in the city. only one full day and that is why we chose this tour. We arrived on Wednesday afternoon for Billy Joel concert and then took this tour on our full day in the city on Thursday. We were able to see so many sights and had an outstanding guide. Our guide was Tim and He truly was the greatest tour guide I have ever had and I have traveled to the carribean, northwest, Canada,and Mexico. He was extremely knowledgable about the city. He knew so many facts and even had first hand account of the terrorist attack on 9/11. This guy was amazing and so cordial that it felt like a family member rather than a tour guide. I highly recommend this tour and hope that you get Tim as your guide. I learned SO much about the city that was above most things that you could ever read about. TIM WAS AMAZING. if you have a limited time in the city THIS is the tour to take. I will do it again if I am back in the city again. Very well worth the money and time. Would like more time at 9/11 memorial but TIM is worth taking the tour for all alone. AWESOME

We were in NYC with two teens. This guided tour is the way to go......there at Thanksgiving time traffic was extra heavy.....we saw more than was on our checklist and looking back so glad we had GIL who ushered us around , had prepaid tickets for entry and kept us at a good pace...the group was small...maybe 9 and the information was so interesting....on our own we had walked right by things and not known the story or history behind stuff......that is what makes traveling fun.......I liked the size of the group so you are not waiting for 40 people to get on and off the bus.......no one complained and raved about him the whole time.....time was sufficient at each place and if you wanted to go back you had the information. The trip to the statue of liberty was by boat...the way the immigrants saw it....heard the waiting line to go up in the statue was 3 hours......not for us...... I would highly recommend this guided tour. Sometimes you just need to be guided and know what you are looking at!!

I hate New York. It is brutally expensive. Too many people crammed into too little space: even if you find a place where no one is bumping into you, it is hard to escape the assault on the senses. Why would so many people want to live here?

We had time free on the last day of a necessary visit to the City; my wife had never seen New York, so we signed up for the Tour. A bus tour seemed convenient, if a little impersonal. Reading the reviews on TA, it seemed that much depends on who your tour guide turns out to be.

We arrived early to "7th Ave. between 50th and 51st, behind the Winter Gardern Theater". Note: there is no sign to denote the Tour meeting point. We wandered around the block--no sign in front of the theater, either--and returned to find a friendly young man with an iPad scooping up bewildered tourists like ourselves. He efficiently checked us in and guided us to the correct bus.

Our tour guide, Gil, was the real treasure. (I give props also to Roy, our driver who got us through the traffic without drama to all our stops.) Gil not only got us to all the highlight stops, he also was constantly highlighting points of interest while we were driving and while walking. Each point he illustrated with a little vignette about the individual associated with the geography. The common theme: New York attracts the best and brightest, whatever their field of endeavor. This leads New Yorkers to feel pride in their city and, yes, themselves. This pride motivates a New Yorker to be the best financier, fireman, or even tour guide he or she can be.

Ignore the haters and the negative reviews. Take the Tour, see the sights, and enjoy the performance if you are lucky enough to get Gil. He puts his heart and soul into sharing his love of New York. Even if you could never imagine living here yourself.

Did not feel it was a great introduction to NYC but it was because of our tour guide. He just kept rambling on about everything just confusing the highlights of the city. His facts did not seem so accurate and would backtrack on what he told us and changed the what he was saying. A lot of information about what was there before and not what was there now. I thought it would be one of the buses you could ride on the top but it was just a van so picture taking wasn't ideal. We didn't stop for lunch until 2pm as most everyone was starving. Then lunch was at a grocery store where you could fill a plate with deli items and pay by weight...we went to McDonalds across the street. (Lunch is not included in the price) The only enjoyable part was the water taxi that you spent in the New York Harbour, though only about 1/2 hour. I would suggest trying the hop and go buses where you can get off and check out a neighbourhood then jump on to go somewhere else! With I had known!

Visited New York to celebrate my daughters 21st birthday and booked this tour for our second day on 20th October 2017 for a taste of what the city had to offer...our driver was Anthony ⭐️ and our tour guide was Tyler ☀️...what a fantastic decision. Experienced so much of the city, it's history, it's landmarks, skylines and waterways with an ongoing, informative, educational and humorous narrative provided throughout. We rode, walked, viewed and cruised around the big apple. The coach was comfortable and the staff were first class, friendly and courteous at all times with no repeat reminders in respect of tips. I would recommend this tour, this company and staff for anyone visiting NY. Tyler was the best guide we encountered throughout our visit to NY and with the biggest and most welcoming smile. This tour helped to make our trip extra special. Thank you. We had booked a different tour with another prominent NY company a few days later and there was just no comparison to USA guided tours.

We took the day tour with Tyler. She was very knowledgeable and gave many excellent tips. The tour was informative and well planned out. Was able to see so many more attractions than if we had tried to see them on our own! It was a well balanced tour of riding and walking. Would recommend this tour to anyone that would like an overview of the city!

We arrived for this tour and didn't know what to expect. Well Rachel and johnny the driver were brilliant. Johnny for his skill in negotiating the roads and Rachel for her wonderful facts which she put over with humour. We didn't expect to see so much in one day but we did. Wonderful tour and I would highly recommend this to anyone. Do it on your first day , it's well worth the money.

Our first guide was Rachel and she is the only reason for the low star review. She started the tour with what you cannot do and continued with the don’t’s during the tour. After our first stop I asked the driver for a bottle of water ( provided with the bus). He pulled a bottle for me right away, but the guide said no- you cannot , not now… she said “ I like to have a water break after the second stop”… my husband replied to her “ this is not a High school trip , you have to calm down”. I got my water right away . And we continued to our second stop- we were provided with a brief commentary about the place and were escorted to a restroom. I went first and when I got out I came to a meeting point. My husband was walking around near by. The guide Rachel approached me and said: “ you clearly don’t like my tour and I want you to leave. We will refund you and you can leave now “. I was shocked . Out of the blue- just like that. I asked what did we do to be banned from the trip? She said you clearly don’t don’t like it, you husband didn’t go to the restroom 🤔 , I’m the top rated guide on TripAdvisor and you are not going to tell me how to do my job”… after that I wasn’t sure if she is a sane person.. I asked if we could be moved to a different bus, as there were several leaving the pick up stop with us. She called someone and a few minutes later she called us by using her finger in our direction with “you-comeover here “… she said go downstairs, Gill- with a different tour bus is waiting for you. We went right away. Gill was downstairs. He was nice and from that moment we felt at peace and no longer threatened and under attack.
Gill was knowledgeable, nice guy and we truly enjoyed our trip. So- as long as your house isn’t Rachel - go for it- great tour of the city, hitting all the spots and more.

The experience was amazing, we were a family of 4 including a toddler (we had a compact stroller that worked perfectly if you have something bigger it might not work), Robert our guide was very polite and very nice. The bus is very comfortable, clean, and new, we chose the open roof bus, that I booked directly from their website as Tripadvisor was not available. We had cold bottles of water available to us. The tour was amazing, very interesting, and amazingly organized, the logistic was implacable, kudos to our driver Manuel who was always on time, honestly, I really don't know how they do it with NY traffic! If you want to see NY and you don't want to be with the masses, this is the way to go, worth the money!
Super informative! They pack in a ton of knowledge about the city! It was fun getting to hear some of the "underground" tidbits of happenings that you normally don't get to see.

Rachel was our guide with Manny as the bus driver. Both were phenomenal! Wow. Rachel was a great host - she was warm, inviting, organized, kept the visitors in close contact so that no one "strayed" away. She basically provided us with a "Brain infusion" of all things Manhattan. Want to be a New Yorker, know cool history facts, know architecture differences, understand the grid, understand the harbors, understand ...well - almost EVERYTHING - then ask for Rachel as your guide. My husband, daughter, and I left with our brains infused with information. I feel so much more knowledgeable now. Manny, the driver, was always right around the corner - and able to meet us rapidly for pickup. Plus it was FREEZING outside - but they kept things moving the entire time. A great experience and one we HIGHLY recommend.
Gil was very informative and funny!! He had an astounding amount of information about every stop on our tour!!

Our tour guide was Rachel and you’d be hard pressed to find anyone who know more about NYC, cares more about the experience you’re having, or has more energy. This tour was worth every single penny and Rachel took it to a new level.
So well done and so much to see Tour guid Mike was so proud of his city and it bled into his presentation so much to share …wonderful tour

Rachel was very informative and absolutely pleasant! She gave us great advice about New York! Wish tour was longer! I would have enjoyed some time in Staten Island Ferry Station!
J was a great driver! We could tell he was very experienced!!
Don’t miss out on this tour!
We truly saw all the famous attractions!
5 Star Tour
Thanks Rachel and J

USA Guided Tours New York
We researched the Tours available in New York and this came highly recommended. I had a couple of queries and posted these through emails which were quickly and efficiently dealt with. I booked online with no issues at all.
On the morning, Thursday 7th November 2019, we met at the designated venue on 7th Avenue between 50th and 51st Street, immediately outside the Theatre where ‘Beetlejuice’ is being played.
There was a group of about 30 people which never felt ‘too big’. Our bus was very comfortable with large leather seats and big glass windows for a marvellous view.
Our host and Tour Guide for the day was Tyler who was absolutely amazing. What she didn’t know wasn’t worth knowing. She made the day come alive and we all left richer in knowledge and data about New York. The day is mostly on the bus but we have the opportunity to get off and view certain points of interest. Tyler, our Guide, was with us at all times.
We started by heading towards Times Square and then changed direction to Uptown Manhattan and Central Park. We were shown the building adjacent to Central Park where John Lennon lived and died when he was shot entering the gates to his home. Yoko Ono has subsequently created a memorial for him known as ‘Strawberry Fields’ which we walked around.
We then continued around Uptown New York before heading back down Fifth Avenue passed Trump Tower and all the Designers’ shops and jewellery shops such as Tiffany’s.
We passed the tall skyscrapers and came across the beautiful St Patrick’s Catholic Cathedral in the midst of and surrounded by the tall New York towers.
We stopped at the Rockefeller Centre to get out and view the
Rockefeller Skating Rink which is open from October through till March.
Tyler gave us the history about New York’s Christmas Tree and how this is sourced from all over America. However, this year (2019) it is very local to New York. We were advised that it was arriving on Friday 8th November.
We headed further along 5th Avenue to Downtown and the Financial District and Wall Street area including the bronze statue ‘Bull’. Again, Tyler gave us so much information that we would never have gained had we just walked through on our own.
We stopped at Ground Zero where the Twin Towers once stood and were afforded the time to walk around this poignant memorial including the two ‘Memorial Holes for Souls’. We saw the ‘Survivor Tree’ and the ‘Ground Zero Memorial’ building.
After having paused for some reflection, we headed through ‘China Town’ and ‘Little Italy’ which has now been reduced to one street.
We then stopped for lunch at a suitable spot where we could access a variety of food options for us to choose and buy with a 25 minute break.
After lunch, we headed to the nearby Harbour area for a Boat trip around the ‘Statue of Liberty’ for great views and also Brooklyn and Manhattan Bridges. During this time, a Guide on the Boat was providing further history and information.
The views of Downtown Manhattan, New Jersey and Staten Island were spectacular.
On arrival back in the Harbour, we boarded our
coach and returned back to our starting point at Times Square via Eighth Avenue on the West Side.
The whole day (10am to 4.45pm) was filled with information, facts and statistics about New York and its Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens and Staten Island areas.
Summary:
I would highly recommend this Tour Company, the itinerary and especially the Tour Guide, Tyler, who was amazing.
A great day seeing New York and learning about its history from Tyler who was clearly passionate about her home City of New York.

Our driver was Anthony, and our guide was Gil. They were a great team, and worked together well. Gil was very funny, entertaining, and so knowledgeable about the city. He included many helpful things about the area we wouldn't have known otherwise. His love of his city is evident, and I would recommend his tour to anyone.

We had an awesome tour and tour guide! Despite the cold and wet weather, we made the best of it! We were finally in New York and we were going to do this! We walked a lot, wear comfy shoes, but we saw so much! It is so worth it.

Our tour was great because you saw everything you needed to see in one day. Then the next day, you can pick the areas you want to see and explore more. If that makes sense. Gil did a great job, got a little frustrated at time but he's a professional cat herder. Literally. Highly recommend this tour. I think the gratuity speech at the end could have been lightened up but besides that, very good.

Although originally disappointed that the bus was top-covered, Gil's personability, his vast knowledge of the city, his sense of humor, and passion for The Big Apple [art, old movies, food] made this tour an enjoyable one.

Gil isn't just fun to have around. He is also an advocate. There was an Italian family in our group, a group of loud and undisciplined kids and parents. So, instead of letting them run around, ruining the whole trip for the rest of us, he repeatedly called them to order [politely, but firmly]. He gave us great tips on where to eat, which Broadway theatre has the most discounted tickets, where to be at what day and time, and what to say/not to say to cab drivers [and actually stayed behind working a good route so me and my boyfriend can commute cheapely to Newark, NJ, where we would be taking our train back to Seattle - an error that overwhelmed us throughout the tour, being new to the East Coast].

Gil's warm professionalism, along with Roy's mad driving skill, made a day that would have otherwise been rushed and too short, plenty to learn through.

5 stars for both. You won't regret choosing this company

Highly recommended, although only downside was I don’t recall the Chrysler building being pointed out, but I can just find it myself thanks to Rachel. Really good way to see the city and includes a harbour cruise to see Brooklyn Bridge and Statue of Liberty.

We really enjoyed this tour. There was a Columbus Day parade on the date of our tour so a couple of scheduled sites we could drive to. Our tour guide Rhonda and Roy our driver, were great. We learned a lot despite having gone to Manhattan a number of times before. The bus was very comfortable BUT it does not have a restroom. The tour is six hours total and rest stops are infrequent. "Prepare" before you depart, and take advantage of the only two restroom stops during this tour. The lunch options are disappointing, but that is not why you are going on the tour. The McDonalds has a restroom as does the boat. Have a big breakfast before you start this tour.
