We enjoyed every minute of this tour. Dana our tour guide is so knowledgeable about the city. We saw so many interesting places we could not have seen ourselves. Dana was so informative and keep us on schedule as much as possible with the traffic. She gave fantastic information about all the sights. The harbor cruise was amazing with seeing the Statue of Liberty up close. This tour was even better than we had hoped for. Loved it!
Thank you Dana (guide) and Arles (driver)!

Kudos to USA Guided Tours; very good this tour really showcased the sites. Fast paced, but very enjoyable and informative. The tour stopped at several different important locations and we had alittle time on our own. Our guide Gil was witty and full of New York insites. I would reccommend this tour to anyone who wants to get a feel for The City., helps knowing what to go back to on your own.

So pleased we booked this trip , Mike the tour guide was so knowledgable about his home city as Roy drove us smoothly around , frequent well timed stops , well organised . Gave us a good overview of attractions , bus very comfortable

Rachel & our driver were outstanding hosts for this tour! Great mix of riding, walking around a bit, photos & a boat ride in the harbor. Rachel has a tremendous amount of knowledge about the city, past & present. She kept it interesting & all of us felt like the time flew by. Rachel, who took great photos of us, made sure everyone had a chance to get family photos with views of the landmarks, at just the perfect angle.

Driver Roy and guide Neil efficiently introduced us to the southern half of Manhattan, staring on time at 11am and finishing around 5.5 hours later. Apparently the later tour (11am) runs 30 minutes shorter than the earlier start, so the pressure was on for us all to keep up and for Roy to get through the busy traffic. Neil was informative and entertaining and by the end of the day we had a much better idea of how we would spend our time for the coming days. Highlight was the harbour cruise, with the short entry into Central Park to see Strawberry Fields was another positive. The vehicle was new with excellent visibility. All in all a good option as a New York introduction.

Great tour - Cannot rave about this enough.

Smaller bus, comfortable and well air conditioned.

Very informative, Dina really knew her stuff. She was very helpful with taking photos of us at landmarks. Boat cruise included which was a bonus.

If you want to know areas or certain landmarks that you may want to visit more in depth this tour is perfect as it's whistle stop. There are a few stops where you get out and walk (Central Park, 9/11 Memorial, Flat Iron, Rockefeller, Boat Cruise). Lunch we stopped at 55 Fulton Street Market. As soon as you walk in the door you can smell the fresh fruit.

It's a long day, but so worth it.

The tour was good, our guide was excellent, however on a sunny day we would have preferred being on an open air bus. Can't say that we didn't know what the bus looked like, however all the great reviews made us book the tour. New York is a city of skyscrapers, one wants to be constantly looking upwards, so an enclosed bus is not ideal, especially in the summer time. Boat tour was one of the highlights, and have to say, one gets a good feel of the city. Also, thought it was a bit overpriced. As for the tips given on street numbering and the subway, I'm sure everyone figures these things out on the first day on their own anyway, should't book the tour just for them.

This tour is in an air conditioned (or heated) transport. No worries about rain, the heat, etc. that you have to worry about on an open top bus. We had a great time with Ray driving and Mike leading the tour (Try to get these guys when you go). Mike is a local NYC native, and Ray has serious driving skills. Very informative trip for the first day of a trip to NYC so you can determine what you would like to see more of later in your trip.

A really great way to see Manhattan in one day. Comfortable, good pace, and informative. We learned a lot about the history of the city. We saw as much as you can cram into 6 hours, but it was not rushed. The bus was comfortable. Our guide and driver were great.

We can’t tell you enough how wonderful this tour is! Dana is so nice and knowledgeable and loves her city. She shares all of her stories and learning and really makes you feel like you are an important part of the tour and the city. Our 6 year old stayed entertained and happy for the 6 hours! Arlis was able to miraculously get us around stopped traffic and pick us all up quickly and safely. Bottled water is provided, and Dana has a great little market where you stop for lunch. She even told us where to find the restrooms. We were so lucky to find this tour,and it wouldn’t have been the same without Dana! Just a heads up...when you arrive at the meeting place for the tour, have one person find the USA tour guide employee who is doing the check in while the rest of your party finds a bus and gets seats. There will be 4 to 5 buses waiting on passengers so board any of them. You could look for Dana first before boarding. Thanks so much for a great NYC experience.
Driver and guide were excellent. Gil was the guide and he was very well informed & humorous. Definitely recommend this tour as an introduction to NYC and the must see points of interest in the city.

We had an awesome time on our tour! Anthony the bus driver and Gil the guide were both excellent. They were very friendly, welcoming and informative. We have family who used the hop on and hop off tours with another bus company and they were very disappointed. If you want the best land and water tour in NYC, this is the one to use and definitely ask that Anthony and Gil are there!

This tour was perfect for all the must see attractions at NYC. We spent the majority of the trip in an enclosed van with big windows and made 10-20 min stops at each location to get up close at take pictures. The last part we took a boat tour to see the Statue of Liberty. Rachel, our tour guide, and Roy, our driver, worked very well together to coordinate the timing for all activities to be able to get it all done in the 6 hours and so that we wouldn’t have have to wait in lines. They were awesome. Rachel took good care of us and helped us take pictures at each attraction. She shared lots of interesting historical facts about the city and also shared some good tips on where to eat, shop, and transportation that turned out to be very helpful during my trip. I’m glad this tour was one of the first things I did in New York because then I was able to decide which places I wanted to go back to and see again and helped me plan my activities for the remainder of my trip. I took Rachel’s suggestions and I had a beautiful, magical visit my first time in the big apple! I was also able to bring home a bunch of nice souvenirs because of the shop Rachel suggested- they gave me great deals!

Gil (tour guide) and Anthony (driver) did an outstanding job from start to finish! They worked so hard to entertain us, get us where we needed to go, and keep us safe and happy. Gil is a walking encyclopedia of NYC knowledge. Tons of information we normally would know, I doubt Google has the information! I don't know how he remembers all that information! We saw all the key sites of Manhattan and beyond. During the boat ride we saw the city skyline, statue of liberty, Governors Island, etc..

Great trip for the first ( and second) time visitor..get your bearings..understand the street system..get tasters of the different areas you want to revisit..did SO much in one day..our guide Mike was very informative and knowledgeable...fantastic lunch stop!!! Couldn't rate that high enough..food choices amazing ..slightly rushed but needed to be off on tour again..liked the bottles of iced water..one in morning one in afternoon...lovely air conditioned bus..always ready and waiting after our hop offs for pictures..liked how we could leave our bags etc on there...good value all in all would definitely recommend.

We usually use the Big Bus but decided to try something different given the great reviews this has on Trip Advisor. It is definitely worth it and Rachael is beyond 5 star as a guide. You get to know so much...best done early on then armed with all the info and tips from Rachael you can explore the city alone at your pace. Definitely worth it!
Our tour guide Dana and driver Arlis were awesome. Saw so many of the major highlights of the city. Dana was so full of interesting facts about the sights we saw. Would highly recommend this tour.

I was traveling solo and first time to New York and had tour guide Rachel and driver Roy. This was so good to do at the start of my visit to get a good overall understanding of the city so I could go back later to places I wanted to spend more time at. Rachel was very knowledgeable and entertaining and there was never a dull moment. Rachel was brilliant in navigating NYC traffic and keeping us on time so we could see as much as possible and helping us all to quickly get photos at certain locations which I personally appreciated alot. Rachel also gave some fantastic tourist tips when visiting NYC which was super helpful that I kept in mind for the remainder of my trip. I do not regret taking this tour at all and enjoyed it thoroughly.

FUTURE TIP: Get there at least half an hour early to secure the best seats on the bus. I was there 15mins early and only a handful seats left. However wasn’t an issue for me as I was solo and to be honest there really isn’t a bad seat on the bus but if you have your family with you get there super early.
This tour had a lot to offer!! Would definitely recommend booking it!! The tour guide, Dina, was very knowledgeable about the city.
I had a great experience with the tour Rachel was very knowledgeable and ensured we all had a great experience.

Third day in NYC with my 16 year old niece (8/9/19). Yes we did the #NewYorkinOneDayGuidedSightseeingTour. It was like the readers digest tour of NYC and it was worth it (especially if you are on a short trip and haven't been to NYC before (this was Hailey's first (but probably not the last)).
Tyler was fabulous: facts, food, fun. I was able to run to TKTS (down by the Pier, South Port) during the lunch break to get play tickets!! Winner, winner lobster dinner!

It is highly recommended that you do this on day one of a stay in NYC.
Mike was a great guide and I managed to see so much on this tour of the city allowing me to go back to places again if I wanted. The bus is very comfortable and water is provided.
Mike, our guide was able to give some real good additional information on the places we visited and was good at pointing things out too along the way.
A thoroughly enjoyable experience and a great start to my NYC trip.
Rachel was fantastic. She made the tour great. She answered all our questions and had some great advice on where to go for food and after the tour. I highly recommend Rachel and these tours.

What an amazing experience . Dana (sp?)was a fountain of facts, history and awesome little known facts about New York’s most amazing buildings and icons . She was energetic and engaging , never a dull moment . Tony , our driver , was amazing in navigating those congested streets. Highly recommend this tour .

We took the New York in One Day Guided Sightseeing Tour. We learned a ton about the architecture and the stories of the areas, the history of the neighborhoods, as well as some great on-the-ground New York knowledge about the Metro and the different areas of the city (e.g., downtown, uptown, midtown, and where they all stop and start).

We had such a great tour team with Mike and Johnny. Johnny was fabulous maneuvering that bus around Manhattan. Mike has such a depth of knowledge about the city, as well as a passion for the topic. We took the tour with our three kids (ages 13, 12, and 8) and they were never whiny or bored. We were here in summer, too, so the air conditioning on the bus was a respite from the heat. When we got back, we were right next to restaurants (with Mike's recommendations on where would be the best for a lot of different types of experiences) and the theatres. Mike was also always quick to help us get pictures at the sites.

This tour is excellent. We recommend it at the beginning of your trip so you can identify the areas you want to spend more time in throughout your stay.

This tour was great! Gil, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable and friendly. He provided lots of information while keeping the tone conversational and interesting. Gerry (Geraldo), our driver, was outstanding. We had a group of six with various ages and we all loved it. The whole experience was awesome.

As a solo female traveller, I went by the reviews on this site and I’m glad I did. Both Gil and Robbie are masters at their craft and made “Ireland” feel very much at home on this very entertaining day. They were both very friendly and informative and I learnt of places I wanted to see, even though I hadn’t known they’d previously existed. Gil came up to me and offered to take pictures of me in front of landmarks, which I loved. All in all a fabulous day and I can’t thank them enough. Thanks again.
Poor. AC didn’t work. Gil, the guide, was rude with personal attack. He was very knowledgeable, but about trivia. I was not interested in trivia.

It was amazingly hot in NYC this past weekend. SO HAPPY I booked this tour for me and my 16 year old daughter. The coach was cool and they had plenty of water for us. Gil was our tour guide, Jose was the driver. Both were excellent! Highly recommend.

We booked this tour on a recommendation of a friend and it did not disappoint. From the start you realize these people know what they are doing. Buses are enclosed and well air conditioned which we desperately needed in July. Gil was the guide and Arliss was our driver for the day and they were both excellent. Just some quick info: stops are generally quick, only lasting 10-15 minutes but plenty of time to get some pics and whatnot. Gil knows his stuff and is informative the whole time whether on or off. Cold bottled water is provided during the tour and we did stop for a quick lunch before the boat cruise. Overall great tour and you will get to see most of everything you want.
Our guide was extremely knowledgeable and pleasant. Our driver was amazing getting around NYC traffic and always being there to pick us up. Well worth the time and money

First time in NY and we couldn’t have scripted a better way to tour the city. Our tour guide Tim was not only extremely knowledgeable, but also very friendly and enthusiastic. Tim made the tour fun, educational, and entertaining. Thank you for a wonderful day!!

An excellent way to take in the main sights of NYC with informative guide Dina highlighting tips for getting the best out of our trip. Lots of time for photos and the river cruise was a great way to see the city and the Statue of Liberty. Dina made it a fun day and our driver Roy was excellent.

Very nice tour, where you get to see a lot of Manhattan in one day.
We had a very nice, funny and entertaining guide, Taylor.
At the begining, I was a little disappointed that the bus didn't have an "open roof" where we could sit outside. But then, I understood that it was beter that way, because there was air conditioning. And when you spend the whole day in a bus, air conditioning is very important, especially during summer.
You spend half of the time in the bus, where the guide explains what we see.
There are also lots of stops where you can go outside, and walk a little.
So even if it's a busy day, it isn't too tiring.
I would recommend it, especially at the begining of your trip. It helps creating a quick idea of what you may want to see later, when you have more times.
Great guide in tour funny, knowledgable and a breath of fresh air. Seen all attractions without stress of getting around by ourselves. Loved the boat ride.

I've been to New York many times in my life, but never I've had such an amazing experience! All thanks to Mike and the United USA tour! At first I was worried to pay this price when you have a thousand people in the streets offering 29$ tours on the spot! But the tour we had was breath taking! We got to see and learn about so much from this magnificent city! It's a well balanced hop on and off tour! The knowledge that our guide had, was unbelievable! Super efficient tour and you get the boat tour as well! I would recommend this tour to anyone and I would even go back again because it was so fun!

This is a great way to see the highlights of the city. One downfall is you can't always see the attractions being pointed out, depending on where you're sitting in the bus. There are a few stops on the tour at some major attractions. The boat tour is great for seeing the skyline, the statue of liberty and Ellis Island. Overall, would definitely recommend this tour!

After wanting to visit this place for so long, I Thought why not take a guided tour. Definitely worth the time and money. Staff included was super helpful and we all had a great time. Appreciate the city more now.

We were totally skeptical on a 6 hour bus tour, but our guide made it worth every minute. We learned so much information about the City that we would have never known had we not gone on this tour.

5-6 hours seems like a lot on a bus, but this bus was super nice, air conditioned and information was relevant. They did allow us to take breaks and make several stops along the way to get photos and experience a little taste of what each location was like. I wasn't disappointed at all that we didn't spend more time in each place since we were able to see so much!

At the end of the tour our guide gave us some great advice on how to work with vendors in the city and how to get around, which all advice worked wonders!

The best tour ever! Guide, Dana, was very knowledgeable, enthusiastic, funny , helpful and just made the trip so fun. Can’t say enough about how worthwhile this trip is if your coming to the big apple.

We booked this tour as we were only in New York for 4 nights and wanted to see as much as we possibly could. This was a fantastic start to our holiday and we booked it for the first full day so we could get our bearings and establish what we wanted to go back to and see in more detail. It is a whistle stop tour of the main sites, you dont get to go into places (except for quick scheduled toilet stops) but it gives you an overall view of the place with lots of photo opportunities. We went to Strawberry Fields, the Rockefeller, Empire State Building, Ground Zero/World Trade Centre and finished with a boat trip to see the Statue of Liberty and Brooklyn Bridge.

The bus was air conditioned and had a good supply of bottled water on board. We were on and off this throughout the day at the various stops and we stopped for lunch where there were a range of options to suit everyone.

We were travelling with a seven year old and at the time of booking I was concerned whether 6 hours would be too much in the heat after travelling from the UK. However I couldn't have been more wrong, he was in awe of everything and loved learning about this great place. He didnt moan once, so this tour was definitely a winner!

What really made the tour though was the guide Tim. What Tim didn't know about New York, was not worth knowing! We learnt so much about the history, the lifestyle and got great tips about places to eat, drink and shop. The driver Tony was fab too, navigating the busy traffic and being there to pick us up from various points on the trip.

Thoroughly well worth it and I would definitely recommend.

This tour was great and was the highlight of our trip. My kids are still talking about it. We had Dina as our guide and Gary was our driver. Both were awesome! This was the perfect tour to do on our first day so we could see what we wanted to spend more time at. Check in was easy and right near our hotel. We had some people in our group that were never paying attention and not keeping up so in our case I wish the group was smaller but overall I would totally recommend this tour!

We had Mike as our tour guide, a Brooklyn native, and a funny guy. Mike had a lot of character, and was a pleasure to be around. The places you went were the "essentials" of New York, and you do it pretty cheap too. Ubers are pricey in New York, and this tour is cheaper than Ubering to all those places

My trip to New York would have been worse if I didn't have this

The tour was a perfect way to start our trip! We got to see all the highlights and gave us good insight as to where we might want to go back and spend more time. Rachel and driver were great! Rachel kept things on track and supplied us with a wealth of information that will be very helpful for the rest of our trip. We successfully rode the subway today. Would highly recommend.

Gil was brilliant. Amazing detail with the right amount of humour tailored for the audience.

Arlais the driver was very patient with other road users

Once you’ve done this, you’ll know where you’ll visit in more detail. With over twenty of the iconic sights to see and more, it’ll make your visit much more economical.

Before you dive into a sight do this tour first and you won’t be disappointed, and make the correct choices for the rest of your stay.

Unfortunately I cannot review the actual tour. My wife and I were in town for our honeymoon June 8th – 15th and had booked the 11am tour on June 9th. I suddenly became ill (something I ate the night before??) just before we left and we had to bail. The employee who was checking everyone in was so quick to offer to look for seats on the same tour the next morning. That was so awesome!! Unfortunately I had not recovered by then and we had to cancel the tour altogether – an informed them so that they would have the seats available. I was so happy with the level of customer service that I simply had to leave this review. Any company that takes care of customers this well deserves mention. Thanks guys!!

Many thanks to Gil our tour guide and Gary our driver. It was the most gorgeous day in New York. This was my first visit to NYC and this tour was great. Gil was the best. He knew everything about the city and had recommendations on where to eat, what to see, how to save your money and how to avoid scams. Our driver, Gary was also great too. How he manoeuvres around the crazy traffic and rush hour traffic is perfect. Thanks again guys for a perfect day. From your only Canadian passenger. Ha 😊

6 hour tour with Gil and Gary, very informative, great info znd city history. Would recommend anyone do this first when visiting. From there you will have a much clearer idea of what you want to see and do. Just an enjoyable day with great people.

We've taken other tours & typically like them because of what we learn & see vs. visiting the sights on our own. We received so much more than that with Gil as our guide & Raymond as our driver. Just an excellent team that communicates well & takes care of their passengers. Gil was a no nonsense guide who not only made sure we were informed, but took pics of folks, recommended some of his favorite eateries (loved the Tim Ho Wan suggestion-as good as he said) & actually did as he promised. He made sure to come back to topics that he was talking about as he said he would-we were waiting for him to forget something that he would say he would discuss later & he always did. How-I have no idea because he has much responsibility & never failed. Just excellent, funny, caring & never lazy or bored. We are tough critics & we would take Gil's tour again. Thank you!! What we thought was going to be too long at 6hrs. went by very fast. Perfect amount of stops time flew by. Excellent tour.

Our guide, Rhonda, worked really hard to give us the best possible day. She provided details about the places we visited and appeared passionate about her job. Straight talking but kind. We saw so many sites but it didn’t feel rushed. Would definitely recommend it. Thanks very much!

Our NY USA Guided Tour with tour guide Tyler and driver Gerry on May 25th was excellent! Tyler was very knowledgeable and provided a wealth of history, interesting tidbits, current news and great information about New York. She was so welcoming and engaging and made the trip fun and interesting for all. We live in Raleigh, North Carolina and were in New York on a family trip with our daughters (a teen and a young adult). We all loved the guided tour. Our driver Gerry was great and trip was smooth. Beautiful weather, loved the places we visited and saw many of the iconic sights and interesting places you'd want to see when visiting New York like the Empire State Building, Central Park, 9/11 Memorial to name a few. A great trip to see a lot of areas of NY in a day, included some walking tours also and a nice boat cruise at end to get a close up view of the Statue of Liberty. I can't say enough about our tour guide Tyler! She had a great personality and helped make the trip memorable. Our bus included people from all over the world. She kept us all engaged with NY history and info on things to see and do while in the area. I highly recommend USA Guided Tours and their guided sightseeing day tour. Bus was clean, comfortable and perfect group size. They lived up to what they said and their reviews. It was lovely! Would do it again and have already recommended it to others. Thanks USA Guided Tours NY and guide Tyler and driver Gerry for making this a memorable time for our family!

Just like the hustle and bustle of New York City this tour was fast paced and not for the faint of heart. I'll admit that we saw much of what New York had to offer in a few hours, but it may have been slightly more enjoyable if it were done over a couple more hours. The lunch break was at a grocery store for 30 minutes and was not included in the tour. I think they would have been better off to supply sandwiches on board the boat tour so we could relax and eat with our group. The guide Rhonda from Barbados was very friendly but after listening to her sophomoric rhetoric for 6 hours it was a bit much. Also the narration on the boat by Mark from Brooklyn made us feel like we were in North Korea listening to political propaganda. All in all an okay arrangement, but there's room for improvement. The best part was Tony's good driving, although the shocks on the bus could use a replacement.

This was my first time to New York and with limited time, I thought this trip would give us a good overview. It did not disappoint. Our guide Racheal was amazing and gave us all sorts of tips, including how to get discount tickets for a broadway show, which we did. She recommended foods to try and took us to so many amazing places, even knowing when is the best time and where to stand for the best selfie. It's a lot of brisk walking so wear super comfortable shoes but prepare to be wowed like we were and by all means take this tour!! We are really happy we did!

one day was not enough fo see all the sites on the tour, we were early in season so jacket was needed once the sun when down. only negatives was the bathroom on the cruise boat, it had seen its better days and if you have elderly people with you getting on and off the boat is challenge. Love the people, we felt safe and would do the longer tour. .

Having never been to NYC before and, with only 36 hours in town, I wanted to see as much of the city as possible in one day and this tour was perfect. It took in all the main sights and the inclusion of the harbour boat trip was a great (even if the weather wasn't!).

The tour included all of the main sights and as we drove around, our knowledgeable and funny guide, Gill, pointed out interesting places and people and regaled us with various interesting anecdotes. He also kept the tour going at a good pace and made sure the group was on time and we weren't waiting around for stragglers.

The bus was clean and comfortable and in my view the itinerary was just right, with the driving interspersed with regualr stops where you could look at things close up, stretch your legs and take photos. The driving was smooth and our driver Jose was always there on time to pick us up.

I really enjoyed the tour and despite only having been briefly in the city I definately feel that the tour helped me get a flavour of New York and would thoroughly recommend it to anyone else who wants to pack as much into a tour as possible.

Tour guide took half the day to warm up as he was irritated the bus was overbooked and his normal seat was taken. Can’t see anything from this bus as small windows and you are trying to look up ... in NYC!

Neil and Jerry really looked after us all day with plenty of stories, free on board water and great trips.

Worth doing this tour to start your trip to NY if unfamiliar as it helps orientate you to places and sites that you may want to come back to to visit.

Be prepared for a bumpy ride as Road potholes are horrendous in NY!

Thank you guys.

We loved our ny day tour! 6 hours approx and was just the right amount of time, we seen loads and heard so many interesting facts and story’s! Tim kept everyone together and kept the tour funny and everyone was interested, we seen Brooklyn bridge, grand central, rockerfeller center,empire state building, trump tower, Wall Street, St Patrick’s catherdral, flatiron building, 5th Avenue, Central Park & 9/11 memorial (not including entry) we did this on our first full day and it really gave us a feel for New York. Thank you to our tour guide Tim & tony our bus driver xx

I have been to NYC 20+ times, but this time I took my 12 year old. Did the tour so she could learn and I wouldn't have to worry about giving the correct information. We had Tim as our tour guide and he was AMAZING!!! Entertaining and very knowledgable! The tour had a great mix of being in the bus (great for a hot day or to get out of the rain) and enough walking, where you got close up and time to stretch! Stopped for lunch, and though the options were a little limited, the choices were delicious! After the tour of Manhattan, we went on the ferry tour! Don't worry about what side you sit on, the ferry gets close enough to the Statue of Liberty for all to see! Can't say enough about the tour, even though I was a little nervous about the length of it. The hours flew by and I couldn't have been happier! Thanks Tim for such a great tour!!! - Miami Girls!!!
Jack was a wonderful and very knowledgeable guide! His pride as a NY native really shows. The tour is a great way to see the highlights of the city. The harbor cruise was probably our favorite part.

A great tour jam packed with sights and interesting facts, non stop commentary from the brilliant commentator Gil and patient driving from Gerry. A good balance of time on and off the bus, plus seeing sights up and personal. Nice boat tour gives great Vistas of NYC harbour. Gil made some great recommendations for restaurants and helped with the photos! Great to have complementary water. Around an 1.5hours between bathroom breaks but can ask the guide if you get caught short!

I wanted a tour that would give us all the highlights of New York. This tour did just that. You visit the big tourist spots and get to stop for pics. The guide Gil was very knowledgeable and the driver Roy got us through safely which is no easy feat in NY. The tour was limited to a group of 20 and on an enclosed bus. It ends with a boat ride to see the Statue of Liberty. Overall a great tour.

This is the best and fastest way to see a lot of sites and monuments. Tim was our guide and was BEYOND AMAZING!! He had a lot of information and was very aware of great facts our tour party was interested in. He kept track of our entire party and even gave us little nuggets of info for after the tour ended. Well worth it - you will not regret it!!

This is by far the fastest and easiest way to get as much out of New York City if you are on a short trip. J Allen was our guide and Jerry was our driver. J provided us with loss of information and even done funny moments of jokes. He gave us practical input of places to buy things, how to use the subway and how to negotiate the streets and avenues in NYC. Would highly recommend this tour.

Loved this tour - so informative and fun. Covered all the sights we needed to see. Highlight for my son (11 years old) and I was the ferry trip including Ellis Island and Statue of Liberty. Trip lasts approx 6 hours (starts at 10am). Our guide Jack was just amazing, his knowledge was unlimited - he stood with us on the deck of the ferry and we asked him about different buildings/land/dates of construction etc and he was able to answer everything. We were really glad we booked this trip.

We would highly recommend this tour particularly if it's your first visit to NYC. Rhonda was our guide and was so well informed about every area we visited. She was very interesting and obviously loves her job! The tour took approx 6 hours including the boat trip and lunch but it flew by and we couldn't believe it was 4pm when we returned to Theatre District. Having done the tour we felt confident enough to find our way around the city ourselves the following day. Rhonda gave us tips re public transport and the best ways to get around. Our driver on the day was very pleasant and patient too. Definitely worth the money for this tour.
Neil and arlas were amazing. Very helpful and attentive. Really recommend this trip. New York with knowledgeable experience and excellent driver. Thank you 😊

We were able to see SO much in those few hours that we never could have traversed our selves. Our tour guide Tyler was amazing! She has so much knowledge and history to share, we saw and learned very much. Very organized and enjoyable!

First of all, our guide, Tyler, was great and so informative. Her personality and humor made the tour amazing. There were time we were getting a little tired and she got us all excited and motivated again. We saw all the major points of interest and the cruise by the Statue of Liberty was better than expected. You get very close! I recommend this tour to everyone!

Yesterday we have a perfect start to our NYC adventure courtesy of J our tour guide and Anthony our driver. Packed full of information, humorous anecdotes and hints and tips to get the best out of your stay. Great photo opportunities a day full of wonderful memories. Can’t recommend it enough.

We toured on the Sunday of the N.Y. half marathon which caused problems like reaching the meeting spot then (after walking an extra mile to get across the road) on-going road closures made it hard for the tour bus to do it's normal route, but if something didn't work, they would try something else - the driver (Gary) and the tour guide (Jay) worked miracles!
I carefully selected this tour (not on price but on quality) If I was spending most of a day of my holiday on a tour I wanted it to be time well spent.
Tour guide Jay was friendly / funny / informative / educational, he made sure we were walking at a pace that suited all the group (the group numbered around 16 of all ages) and that everyone's restroom needs were taken care of.
Jay made gave so many good tips, my son and I were able to use his information and tips for the next six days of our time in N.Y. he was also very open to any "Inside" information tourers had about the city (for instance the Publishing business resident in the Flat Iron Building)

On route around the city (and later in the holiday) I noticed tour guides with much bigger groups than we had - I have no idea whether there is a limit, but felt so sorry for those in large groups.

The minibus we travelled in was in good condition and clean, well driven (safely) they only negative in my opinion was I'd rather have had a windowed roof than a solid one. Bottled water was offered free at all on / off stops.

Value for my time and my money what more can I say.

Enjoyed our tour with Mike and Rachel learning so much about New York City . A good tour to take for first time visitors.Gives a short visit to so many important spots then you can return for more in-depth visit on your own .Learned so much about the city , very informative!

I'm so glad we did this tour!! Our tour guide had a brilliant sense of humor, being a NY native and made many funny remarks about neighboring New Jersey. We really got a kick out of that. The small shuttle was the perfect size as opposed to a large, impersonal bus. By the end of the trip, we felt we all knew each other a bit better. The sights were impressive with just enough time to see everything. The Horn Blower cruise was a treat and gave us fantastic photography opportunities. We had one person who was on crutches in our traveling party and he was able to get off on the stops he wanted to or stay on the bus and wait, as needed. Here's my tip, if you are looking for a hotel super close by, the Michelangelo Hotel is across the street from where this tour meets. Hotel is a bit more expensive but might be worth it for one night if you are on a time crunch and are worried about maximizing your time or avoiding parking.

Went on the tour with guide J and driver Anthony. It was very a very informative tour, and a good way to see all the sights in one day. The tour bus was very comfortable, just the right amount of bus ride vs short walks.

We came here from California and have never been to NYC. We only had one day to see the city and this was the best money that we have spent. Neil was our tour guide and gave us excellent history and other tidbits. He wasn’t the typical tour guide and gave us a really special experience. The pace of the tour was great with plenty of sight seeing on and off the bus. The bus was set to a perfect temperature and water was provided. Our driver Roy got us to all of our stops safely which in NYC is a feat in itself. We saw so much I can’t remember it all but I have the pics to prove it! For lunch, we ate at Papaya Dog and Little Italy Pizza. Yes, we ate at two places but got to check off pizza and hotdogs on our list. Both were delicious! The final stop was the 9/11 Memorial which is very powerful. It is amazing to see. Book with this group and you won’t be disappointed!

Over 6 hours which includes a stop so you can buy lunch, this excellent experience was well worth every dollar! We had Raymond as our driver who was so chilled out and kept us all safe on the busy roads and we had Tyler as our female guide who was just perfect. She was amazingly knowledgeable of the history of NYC but was so funny too. Her commentary couldn’t have been any better & we would definitely recommend this experience for anyone who wants to get the vibe of NYC and get some local info too.

I have been fortunate enough to have travelled to NewYork several times before and loved it..my Daughter is celebrating not only her birthday but her first time to NewYork..Tyler and her driver Mario just made it absolutely amazing. Tyler’s knowledge of this great city is very impressive and extensive she delivers it in a way which is very interesting and memorable I can’t recommend this tour enough it’s a great way to cover a lot of the more iconic NewYork landmarks..Tyler is very bubbly (and also shares her birthday with my Daughter) absolutely brilliant start to our holiday and well worth the money.

We were only in town for two days and figured a one day tour is a good starting point. We love to walk and sight see so this was perfect. I think we covered 7 miles over all not to include the ferry ride to Staten island. The guide was excellent and kept us together and on time. We are planning our next trip based on what we saw on this tour.

For out of towners, it is nice to spend a few hours getting the lay of the land and seeing how all of the neighborhoods are laid out in Manhattan. It had been 20 years since I had last been in Manhattan so it really helped jog my memory. Plus, the recordings are helpful when describing the history of various apartment buildings, museums, etc.

I would not recommend paying more for a 2 or 3 day pass. You can see all of the sites in a few hours and then its worth it to take the subway to get to other destinations quickly.

Tour Guide J held our attention for something like five hours as we made our way around Manhattan. So many historical and local-color details mixed with the right amounts of humor and warmth, especially for families visiting from other countries. It was a fantastic introduction to Manhattan for our teen/young adult children, and also a lot of fun for older, returning visitors who simply want to know more about what NYC has to offer (everything).

our tour guide was well educated on New York city history and culture. She was warm and kind, she was funny and cared, you could tell she has a passion for her home and it showed. very interesting and informative. the only issue we had during the tour was no fault of the tour employees , it was the weather , it rained all day, but it wasn't too cold so it least it didn't freeze. Still they took care of us even with the wet and rainy conditions. we had a wonderful time, and it was worth every penny.
very good tour. Although a bit expensive, good quality. Gave us the chance to see almost all New York in 8 hours. Very good guide (Gil). Recommended.

This was the first time we have visited New York and are only here for a few days. We felt we would like to get a quick impression of the city. Well, Manhattan at least. The best way to do seemed to be to catch a sightseeing tour. USA Guided Tours did not disappoint. We met the bus in the Theatre District and left at 10h00. We returned at 16h30. The tour includes a break for lunch and a river trip. There is some walking as well, but if you don’t feel up to it you can stay on the bus. We got to see the major points of interest, the Rockefeller Centre, 9 11 memorial, the Flat Iron, Strawberry Fields and the Dakota, Empire State, Greenwich Village. The boat trip took us past Ellis Island and the Statue of Liberty, showed the wonderful Manhattan Skyline and finished by cruising under Brooklyn Bridge. Our driver, Arliss, navigated the madness that is NY traffic very smoothly and our guide, Gil, provided a non-stop, amusing and informative commentary. We got to met an interesting melange of fellow passengers and had some time to chat. All in all a fantastic experience if you are looking to understand a bit about the city and what makes it tick. I really recommend this tour.

This tour was absolutely AMAZING with Tyler our guide. We did this on our second day and saw all the highlights of Manhattan. This allowed us to choose the places to return and spend more time but also gave us a great overview of the entire city. The information Tyler gave as we travelled through Manhattan was more than could ever be found in any books. Being Brooklyn born and raised, she shared information acquired through a lifetime. There were stories about movie stars, locations where movies were made, details about Lennon, his death and his residence. We were told about the costs of properties and who owned properties. Her personal "take" on 9/11 and how the city and the world came together at such a time of crisis was emotional. SO some commented that this was an expensive tour, but it was worth every dollar! I cannot recommend it enough for first time visitors or even if you have been there and not been exposed to the entire Manhattan area. A MUST DO!!!

I had a fantastic time - mostly due to our tour guide Gill - the amount of knowledge of his city was impressive. I don't think I would have been able to see New York in one day on my own, so I feel that it was well worth the money - and I would absolutely do it again!

My teenage son and I took a red eye flight from CA to NY and we hit the ground running with this New York in One Day Tour. It was fantastic! Our tour guide Tyler and our driver Roy were awesome! We hit all the highlights: Central Park, Times Square, the WTC Memorial, etc. and it included a 1 hour boat cruise which took us by the Statue of Liberty, Brooklyn Bridge and around the harbor. The tour bus only holds about 20 people which is great. Tyler is super knowledgeable & she gives out a lot of helpful info about places to go, where to eat, etc. while visiting the city. Thanks for the amazing time, Tyler & Roy, from your new friends from the OC! : )
Tim our guide was excellent and with the help of our driver got us everywhere on time. Tim was very knowledgable and I’d Highly recommend the tour

Without knowing where to start to explore NYC, we booked this tour and are very happy we did. Our guide "J" was very funny and informative. This tour gives you a glimpse into the many places to see, from the 9/11 memorial to Central Park.

This was an excellent tour of the City - I am quite familiar with it and wanted a way to show my friends as much as possible with a minimum of walking/buses/subway. The bus tour was comprehensive, our guide was very knowledgeable, and the boat ride was an added attraction! We were lucky to have great weather. Overall this is a great way to see a lot in a short amount of time.

Excellent day out to see all the attractions in New York and then return individually to see the ones that interest you the most... Great value at €82.50 per person.. Boat trip to fantastic especially on a clear day. Only down size is there's a lot of time on the mini bus going from place to place.
Did this one day guided tour a year ago with my wife and loved it. Make sure you also book the trip to the top of the Freedom Tower, AWESOME :)

I really appreciate how the guide stuck to the schedule so that all the items that were in the “What You Can Expect” description were actually seen. This tour checked off all the things that we wanted to see. The bus was clean and comfortable. The boat ride was really a nice touch. Debbie, our guide, was excellent, and the driver was very friendly.

This tour was a great way for my wife and I to be introduced to NYC. Our guide Tyler was entertaining and informative and especially did a good job of helping us understand the history and nature of the different parts of Manhattan. Ample time was given to see Strawberry Fields and the 9/11 Memorial, though we wished we could have gone inside St Patrick’s Cathedral. The half hour stop for lunch offered several eating options; the deli was a big hit with us. The boat tour gave us good closeup looks at important sites. This tour experience was a great way to begin our visit to New York City. Highly recommend!

I booked ahead for this one day tour, booking for the day after we arrived in NYC. Timing was perfect as it allowed us to go back to places we'd seen on the tour and spend a little more time (WTC area was one). Meeting our bus (the perfect size, with large windows and because it was smaller than a lot we'd seen it didn't take ages for people to get on/off as we stopped at various locations) beside the School of Rock we were greeted by the driver Roy and Tour Guide J....to say they know the city is an understatement. Roy weaved his way in and out of the heavy NY traffic with ease and J was a brilliant guide who offered an exceptional insight to areas of NY and the people who live here.

I can highly recommend this tour and we'd certainly book with this company if we return to NYC.

I booked this tour in advance hoping that it would be a good introduction to New York, and we were not disappointed. Brilliant guide Gil and driver Raymond made our first day in New York one to remember. Gil was an absolute mine of information on everything NY showing us the most important sites as well as giving lots of tips & advice, and stepping in to take photos of us in just the right places. We learnt a lot about NY in one day. Chapeau to you both.

First time in NYC and we booked this tour for the first day. So glad we booked this. t was an awesome overview of the "must see" spots and then we went back the following days to spend more time where we wanted. Rachel was our guide and she was energetic and very knowledgable. She gave us tips on shopping, places to eat (we tried several she recommended) and even bargained in Chinatown just like she taught us. The only thing I can say is a "negative" is that you can't see everything as well if you don't have a window seat. There are two seats per row, and I was sitting next to stranger, so I wasn't comfortable leaning over her to get a better looks at things Rachel was pointing out. Definitely not a criticism of the tour itself. It was a busy day and I felt that the price was very good for everything that we covered. She loved it so much we thought about doing more but opted to go out on our own. Would definitely recommend this tour and will book another next time we go.

We recently visited New York for the first time and were really pleased we did this tour. Gil was our guide who had a brilliant knowledge of New York and was an amazing guide. He made sure he engaged with all members of his group and took some lovely photographs of me and my husband.
I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting New York.

Gil was fantastic! He added so much to the tour!
Glad we went this route instead of the Hop On Hop Off Bus.
Tip...arrive early to make sure that you sit with your group, or significant other.

My 19 year old daughter and I had a great time. I booked this so she could get a taste of the city. It was great. Our guide and driver were great. Mike was extremely knowledgeable. The UN altered the route but it did not take away from the tour. We were able to see a lot in a short amount of time. I loved it and would do it again.

Best city tour I have done globally. Made perfect by Tyler whose knowledge of the city was superb and what a memory for streets!

Weather was poor but her bright smile and sense of humour meant the day was still great. Obviously guides vary but this city and boat tour was worth every penny. Highly recommended.

This is an easy and quick way to see lots of New York. Our guide Debbie was very proud of her city and her passion was infectious, she was very knowledgeable and clearly enjoyed her job. we saw Time square, St Patrick’s Catherdral, Central Park, 9-11 Memorial, Empire State Building,the Rockfeller centre,Statue of Liberty, Ellis island, Brooklyn Bridge and loads more. The tour was about 6 hours and extremely good value.
Thanks so much guys. Saw and learned lots, a fab taste of NY and worth every penny, can’t recommend this tour highly enough.

A must do on your first day, this tour covers all of the things you want to see in Manhattan. We had "Tour Guide Jay" and he was great, so knowledgeable about everything in the city - we learned so much from him about where to go, what to see, how to get there, how much it should cost. Our driver Arliss managed that bus through the traffic like a pro, and there was a day long parade in the city that day so this was no minor feat! We had no trouble finding the bus in just off Times Square and checking in. I had recently sprained my ankle and was in a very attractive and bulky boot that day, but had no trouble getting on and off the bus for our few walks to take pictures and see sights. The bus was comfortable - We sat in the front because of my boot, but the best seats are in the back. Can't see everything from the front!! We had a 30 minute stop for lunch. Things we saw - Statue of Liberty, Central Park, John Lennon Memorial, 9/11 Memorial, Empire State Building, Flat Iron Building, St. Patrick's Cathedral, and other cool places of history that we would have never even known about. Jay passed out a "NY cheat sheet" with recommendations on places to go, places to eat, how to get tickets to Broadway shows and more. HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS TOUR! GO ON DAY ONE OF YOUR VISIT!!

We left Times Square right on time, after sorting our being a day late for the tour. The tour guide was Jim, the driver was Roy. Roy was very quite (as Jim confirmed) however got us were we needed to go. Jim was great, very knowledgeable, having lived in New York all of his life.

During the tour, we were a little confused, and Jim's age went from around 23 year, to 60 years, with many jokes between both, but clearly having been in the area for that time gave him a real insight that he shared with all of us.

One large "school style" bus, with 30 people on the tour, we visited all of the areas as listed.

Most moving was, of course, the World Trade Center - Ground Zero. The replacement architecture was stunning, as were the memorial elements of the site, the bronze plates commemorating the fire fighters on the site of the fire station opposite the twin towers to the twin pools with the names of those lost 17 years ago.

Traffic was heavy, but Jim continued his commentary to keep us distracted.

Then to the water, riding the waves to see the Statue of Liberty, and the Brooklyn Bridge - it was a bit murky, but still the vista from the water was good. We had the boat guide take over, who did a rendition of "New York, New York" - quite amusing, and had plenty of facts for us.

Overall, I would recommend this tour to first time visitors to New York.

We had the tour guide J and the driver Alex taking us around New York.

It became quite clear that NY is a huge place with a lot of history behind it and J was really helpful and knowledgeable around the history and the stories. I was happy with the information provided, would have definitely liked more photo taking stops and opportunities but appreciate that you can't stop the bus anywhere you like in NY. The ferry ride was great too!

This was an excellent tour and introduction to the Big Apple. Our tour guide, Tim, was excellent. He had a lot of insider knowledge and behind the scenes stories for all of the landmarks. Not only knowledgeable, but very entertaining. Our driver, Gary, maneuvered the traffic like a pro and got us from place to place smoothly, safely and without a hitch. If this is your first trip to NYC this is a great tour to get a good sampling of what to do and see so that you can come back and spend more time at places you may want to explore a bit more.
This was not my first trip to New York and still found this tour very informative. This was my wife's first trip to New York and she has not stopped raving about this tour.
The tour lasts about 6 hours and the last couple of hours consists of a boat ride in the harbor giving you the best view of the statue of liberty. There are bathroom breaks during the tour and also a lunch break (on your own dime). You will do some walking, but there are no long distances and you are able to wait on the bus if you want to skip a location. Getting back on the bus promptly is a must after visiting a site because you are on a schedule and you have a boat to catch in the afternoon.
Highly recommended. A must do when visiting NYC.

Saw so much and our guide was great! Informative and nice. We were able to see things that we wouldn't of had the time or the money for. Saved the hassle of driving and parking in New York City. Plus it showed us where some of the things were that we wanted to spend more time at. I would recommend this to anyone and do it first.

This tour was really great and so much fun! I truly commend the tour operator as she was so knowledgeable about all the points of interest in NYC, explained everything in detail and answered all questions. She spoke very clearly and was very easy to understand. All the points of interest in this tour were covered in detail such as Times Square, Central Park, Financial District, Statue of Liberty and the 9/11 Memorial/Freedom Tower. I highly recommend this tour! Bus ride got a little bumpy as some of the roads throughout Manhattan were not clean paved streets.

Guide Gil spoke solidly for hours and is deeply knowledgeable about the city, events, and history. He led our group through this tour so swiftly and offered great enrichment. Raymond our driver moved us through the city swiftly and on time! Don’t mess this chance!

Nice tour through New York.

Thanks to Tim Douglas for your beautiful stories about buildings and famous people!

The Dutch boys,
Rick en Arjan Buur

We went on the one day guided tour. Tim was our tour guide and our driver was Johnny. They were wonderful. They genuinely wanted to ensure you have a safe and good time. The tour was an informative overview of Manhattan. Would definitely recommend to friends.

This tour was costlier than the Hop Ons but we have been to many of the sites already several years ago so we thought a guided 5 hour tour on our last day would be just the thing. We lucked out right away with "Debbie" as our guide, a genuine New Yorker. Despite the light drizzle, she absolutely made the 5 hours fly by. You do 5 to 15 minutes of walking as a group at some spots like Central Park and the 9-11 memorial. She has to keep you moving so you don't miss the hour boat ride which has another energetic guide. Thank you Debbie. You're fantastic!

Our tour guide Rachel was absolutely wonderful! She is very knowledgeable and gave many useful tips to help 1st timers, like myself, navigate New York! So listen to every word she says! Wonderful sights and the boat ride was my family’s favorite part of the tour :) my family had I only had 3 days in New York so it was truly the best way to see most of New York in one day!

Our guide Tim was personable, knowledgeable and fun. We have a lovely day seeing the sites and also listening to Tim’s personal experiences as a New York City resident. This is a great way to get an oversight of the city and identify locations that you would like to revisit. The boat ride is a plus and the guide there was great as well.

I'm so glad we chose this tour for my first trip to New York! Our guide Debbie who is a native New Yorker had an amazing amount of knowledge and passion for the city, especially the 9/11 memorial. I was overwhelmed with information but I felt at the end of the day I got so much value and experience from a 6 hour tour, plus she even knew where the good bathrooms were! I would recommend this tour to anybody especially a first timer like myself. The big bus tours will never give you a personal and informative insight into the city like this tour did. Thanks Debbie for helping make my first trip to New York so memorable!

Rachel is one of the best tour guides ever! Very informative, organized and kept us to our schedule without rushing us. Lots of great information.

I especially liked the 911 memorial stop and the harbor cruise. The only way to get great pictures of the Statue of Liberty is from a boat.

Highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting NYC.
Perfect way to see the city in one day and gateway to plans the rest of the trip. Jim was great and helpful with all questions and made the tour fun and exciting.

This was an excellent trip! It’s a 6.5 hour tour but a perfect amount of time to see the whole city including the boat trip of Statue of Liberty. Our guide Tyler was awesome! She was very educated about the history of nyc but also very funny and entertaining to all ages on the bus. The bus was nice to sit in the a/c bc it was a hot day but you get out plenty of times for pictures/walk around/washroom breaks/lunch. Our guide gave us many good tips for restaurants/transportation/discount show tickets/etc. Overall a great experience and would highly recommend this tour!

We did the 6.5 hour tour that offered a 1 hour boat ride around Lady Liberty and much of the city. Tour Guide Jay was awesome and very thorough and well spoken as well as funny. Myself, my wife, and our 15 year old daughter found the tour VERY informative and entertaining!

Went to NYC this past weekend ( July 13 - 16, 2018)for a long weekend. Have been to NYC before and did touristy stuff by foot. Decided to try a bus tour and, it was well worth it. Tour begins and ends behind the Winter Garden Theatre, which was easy to walk to from my hotel in Times Square ( Marriott Marquee). Bus was nice, air conditioned, clean and comfortable. No bathrooms on the bus but bathroom stops were scheduled on our trip. "J" was our tour guide and "Gio" was the driver. Gio is a good driver, winding through the busy streets of NYC. "J" was very good, knew his stuff, animated, interactive and funny. J made some great recommendations for lunch. ( The Papaya hot dog is good and cheap). Pizza place next door had great slices of pizza.You are able to get off the bus at various landmarks such as the Dakota ( where John Lennon was shot killed), Strawberry Field Garden in memory of Beatle member John Lennon, St. Patrick's Cathredal, Rockefeller Center, 9/11 memorial just to name a few. "J" was more than accommodating taking pictures of you in front of landmarks. Tour included a boat ride to see Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island. It would have been nice if we were able to stop and visit one of these landmarks.
Even if you have been to NYC in the past, realistically it is difficult to see everything. This tour highlights the most interesting landmarks in a comfortable way.

This tour was absolutely amazing! I was a bit skeptical about doing a tour as I've never done one before, but we were fortunate to cover the listed attractions and really learn so much. Gil, our guide, made this tour amazing! We also had Gio as our driver. Through the hectic, bustling NY traffic, Gio got us safely and reliably around town.

This tour is probably your best bet in exploring NYC in such a short time-span. You truly need at least a week to extensively cover the tourist attractions of NYC; however, this group tours the major attractions, and the ferry to visit the Statue of Liberty was amazing.

Gil was an amazing tour guide. He knows so much, and keeps it extremely light-hearted. His humor and wit keep you entertained on the tour bus. You'll have ample time at the stops to take pictures. If you get Gil, get ready to have one of the best tour experiences of your life.

We stopped for lunch at the Fulton market where there was a solid selection of foods. Finally, the last stop is a cruise (Hornblower Cruises) that tours around Ellis Island, Liberty Island, and sails all the way to the Williamsburg bridge.

This tour is worth every penny, and there are no complaints from me! I hope this company expands to other cities around the States!

My mother and I found this company on Groupon and booked the New York in One Day guided tour. Jack, our tour guide, was extraordinarily knowledgable and Gabby, our driver, was an excellent navigator. Jack provided a wealth of knowledge about the city and he picked out picture perfect photo-op areas around the city and offered to take photos of each family. The boat right and the end was a huge plus. We got to see and enjoy Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island from afar and learn about the various forts in the area. I would highly recommend this company!

I want to start out by saying Rachel was simply amazing! This tour was great because of her. She is extremely knowledgeable about the history and current events of NYC. She was very engaging and she kept us on schedule which allowed us to get the most out of this tour. I highly recommend this tour for first timers to New York and I am thankful that we had Rachel!

Gil was our guide and a walking encyclopedia for all things New York City! His knowledge of the city’s history and at the same time, everything happenening now (including current Broadway shows) was outstanding. We saw so many things of interest it’s really hard to pick a favorite. The bus was comfortable with great window views. We had stops where we left the bus and walked into special areas like the 911 memorial. The boat ride got us up close to the Statue of Liberty and offered great views of the skyline. You won’t regret this experience!

Rachel was such a brilliant tour guide. I'm so pleased I booked this as New York was heaving and the sun beat down on us but in our bus we had air con and free bottles of cold water. Rachel was informative about each sight, the city in general and some great tips to get round. I loved this tour I was able to take so many great photos to show off and was able to share the info I'd recieved. I would suggest taking this tour at the beginning of any holiday to figure out where to spend more time. Thanks so much Rachel, I hope your daughter makes it!!!!

Overall we enjoyed this tour but that was mostly due to our tour guide J. He has a wealth of knowledge in his head and is ready to share all of it with us. He made everyone feel welcome with asking where we were from and what we did and often had anecdotal NY stories to relate to it.

Our driver, Ricardo, was terrible though. He had no idea where he was going and ran onto a curb just 2 blocks into the tour. J was both navigator and tour guide which was a bit annoying.

The “walking” portions were not as good as I expected. Find a place for bus. Walk across street @20’ Into Central Park , assembly line of pictures and walk back out to find bus.

Lots of traffic leaving park and heading to Rock Center and turned out streets were all closed to a fire there. J took control and took us to Grand Central instead. It was awesome and again, his knowledge astounded me.

Then bus to market to eat, and off to boat dock. Because of all our delays, J decided we’d do 911 memorial after boat which was a great plan.

Boat ride was fine, loved go gn in front of the statue. Just a nice little break and great views of the skyline.

Overall, I was glad I bought thru Groupon at a discounted price, there’s no way it’s worth the full price.

If you’ve never been to NYC, loads of great tips. If you’ve been, great anecdotal stories

I don't know how Tyler kept that much interesting NYC information in her head! She is a born tour guide. Tyler wasn't just informative; she was friendly, enthusiastic, and fun. We were all very pleased with her tour.

Tim the tour guide was amazing....so enthusiastic and knowledgeable. Made the trip awesome. John the bus driver did a great job navigating the NY traffic and getting us all around NY on time. After the tour my kids and I felt like we had seen all the major touristic attractions and learned so much history and current events of New York. Bravo to John and Tim!!

This tour was made extra special by our guide Tyler and driver Geo.Pick up point easy to find and we left on time.As we travelled round Manhattan the
knowledge and information that Tyler gave us was incredible and presented in a fun and enjoyable way. We stopped outside the Dakota building where John Lennon was shot then entered Central Park for a quick visit to Strawberry fields,that was just one of the many places we visited .The ferry trip was excellent seeing the Brooklyn Bridge Ellis island and the Statue of liberty.I think we felt a visit to the 9 11memorial was very special and poignant.
There is so much to see in New York this trip is an excellent overview.Thanks to Tyler and Geo our guide and driver for a wonderful tour and a memorable day it was a great start to our New York trip.

What an amazing tour. It was great and our guide Gil was awesome. He was so knowledgeable and had tidbits to share with us about so many things about New York. We saw all of the major attractions and more. Gil ensured that we were always on time and that the group was always together. He really cared about our experience and wanted us to enjoy our visit to the city that never sleeps. I highly recommend this tour as you will get a great taste of New York. Ask for Gil as he's the best!

We had such a great day yesterday (around 6 hours) out with Rachel our guide who, with such enthusiasm and knowledge, showed us around the city. Such a great size bus (about 30 people) expertly driven by Tony while Rachel kept us entertained and informed. The tour stopped at a few important places for us to stretch our legs and take photos and finished boat trip to view The Statue of Liberty and bridges from the water. Rachel gave us such great inside knowledge and tips for New York.., how she remembered all the information was very impressive for so many hours. Terrific value and a ‘must do’ early on your arrival in NYC

This tour covered so much, it was perfect! Tyler, our tour guide was AMAZING! She never stopped the entire time, always throwing tips, history, and facts at us. She is truly blessed in her craft and her love for the city shows through. By the end of the tour she felt like an old friend. She gave us so many wonderful ideas on how to spend the remainder of time in NYC...we took every food recommendation and each one was incredible!! Can't recommend this tour enough!

What an amazing tour, I am so glad that we booked onto this trip. It literally made our stay in New York, we got to see so many different places and the information and knowledge given by Gil between stops was fornominal. Gil was so knowledgeable about the amazing city that is New York and this was delivered in such a professional and humorous way, he had our attention from start to finish.

I've done the open bus, hop on/off before. Yeah, they look fun but you are tethered to your seat and if you get off you can have a very long wait to get back on. Your tour guide, Tour Guide J in our case (Thanks Jay!) pointed out as much as he could with lots of fun facts and statistics and with an abundance of humor. The tour makes frequent stops, we exit as a group, the guide walks and talks about areas of interest, points out the best places to use public restrooms and then get back on the bus and repeat. A very meaningful opportunity to visit Ground Zero and wander about. While in downtown we stopped at a location with many restaurants and a Fulton market with a huge buffet style deli. Later, a short drive to a pier. Board a boat to get a tour of the lower parts of East and Hudson, then to Liberty for awesome photo ops (from the boat, you don't land there) and a pass by Ellis.

After the boat ride the tour is over (and almost 6 hours have elapsed). You can choose to take trains, buses or wander to spend more time at sites that interest you. Our guide was excellent in directing folks to the correct subway stations and how to get to specific sites. About 3/4 of the group chose to wander and did not return to the bus. Those staying on the bus are returned to the starting point. This tour involves a considerable amount of walking and stairs. All quite doable, one in our group had mobility issues and managed to do it all.

Writing as a former NYC resident, if you've never been to NYC and it's not the middle of the summer when it's volcano hot and everyone wants the upper deck of a double decker bus, this is the perfect city tour for you. You see all the hot spots with a decent historical overview from a tour guide and a multitude of stops - uptown to 72nd Street, a taste of Central Park, 5th Ave, Rockefeller Center, Times Square, Washington Sq. Park, Greenwich Village, South Street Seaport, a great boat tour around southern Manhattan including Ellis Island, Brooklyn Bridge & Statue of Liberty drive byes that enable photos close enough to avoid the dedicated all-day tours (waste of time/money), Wall St., City Hall, Freedom Tower-9/11 Memorial, and back up the West Side Hwy, with a quick stop for lunch in between. The boat tour is the real differentiator as it's a rare city tour inclusion without having to buy a dedicated tour for the same price. The tour guide (Dina) was very knowledgeable and was great at making sure everyone had photo opportunities, even doubling as a pretty good photographer herself. Just don't have a conversation with your seat mate while she's speaking else you'll get the 3rd grade teacher treatment and she'll stop talking till you're done. Such a NYer move. My only other beef is with the busses themselves - pretty standard short tour bus, which could be made better if the windows weren't tinted and customized for higher windows so non-window sitters could see more. All-in-all, you get a great overview of the city in a relatively short period time (~6 hrs) and allows you to go back to the spots you want to explore in more detail. And, you can say you saw it all. Highly recommended.

I’ve been to New York many times, taken many tours, but I have to believe that Rachel at USA Guided Tours made this 6 hrs the most memorable ever! I was expecting more out of this tour according to the rave reviews that are fake and they probably pay for. First of all, I was rushing to get there to find out the bus is going to be 25 minutes late. We didn’t even get the USA Guided Tours bus. We got a cold bus with smaller, dirty windows and a broken speaker. The tour guide, who was some older man, had to yell most the time. Sometimes he had to tell the bus driver where to go so this must of been an unplanned tour. He also took routes that aren’t part of the tour so we weren’t seeing everything we were supposed to be seeing. I am mostly disappointed because I thought we were going to get off at most the sites mentioned in the tour description. We only got off at 4 to see the Imagine artwork at Strawberry Fields, the outside of St. Patrick’s Cathedral, the foyer at Rockefeller Center, Madison Square Park, and the 9/11 Memorial Park. All the other sites mentioned in the tour description we just rode past and we had like 1 second to look at and take a picture of. The tour guide wasn’t being very descriptive. He was just telling us what the names of things were most the time and what streets some older famous people live on. I haven’t even heard of most the people he mentioned. This tour is geared towards older people. It seemed like he was just making things up as he went sometimes. I also would of liked to know more about some of the artifacts and sculptures we saw and the meanings behind them. I don’t even think we saw all the places in the tour description because he was clearly rushing since we were running a little late. I also heard him on the phone with I think his daughter telling her what time he thinks he will be home so maybe he was rushing for her. When the tour guide wasn’t around, I heard other people complaining about the tour too. The tour ended up ending later than is supposed to mostly because we were waiting on the bus to pick us up at a certain stop. We saw it ride passed us and then waited outside in the cold for like 10 minutes for it to come back. We also had to wait in line for the boat tour when we should of had VIP access. We had to wait 30 more minutes for the boat to take off after getting on the boat. The boat tour, from waiting in line to getting off the boat, will take up like an hour and a half of the whole tour which sucks because I want to see more than just a skyline and Statue of Liberty in an hour and a half. I wish I did the hop on hop off tour instead because then I can go see every site and take good pictures, instead of looking at the outside of everything I want to go inside of. If I were you, I would do my research ahead of time and plan your own tour to see all the amazing attractions and sites. Get a Metrocard for only $2.75 a ride and you would be saving a lot more money including tickets to attractions rather than taking the tour that I took which didn’t even include tickets to attractions. I also would look into pay what you want tours since they are probably more in depth and not rushed.

And our driver Gary did an excellent job maneuvering around that crazy New York traffic! Do yourself a favor and book this tour!

Our guide, Rachel, was personable, knowledgeable and well organized. She really gave us an informative tour and we really know New York much better now. Keep up the good work.

Our tour in September was a challenge due to severe traffic relating to the UN General Assembly meeting, but our tour guide Tyler and her driver still made it very memorable! The city portion was very informative and the visit to the 911 site particularly outstanding, but the harbor tour was just great, aided by the wonderful weather. We highly recommend for an introductory tour of Manhattan.
Good to do this on our first full day in NYC and see the main sights in one day . Tour guide Tyler made it fun for all.

We did a 6 hour tour of Manhattan, and boy was it great. The tour guide Gil is a fountain of information of everything Manhattan. He pointed out where celebrities live, anecdotes of special events, and historical perspectives. Roy drove the bus, and he drove through some amazing traffic. I would recommend Gil and Roy if you want a great perspective on what makes Manhattan great.

Taking this tour was a great way to see the city. Our guide was a native New Yorker and had a lot of personal stories and knowledge of the city. This tour was nice because the bus was comfortable and not overcrowded. A tour is good to do on the first day of your trip to get the feel of the city.

We did the tour this Friday with Gil. He did a great job and the bus was very nice and convenient. I recommend doing the tour early in your trip to help get acquainted with the city. Great photo ops all over.
The tour was awesome !! Our tour guide was Rachel. She was very informative and gave us great tips. She was the best !! I would definitely recommend this tour for first time visitors to NY
Excellent and informative. Our guide Tyler was awesome and answered all our questions. Could tell she loved her city. Betty was great driver, could put the bus in tight places.
I took a boat taxi, left it in 3 places and breath in the ambiace... best way to take great pictures!

We have just returned from New York City - and we did this tour on Friday 18 October. Our tour guide was Brendan (who was great). What I liked about the tour was that that there was approximately 30 of us on a small, air-conditioned single decker bus. We set off from next to Times Square at 11am and visited various sites, including Central Park, Rockefeller Center,

I couldn’t begin to explain what a great tour this was. I have been on tours of NYC before but wanted my friend to see as much as possible in a short six hours. We covered a lot of territory and learned a lot of fun, interesting facts about my favorite city. Rachel was our tour guide. She was such unbelievably knowledgeable and detailed about the city and gave great suggestions in navigating through the city and getting g good bargains. She gave excellent advice in avoiding scammers. She also kept us on time at each stop so we were the first group to go to the Statue of Liberty. I had read before Rachel was good but she truly was exceptional. The bus was comfy too.

Arliss was a super good driver. Highly recommend this tour.

We absolutely loved this tour. Arliss & Gil exceeded our expectations of our idea of a tour. Arliss is a master behind the wheel keeping us on a great time schedule and seeing so many sights. He was quite but very friendly. Gil was so engaging. A plethora of information, like a walking book of knowledge of the sites and city. He held our interest so well, as well as everyone else on the tour. Everyone gave him our undivided attention which was great so we could hear every word he said. (No side chatter from fellow tourists.)
My husband, 2 adult daughters, and I give this RAVE reviews. 5 star rating!!!!
Gil and Arliss made a wonderful team. Both friendly, polite, and kind.
Absolutely LOVED the tour because of them. No stupid corny jokes, just informative, interesting and fun.
I'd highly recommend taking the tour with them. In fact, I'd take the tour again .
Tina Helbert
Auburn, Indiana
