Several friends and I visited New York and took this tour on our first full day in town. We enjoyed it immensely and signed up for the night tour with our guide Rachel. She gave us all kinds of tips on getting around and shared unique and interesting facts on the sites we visited. Rachel was very efficient getting a rather large group through the sites and we felt like it was great way to get a glimpse of many attractions without spending too much time at any one attraction. I recommend doing this tour early in your trip so you can followup on any stops you would like to see in more detail. Rachel was fabulous!

Did the tour last Friday 11th October. The guide was very welcoming,humourous and knowledgable. Saw all the major sights of New York which was great and then went back and did them in depth. A great tour to get your bearings around the city and then visit at your own pace.

We began our trip to NYC with this tour and it was excellent. We got the lay of the land and a wealth of information. Our tour guide Mike, really has a love and passion for the city and presented us with detailed information that you can't get from a book. His enthusiasm made you see the city in a whole new light. I highly recommend this tour as the first step in your trip to NYC

Our first full day in NYC and what a great day it was. My wife and I are both from Liverpool England and were teenagers in the 60s and both massive Beatles fans, so the Dakota Buildings stop was particularly emotional being the site of John Lennon’s fatal shooting.
Tim, our guide was superb. If you are lucky enough to have him as your guide, you won’t be disappointed.
It was a full on day and Tim’s knowledge of NYC was encyclopaedic. Here are a few pics

I can't see how any other tour would be better. We got to see pretty much the whole city in a comfortable atmosphere. Guide was amazing, so knowledgeable about everything.. gave a great history story about the buildings and many different things along the way. I would highly recommend.

We really enjoyed our tour. The sites and attractions that were included were great. Our guide was very knowledgeable and pleasant. At times he would begin his talk before we had all exited the bus and I found that frustrating but overall, very good.

We had a great time with our guide Rachael, she gave a lesson in New York that was outstanding, not only sights to see, and history, but also local culture, do's and dont's, and how to avoid rip-off's. Can't say enough good things about Rachael, she really went over our expectations! Thank You Rachael! The bus was roomy clean, and had huge windows to see through, and the driver sorry I didn't get his name, manuvered that big bus through traffic like he was the only one on the road Kudo's to him also!!

We chose to go on the tour on our first full day in NYC to tick off some of the key landmarks and thought it would be a great way to see the city with the help of the guide. The tour was a great mix of getting off to see key locations (Strawberry Fields, Rockerfeller Centre, 9/11 Memorial to name a few) and seeing lots of the city from a comfortable bus. Admittedly, if you want to see some of the attractions in greater detail, you would need to revisit - as we chose to return to go to the Top of the Rock and the 9/11 Museum, but that's not the purpose of the tour, you can only fit so much in!
The boat trip was a fantastic addition, getting to see the New York skyline on a bright and sunny day was certainly something to tick off the bucket list, whilst seeing the Statue of Liberty too.
Our tour guide, Tyler, was fantastic. She was so friendly, extremely personable and had fantastic knowledge of the city. She ensured it didn't feel like a lecture, as she was engaging and interactive - a real asset to the tour! It's also worth shouting out our driver Anthony, we collectively decided that driving in NYC wasn't for the faint hearted, but he did a fantastic job.
Would certainly recommend for anyone wanting to tick off some key landmarks early on in their trip (or learn more in a city they've been to several times before!) and hear more about this fantastic city.

I have to admit that I presumed that the tour we were about to take might be boring. I equated this kind of thing with 'old people', but then I realized that I am now one of those 'old people'. (I'm a very active 64 year old). I enjoy learning new things so, though I had been to NY previously, I didn't expect too much out of this tour. How wrong I was! Mike our guide, who looks like an old hippy, (no offence to Mike, old hippies are still cool), has lived in NY all his life. He was a treasure trove of information, and spoke well about his home town. He answered questions with solid, well thought out facts. I would go on this tour again just to hear more stories that one cannot possibly hear about this exciting and historic town, New York, in one trip around town. Thanks Mike!! (By the way, Betty, our driver, was an excellent driver, a tough call in this town).

What a wonderful way to see so much of NYC in a day!! We walked, we ate, we rode and we boated. Just such a wonderful day ~ Gil and Jerry were the best and especially appreciated Gil taking our pictures. Such a great tour guide who had so much knowledge - I would do this tour again.

This tour was well worth it, especially if it is your first time in New York. Our guide Jim was very informative and funny. Got a lot of information which helped us during our trip and saw a lot of things we may not have seen otherwise.

We had clear blue skies all day so that was a good start. The tour guide, Dina and driver, Raymond were excellent. A well organised and very informative tour. The boat part out to the Statue of Liberty was a real highlight. Well worth doing and excellent value for money.
Our first time in NYC and this tour was awesome. I would definitely recommend. Gil was great and extremely knowledgeable. He even helped with pictures. Great tour!

We enjoyed our tour very much! Dana, our guide, was wonderful! She was knowledgable and fun! We covered all the important areas of NYC, and were able to get off the bus and take pictures. Dana provided us with facts as we traveled to another site and pointed out other areas of interest. The boat tour was a great addition!! We were very happy with the tour!!!

My daughters and I enjoyed a downtown tour of Manhattan. The tour guide was a gentleman who sounded to be from the Caribbean islands. He was extremely knowledgeable about what we saw and what we didn't see. He shared the history of Radio City Music Hall, various sports venues, Which former attractions had been replaced by other, newer ones. Although there was a chill on the upper deck, he was worth the cold!

My wife suggested the sightseeing tour for our first day in New York so we would know where we'd want to visit later. Dina and Raymond negotiated the traffic and the Korean Day Parade with admirable skill. Lots of interesting information on the iconic landmarks. The bus was comfortable and seemingly never to far away. Had a great time.

For our first time in New York this tour was perfect Gil the guide was fantastic a wealth of knowledge and always appeared at the perfect time to get a photo for us. The boat trip was amazing and helped by the fact it was so straight forward and a beautiful day to see the sights! Betty our driver drove us safely around the crazy streets thanks again Gil and Betty from the Londoners :)

This was an excellent tour and Gil our guide was very enthusiastic about giving us a lot of information about the various sites. He took photos of us in front of some of the sites. He was very accommodating. Roy, the bus driver, did a superb job in getting us through the traffic and around the city. Thanks to both for a great tour.
Great tour and great host gill and driver Roy would recommend to anyone who is visiting New York city
Rachel our guide was very lively and informative.the tour gives you a good idea of the various neighbourhoods and their attractions. Good tour to take on your first day.

Gil was our tour guide and he was AMAZING. Such enthusiasm for New York and very passionate about his job. He had some great jokes and great advice for being on the streets. Roy was a great driver as well--no sudden stops or incidents. The only downside to this tour was the very squeaky bus. Otherwise, it was a great way to see a little bit of everything.

We did this our first day in NYC and it was a great way to see the city.Definitely do this! Our tour guide, Tim, was so very knowledgeable and friendly. It was a good combination of riding in the bus and walking. We had about a 30 minute lunch break with several different choices.

Fantastic way to see much of Manhattan in one day! Mike was a wealth of knowledge which he loved sharing. It didn't seem like a job to him but rather just a local guy sharing the great things about the city he loves. Price is very reasonable considering the tour is 6-7 hours long and includes your ticket for the boat ride. I much prefer this to other sightseeing buses because Mike got off at all the stops with us and spent time explaining what we were seeing and taking pictures of us.
Don't waste time on other companies - this tour is the one! We talked to others who were disappointed in their bus tour and everyone in our group was saying wonderful things. Try to book on your first day in NYC - it's a good overview and Mike gives lots of tips that will help in the rest of your stay.

If you want to spend half of your 6 hours stuck in NYC traffic, and listening to a tour guide waffle on about where celebrities lived, died and where they had their funerals, then sure, book this tour. Tip for the guide, instead of being invidious about contemporary architecture in your home city, how about you educate yourself so you can educate others. Despite the tour, I still love NYC!

Excellent way to get a quick overview of the city. Includes almost all of the well known sites. Gil, the tour guide, was full information and helpful hints and Anthony,the driver, did an excellent job of negotiating traffic and being where he needed to be. Be aware this is a fast paced tour.

Great tour, especially for those who are first-timers in New York and/or have little time to explore. The buses are comfortable and air conditioned and small bottles of water are provided. Our tour guide and driver were excellent. The only disappointment for us was that the company operated the tour on one of the days that the UN was in session (September 23). We came to understand that roads were closed as a result and there was gridlock in many sections of Manhattan. The traffic was so bad that we missed seeing a number of landmarks and districts listed on the tour. (It would have been nice for the company to have offered a discount for this.) The bright spot was our guide, Rachel, who was not to blame for the traffic and who dealt with the delays professionally and, along with our driver, successfully maneuvered us through the challenges so that we could see some of the key highlights of the tour. While it must have been stressful for her, Rachel maintained her composure and humour and kept us informed about what she was planning so that we could enjoy the day. Rachel provided us with a lot of information about the history and the areas that we were seeing, organized taking pictures for all people on the tour at certain destinations and gave us many helpful tips for visiting New York that we personally put to good use during the rest of our stay. Thank you, Rachel, for giving us a great introduction to New York!

Had a great time on this trip. We were lucky only us and the tour leader. Saw everything we wanted to see it involved a fair amount of walking but you didn’t have to walk if you didn’t want to. Couldn’t fault it in any way.

Our day was packed with the sights and sounds of Manhattan. Rachel was our tour guide and she was so informative about all the sights . We were able to get off the bus and follow her closely to the various spots for pictures . She never stopped talking about what we were seeing and we learned so much about the city . She gave us some really GREAT tips and advice on how to navigate the city and what to watch out for etc. Fantastic way to explore the city for the first timers like us. I highly recommend this tour.

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our six hour tour.
Our guide, Mike, was very informative, funny and patient.
He shared a wealth of knowledge and information about New York which made the tour well worth the cost. We booked this tour at the beginning of our vacation so we could get an overview of the city. It was certainly very helpful to get a feel for the city and to return to places of interest and to later recognize sites that were pointed out
by Mike. We highly recommend this tour.

Rachel was our tour guide who gave us a terrific tour. She was very knowledgable and very well organised. She made sure everyone was included and had an equal opportunity to take photos. A great way to sample the best of New York

Took my senior parents for a 1 day trip to NYC. First time for all of us. I knew my parents couldn’t do a lot of walking and this trip was perfect. Staying with the same driver and guide all day was exactly what we needed. It was the perfect combination of stops for first time visitors. We happened to be there during the UN General Assembly and traffic was unusually bad, but neither our driver (Roy) or guide (Tyler) tried to rush us and were amazing at adapting to the situation and giving us the best tour possible. Tyler was the best tour guide we have ever had ANYWHERE!!! You can tell she truly LOVES her home city. She is so very knowledgeable about every aspect of the city and was so enthusiastic from start to finish. Would definitely recommend this tour!!

This was a great tour. You get to see all of New York in 6 hours. Our tour guide Gil had so much information and history of every street we drove on. We had to detour the bus because the president was in town along with all the UN delegates, but we barely noticed the driving delays because Gil had so much to tell us. I am glad I did this tour in our first day in New York because it helped me for the rest of my trip.

Our tour guide, Rachel, was fantastic. Although she had no control of traffic delays, she knew how to get us to some of the best sites in Manhattan. Our driver was also awesome. I would definitely recommend this tour.

We had such a full and memorable first time in New York thanks to Dina and Gerardo. So much history and information! The traffic was very slow in town due to the UN in session which made it difficult to get around however this team did an amazing job in safely getting us around the city. The cruise was among the many highlights and broke up the bus ride nicely. We will likely do the evening tour next time we return.

Best tour of New York City! My friend and i had one free day to tour the city and we chose this tour! You get to do it all and hear a lot of history of the city! They offer cold water throughout the whole tour and our driver John was awesome! Dana our tour guide LOVES NYC!!! She’s the best and made our experience amazing! She loves her job and knows a lot about the city! Best day ever!!

I absolutely cannot say enough great things about this tour! From the content (incredibly thorough, some history, some entertainment/film info, and even a special segment at the end on "How to be a New Yorker") to the guide Rachel (absolutely phenomenal) and the driver Ray (deftly navigated the worst traffic day in the year: UN week), this tour was the highlight of ny trip to NYC.
We did a ton for the price! Rachel took photos of us at the different locations, and she made sure we had unobstructed photos at that. She also provided us with a list of best places to do various things (shop, cheap Broadway tickets, vendors in Chinatown, and the place with the best soup dumplings in the city).
Five stars, definitely recommend. As a solo traveler, I made several friends on the trip, too. Must do!!!

This is a great way to tour the city. However, the bus drivers are definitely out of control and will make the experience not as pleasant for you. Majority of the time they lay on their horn to any car, bus, truck that is in their way which you have to hear the whole time! They do show you great spots in NYC but as someone who goes to the city often I would try other options to see the great locations NYC has to offer!
I wanted a general overview of NYC and this was it. Rachael was a great tour guide. Great info, funny stories and no stupid jokes. Great time!
Guided tour of new York with Racheal and Raymond , fantastic do at beginning of your trip to get all the best tips and places worth seeing
Excellent tour a very knowledgeable tour guide. The best way to see all the sites. Gil the tour guide is excellent.

Our tour guide was Tim. The tour was mostly about what movie/TV show was shot in the city and where. The worst part was his facts- which were easy to research- were wrong. The tour seemed more like a guy who heard stories about celebrities, where they lived, and what shows were filmed in the area but didn't check to make sure any of the stories were factually accurate. Some of them were, most were not. I had hoped for a tour of architecture, art, and history but resigned myself to this. Then, to learn extra information on some of his "facts", I discovered he was wrong over and over again. My husband and I did enjoy the boat ride, though, we found it hard to understand what the tour guide was saying sometimes. In all, I would not recommend this tour. Tim should make sure the information he is sharing is factual, and perhaps, the touring company, USA Tours, should let their prospective customers know what type of tour they are purchasing. Mostly, tours -any tour- should be well researched and based on facts, only facts.

We took this tour because none of us had ever been to New York before and we were only going to be there for a few days, we wanted to see as much as possible and this one hit the highlights of everything!
Betty was our driver, did a fantastic job getting us around New York without incidents, which quite frankly was a bit intimidating! Tim was a fabulous tour guide and story teller of all that is New York - we learned so much from him and he entertained us the whole time! Book this tour and enjoy the sights, it’s truly worth it!

Best guided tour ever (I did a lot of tour). The tour guide Gil was so knowledgeable, so entertaining and kept the group motivated with all the information pretty much about everything. We could do 3 days tour with him :-)

Regardless how many days you stay in NYC, this tour should be THE FIRST THING you do when you arrive!! And ask for Gil! Thank you to Roy too (the driver)

Really enjoyed this tour. Great stops, with great info. Our guide, Gil, was on it! Very knowledgeable, kept us well informed, together, and on schedule. He could answer any question, was funny, and entertaining. Any downtime between sights, he would continue to inform, and provide helpful tips, to those of us that have never visited NYC before. We arrived from the west coast on a red eye, and this was the first thing we did. It was the perfect way to get us orientated, and made the rest of our trip better. Highly recommend!!!

We had an amazing day. Gil was was very knowledgable and kept us up to date with everything to the past and the future of the city. Many thanks to our driver Roy who got us to each stop on time. I can recommend this trip to anyone.

As first time visitors to NYC, we were exceptionally pleased with our tour last Friday the 13th. Our tour guide Mike, a long time resident of the city, entertained us with little known tidbits about his city. Our driver, Tony maneuvered through NYC traffic like the pro he is. Largely due to this great overview, we were able to get around the city by foot and subway unassisted for the remainder of the weekend. I would highly recommend this tour.

Gil and Betty were outstanding Guide and Driver for our tour. Gil is extremely knowledgeable and enlightened us about many of the areas of the city that we would never had known touring on our own. Betty managed to maneuver through the City with ease and always stopped in locations that made it simple for us to get off the bus. I strongly recommend this tour, with Gil and Betty, to see the City in a day.

What a great way to see NYC, we spent the day seeing the sights. Now we know our way around New York and can return to the sights we choose for a more in-depth visit. Our guide Gil and driver Roy really know the ropes. So much interesting anecdotal information. An entertaining and enjoyable day - I highly recommend this tour.
Tyler was our guide and she is amazing - fountain of knowledge so friendly and stayed with us the whole day - it was an amazing day to spend a special birthday. Highly recommend!!!

We were in NY for 6 days. Two of those days were going to be travelling to Niagara Falls so we needed to maximize our time. We pre booked this tour from Australia after researching on Viator.com. It was a great way to see New York City. We saw loads of things and whilst I wish we could have stayed longer in Central Park and 9/11 Memorial site it was just great that we went there. We travelled with two other couples and we all really enjoyed it! certainly would recommend going. Our tour guide was great and he certainly knew what he was talking about. Highly recommended

We took the day tour with Gill. He was very knowledgeable and gave many excellent tips. The tour was informative and well planned out. Was able to see so many attractions. It was a well balanced tour on a bus, walking and on a boat. The boat was a hightlight. Would recommend this tour to anyone that would like an overview of the city in a day and if you can ask for Gill as he amazing during the tour and gives you so many tips around the city and advice. After doing this tour I wish there was a part two you could take as so many areas to see in NYC. This tour made me want more. Our bus driver was also very friendly and helpful sorry I not sure how to spell his name Arus. Just awesome time thank you Gill you made the day for us.

Tyler was an excellent tour guide. It was clear she loves her city. She had a great laugh and made us all feel welcome and valued. My friend and I had only 2 1/2 days to see this amazing city and this tour gave us the overview we were hoping for... and exceeded our expectations. Our coach was clean and comfortable. Our driver amazing, getting us smoothly through the maze and chaos of traffic filled streets. We will be back, "to the city that never sleeps"!

The tour guide Tim was outstanding. He was so knowledgeable and spoke so clearly (essential when you are well into you seventies) . The driver Tony knew how to get around smoothly and always parked conveniently. The range of destinations was varied just what we wanted. The visit to 9/11 memorial was moving and inspiring. We would highly recommend this tour as a great introduction to this amazing city.

We did this tour and it was excellent. I think what made it so good was our tour guide Rachel. She was very knowledgeable and fun and made sure people were on the bus on time. If you book this tour, I would highly recommend requesting Rachel.

This was my first tour of New York City and I can’t say enough about our guide Dana. She is so entertaining and gave us so much information about what we were seeing.i highly recommended this tour and ask for Dana. You will have a wonderful time

Dana was our tour guide and Tony was our driver, we weren’t sure what to expect with a 6 hour tour. Dana is so friendly and hilarious, we had such a great time. She gave lots of “tour guide tips” which were very helpful and her biggest tip was to try Juniors Cheesecake. We headed straight there right after the tour, and Dana was right, the cheesecake was to die for.....so good! We got so see so many things on our tour it was so awesome, there would be no other way to see all the sites on our own with the limited time we had, so we loved this tour! Shout out to Tony with your great driving skills, you truly are a magician!

Our guide, Tyler, was absolutely wonderful. She was knowledgeable, friendly and flexible. The flexibility came in handy when we discovered we were taking the tour on the day of the Labor Day Parade and half of Manhattan was shut down. That's where our driver, Ray, rose to the occasion and got us safely through the log jam of traffic. The tour was comfortable, informative and very enjoyable.

First time visitors to NYC, my daughter and I booked the tour for our first full day and loved it! Saw so much, the time flew by. Comfortable air conditioned bus with iced water provided. Our guide Dina was really great and really made it special. Boat trip to see Liberty was a highlight but there were so many. Definitely recommend this tour, great value and made lots of memories.
First The Driver was Just great. Plus Guild Lady was Just great. Plus the both of them showed me all around New York. 10 out of 10.

This is the way to see NYC in a day! Rachel & Arlis had us see as much as possible without sitting in traffic. From Lady Liberty to Strawberry Fields in Central Park, we saw it all. Not only were the highlights covered, but tips were given to help get around the city on our own. Great day! Great tour!

Rachel was a great tour guide! I only had one day to see as much as possible and this was the perfect way to see the main attractions. Now I know which places I’d like to come back and spend more time at. Jerry was our amazing driver. They both worked so hard to make sure we got to see as much as possible and to not spend our time sitting in traffic. Highly recommend this tour. I actually liked this tour so much that I also booked the night tour as well!

This was a great tour , our guide Rachael and driver Jerry were fantastic thank you to you both
Would highly recommend

Dana is absolutely amazing!! She is knowledgeable and passionate about New York! Her tour was informative, enjoyable, and FUN! It is a MUST to tour this wonderful city with her!! I wouldn’t recommend anyone else!

If u have less time and you want to optimise your visit to New York or if u want to do short visit to key attractions in NY before taking a detailed tour, this is the best tour. The guide (Mike) as well Driver (Gerardo) Both we’re very helpful. Especially mike gave us lot of knowledge through out the trip relentlessly. All I can say it is amazing

A tour is nothing without a great guide and we found that in Dina. She was extremely knowledgeable in the history of the city. Bring a camera and a good pair of sneakers. This tour is 6 Hours long but flies by. It is money well spent. Since it is not a giant bus it feels more comfortable and friendly. I saw everything I could possibly want to see on a tour. We even had a boat ride in the harbor and saw the Statue of Liberty and Ellis island. I could go on and on. The only down side is that there are not enough hours in a day so we could not stay in certain areas ex: Central Park, or the World Trade Center As long as I would have liked but again understandable. This is the tour you want to take....and tip your guide.......

I was in NY for a week but only had one day to visit Manhattan. I had originally thought that I'd just look at a map and explore what I could on my own. After some consideration, I decided on the New York in one Day tour. I am so glad that I did. This was the best way to see the city in a single day. The tour lasted 6hrs. Our guide Rhonda was extremely knowledgeable about the city, and was very friendly. On this tour you ride the shuttle bus around and then get off at certain stops. You will hit all the most popular sights of the city while on this tour. There's too many to mention here so I advise you to visit the site for more info. I will say that near the end of the tour you get a cruise of NY Harbor to the see the Statue Of Liberty. At $89 this is a big value. Lunch isn't included but I was able to grab a couple of hotdogs and a drink for $6. If you are on the fence do this one.

The tour was very interesting had hit all the important spots on our list of sites. The tour guide Dina was very experienced and added meaningful anecdotes to each of the sites. The driver was a master at getting through traffic and kept us pretty much on schedule.

This was our first time to NYC and this was the first tour we booked. It was AWESOME! Dina was our tour guide and she was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. We learned so much about NYC in such a short amount of time. From the tour we were able to map out the sights and areas where we wanted to go back to and spend more time. The NYC Skyline boat ride out to Staten Island and The Statue of Liberty and then under the Hudson Bridge was also a huge bonus that was included in this tour. We booked this specific tour because of its high ratings and it did NOT disappoint! If you’re looking for a fun, informative and well worth tour, then this is it!!!

This was a great way to see the city! We took the tour on 8/27. Anthony (our driver) always had a smile on his face and he maneuvered around the city like a pro. Tyler was an incredible guide. She knows so many things about the city that you just can't learn from exploring the city on your own. We adored her. She is kind, funny, sweet and very smart. The four of us Floridians highly recommend this tour.
Rachel was our awesome tour guide. She was a fountain of historical and current information. Whole trip well worth it

Great tours are usually the result of great tour guides and Gil is the best!!! 6 hours of constant info. on this tour.
This tour is on a smaller comfortable commuter bus. Not the huge double buses you see throughout the city. Had maybe 15 or 20 people total on the tour. You go to several sites throughout the city like Central Park, Rockafeller Center, Madison Square Park, Financial District, Fulton Market, 9/11 Memorial, boat ride near statue of Liberty, etc.
Definitely do this tour on your first day. Your guide will be intimately familiar with the city and point out so many things that you'll want to check out during your visit.

Tour guide Tim and driver Betty gave our little group a great tour, hitting all of the highlights as listed in the description and providing just a ton of facts and tips along the way. We hit it all, starting and ending at Times Square in a very nice 30-person, air-conditioned, enclosed tour bus. They made sure we had several bathroom breaks and stopped at a nice neighborhood to grab some lunch before we boarded the boat for the one-hour harbor tour around Ellis Island and the Statue of Liberty. Doing this tour early in my visit helped me plan the rest of my stay in NYC, would absolutely do it again!

Loved this tour. My main reason for picking this tour was to be able to see a lot of NYC without having to drive around. I knew my elderly parents were not up to a lot of walking, and this was perfect. We were able to get off the bus to see the sites, take a few photos and conveniently get back on the same bus. It was very easy. Our guide, Rachel, was very knowledgeable and the driver was fantastic getting us quickly from spot to spot. It was the perfect way to see the main highlights and give you an idea where you want to go back to visit for a longer time. Definitely worth the price paid.
It was very informative. Bus driver was very competent in the traffic. The tour guide was knowledgeable and friendly. All in all a great time v

Tim was an excellent tour guide that gave us great insight to the attractions along the route and at each stop. Betty did a great job negotiating the roads to make for an all round excellent tour. Highly recommend Tim and Betty for a smooth experience! Only downside is that the bus is not easy to see out of the front or if in an isle seat. Open top bus would be great.

Superb tour hosted by Neil who was extremely knowledgeable and provided an informative tour. Saw some of the highlights in Manhattan with walking stops at various locations. The boat trip to the Statue of Liberty was amazing especially with the weather. The guide on the boat was also extremely knowledgeable.

Roy the driver made the tour very comfortable and a total joy!
Good bus. Easy walks. Good AC, guide(Tyler) was knowledgeable and organized. I recommend this tour. A must for first timers in nyc

This tour was an excellent way to get an overview of what New York has to offer. I had a wonderful tour. Tour guide and driver were both excellent at their jobs. Lunch stop was well positioned with a range of foods available to suit everyone and the included boat cruise offered excellent views of both the Brooklyn Bridge and Statue of Liberty.

Took the 6 hour NYC tour and had a great time. It was our first time in NYC so this tour took us to all the major attractions and gave us ideas for which areas we wanted to explore in greater detail the following day. Dina was our tour guide and gave us all the history and interesting facts about the city. Gerardo was our driver and OMG ... he got us through some incredibly tough spaces. Great driver! The water cruise was also excellent as it gave a great view of the city and of the Statue of Liberty/Ellis Island. I would highly recommend this tour!!
We had a such a great tour with Rachel. She was funny, smart and knew everything about NYC! The tour was a perfect mix of on the bus, off the bus, on the ferry, lunch.... highly recommend!

Enjoyed the tour very much. Our guide Cindy, oh I mean Gil (lol) was loaded with the jist of history and infis about the places we visited. Anthony was also a very good driver. The tour was very informative and was really worth taking. Thanks for today guys 😉

Tyler, our tour guide has ecstatic personality. She made our sightseeing tour a very memorable one. She is very knowledgeable and has a cheerful disposition. We love her smile and she encourage us to ask questions. She made everybody in the group welcome and at ease. We learned a lot about New York City from her. I would recommend it to my friends and loved ones. I gave her a nice tip. I wish I would have given more. I plan to come back to see the tour again with my husband, niece, nephew and his wife and their daugther. God bless Tyler and the driver for a job well done. Thank you so much for a wonderful and memorable experience. Take care.
We visited New York for the first time. We enjoyed this tour of New York, we learned lots of things about New York. Mike was very knowledgeable and took good care of us.

This is a great way to see the sights and get your bearings on your first day. You see everything and the afternoon boat trip across the Hudson ticks the box for seeing The Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island without having to do another tour. Our guide was Neil, who was incredibly knowledgable and had a great sense of humour. If you are lucky enough to get Neil as your tour guide, then you’ve had a result!

I had read great reviews about this tour company online, so I decided to buy a couple tickets for the NYC One Day Tour. It was a comfortable ride thanks to our driver Anthony and our tour guide Gill was highly knowledgeable and entertaining! I would recommend the tour to anyone who is crunched for time while in NYC. You go around to the greatest places in town and you get off the bus at a few select areas to get a short walking tour. Again, this tour is highly recommend!

Our tour guide Mike was AWESOME! PERFECT! He knew everything about the history of New York and had lived and worked there for a long time. For me, having him as the guide made the tour a 10/10. I would definitely take other family members on that tour if I knew he would be the tour guide again.

The bus was very nice and had outlets and USB ports for charging our phones. The air conditioning was needed and worked great, and the seats were comfortable.

Our family loved visiting the tribute to John Lennon in Central Park, the boat cruise with wonderful views of the Statue of Liberty, and getting a beautiful picture with the Empire State building in the background.

Thank you Mike for a wonderful day!

This was an excellent tour led by Mike. As a native New Yorker, he gave great insight on the City. The tour is fast-paced and enabled us to cover a lot of the must-see places in a short period of time. The boat ride to the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island offered wonderful photo opportunities. Highly recommend! Tips: Arrive early..seats on the bus are first come, first served and you keep the same seat for the entire tour. Check out the Viator website (owned by Trip Advisor) it gives a more detailed listing of what this tour covers.

This was a great tour of New York. Got a chance to see a lot of New York. This is just a taste of each area and gives you a chance to see where you want to come back and see more of. The tour guide was very well informed and made sure our questions were answered. Rhonda was very familiar with New York and gave us lots of details. Seeing the Statue Of Liberty by ferry was the highlight. Lunch was short but very good. Found a great place to eat: 55 Fulton Market. We are in air condition transportation and they provided bottle water throughout the trip. Lots of walking involved.

Tour guide Rachel paid small attention to all guests and we didn't have any major inconvenience or difficulty during our trip.
Thank you. Now wearealso NewYorker.
Great introduction to New York. Excellent guide, Rhonda was extremely knowledgeable and made the tour fun and very enjoyable. Fabulous day out, don’t miss it!
I highly recommend this tour, Jack was incredibly knowledgeable about the city and it’s history!! We got to see everything we wanted to see and then some!! Thanks Jack!!

I found this tour was good value. Gave a good overview of New York plus guide was very knowledgeable on New York. Also offered great advise on restaurants, places to visit. Was well worth the money as a tour.
Very nice tour, I didn’t expect a lot of walking but it was okay. Our driver Anthony was very good and Gil our tour guide was a wealth of knowledge. I highly recommend the tour.

Had an amazing time today! Dina did an awesome job showing us around and i got a very good insight on the history of new york ,would highly recommend for anyone visiting! Gerardo did a good job driving making sure we kept on time a very good team 10/10

I had one full day to see the sights and chose this tour. Our driver, Raymond, was a pro at the drop off and pick ups. Our guide, Deena, has a knowledge and passion for the city which was remarkable. The shuttle itself was of the smaller variety - not a big bus - which made it very nice. I’m a larger gal, and was comfy with the seating.

I feel we got a true taste of all of Manhattan. We got off at Central Park, Rockefeller Center, near Empire State Building, for lunch, the boat tour, and finally at the 9/11 memorial.

The only drawback was our lunch time which due to our schedule was 15-20 minutes. You don’t do anything fast in NYC, so that was pushing it.

I would highly recommend this tour. Make SURE to bring some cash along to tip your driver and guide.

This was ABSOLUTELY great! Our guide (Gil) was very knowledgeable & was a fantastic resource. We booked this for our 1st day in NYC & I am glad I did - I knew we would catch the highlights & it helped us pick out where we wanted to spend our time for the remainder of the trip!

Having only a short time in NYC, we wanted to see/learn as much as possible about the place. Our guide, Gil, was professional, extremely knowledgeable and informative on both the history and the daily living in NYC. He knew where all the stars and common folk hung out, and was extremely helpful in picking a restaurant for both lunch and dinner...The combination of motor coach (not a Big Bus) and boat cruise to the statue was extremely informative and interesting. To sum it all up, the entire tour was loaded with interesting, informative and humorous information. Well worth the few dollars it cost...
Gil was an outstanding tour guide. Fun, knowledgeable. Definitely recommend this tour to see all the highlights of NYC

We came from Ohio for a short stay to see NYC. Friday afternoon and evening we were on or own and I was not enjoying the big city very much. Saturday we took this tour and I had a whole different opinion of the city. Our tour guide Debbie did a great job. She was so passionate about her city and knew so much. This was the most enjoyable part of our stay in NYC. Thanks Debbie!

A great way to get an overall view of the city. Had the right number of stops. The boat ride was the part I enjoyed the most. Got great views of SOL, by Governors Island and then under the Brooklyn Bridge. Our guide Rhonda was very knowledgeable and welcomed / answered all questions. Would recommend this to anyone who wants to see manhattan in a day.
So glad we took the tour. Learned and saw so much. Debbie M. made it even more fun. Thanks for a great day showing us how great YOUR city is!! Highlight of the trip!
A super overview of the city with a competent and extremely knowledgeable guide. I learned lots and would do the same trip again.

Strongly suggest you do this on your 1st day so you get to see bits and pcs of NYC. Go back where you want to go next like 911 memorial and Central Park. Got lots of trivia, food suggestions and tips from Jack. Got the deal from via Viator for only $89/head.

I had tour guide Dana and driver Tony. Both were fantastic! Dana brought so much energy and enthusiasm when talking about the city. It is a little long and it sounded like the amount you see might be dependent on traffic, we had a pretty good day so traffic wasn't bad.

We loved this tour. Amazing guide GIL and skillled driver Betty did a marvellous job keeping everybody happy. We learnt so much about ceveral places in just one day. We highly recommend this tour to everybody that want to see as much as possible in a few hours! Best regards from Norway

My husband and I had our tour on Tuesday 23rd July, our guide was Rachel and driver Washington.
We had an amazing day!
I can say that THIS is the way of exploring NYC and it is the best way. Far better than hop on/hop off bus. We were exploring NYC in small group and we had our own bus for the day.
Rachel was outstanding guide! Very organised, knowledgeable and kept us entertained throughout the day. She shown us interesting places, told the stories behind them. Thanks to her we have a few pictures taken together at iconic places. Amazing!!
Also Washington was a great driver - he was making sure that we were not going to fast or we are close to the places that Rachel was talking about. This way we could fully see the places. He did very good job.
Massive thank you Rachel and Washington.
I would definitely recommend that trip. Do it at the beginning of your stay in NYC. This tour will give you a good understanding of the place as well as helps you in deciding what do you want to see and do in NYC.

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED day tour.

This is for me the best 1 day orientation of NYC - just the right group size and the tour guide 'sorry forgot his name' knows every corner of the city and additional helpful tips to enjoy the city. It is very organized.

We had seen how well reviewed this tour was, so booked it as we fancied learning about the key attractions.
It turned out to be great fun and our host Tim was great- funny and informative. Lots of stops and time for photos & lunch. The boat cruise was an excellent way to see the Statue of Liberty etc.
All in all great value we thought and a fun day out.
Gill was great! He is a walking encyclopedia of New York City. Had a awesome time. Especially the boat ride.

We had a wonderful day with our tour guide. Rachel our tour guide for the day was very engaging and informative of New York City. Her tips were great for navigating the city on our own. The bus was nice and comfortable. The ac worked great on a
very hot day. The boat was the perfect way to end the day.

My daughter and I signed up for the New York in One Day Tour as this was our first trip to NY and we only had 2 1/2 days - a lot to try to see and so little time to do it in. We decided an overview of the major sights was the way to start our visit so we could determine where we wanted to focus our attention in our remaining time. We lucked out with Rachael as our tour guide. She was a fountain of information! Kept us engaged, and moving throughout the 6+ hours of our tour. The time raced by. The day was inordinately hot and humid, Rachael made sure we were well hydrated and in the shade as much as possible throughout our time out of the bus. We could not have asked for a more knowledgeable, personable, organized guide. Strongly recommend this tour - maybe you’ll be as lucky as us and have Rachael as your guide. Enjoy.

In our group, we had two adults, two kids (ages 5 and 8) and a senior adult in our family attend the day tour. Rachel was our fantastic guide! It was great to see so much of NYC in one day with little effort, no worries about parking and no worry on where to go and how to navigate the city. Well worth the money to sit back and enjoy the city without the hassle!

Rachel was our tour guide, she was informative and very helpful. She provided great tips on where to eat and how to get around NYC like a real New Yorker. She was great at showing us the best of NYC. Our driver was Adessa. He was very good as well. It was great for kids to get on and off the bus four or five times to see the sites, take photos, eat, etc. The air conditioned tour bus was a plus!!!

I would recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see NYC, and take this tour on the first day of your visit....it’s worth it!

First let me start by saying I have never been to New York City. My husband and I were in the Meadowlands for a conference and we only had Saturday and Sunday to visit NYC and wanted to get the most out of our trip. Sunday we were going to the Yankees game so we really only had Saturday. I googled best tours of the city and this popped up. It had great reviews (as long as you had a good tour guide) and I hoped it would at least let us see some of the popular tourists spots while safely navigating the city. It started off a little rocky when we changed tour guides 3 times, but settled on Gil as the third and wow were we lucky! He was very personable and exceptionally thoughtful throughout the entire tour. There were sights that I wanted a picture of my husband and I and before I even said anything Gil would be grabbing our phones to take the shot. He and Jose were also very attentive in making sure we had everyone in the group at each spot and keeping his eye on the lone female passenger that didn’t have a ‘buddy’ to notify him if she wasn’t there. Being a female lone traveler in the past this really hit home and impressed me even more. The tour its self was packed! We saw a ton of the city and Gil’s knowledge of the city was also incredible. Not only did he know the history of literally every building, he knew the history of the broadway shows, where important events took place, pop culture knowledge, and fun tid bits about celebrities. I thought he also did a very tasteful job when talking about the 911 Memorial site. You could definitely feel the pride he has for his city. For lunch we stopped at a market that had a buffet where you could pick different items to eat, but also had a pizza place and a McDonalds for those less adventurous. The boat tour was also very good. It was about an hour and though Gil did not MC this tour the female tour guide on the boat was good and the views of the city and the Statue of Liberty were again fantastic! Gil again impressed me by making rounds on the boat to check on each of the guests that were on the different levels of the boat and asking if he could take pictures and chatting with us. One of our best pictures of the day was taken with the Brooklyn Bridge in the background and we wouldn’t have gotten it if it wasn’t for Gil. As we made our way back to the bus stop Gil continued the tour. I also want to say that not once did I feel unsafe as we walked the city or on the drive. Jose was a really wonderful driver and navigated the city well. He was always close by for us to board back into the AC. If I could give this 10 stars for them alone I would! The only thing I wish I could have done more is tip them more! My husband and I don’t carry a lot of cash on us but we gave whatever was in our wallets! I highly recommend this tour!
Taylor is our guide and she is GREAT! The only draw-back was that it is not an open-roof-top bus and therefore you cannot see the complete beauty of the city.

Booked this on advice of my cousin who took this tour and we were not disappointed!! Dana, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable and you could tell she loved the city. This made the tour very enjoyable. We got a wonderful overview of the city plus a boat cruise as well. Next time we are there we will take the night tour.

Our 6 hour tour with Mike and Tony was excellent! We learned so much about history, saw so many interesting places, and traveled to parts of Manhattan to which we likely wound never have ventured on our own via subway. My 11 yo granddaughter thought the boat ride was the very best thing next to seeing the broadway show. Mike was prompt, timely, interesting and yet laid back (and a great guide with his light saber leading the way). Tony is truly a master maneuverer in horrific NYC traffic where an inch is truly as good as a mile! The bus was clean and cool, and although the views from the open-top double-deckers might have been more fun, we were grateful to not be sunburned at the end of the day and to be able to hear all Mike had to say. While this tour might not be the least expensive one in town, the 6 hour time frame worked best for us and I think we all agreed it was some of the best money we spent on our first trip to NYC. Would highly recommend!
Wonderful tour!! Would highly recommend!! Rachel was so informative and we learned so much about New York! The boat tour of the Hudson was awesome also!

Tony was our awesome driver who got us to each location safely! Mike was our amazing man of knowledgeable. They are on a schedule, so be sure to have your NY feet ready. You do need to be able to walk and do stairs for this adventure, so wear comfortable cloths and shoes. Learned a lot and it was a great way to explore all the different things there are to do in NYC.

I'm from Australia and my daughter lives in the U.S. I found this site before my departure and it seemed to have all the sites I wanted to see as well as the small cruise. We were not disappointed and the guide was exceptional in his commentary and knowledge about all the places we visited. He answered all our questions very well and made sure we were all safe. I thoroughly recommend this tour and am pleased I was able to book it online and before departure.

If you are going to only be in NYC for a couple of days!
This is the best way to see NYC key points in NYC.
Oh guide was great ! Tim I believe was his name
We had a fab excursion, our guide Tyler was very informative and funny. Driver got us to every place needed. Would recommend any day.

Brilliant way to get a taste of the city and pick up hints on where to visit later. The trip was definitely made by our awesome tour guide Tyler who was informative, entertaining and genuinely lovely. Would recommend this trip is a must do, but you need Tyler to make it great!

Great way to begin trip to NYC! Tour takes you through all parts of Manhattan so that you are able to get clear picture of what you want to explore in more detail on future days. Mike was very informative and went the extra mile to ensure pictures were taken in perfect spots and the tour stayed on track! Good investment of time!

Took this tour with my family and was not disappointed. Rachel our guide, was engaging, funny and very informative. Great overview of the city and its history. Laid the ground work for future visits. Would highly recommend!
Dana was awesome, trip was informative and historical. The boat tour was super fun. Everyone was friendly

Really great tour- we saw the tour bus (which is limited in terms of views) and how busy it was and weren't sure what to expect, but within half an hour were having a great time. The format of stopping and walking around really worked well. Very slick and well organised, no waiting around. Betty (Bus Driver) and Mike (Tour guide) were both fantastic!

PS: try and get their earlier than the time you are meant to guarantee seats next to each other/together on the bus. Not a massive problem if not because you're on and off all the time anyway, but just an idea.

PPS: Thanks for the restaurant recommendation Mike (Noodle Pudding in Brooklyn)- it was also really great!

We had a great time on this tour! Our guide was Tyler, and she did a wonderful job! My only 2 pieces of feedback are:

1. If you have small children, I would recommend bringing a smaller stroller. They don't really have room on the bus for strollers, and they can be cumbersome getting on/off the bus at the various stops. You are not on the bus long between stops.

2. The place we were dropped off for lunch is not that great. The employees at 55 Fulton were more interested in their phones than helping customers. The food from the buffet was cold, and the pre-made sandwich we bought had moldy bread. McDonalds across the street didn't appear to have AC, and it was extremely crowded. The tour would have been perfect if not for our lunch experience.

Our group of 4 searched for a tour through Trip Advisor and this one was the most highly rated so we took a chance - and I'm so glad we did. I am very particular about how I spend my $$ and try to make wise choices.

Mike, our guide, and Johnny, our driver, were excellent and made the trip so enjoyable. Mike is full or facts and experiences and Johnny was patiently waiting for us on our return to the bus and stops to walk and to eat lunch. It was well organized with the buses waiting when we arrived for the tour through the end with us ending right on schedule.

The tour includes the "must sees" including the Empire State Building, Central Park, Rockefeller Center, 9/11 waterfalls,St. Patrick's Cathedral, and the Flatiron Building with trivia and facts provided by Mike, It would have been impossible to glean the information without Mike. We even saw the building featured in the original Ghostbusters movie.

Plus, there is a bathroom stop and lunch. I was curious how different eating styles would be covered.The lunch stop included a stop that included McDonalds, a pizza place, and 55 Fulton Market which has hot and cold food bars with great variety for $10/lb. which is where we went and we enjoyed it b/c everything was delicious.

The tour includes a boat ride around the Statue of Liberty and it was great. However, the actual boat ride was our least favorite part of the day b/c it was hot, humid, and the boat was very crowded. Mike was present and availabe but the guide on the boat gave the details.

As Mike said, it's a brief introduction to the sites but gives an idea of where you would like to return to and spend more time.

I must confess, I probably would not follow around anyone else carrying a light saber to keep the group together but that's what Mike did and so we followed.

Have fun!
Tour guide J did a fabulous job covering a lot of territory in a relatively short time. His handout had some excellent Tips and I found myself quoting him for the rest of the week. Worth every penny.

Our first trip to New York and wanted to cram in as much as we could.
Wonderful tour with great guide Tim and driver in a much needed AC minibus .
Saw all the top places to visit which gave us an idea of where we wanted to re-visit for a longer time.
Can highly recommend this tour

Tyler was our guide...super friendly and helpful guide who was loaded with information and took great care to pour our attractions and answer all our questions. Got a great feel for New York and directions. This is s must esp on a “first day here” type vacation.

Most excellent tour. We highly recommend this company and its employees. Our tour guide was Tim and the driver was Ellish. Both were professional and entertaining. Really, really good time for me and my family.

We had a great day of sights. Our guide was J and he was so much fun. My kids and wife also enjoyed his humor and charisma. He was full of great New York historical facts. Our driver Arlis was great too. We never had to wait for him to show up after our walks he was always right there. Highly recommend this for anyone who is only in New York for a short period of time.

We were only going to be in NYC for a short time, and we wanted to see as much as possible in a short time. This was a perfect tour for that. We covered so many areas of town and got to see so much. It was a small group, less than 30, and that made it even better. Our tour guide, Neal, and driver, Raymond, were the absolute best. It was a great value for the money. I highly recommend it.

We loved this tour. It was extremely informative. We toured the whole city. Our granddaughter graduated from high school and this vacation was our gift to her. We are from California and she has never been to New York. Our Tour Director, Mike Khan, was the BEST. A native New Yorker, he was able to tell us so much more about the city than we expected. He was delightful to be with and accommodated the group in every way possible. I will recommend this tour to anyone I know who is going to visit New York especially for the first time.

I wouldn’t recommend this bus tour. Being inside the bus didn’t allow us to see the things the guide was pointing out. Our guide needed to learn her left and rights because she was almost always telling us to look in the wrong direction. Also the the Gimmick of “ buy now before it sells out” is a joke. There are many tours everywhere that a group can but the same day. More on the history and less about whose who and where they lived would have been nice

We went on the tour on 9th June with Gil who was incredibly knowledgeable about NYC. He told us loads of interesting facts about the different buildings, parks, architecture and cultures of New York and gave tips on where to go for food, for drinks and for theatres. We had a fab time and would definitely recommend anyone to take the tour especially if it's your first time in New York.

Absolutely loved, Gill!!! My husband hates tours and he thoroughly enjoyed this tour, Gill and Roy. Gill was extremely knowledgeable and very engaging. :) I highly recommend doing this at the beginning of your trip. This is my 3rd bus tour in my 5 trips here and it was definitely the best!!

Recommend! Took in all the highlights, including a boat trip !easy pick up, easy drop off, nice pace throughout.
Tim the guide, was excellent! Had all the facts and figures, looked after everyone, was personable and a really nice chap.
Great tour, really good value

We had only one day to spend in NYC but so many things we wanted to see! This was the absolute best way to spend the day. The tour takes you all over the city and our guide Tim was full of info about the various parts of the city, the buildings, the history, etc...he was awesome! I would highly recommend this tour!!

We just took this tour. It is the best tour I have ever taken. This is because my tour Guide (female-Tyler} was amazing. She was knowledgeable, fun, and fantastic. I was trying to find a tour my husband with heart problems would enjoy. He was able to participate as much or little as he wanted. If you have someone not in the best of health this is perfect.
we were there last weekend. Had so much fun! Gil was our tour guide he was extremely knowledgeable and helped show us so much of the city in such a short period of time. Strongly Recommend.

My sister-in-law, my daughter and myself, decided to take this tour of NYC.. it was a great way to see a lot of things in a short period of time!! The tour was great, but the weather was rainy all day, however we made the most of it! Loved seeing 911 memorial, the Statue of Liberty, Central Park, Rockefeller center, and much more! Stopped for a quick bite, and was able to see so many beautiful buildings our tour guide was full of information about NYC living, places to eat, and other things to do, to even discounted tickets... it was well worth the money!! We were also given rain ponchos and bottled water complimentary!!

There are several tourist bus outfits serving Manhattan and I mean no disrespect when I suggest this is the best. Our motor coach was modern and small enough that we got to know our guide [Tim] and driver [Roy] well and could hear what Tim had to say. Tim was very knowledgeable, in ways that surprised us, like linking what we were looking at [a building, a park, a street] with a famous scene in a movie, an historical event, a celebrity, etc., etc. The cherry on the top was of course the hour-long harbor cruise, which allowed us to fill our cameras with shots of Ellis Island, the Statue of Liberty, the Brooklyn Bridge and that famous New York skyline.

One side note: this is a six-hour cruise, and we were slightly reluctant to select it because its description FORGOT TO MENTION that you are encouraged to step off the bus with your group at select venues [like the Dakota House, where John Lennon was murdered and Yoko Ono still lives], and were given an opportunity to grab a bite and take a couple restroom breaks during that six hours. We are glad we didn't let that oversight keep us from signing up for it. You will be too.

6 of us were in NYC for the Cards/Mets series and we enjoyed a wonderful afternoon with Rachel. This tour is perfect for the traveler who has never visited the city or if you are an experienced New York visitor. Thanks to Rachel and Johnny for providing a terrific experience.

Gil our tour guide and Betty our driver were the BEST. This trip was so informative. I have no idea how Gil can keep all this info in his head We loved everywhere we went and all the NYC highlights and tidbits we were given from places to see and restaurants to visit and where to buy show tickets etc. make this your priority when visiting this exciting city Thank you Gil and Betty for making our trip awesome
4 Canadian gals AKA Brunch Club

Tim was our brilliant guide and kept us entertained throughout the tour. We really felt that we saw all the best sights in NYC.

Tim really knew his stuff and made sure we got the best views, the best seats (on the boat), the best photos, the best lunch (took us to an area with various great choices, for all budgets). The boat tour really made this special and was a great end to the day. Would highly recommend!

We took this trip to hopefully be an all round introduction to New York. Glad we did. Our guide Rachel was excellent. We were given detailed information at all of the stops we made. In addition we were given great information and advice on how to get around New York and various other details varying from places to eat, museums, Broadway shows and much more!
Would definitely recommend!
Nothing to complain about. Well organised. Great driver and guide. Lots to see and do even on an unusually wet and wild day in NY.

The guide was excellent and had a great sense of humour. We toured all the high spots and got a good insight on where else to visit and how to get there. We were also given warnings of what to watch out for which is vey necessary in New York. A pity that the city did not come up to my expectations and has 3rd world standards with food stalls everywhere and people hassling you on the streets to buy bus and theatre tickets. Hard to tell who is genuine and who is not. Traveller beware!

We did the one day bus tour of NYC and it was a perfect overview of the city. Finding and boarding the bus was easy and the balance between walking and riding was just right. I'd highly recommend this tour for first time visitors early in their stay and for those returning who have never taken it before.

For a first timer in NY this was a perfect introduction, Guide Rachel and driver Jerry filled the tour with hints, tips and anecdotes that would ensure you would return again and again. The weather was extremely warm and the bus made a nice cool haven inbetween stops, not too much walking and definitely bring a camera, everything you needed to see was seen without being rushed which made for a very enjoyable day out sightseeing. Thank you, guys. Recommendation, definitely one to do.

Great tour of New York City. Easy walk and bus tour through the city. We saw lots of interesting sights. Grand Central Station, Central Park, The Dakota and my favorite the 911 Memorial. This is a must for anyone traveling to NYC. If gives you a feel for what's there and then you can decide what places you want to revisit.
Great well organised loved it . The tour bus driver was great felt very safe and was very informative

Tim, our guide, is soooooo fantastic. He knows New York really well, he is nice, funny and helpful. The tour is great, makes you see the principal attractions of New York. Worth the price, especially for a 1st time visit!

Just got back from an amazing tour around Manhattan with our tour guide Rachael and our driver Johnny. I’ve just recently moved back to NY and decided to take this tour as I have a friend visiting that had never been to the city. I, as a long time fellow New Yorker learned so much neat stuff on that tour. The tour was highly enjoyable, our guide was friendly and knowledgeable about EVERYTHING!! Highly recommend this tour for everyone wanting to learn about the city and also getting the BEST photo ops.

Tyler was an excellent guide with so much fantastic information - we did this tour at the beginning of our NY trip and it was so very helpful, with info about sightseeing, food, subway etc. Highly recommended!

Excellent guide and driver.
We saw all the major sights in one day. Great for those with little time to explore further.
Our tour guide Jay. Absolutely brilliant, So informative, funny and so well organised.
Enjoyed the boat trip which came during the day. Jay allowed plenty of time to take photos, nothing was too much trouble.
We would highly recommend this trip.
Thanks Jay brilliant day.

FIVE STARS We absolutely loved our sightseeing tour with USA Guided Tours New York. We met behind the Winter Garden Theater between 50 and 51 at 7th Avenue - there was a white tour bus waiting and someone to greet and check us in (buy tickets on line ahead of time). Our guide was Tyler. She was so very knowledgeable and friendly. She had all sorts of info on all parts of the city. She made us feel welcomed and like family. She stayed with the tour all day through the sites Uptown to the harbor boat cruise and to the One World Trade Center area. The tour was 10 am to 4 pm and we were able to leave the group at the last stop before the bus went back Uptown because we were staying at the Millennium Hilton Hotel right there at the last stop. That saved us a subway ride back Downtown from the drop off point at the Theater (same as pick-up point). We were able to see and learn about SO many sites in NY and have lunch at the 55 Fulton Market (hot and cold choices), and the group was small enough (about 22 to 24 people) that we didn't feel crowded or rushed. Kudos to Tyler for making the tour so much fun and so interesting!! After the tour day, we knew the areas of NYC that we wanted to re-visit to spend more time. HIGHLY recommend! Well worth the money.

This was a nice tour. The staff were friendly and informative. Our guide, Tim, was knowledgeable and gave solid recommendations for dining and entertainment. The instructions were clear, pacing reasonable and the bus was comfortable.
The hornblower boat cruise was decent and a nice add-on to the day.

First day in NYC we went on a tour and we are sure glad we did. Gil our tour guide was amazing. Lots of good information and answered many questions from the group. We got to see many many things in the city and the boat ride even tho it was raining was great. Gil even became a photographer to the group. He took my favorite picture from the trip. THANK YOU Gil and Anthony for a great adventure through NYC.
I wish I had gotten the name of the tour guide, a black lady from Brooklyn, on Tuesday April 30th. She was fantastic !! A viarable fountain of information and presented so damn well. KUDOS

This full day trip is definitely good value for money. Our first visit to New York from the UK. Wasn't sure what to expect, and had looked and booked this trip online as nearly all the reviews were good. It did not disappoint , from the pick up point -easy to find , to the drop off, we had the most wonderful day(despite the weather)
The tour is so informative and gives you the history of each and every area. Our tour guide was wonderful.
I highly recommend this trip.

Rachel was our guide and she was an expert about NYC and getting around. We had a great tour, and saw all the sites plus worked out what things we wanted to go back and see in more detail. As we were heading back to the city Rachel gave us all these tips on getting around, using the subway, who to tip and how much to tip. It was a fantastic experience for myself and my 77 year old mum. Thanks very much for a great start to the holiday

My son and I took this tour on May 4, 2019 and we had so much fun! Tyler is so knowledgeable and funny and bright and clever and nice! We tried to stump her with questions but she answered them all. The tour itself is perfect. Left on time, stops were excellent. We saw all the great sights. The bus was comfortable although a larger front window would be nice but the side windows were huge so we had a good view and there was a good balance of bus time and walking time. I highly recommend this tour. Thanks Tyler!

The weather was absolutely miserable but Gil and driver Anthony kept us informed and entertained. I would highly recommend this tour especially if it’s your first time in New York. The tour guide Gil was exceptional.

Tyler our tour guide was a 10. So knowledgeable. So interesting. you could tell she loved her job. thanks Tyler. Roy was a great driver. Would take the tour again, saw so much wouldn't have seen on our own. Tyler gave us so much info about New York, that was useful to us for the rest of our trip.
Gill and Anthony were dope! I’m from Sf and expect a lot from tours. Gill kept me entertain the whole time. Anthony, great driver.

It's worth it! We really enjoyed our tour. Learned a lot of facts and saw a lot of places. Our tour guide Gil and driver Anthony are knowledgeable, funny and respectful. Tour is highly recommended for first time visitors.

We did this tour the day after we had landed. We considered a walking tour but thought it might be too tiring after the long flight. It was excellent. We saw all kinds of stuff and we’re given some very practical advice on how to get theatre tickets etc.
We had Rachel and Anthony and both were good.
One of the highlights was lunch inLittle Italy, advice on cheaper theatre tickets and the subway plus the boat trip. It was really good with the right amount of on and off the bus and the boat trip. Well worth doing

Just did the NY in a day trip and loved it from start to finish! Our guide Tim and driver Tony were absolutely first class and greatly enhanced our tour.
We would recommend this trip to anyone looking to see a great deal of NYC in a limited time and the little-known things we learned from guide Tim about his beautiful city were a real bonus.
The company were kind and efficient and the sites seen in a few hours gave us a really positive vibe for the rest of our trip as well as some great photos. Great trip, great people and we will be recommending this trip to our friends that come to NYC,

I like to take a tour of a city to get acclimated to that town if I’ve never been there before. This all-day tour was perfect. The tour is limited to 30 people and you’re on a mini bus. Water is provided and there are two bathroom stops on the bus portion. Then after lunch when you get on the boat tour, there’s s bathroom on the boat. Arlis was our driver and Neil was our guide. We met in the theater district and started the bus tour. We made stops along the way...notable stops are Strawberry Fields in Central Park, Dakota building where John Lennon died and 911 Memorial to name a few. You’ll drive through many areas and see other NYC landmarks. There’s a stop for lunch at either a market, pizza place or McDonald’s before the boat portion of the tour. On the boat, you’ll see the Brooklyn Bridge, Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island. Neil did a fantastic job at describing the landmarks and stories, keeping the group moving and together. I felt he was very thorough. Arlis was always prompt at picking us up on the portions where we departed the bus for a closer look at a notable site. I recommend this tour especially if you only have a short time in NYC to see many of the city’s sites.

Rachel was an outstanding guide! She was extremely knowledgeable, lots of fun, offered to take photos, and just made six hours fly by. She kept things moving and rerouted us based on traffic jams. And Anthony/Tony was an excellent bus driver.

The tour was very comprehensive. There are many NYC tours available online and the five star reviews for this company made it an easy decision. I learned so much and appreciated Rachel’s practical information for getting around NYC.

Some comments here are about a 30 minute lunch break. However, it was more than ample time at the Fulton Street Market to get some sushi and a salad at the cold food bar and take it back to eat while the bus was parked. Very easy. I highly recommend this tour.

Though you expect heavy traffic in NYC, there was more than normal (according to the guide) and the whole day felt like we were waiting in traffic and then hurried at the stops. It's an OK way to get a feel for the city, but I believe we skipped some of the highlights that were supposed to be included - like Wall Street. A more extensive walking tour would have probably been a better bet for us. We took a tour the next day that had headsets and transmitters which made it a lot easier to hear the guide. It would be great for this tour company to invest in that technology.

This is a great way to get a taste of New York in six hours. Neil was the tour guide and he was full of information. Very nice and he would even take photos for you. Jerry was a great driver. Adequate bathroom breaks and a stop for lunch. The ferry ride to see the Statue of Liberty was wonderful! We got off at different locations such as Central Park, 9/11 Memorial and Rockefeller center.

Haven't been to NYC in 34 yrs. Having only 2 days, this tour was super! Got to see many highlights and our guide, Gil was fabulous! Learned many interesting things about the places, people, and facts! I highly recommend this tour!

This was a wonderful tour! It was our first visit to NYC. Our guide, Gil, took us to all the main sights; Empire State bldg., Grand Central, Times Square, St. Patricks Cathedral, Rockefeller Center, John Lemon’s home, Central Park, boat ride around Statue of Liberty, etc. We saw much more than we could have seen on our own. It was a wonderful day. Well worth the cost of tour. Gil gave us so many fun trivia facts about NYC, and he took some great photos of us at the various stops. His driver, Roy, did a great job in very congested traffic. Thanks for a fun day we’ll always remember.

Really good way to orientate yourself ( especially if you are a first timer) in New York. A really good mix of gentle 5 or 10 minute walks from the bus to see all the major landmarks. Tour Guide Jay was really knowledgeable, amusing and accommodating. A really great start to a fabulous stay in the City.

There are no complaints on our end. Our tour guide Jay was hilarious and very knowledgeable!!! This tour came highly recommended and I would like to make it very clear that this tour was amazing. Everything important to see is covered on this trip. I highly recommend doing the 11am trip, you will stop for lunch and then be back on time for dinner.

This Tour is a mixture of walking and bussing and a whole heap of information. We were a family raging in age between 24 and 70 years old and it satisfied every single thing we all wanted to see and experience.

Thanks to everyone including the driver!

As a first-time visitor to New York with very little time to spare, this was the best way to enjoy a comprehensive tour of the city. Our tour guide and driver were both clearly experienced and provided an informative and well-organized experience for their guests. I could not have asked for a better city tour.

Bought tickets for my parents last minute (2 days before selected date). They really enjoyed the tour guided trip and visited all the expected tourist sites. They thoroughly enjoyed it and would recommend to everyone.
The tour guide Debbye is a friendly, and engaging native New Yorker. She enthusiastically gives you little known details about the history of N.Y. You'll have an unforgettable time!

We (two adults & two teenage boys) did this tour on our first full day on holiday in New York. It was the best move we made - Rachel our guide was an encyclopaedia of information on New York and has fantastic advice on how best to navigate the city even once the tour ends. Rachel pit stops in all the right places so that you can get great photos as well. Money well spent.

Only criticism I would have is the instructions on where to meet wasn’t clear. We waited exactly where we were told however we had to call them and the guy was waiting elsewhere for us. Not too far but it was a bit of a pain BUT the tour was fantastic. The guide Gil (Gilbert) was brilliant. He was so knowledgeable and informative. Definitely would recommend this tour!

Had an amazing time and got to see everything me and my wife wanted. Driver Tony and guide Neal are awesome. Would recommend it to anybody worth it. Got to walk and see each place in person. not just drive by it like other tours. Loved it.

We booked this tour since we had never been to NYC. Rachel was our tour guide and she was amazing. She was so informative, helpful, organized and fun. We saw so much in the approx 6 hours on the tour and we were able to get amazing photos of the day. Rachel offered us numerous tips for NYC, transportation after the tour, what to eat and how to deal with the street vendors etc

Our guide Taylor was great! She is Friendly, enthusiastic, equally very knowledgeable and entertaining and most importantly genuinely loving NY and it’s history. Highly recommend! Worth every penny. BTW the views from the cruise can not be compared to the view from Staten Island Ferry. The cruise comes closer to the statue and the islands and goes under the Brooklyn bridge, which Ferry doesn’t do. We made a couple of stops and walked around, everything was timed so perfectly and was highly informative, in the 6 hours I learned a lot about the City. Taylor gave us many tips regarding things to do and places to visit. We laughed a lot and were all hugging the guide at the end. I’m so glad we’ve taken this tour instead of Hop on hip off bus!
