Had a great time seeing all the sights of New York. We stopped for just enough time to see the sight and take photos. Neil gave a brilliant commentary which was informative and enjoyable. He was a very friendly helpful and knowledgable guide. Roy the driver made the journey comfortable and was also friendly.
What a wonderful introduction to New York. We thoroughly enjoyed our tour with Gil and his excellent driver Anthony. Gil was so informative, friendly and professional providing an exceptional tour!

Great tour with guide Tim and driver Tony. Saw everything as promised and then some.
Very knowledgeable guide and safe driver who navigated the traffic with ease. Tony snapped photos of clients which was really nice and appreciated. Only slight negative was lunch stop. I think there must be better choices in NYC but also realize a need for fast eats to keep tour on time.

This tour provides an excellent snapshop of NYC. Researched online & booked it for my family of 5 persons. The rating here says it all. I have a combo offer from their website. DC tour to follow. Hoping it goes as good as the NYC one!

A top notch tour conducted by top notch folks and well worth every penny of its cost. Our guide was Neal and our driver was Jose, who effortlessly and safely navigated us through NYC's abominable traffic with aplomb. Neal, however, was the real star. His knowledge of NYC, both historic and present day, is encyclopedic and is delivered in a timely and entertaining manner. Wherever we were he conjured something entertaining, informative, educational and perhaps even humorous to impart. He was phenomenal and made the tour fun and informational and made our six hours or so with him seem to pass quickly.

Generally it was good,but our your guide talked too much. We could have actually done more sightseeing except he would get us off the bus and talk quite a bit then give us 10 mins to walk around. You couldn't see out of the front of the bus either. We always do one tours,but found this one to be sub par.

First time NYC visitors, our tour guide Niels was super informative and gave us many tips to enjoy our trip till the fullest, He managed the time very well even when we were trapped in NY traffic jam.
Also big up to Roy our driver who was very professional.
Great tour for any age. We took our two teenagers and they really enjoyed it as well. Well worth your time and money. Tour guide Jay is fabulous!

This was an awesome experience for our first time in NYC. Tyler was awesome. She was so knowledgeable and really gave us a fantastic tour. We loved that we got to get out and grab pictures of certain areas. Well worth the money and the time. Would do it again in a heart beat!!!

I thought I has seen the city--but after this tour, I realized how much I had missed. Rachel was our guide and was amazing! Very informative and provided great information and tips--entertaining as well! After this tour, we were able to set out on 2 more days of adventure and know what we wanted to see and were confident to even use the subway.
Anthony was our driver and did a great job--never had to wait for him once we finished touring an area.
Thanks so much for a great experience!

We had Tyler as our guide & Anthony as our driver and they were wonderful. The weather was beautiful but chilly so we were able to get out of the bus and walk some. We enjoyed our tour guide who was so informative & funny. She is a local and loves New York so it was easy to fall in love with New York. She was so informative with history and dates (which my daughter and I love) She showed us the 'secret' 'whispering wall' in Grand Central Terminal and we thought that was amazing. We are so thankful that Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis did so much to save the historical buildings. We loved understanding the streets of New York! We had a delicious lunch at a fresh market and Tyler also helped us with being able to get our tickets for a show for Broadway that night . We just cannot say enough nice things about this special lady! Highly recommend this tour!

This tour was a great intro to the city and helped us plan out the rest of our trip. Our tour guide Tyler was amazing! From start to finish she provided an insane amount of information in a way that was easy to understand and remember.

My 20 year old daughter and I were on this trip.I deliberately booked this tour for the first day of our stay as I thought it would be a good idea to see the whole of the city albeit brief so that it gave us an indication of what NYC had to offer. Sooo glad I did! Tim our guide was fantastic and made everything so interesting and Roy our driver was very safe! An excellent way to see city as walking bits are short and not arduous. We then picked the sights we wanted to revisit in detail. Excellent value and loads of ground covered. Tim - you’re a star!

The best day you can have - in one day - so many wonderful sights and sounds. Our guide Tim was so knowledgeable and respectful of our time. He made the day fabulous. We saw so many things we had wanted to see. Thought we would just drive by most of it but we were able to get out and get up close to the sites. Such a memorable day.

If you have a short stay in New York then this is the tour for you. It takes you all over Manhattan and stops at various points for you to get off and have a wander. Tyler was our tour guide and she was very knowledgeable and funny. Highly recommend.

Our tour guide was a born and raised new Yorker and did just a great job explaining the culture of the city to us. We hit all the key points and places, and it was just amazing. I would absolutely suggest that anyone visiting New York take this tour!
My husband and I spent the day with Neal and Johnny and they did a fantastic job getting us around the city and showing us all the sites! I highly recommend this tour! 😊

Absolutely fantastic. Well organised, comfortable transport and the tour guide ‘Gil’ was awesome (and his driver Ervis). Gil is a very knowledgeable guy, passionate about his city, very humorous and most of all, ultra enthusiastic (considering he does it daily). You can fire questions at him, he will give you recommendations and he was so caring of the older members of the group. You stop for lunch in the Fulton market area and can choose from pizzas, hotdogs to buffet style chinese food. You cram so much of NY in within 6-7 hours, I only wish I had took the tour at the beginning of my trip so I could visit all the different districts and points of interest he showed us. I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting NY who wants to see what else NY has to offer apart from the bright lights of Times Square. I have been to NY once before but had no real idea what was beyond ‘midtown’. I do know and have a huge list to tick off next time I’m there.

Let's start with, this tour exceeded our expectations. This tour is great if you want to cover a lot in a short period of time. My husband and I were only in town for 1 1/2 days so we selected this tour to enjoy a broad overview of what NYC has to offer. The reason the tour exceeded our expectations was due to the tour guide (Gil) and the driver (Arliss). Gil is a walking/talking encyclopedia and Arliss is adept as navigating the crazy pre-XMAS holiday traffic on what turned out to be a beautiful late December day in NYC. It crazy to think you can see as much as we did in a six hour period (the Tree and skating at Rockefeller, Strawberry Fields part (John Lennon park) in Central Park, 9/11 memorial, boat ride past the Brooklyn bridge, Statue of Liberty, Ellis Island and etc) - just a great tour made greater by an awesome tour guide.

I took this tour on 12/20 with my two teenage sons. Our tour guide was Tyler and she was fantastic. She was friendly, energetic and had a great knowledge of the area. All three of us really enjoyed it. It was a great overview of the area and we ended going back to a few of the sights to spend more time on our own later in the trip. I would definitely recommend this tour.

Hubby and I had the pleasure to go on this tour. I will say that if you have limited time & knowledge of the amazing New York City, then use this tour to introduce you. We thoroughly enjoyed our tour guide, Jack. It is evident that he really enjoys his job and he is so knowledgeable. I walked away totally intrigued with NYC. Hubby and I are already planning future visits. And I must also mention how accommodating USA Tours were to us. I mistakenly booked our tour for the wrong day. I was so afraid that we were going to forfeit our fee. But graciously they worked with us to allow us to take the tour. As well, they dropped us off near our the NY Ferry -- in stead of the normal drop off. We are so thankful & cant say enough great things about this tour. Highly recommend..!!

Our tour guide was Rhonda and she did an incredible job showing us around New York! Definitely worth going during the first day of your trip so that you know where to go back and visit. The best part of the tour (in my opinion) was the boat ride. If you're going on a weekday, it's definitely less crowded around town.

Our tour guide Gil was absolutely amazing! He showed us everything you could possibly see and learn about NYC in a day! Gil is full of information about the city and we learned so much. We wouldn't of been able to see the whole city without this tour! Gil offered us other suggestions to do during our visit and gave us cheap ways to see a Broadway show and enter museums. I 100% recommend this tour- best way to see the city! Gil gave great photo op's and also took the time to get great pictures of everyone on the tour. It's a fast paced tour, but you see everything. Gil and Gary were a great pair.

This was such a good tour and a great way to orient ourselves in NYC. Tyler our guide was amazing and driver excellent too. There is no comparison between this and the various on-off-bus tours so don’t waste your time or money on those.
As we only had 3 days in New York this tour was excellent as we got to see so much more than we would have done on our own!

This was the perfect way to see NYC in a day. Our guide (Tim) was very knowledgeable and had a perfect balance of facts, gossip and humour! He looked after the group very well, ensuring we got the best views and all the photographs we wanted. He made each one of us feel like family, and Tim seemed well liked and respected by other guides we encountered. Tour was fantastic and I really cant recommend it (and Tim!) highly enough!

We enjoyed the One Day Tour of New York and recommend this tour to anyone with limited time for site seeing. We found the tour guide J a bit brash and noisy at times, but he is a great personality and his knowledge of New York is amazing. His commentary was very informative and he was very helpful. Overall very good value.

i‘ve been to NYC several times, this time with my teenager daughters. I wanted them to have a good insight of the city. Out tour guide Rachel did an excellent job. Informative, convenient being driven around with a small bus. Great value for your money.

This was an excellent one day tour of NYC. Our guide Debbie done a fantastic job. She is full of knowledge about the city and the sites that we visited. She also gives great advise on how to save money in the city and great recommendations for restaurants. Our driver Gary done a great job negotiating the traffic and getting us to each stop on time. Thank you guys for a great time.
great way to start our trip to N.Y. Including lots of sites and trip on boat to see statue of liberty. Great tour guide..

After never visiting New York before, I wanted to get the most out of the first day of being in a new and big city so thought a guided tour would be the best way. The busses arrived promptly at the meeting point which is very easy to find.
The tour itself packed so much sight seeing in but you never felt rushed. Rachel was our tour guide and she had excellent knowledge of the city and guided us round all the worst traffic to get to our destinations on time. Raymond was the driver who drove safely around the busy streets, picking us up in all sorts of places!
I would highly recommend this tour for the price and the sheer amount you got to see. Central Park,rockerfeller Center, Statue of Liberty. It would be far to much to see on your own.
There was a bit of walking but not an excessive amount and it was nice to stretch your legs from the bus.

This was not what I expected (in a good way). Tour guide J took good care of us and explained every block in New York in detail also, he was extremely funny and had me laughing the whole time. He will come for everyone on the bus so be prepared. He made the whole tour interesting and I was never bored at all. Totally recommended. Also the lunch options were really good as there was a huge buffet in a supermarket with Halal, Kosher and vegetarian options and if you don’t feel like it, there is a McDonald’s, a pizza shop and a hot dog shop (both run by Muslims so Halal is guaranteed too).

This tour really covers a lot of territory. Our tour guide, Rachel, was excellent. She gave us some insider hints that really helped us for the rest of our stay in New York. The tour covers a lot of sites and made us feel at home after the tour. Make sure to dress with comfortable shoes and coats and/or rain gear if needed as there is more walking on this tour then I thought there would be.

Let me start off by saying I've been to New York several times in the past and have taken many tours through the city. This tour is by far the best one and most comprehensive I've taken yet. Our tour guide Rachel was very informative and quite comical. She teaches you about the history, the culture, and the way of life in the city, as well as many other things about the city. The pace of the tour is very quick to ensure that it stays on schedule so make sure to keep up. My only advice for the next tourists is to make sure to get seats ASAP on the boat ride to the Statue of Liberty because the good ones go fast! All in all, it was a great tour full of important information about the city and some good laughs.

Rachel was an awesome tour guide. I would have guessed she's a native New Yorker, but she has just really studied up & knows her stuff. I learned SO much about NYC; not just the sites, but how use transportation, shop, where to eat, and how to not get scammed while exploring the city. There's no way I could have learned so much about the city in the one day of tour time I had. I wasn't as fond of the boat tour guide, but it was still well worth the money since Rachel was so awesome. Oh, & she has great stories & a sense of humor!

This tour was a great introduction to New York City. We planned it for our first day in the city so that we could get a good overview, and then decide what other things we wanted to see more of during the rest of our stay. This tour was perfect for that. Our tour guide, Gil, was very knowledgeable about the city, it’s history, and the various sites we were seeing. He also had a great sense of humor, and kept the small group engaged throughout the tour. Our driver, Tony, was excellent, handling the NYC traffic smoothly and safely. The mini-bus was definitely the way to go! Gil was able to know something about each of the people on the tour, and he tied this into the commentary throughout the tour; and it was definitely easier to round up everyone after each of the stops. The boat portion of the tour was a great change from being on the bus, and so nice to be on the water, seeing the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island close up, and the beautiful skyline from a distance. The only downside of being on a bus in a city of skyscrapers is that it’s sometimes hard to see the tops of the buildings from inside the bus. But that’s part of being in a big city in a closed in bus. We decided that being on a small tour with a guide that gave very personal service was worth the trade off. Highly recommended USA Guided Tours New York. Gil as tour guide and Tony as driver were fabulous!

Had one day to enjoy the sights of New York City so engaged this tour. Our guide Gil and our driver were so entertaining. If you are a history or music or movie/theater nut, this tour is for you. Gil was a great host and guide with no down time between sites as is sometimes the case. Our driver navigated NYC with ease. His vast knowledge of the history of the city and its cultural venues made the day very worthwhile and the conversation flowing. This 6-7 hour tour allowed us to view highlights of the city with the idea that upon future returns we can focus on our areas of interest.

The travel bus was clean and pick up/drop off site was easily accessed from our hotel, We did have various stops allowing us a short walk in Central Park and at other locations. Would highly recommend this tour especially if Gil and team are your guides for the day.

We did this tour early to get a feel for the city. Our guide “J” was knowledgeable and entertaining. “J” had some handy hints for first timers to NYC ably assisted by driver Arless. Would highly recommend taking this tour!
We wanted to see as much as possible from NY because of our short stay and we couldn’t ask for a better tour for a day!

The tour gave us a great overview of mid to lower Manhatten. Our guide J had a wealth of information spiced with humour. The tour was well organized and moved along at a good pace. Unfortunately we missed many of the beautiful buildings we were driving by as the bus was not the right type in my opinion. It should have had higher windows or even a glass ceiling so that we could adequately see the scenery. The boat tour topped it off by giving us a great view of Manhatten and Miss Liberty. I would recommend this trip to anyone who is experiencing NY for the first time/

This bus/boat tour was a terrific introduction to NYC. Our tour guide, Tyler, was a storehouse of information: minutia and important. The bus route took us by and/or to all the sites listed in the ads. Our taste of New York was a good beginning point from which to then choose what we wanted to explore in more detail another day. Anthony, our driver, navigated the traffic like the expert he is.
Since there were two small buses during our scheduled tour time, the company made a good effort to vary each route. There was never a huge group of us blocking the sidewalks, walking in Central Park, or trying to get a glimpse of this or that.
Tyler, as a native New Yorker, knew her history and presented it in an interesting, if not quirky way. Her sense of humor was that of a true City girl. I loved it! She also answered our questions as to the best pizza in Little Italy, the local spot for sushi or the best night life areas. Her tips on getting around the City were right on. It was her love of the City that made this tour!
The boat portion of the trip was also excellent. The boat was comfortable and clean. The guide gave us pertinent details of the sites. He answered questions when asked. I wish we had been able to have a closer view of Ellis Island.
My only improvement suggestion would be regarding the bus.....the company should invest in newer models with a full view front windshield so that the passengers can get as complete a view of the buildings, statues and neighborhoods as possible.
I would definitely recommend this tour to others.
Excellent & informative tour....plenty of time to get a feel for NYC & allow you to choose where you’d like to hear back to!

Tour Guide J gave a wonderful guided tour experience when I used his service for a day tour in NYC last week. He is service-minded and kept us all alerted with interesting facts and tidbits about New York City even in some little corners of the town. His sense of humor kept us all laughing and alerted. He offered to take photos to his customers. All in all, a wonderful experience and worth every cent!

This tour was amazing. I had my 78 year old mother with me as well as teenagers and there was something for everyone. Tim was very accommodating and entertaining. I learned a lot about NYC. Highly recommend!

Our tour guide Tim was the best. One of the best ways to see New York in one day. Now we know what to go see if we go back. We told as many people as we could, to go on the tour if they go and visit New York. We visited New York a day before we got on a cruise ship. Thank you again Tim for giving us one of the best times on our trip.

This was an awesome tour and we couldn’t have asked for a better guide. Tyler was very knowledgeable and had a great sense of humor. She gave us a lot of insight, history, and tips for the hot spots to visit or places to eat.

Great sightseeing tour with a great guide what that man knew about New York was amazing well worth the money.Their was only one fault and that was the weather torrential rain all day but can do nothing about that.well worth the money we had a great time.
Its about a 6 tour hours so keep that in mind when booking but well worth it ...Jay and Roy were great together !

I've been on this tour twice, once with Gil and once with Tony, it is the most comprehensive and fun tour in New York. Gil and Tony were excellent tour guides, informative, entertaining and funny! This is a must for your trip to NYC! Thank you Tony and Gil!

Rachel was absolutely the BEST tour guide I’ve ever had! She kept a large group of us (30) moving along at a steady, energetic pace with enthusiasm, knowledge, insights, and a smile all day, despite a 90* and humid day. Gary, our driver, managed significantly busy traffic smoothly and safely, in his large, comfortable “bus”. I highly recommend this tour for anyone with a day to spend in NYC. Great for getting to know the city and how to get around.

This tour gives you the highlights of the city. Tour guide was awesome and full of history and knowledge of all areas! It was nice to get off the shuttle and walk into the streets, have someone guide you along the way and to experience the highlights of NYC. The boat ride is included and prearranged, so there is not waiting in line. Everything went like clock work! There is time for lunch and multiple places along the one street to choose from. Plenty of time and places for picture taking, and our guide offered numerous times to take our picture in front of the sight we were touring (and he took excellent photos too) !!! I highly recommend this tour vs some of the others offered.

A fantastic trip around NYC with our tour guide Mike and driver Gabby. This was one of the highlights of our week long stay - we can't recommend this enough. Mike was so knowledgeable and was always on hand to snap photos of us in the best locations. The tour bus covers all of the city and the ferry trip at the end is as an added bonus. We learnt more in one day than we could have achieved on our own. This tour is suitable for anyone looking to see all of the key sites in one day without the walking boots.
It was wonderful we seen way more than we even thought we would. Glen was fantastic and the pizza at Adriennes is an absolute must!!

Loved this tour as you got to take a bus, do some walking, and go on a boat around the Hudson and liberty. But Jay the tourguide made a big difference as he can be so funny but yet interesting to tell the tales of NYC and what went on there.

This was a great way to see New York city in a single day. The tour was well organized to get everyone assigned to a bus and on their way from the pickup site on time. Our guide Tyler was great and she had a wonderful perspective on the sites and the people of the area. The stops on the tour were well timed to give you some time to see the 9/11 memorial and a little of Central Park. The Boat tour leaves a little to be desired after having such a great guide on the bus. The sites from the boat are great but the narration not so good.

Arrived in New York late the previous evening so hadn't had a chance to plan my day yet. Booked a tour over breakfast an hour or so beforehand. Very glad I did, as it was a great way to get your bearings for the city. Tour guide J was a great host, very knowledgeable and entertaining. I would recommend anyone doing this tour rather than a hop on hop off type tour, hopefully I will be able to do the night tour also before I leave town.

There is no doubt that searching for the right bus tour in NYC is overhearing, but this is the best!

We saw all of the most popular sights in NYC in the comfort of an air conditioned bus (there is some walking and boat tour).

Our guide, Jack, was knowledgeable about the city and even offered up some restaurant recommendations.

There is complimentary water on the bus.

The tour includes the boat tour, which was one of my favorite stops.

Highly recommend!!!

Our three daughters and my husband and I toured with Tyler on August 4th. We have traveled the world and have been on numerous tours but I can truthfully say Tyler was one of the best guides ever. She was curious to all and had a wealth of knowledge that she shared with all of us. We started the day in pouring rain and ended it in bright sunshine. It was a day we will long remember. Thank you, Tyler!

Being a first time visitor this tour was just what I needed to get started in this wonderful city. Tyler, our guide, was very knowledgeable and provided an impressive mix of history and insider tips for all the sights worth visiting. Anthony, our driver, managed to get us around the city safely and comfortably in a very nice and clean bus. The stops we made allowed to get some better pictures and closer looks at some of the highlight sights. Highly recommending this tour!

The tour was very concise and fast-paced. We didn't really have time to stop for photos at the attractions but we sure got to see the most visited landmarks and tourist spots of the city.
Jim, our guide was very knowlegeable and was truly a hardworker. Thank you for a wonderful experience :)

Thank you to Gil our tour guide and Raymond our driver! Gil was amazing what he doesn’t know about New York isn’t worth knowing! As a first time visitor to NY this iwas a great way to learn about the city and to get your bearings, as well as really useful tips as to what to see, who to avoid and places to eat. Thank you both again for a brilliant day out,

This is a method we use to visit various cities around the world. We take a tour around and repeat it to get off at places of interest. We took the Big Bus tour which took us to all the 'must see' areas of New York. The Tour Guides were well informed and filled us in to interesting facts about various sites and personalities who lived in the city.
Excellent way to begin a holiday in New York! Great overview of all the highlights. Bus was comfortable and cool on a hot day.

Tyler was awesome - welcoming from the moment we met her, This whistle stop tour was about 6.5 hours and covered lots of the main attractions. Great lunch stop and a trip on the East River to see NY's main lady...

My one tip would be DO this tour if you've not been to NY before and if you are lucky enough to get Tyler then you've really got the jackpot!

Our guide Gil was wonderful. On an extremely hot day, he never lost his cool. He gave an informative, entertaining and educational narrative. Our driver Tony was quite impressive with the way he maneuvered through traffic and corner turns. I would definitely recommend this tour to others.

I was here for just a couple days for work, but since I’ve never been to NYC, I wanted to see all I could. This tour did that! J was an awesome tour guide! Extremely knowledgeable, funny, and you could tell he cared about his tourists (I was solo, but always felt comfortable). I got to see all the main sites I wanted (Times Square, Central Park, Rockefeller Center, Empire State Building, Madison Square Garden, historic buildings and churches, 9/11 Memorial, and a boat tour around to see the skyline, bridges, and Statue of Liberty). Plenty of time for lunch (with a variety of choices) and a couple bathroom breaks. This smaller tour lended itself for more personalized attention. And Gio, the driver, was excellent as well! If you are a first time visitor, I’d highly recommend this tour. If you’ve been here before, I’d recommend a hop on/hop off tour so you can spend more time where you want (we had to stick to a schedule to be done in time; tour was roughly 10am-4pm). Thanks, J! 😊

Big city experience that is unparalleled in the USA. So many must see places, 9-11 Memoriable, Stock Exchange (take a selfie with the Bull), Brooklyn Bridge, Statue of Liberty tour, China Town, and on and on.

My husband and I visited NYC for our 10 year anniversary. Since we were short on time this tour was perfect! True to it’s name, you will see all the main sites of this wonderful city. Our guide, Tyler, was fantastic! She was very charismatic and exceptionally knowledgeable about each site we visited. She also educated us on the layout of the city and gave some great recommendations on places to eat - the cheesecake at Junior’s was the best we’ve ever had! We loved this tour and hope to get Tyler again when we come back!

Brilliant way to New York in a 6 hour tour. Gil, our tour guide was a great character and really made the tour a pleasure. His enthusiasm, infectious knowledge of the city and friendly manner was much appreciated by our group and he even made Manhattan traffic jams seem interesting while he never allowed delays to compromise the tour itinerary.
A great tour, wonderful value, 5 stars.
Martin Walsh, Galway, Ireland June 2018

We visited from Houston, Texas and took this tour on May 30. Tour guide Tim Douglas and driver John skillfully covered the top sights of Manhattan (with more obscure sights of interest pointed out along the way) skillfully and efficiently. Tim is personable and charismatic, and peppered the city history and statistics with hilarious personal anecdotes. It was a very enjoyable and busy-but-mostly-unrushed 6 hour total tour.

We weren't too thrilled with the food selection for lunch, but others didn't seem to mind, and that's hardly a fault of the tour company.

The boat portion of the tour was our only complaint because frankly, it wasn't up to par with the excellence we had grown used to from Tim. The boat was overcrowded and the captain's attempts at humor seemed desperate. I am not an overly sensitive person, but comments like "I'll speak slowly so even those who aren't so bright can understand" and "you weren't allowed to get off on Ellis Island if there was something wrong with you" are not funny and seem to me to be very insensitive, especially in today's hyper-charged atmosphere of political correctness. We couldn't hear most of the captain's monolog and no one seemed to know whose right and left he was referencing to point out the sights. The whole ride was just crowded and confused. The topper was the captain's gratuitous begging for tips; we waited while he left the boat first so he could align himself at the end of the exit plank with an extended bucket so that every patron had to pass by him. We tipped out of guilt, which was his intention, and I immediately wished I had it back. Just yuck.

Tim and John, however, more than earned a generous tip. They gave our tour their all and I can't recommend them enough.
The tour included way more than I expected. I bought our tickets on Groupon, so even a better value. Tim was very knowledgeable about the city and he also spoke loudly so everyone could hear.

Went with tour guide J. Had a good time. He explained a lot about the various sites that we would have missed out on otherwise. Took time to answer questions. The boat ride to see the statue of liberty, Manhattan skyline, Governor's Island, etc. was also a lot of fun. Many photo opportunities. Our 8 year old was a little bored.
Tour Guide J is the best tour guide ever. He has exceptional knowledge, entertaining stories and he is attuned to the group.

A great tour which showed us the highlights of New York, we ran out of time at the end and only had ten minutes to ourselves at the twin towers which was incredibly disappointing but the rest of the day was terrific.
Really enjoyed the tour and Gil is a great host. Highly recommend. Wear great walking shoes - this tour moves fast.

Great tour to do on our second day to get an idea where to go after seeing a large portion of Manhattan . Gil was our guide and Sharon our driver .Gil was great , knew what to point out and how to say it !
Tried some of his restaurant suggestions and he didn't miss on those . Had an early issue with AC on the bus but it worked itself out and the driver parked in the shade when we were off-smart.
Thanks from Houston !
Very well organized, good guide very dynamic, plenty of things to see, sometimes too short but very complete

This trip is amazing. My tour guide Tim is very knowledgeable, helpful and friendly. It is my first time in New York. As I am on a work trip, I only have a day for tour and I managed to see most of New York, all thanks to this trip. Tim even recommended some of the places to eat which i tried and I love them (e.g. Shake Shack, Magnolia Bakery). I highly recommend this tour, you wouldn't regret.

Rachel our tour guide was very knowledgable, friendly, and so much fun.
We really enjoy the trip, I really recommend it.

A flying trip of the highlights of New York. Great job by J - a great tour guide full of local knowledge, friendly and passionate about the subjects.
Geo great feeling safe in the hands of a capable driver - friendly, timely and always offering a bottle of water on warm days

Highly recommended!
Tour guide Jay was amazing!! He was funny and entertaining but most of all knowledgeable! My mom and I had a great time and definitely recommend doing while in New York!

Really impressed with the tour. We were gonna do the basic hop-on/hop-off double-decker bus tours, but this was definitely worth the extra money. It's part bus-tour, part walking-tour, and part boat-tour.

Guide: Tim was engaging, knowledgeable and a typical New Yorker. Had many funny and entertaining stories. Perfect for this tour. He was always there to take pics and knew the best spots and angles to take them.

Bus Tour: Took us all around Manhattan in a small shuttle-type bus. Did not go into other burroughs, like Brooklyn or The Bronx, but included loads of big-name sights within Manhattan. Tim was constantly letting us know what we were seeing, including stories and history.

Walking Tour: Several stops where Tim led our group on walking tours through various areas to give us better detail and got some great pics. Especially loved the long-stop at the World Trade Center and 911 Memorial, where Tim was amazing at describing all kinds of interesting design details and history that we never would have known by just visiting on our own.

Boat Tour: Takes you under the Brooklyn Bridge, past Ellis Island, and around Liberty Island. Tim was always available to take pics of any of our group as well as answer additional questions. Boat tour is with Hornblower who also do cruises where we're from in San Diego. Note that boat tour doesn't run in the winter -- I think USA takes you to Grand Central instead from Nov-Mar.

All in all, a fantastic tour, which has a little of everything. Highly recommend it.

Very informative tour and a great insight into New York. Gil our tour guide was very friendly and knowledgeable, always available to answer any questions. Plus our driver Giovanni was very helpful.
An Awesome tour that I highly recommend to anyone visiting New York.

Very informative tour, Gil was extremely knowledgeable about New York’s highlights and even took the time to take pictures for us. I particularly enjoyed the Central Park tour. Giovanni was a great driver also. I will definitely recommend this to anyone.
Great tour! Gil our guide was very informative and rally showcased many of New York's highlights. Grand Central Station stop was lovely!

I've done the Grayline on two prior trips but decided to try this for my niece's first time. I really liked it. We saw many sights and learned a lot of facts. The guide kept things moving and entertaining. He made the group feel at ease and was a lot of fun. I saw things I'd never seen on my other two trips to NYC. I also learned some really interesting facts. I love to take pictures and our guide would recommend pictures. He would also take pictures of us. My daughter and niece sat next to each and I had to sit in the aisle. I was going crazy to be taking pictures you can't get from he aisle. The two things I didn't care for were the lunch stop - thought it was too long and limited seating. Too cold to be outside. The next would be I'd keep the political jokes out. I can really only remember one, but considering it would offend half the population I wouldn't do it. However, I would recommend this tour as a good way to see and learn about NYC. In my third visit to some places, I learned new things.

First of all, we were a little late for the tour and, although they did wait around a few minutes for us, we still didn’t make it in time. New York traffic is NO JOKE! When we arrived at the pickup location, I called thinking we would just have to forgo the tour, but they gave us a nearby location where they could pick us up. The tour driver, we didn’t catch his name, picked us up and took us to where the tour was and even walked with us for a minute to make sure we knew where we were going. When we met our tour guide, Tyler, she welcomed us to the tour like we’d been there all along! She was a plethora of knowledge and her enthusiasm and apparent love for the city was evident throughout the entire tour and even when we had to take a slight detour, she was right there throwing out various bits of information. As first timers to New York, she even provided tips and tricks from souvenir shopping to navigating the subway. Obviously we haven’t done other tours but I can’t imagine they would be as good as this one!

My husband and I went on the USA Guided Tour with Tyler, an extremely knowledgealbe, enthusiastic, and experienced guide. We were so lucky to get her! Our tour highlighted the different neighborhoods of Manhatten. The tour group was small, 9 people, and we were encouraged to ask questions. Tyler gave us an historical overview of the areas in addition to telling us all about speicifc points of interest such as Grand Central Terminal, Strawberry Fields, and others. She was able to tailor the tour to our interests, within limits of course. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting New York!

A truly great day. Very informative and interesting and you get to see virtually all of New York. Anthony our driver drove incredibly well and Gil our guide was fantastic. So knowledgeable and gave us a great day. Small group which made it more personable and a very pleasurable day. Would thoroughly recommend doing this tour.

Driver was Gio,
tour guide: J

Awesome tour even on a rainy day. J was so knowledgeable and answer of of the groups questions. He kept us laughing and loved how he mentioned movies that were filmed in different spots! Would def recommend. My favorite place was grand central station! What a beautiful building.

Was in New York for the Westminster dog show, did not have much time so booked this tour to get a sense of the city as first time visitors. The bus was comfortable and afforded good views, Mike who was our guide that day was Excellent! His knowledge and personal insight into the city was very good. He walked us around some of the attractions and gave us lots of history behind them. Geo our driver was also very good, the two of them made a great team! Would recommend this tour for anyone wanting to hit most of the sights and get the history at the same time.

My husband and two teenage boys thoroughly enjoyed this trip with Mike and Geo yesterday. Mike spoke with real knowledge and pride about NY and shared some of his life experiences as he grew up in New York which was interesting and humourous, Geo was a very corteous driver and gave us complimentary water and capes when it was pouring with rain. It was well worth the money and we would recommend anyone wanting to gain an insight into the history of New York as well as useful tips on places to visit,

We did the day and night tours with USA guided tours New York, and both were excellant. The guides were helpful, knowledgable, and very accommodating to the needs and wishes of all their guests. The tours were somewhat customised and appropriate for the weather, which was extremely cold on the day of our tours. It was not just a job for both the guide and the driver, and we found that their passion for NYC was contageous.
Bernice was out guide and Anthony was the driver. Bernice was very knowledgeable. Tours can be boring for young children but mine loved her! I can’t say enough about this tour.

What a wonderful way to spend 6 hours in NYC and see most of the major attractions in relative comfort. Gil was an excellent tour guide, offering endless information about all the attractions and useful insider tips about places to eat and the best and/or cheapest ways to get back to the attractions we wanted to visit after the tour. Anthony did a great job navigating NYC traffic. This is a perfect way to orient yourself if you're a new visitor to NYC. I also have to mention that the person checking everybody in for the tour was excellent (apologies for not remembering your name). He went out of his way to phone when we were a few minutes late for the tour, and even walked us across to the first stop so we could rejoin the tour there.

My mum and I visited NYC in December 2017 and have not stopped talking about thus your since! We were lucky enough to have Gil who was full of knowledge and told us things that had we visited all of the sights alone, we would not have known or noticed. I loved hearing about the history of the city, who'd lived where, about the artists, writers, activists and musicians that have shaped the city and getting up close to all of the places I wanted to see in just 6 hours!

It's a great way to tick everything off, get your bearings and work out where you want to revisit in more detail and saves so much time!

I have recommended to everyone I know is planning on visiting the city as I feel they would be missing out if they didn't do this fabulous tour.

Thsnks Gil!

I scheduled the tour for the first day of our trip so that we could see all of the sights and then decide which places we wanted to go back and spend more time at. It was an excellent idea and I highly recommend! Gil was our guide and he was absolutely amazing! I tell everyone he was a human Wikipedia!! He never stopped talking for the entire six hour tour and was so informative and interesting! I was able to take lots of pictures as we were traveling slowly in the bus and at the 3 or 4 places we got off. The boat ride out to the Statue of Liberty was very cool also!!

Absolutely the best way to see NYC if you're short on time! The tour takes in all the major sights and our tour guide Gil was so knowledgeable. He was also witty and very approachable. A thoroughly enjoyable day and would highly recommend it!

Whilst the start to the tour was a little confusing, they put us on the second bus and then told us to get off and come back to the first bus, on the whole we had a great time. I don't remember the name of our driver, sorry, but the guide was Tyler and she was amazing. She made our tour so much fun. She was funny, excited, oozed enthusiasm, full of facts and knowledge, her energy was very contagious. I would book with her again in a heartbeat! She told us where to go to eat like the locals which was extremely helpful and way cheaper! I would thoroughly recommend this tour for first time visitors to New York.

Absolutely amazing day, funny, informative and covered loads. Would highly recommend this tour and catered well for both kids and adults. Gil was our tour guide and Roy our driver. I’m not sure we’ve ever met anyone with so much knowledge before. Brilliant. Ireland ☺️

This was an awesome tour. Our tour guide Tyler was funny and very knowledgeable and made the experience a pleasure. We learned so much about the landscape and history of NYC. The van was comfortable and warm (it was very cold outside). I highly recommend this tour to anyone coming from near and far. You will not be disappointed!

This was my first trip to NYC and was a bit hesitant to get committed to a day on a bus. However, the bus makes frequent stops and allows just enough time to see everything, without feeling confined or rushed. Our guide, Tyler, was phenomenal. She was so knowledgeable and her sense of humor made the day that much more enjoyable. Would definitely recommend for all ages. Thank you Tyler & driver, Washington, for making my first trip to the city unforgettable!

We LOVED this tour. It was an amazing way to see most of Manhattan in one day - we hit a ton of major landmarks in NYC. Our tour guide J, was fun and informative. He told lots of jokes, gave us historical and pop culture facts (he was extremely knowledgeable), knew the perfect spots to take pictures, gave us some great tips, and more. We really enjoyed spending time with him and the other participants on this tour. There was about 20 of us, which was a perfect size! Would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting NYC - it was worth every penny.

Hubby and I had the pleasure of going on this 6-7 hour tour with Rachel as our guide. She was superb. She gave us a written sheet of websites, lists of restaurant recommendations as well as savvy advice as to how to avoid scams and how to negotiate the subways, places to go, etc. Meanwhile she mixed in history, humor, little known facts. She clearly had done her homework and loves NYC. She kept the group of about 25 moving so we could be on time for our boat ride out to see Lady Liberty, Ellis Island, and the gorgeous skyline. It was a fabulous day and our comfortable van was driven so very well by Tony. We had a great mix of seeing some things from the bus but also getting out several times to get photos and see some of the major places up close and personal. I can’t over do my recommendation for this tour and company. Yea Rachel!

First off our guide Tim was awesome! He took the time to answer all questions.
He made the tour fun and educational. If you have never visited New York or are thinking about
a tour, this is it. This should be first thing you do! You will get a good overview of New York and Tim pointed out several restaurants and other "to do's". Again do this tour your first day, this will
give you time to experience some of the extra things they point out on tour. I did say do this first,
right?

As a first time visitor with only 2 days in NYC, I'm so glad that we took this tour. Guide, Tim D. and driver Gio were fantastic and did all the work, leaving us free to enjoy the sights snd sounds of their great city. Thanks, guys!

We took this tour on our first day. It was a great overview of the city and by the second day on our own, we knew our way around and felt comfortable navigating the city. The tour also showed us places we didn’t know we wanted to see and places to go back to while in the neighborhood. I can’t say enough good things about Gil our guide and Anthony our driver. Gil was very passionate about the city, full of knowledge, funny and all the while keeping track and caring about each and every passenger. Anthony navigated the city with ease especially in the traffic. Highly recommend to both newbies to the city and even those who live here would learn more about their city.

This is me and my wife’s first time to NYC. We thought a good way to see the sights of the city was to do a tour instead of trying to just search on our own. We couldn’t have been happier with our choice! The bus was punctual, my only recommendation is they have some sort of signage as to where to meet. Our guide Gil was personable, well spoken and very entertaining. There was no “dead air”during this tour! He was full of facts, stats, humorous stories and just very knowledgeable of the city. You got the feeling Gil loves this city! Our driver Anthony was a saint while in traffic purgatory and never had us feeling nervous in the log jam that is NYC. All in all, probably the highlight of our trip so far.

We decided to spend our first day in NYC on this tour to give us a good overview of the city. Tyler was an excellent guide. She was enthusiastic and friendly and was able to share her knowledge in such an interesting way that the tour seemed to fly by. I was a little concerned that we would be spending hours on the bus but we got off regularly to look at things more closely and to take photos. I would recommend this tour to anyone on their first visit to the city.

This tour included all that we hoped to see during our visit to NYC. Gil, our guide, was extremely knowledgeable and fun, he made the tour!!! We highly recommend this tour and plan to share this experience with our West Coast travel agent so she can refer it to clients going to New York.

I am so pleased that I booked this tour for our first day in the city. Our guide (Gil) was fantastic. He seemed to know EVERYTHING about EVERYWHERE in New York City and it was absolutely fascinating. He made it fun - not at all dry - and even recommended good places for us to eat. Even though the tour lasted 5-6 hours it seemed to go very quickly and was very enjoyable. It gave us a real insight into the City and meant that we could plan our remaining days accordingly.

Tour guide J was awesome giving us so much information between stops. They efficiently get you from attraction to attraction with a lot of info about the city areas etc on the way. It was great because he gave advice on specific areas.....Hey J your info about chinatown was spot on. We even got that foot rub after the tour. We were only in Manhattan for 2 & 1/2 days so we got to see the major attractions efficiently. AND he lines you up for great photos and helps take a few so you can actually be in one or two......many compliments on my photos J! Thanks J!!

My husband and I booked this tour for 10/20/2017. Gil was our guide and Roy was the driver. We sawso many interesting places we could not have seen ourselves. Gil was so informative and keep us on schedule as much as possible with the traffic. Gave fantastic information about all the sights. The harbor cruise was amazing with seeing the Statue of Liberty up close. Gil even took our picture with the Empire State Building in the background which by the way turned out great. Our next trip to New York we are planning to do the night time tour. Great people.

Our guide was Mike and we found him knowledgeable and obviously loved his city. He also used humour which does help along with lots of facts and figures which he supplied. We felt this was better than the hop on hop off bus tour. A number of stops were made and the only down side, was that it was difficult to hear him at times. This was not his fault as the amount of traffic and other people talking. The tour was done at a leisurely pace. Our driver was Roy and I would not want his job having to negotiate the traffic of New York.

What an absolutely amazing tour we had today I would highly recommend Rachel as a tour guide is fantastic so knowledgable and nothing was too much trouble She gave us some fantastic tips and saved us loads of money Thank you so much 😊
Had a fantastic trip today with Rachel as our tour guide. Very, very knowledgeable on all aspects of living in NYC, past & present. Highly recommended.

New York Travelers,

I had the pleasure of taking the 1day tour with Mrs. Racheal. It was the "Best" decision I made to tour some of the top destinations in New York during my vacation. You will not be disappointed so please, please please book a tour on your next trip to New York.
Too rush! Wish the tour guide can pulse between each stop so that people have sufficient time to look and walk around Overall is good. Lots fun and learnt history of the New York City.

Really enjoyed this tour. Our tour guide, Brenden was knowledgeable and made the tour both interesting and fun. He also made sure that no one was left behind and all members were accounted for. This tour is a great value of the money and an excellent way to get a lay of the land and kick off a trip to the Manhattan area.
Nathan was a great guide. This tour is a great way to see some major sights if you’re short on time.
Rachel was our guide and Gustavo was our driver. They were both AMAZING! For only having one day in New York this tour was perfect! If we come back definitely trying the night tour.
I dont have a favorite part, I truly enjoyed the whole experience. Our guide Jim was entertaining and very informative. Totally recommend it!
Tyler is the best tour guide in the city! That woman sleeps, eats and breathes new york! I'm moving to NYC!
We are a pair of disabled. Little assistance to cope with our slow walking. Got separated from group and had to get an expensive raxi back to drop-off place.
Superb All Day Tour of the Big Apple. Informative, relaxed with a great itinerary taking in all of the places that will be remembered.
Very good, informative, pleasant guide with good sense of humor. Covered all areas of NY that everyone is interested in.

I had the best time ever! Tyler was an amazing guide. She made the history and culture in New York come alive for us with stories, TV trivia and tips on travel and food! She cued us on the time and places for the best shots! We came away with great photographs and memories! Highly recommended for quality and value!
Great overview of NYC. Alberto, our tour guide, was knowledgeable and friendly. Great way to see the highlights of New York City

Rachel is amazing, hands down the best tour guide in NYC! We saw everything on our list in one day!
Amazing!
The walk was delightful, informative, conversational, and a must for Gilded Age & architecture enthusiasts. A wealth of information was shared at a comfortable pace.
Our tour guide was outstanding. Well worth the $$$ and we learned so much! Definitely do this tour! You will see all the key place NY has to offer
Rachel was a fabulous tour guide! We learned so much about NYC, and how to navigate everything while staying here! Highly recommend you book her tour! Ask for Rachel.
Louis was fantastic. We were able to see all the NYC highlights in a safe and fun environment. Highly recommend.
Gil our tour guide was amazing, best I could have asked for. He was extremely knowledgeable of the city.

We have an awesome experience with Rachel as a tour guide! She's very knowledgeable, gives you a LOT of good tips and tricks to be a real newyorker. This is the best thing you can on tour day 1 trip!!
Saw all the sights with excellent commentary - guide was very knowledgeable - sorry do not remember his name but he was also a DJ
Excellent tour guide. Great coverage of many sites. Good lunch stop. Good ambassador for New York City leading this tour.
Touched on all the main sightseeing spots and gave us a taste for what she’d like to see more of. Our guide was very informative.

My family and I have never been to NYC or the state of NY, and we thought this tour was a good introduction that covered some of the main tourist/historical sites. We saw where John Lennon was assassinated, Washington Park/fountain, the 911 Memorial, Rockefeller Plaza (drive by), Central Park, NYC Library (drive-by), Times
Square (drive-by), film location for the Home Alone movie, Men In Black filming location, St. Pat's Cathedral (drive-by), the Financial District (drive by), Iron building historical district (drive by), and we saw the Empire State Building from afar. We also enjoyed the Staten Island Ferry and saw Elis Island and the Statue of Liberty from a distance. It's so much to see in 5 hours, and our tour guide did his best. He was a quiet talker though, so we unfortunately missed a lot of what he was teaching/saying to our group. The bus definitely needs a microphone. Oh, and please don't sit in the back rows of the bus either if you want to hear the information that the tour guide is saying. The bus is extremely noisy and squeaky back there. I just followed my kids to the back of the bus when we were claiming our seats, and I wish we would've known better not to sit back there. The tour guide was always considerate about those who may need to use the rest room, so that was a plus. We stopped at one of his famous pizzerias for lunch, and they had great thin-crust Margherita style pizza with fresh mozzarella. Just a word of caution and thankfully we did our research ahead of time: We had a 15 passenger Ford rental van for our large family, and there was absolutely no regular parking garage in NYC that would accommodate such a large/tall vehicle. We had to go to a special truck/large van garage 2.5 miles away, and we reserved a spot several days in advance. $90 per day (for 10 hours). So after we parked our van, we had to walk 2.5 miles to the location where the tour group met and dropped off after the tour. So allow yourself plenty of time. We went on a 9AM tour, so we had to leave our rental house (which was 40 minutes from the special parking garage location) at 6AM to give ourselves plenty of time for the 9AM tour, and we had to walk through some "interesting" parts of NYC during the early morning hours. We stayed on heightened-alert since we had several younger kids with us. Overall, it was a good time. After the tour, on our own as a family we spent another couple hours just in Times Square. It was interesting watching the street performers and stopping in the shops. There are also people who try to scam you with pictures. They dress up as Disney characters and grab your children for a picture. They don't even ask. So immediately after the picture, they have their hands out saying that you owe them money for tips and donations. They were getting $5-$10 from other unsuspecting parents for one picture. We also just had to try a hot dog from one of the hundreds of street vendors. They don't advertise prices anywhere, and they try to rip you off. They'll charge on more experienced person $3 and the next person $6. They definitely take advantage of suckers. In my and my families opinion, the NY style hot dogs weren't that great (we're used to Chicago style hot dogs). You should be able to get a small hot dog and bottle of water at one of those vendors for $5-$6 at the most, but they were trying to charge $7 per small hot dog. Not worth it. Move on to the next vendor and wheel & deal to get a better price. Overall, a good tour.

A couple of thoughts / ideas (definitely not criticisms):
• Have some subway brochures available, so when you’re mentioning which lines to take, we can visually see them.
• Maybe create your own “information sheet” with highlights. You’re giving a lot of information. It would be helpful, especially if English is not one’s primary language.
• While waiting for everyone to arrive, consider “introducing” fellow passengers as we board the bus (just first name and home state / country). We had such an interesting group – intro’s would enhance the group dynamic.
• From one boomer to another: we love to talk about ourselves. Your personal experiences added greatly to ours on the tour. But keep an eye on the present. Rather than tell us about the great bargain seats you once scored at Tkts, give us some examples of what bargains one might find this week.
• With the restriction on using a microphone at the 9/11 Memorial, consider giving us all the information while we’re all still on the bus.

We had Rachel as our tour guide and she was just amazing. She has such great energy, is funny and very informative. She gave us some great city hacks & advice as well! It is clear Rachel is methodical and organised when preparing to give a tour - it was just really excellent. 10/10
Rachel was an excellent tour guide. Very personable and knowledgeable and gave great tips for saving money in NY. I would highly recommend this tour!

I am so glad that this was the first excursion that we participated in on our first day in New York. If you are not used to a big city like New York it can seem a little overwhelming when you first arrive. Do yourself a favor and book a guided tour and you will be pleasantly surprised by the depth of knowledge of such a fascinating city. Our tour guide, Mike, a native of NY, provided so much interesting information and kept everyone engaged. The various stops were truly a well-planned view into some of the interesting sites in NY and gave us a better understanding of the city's layout. Mike even gave some great recommendations for restaurants that you might not think of a typical place to eat as well as some great subway tips. The best way to kickoff our visit to New York.

My wife and I went on the tour on October 3rd. Tim Douglas was our tour guide. He did a fantastic job of showing points of interest, answering questions and entertaining us with his great sense of humor. We enjoyed every stop especially the 911 visit. Tim explained how that event changed his life direction. This will be a memorable experience. Thanks Tim for helping to make our visit to NYC special. I would recommend this tour and hope you have the opportunity to meet this guide.

Most enjoyable even with the route detours due to the Columbus holiday celebration. Our guide Gil was excellent, he demonstrated an unbelievable knowledge of the city, its celebrated actors and theathres as well as taking a great interest in all in his party. An enviable debth of interesting infimation which was too much to absorb.
Let's not forget the driver, Hewas super given the number of detours made.
Greatly recommend.
Michael and Sheila.

This was an absolutely brilliant trip. I spent ages debating whether to go for a hop-on-hop off bus trip or one with a proper tourist guide. We had a brilliant day. It was a great introduction to New York, and I would really recommend it for your first day here - it gives you a great insight into everything, and because it's on a bus (and ferry) you don't get too exhausted. Whatever trip you do choose, make sure you get one with a proper guide, not just a pre-recorded soundtrack. Ours, Rachel, was invaluable: she gave us a little bit of history, architecture, great shopping tips, and some great advice as to how to be street-smart in an unknown city. Out trip was form 11.00am to 5.30pm.
Much of the trip is inside a bus, and I was bit nervous that you can't see the high buildings out the windows. This was not a problem at all: get to the pick up point early to get a window seat (we were in a pair so that was fine), you can see loads out the window, and we got out to take photos of all the the key landmarks (Rachel, our guide, showed us how to get the best shots of them). The alternative is an open top bus, but you don't get the great experience of a proper guide. Cannot recommend this trip highly enough - it was the highlight of our trip!

My wife and I were blessed to be able travel from Oregon to spend our 40th wedding anniversary in "The Big Apple"! To make it even better, we traveled with three other couples from California,two of which were also celebrating October anniversaries. So us eight great friends spent our first full day in NYC with two new friends, our driver Betty and tour guide Mike. It was so fun to have a guide that clearly loves his city! He had so many interesting facts and pointed out lots of historic places that we would have otherwise never known. Betty navigated the busy streets with ease. We returned to many of the places Mike pointed out later-on in our visit, especially the restaurants and discount theater outlets. It was a great tour and I would recommend to anyone who wants to get to know this awesome city!

Tyler was a fantastic guide, and the guide makes all the difference! Very knowledgeable. There is a fair amount of walking, sometimes a problem for me, but was able to see and do it for the day. Really glad I decided on this tour, you get a taste of a lot of things, then can decide if you want to spend time another day on a particular spot.

Booked this tour as having been in the US with work I had only one day to explore the city before I returned home. Was a great small group of people and the Guide Jack was excellent and expert regarding all the sights as well as little anecdotes you otherwise wouldn't get if on the traditional tour buses. Betty the driver was also excellent and knowledgeable. Especially as it was a holiday in the city so many roads were closed which made driving around more complex! Definitely recommend.

Dana was our guide and Betty was our driver. We enjoyed our tour guide’s commentary about the city and tips on shopping and getting around the city and last but not least, the jokes. Betty was a fantastic driver squeezing the tour van in between the vehicles. We had a great time. Thank you to Dana and Betty.

Arriving by cruise ship this was our 2nd visit to NY and 2nd time with this company. The bus holds about 20 people so there is minimal problems at the stops, our guide Roy was very knowledgeable and friendly and gave us a good tour.
The driver Jack had great traffic problems due to a UN Summit Conference taking place. Between them they gave us a brilliant day considering the problems they had to deal with. Our party consisted of 5 people and was enjoyed by all.

My wife and I had a wonderful time two weeks ago on this tour. Rachel was wonderful and shared so many 'insider' stories. Not only was the tour interesting, but she made sure everyone, even the elderly folks were taken care of. She gave us all tips on how to ride the subway regarding uptown and downtown. Her tips on getting broadway show tickets helped us get rush tickets for Chicago at half price. We also went to several of her recommended restaurants. All spot on. Rachel is a gem and really helped make New York City memorable.

I thought the 5-star review might be inflated, but after going on the tour I realized that 5 Stars is almost not enough. Tyler ran our tour and she was exceptional. She was knowledgeable, patient, kind and inclusive. She was funny and charming. She gave tons of "insider" tips for navigating the city and getting out to walk a few of the sites was invaluable. We left feeling like we had a true friend in NYC and an understanding of the city that only a local could offer. This tour is worth every penny and the guide deserved the price of the tour in tips.

Rachel was our tour guide and Arlis was our driver. We were very happy with their tour. The showed us everythign we wanted to see and Rachel provided us with paperwork outlining all the best things to see in NY and the necessary links. 5 stars would go again.
Rachel was an excellent your guide. She gave us so much information! Arlas was a great driver and navigated the city extremely well! We will definitely take another tour with Rachel!!

We covered the majority of the main sights of NYC! The tour guide is very knowledgeable (history of NYC included). Please be aware this is just a snapshot of NYC. The most amazing trip. Gill was our tour guide and he is so knowledgeable and entertaining. I would highly recommend. We covered more in this trip than we could have on our own. Highly recommend.

We took this tour on Sept. 20, 2019 with Rachael as our tour guide. She provided us with endless historical facts, amazing sites and great tips for the remainder of our trip. I would highly recommend spending your first day in New York with Rachael on this tour. Well worth every dollar spent.

Excellent!
Highly recommend
Rachael was our tour guide and she was fantastic! Gave us all the tips for visiting New York!

Dayna, our tour guide was phenomenal. She was super fun, charismatic and knowledgeable on everything NYC. And Betty, she's an amazing driver. This duo had us all laughing and feeling quite comfortable. Mahalo nui (thank you) to Dayna & Betty, for making my trip to NYC one that I'll never forget.

Rachel and Jose were amazing! We had a great time. Everything was convenient and comfortable and Rachel was very knowledgeable and friendly. We had a wonderful time and would absolutely tour with Rachel again!

This tour will allow you to see more of the city than you ever could on your own. Our guide, Gil, and driver, Ray Raymond were fabulous. You can’t go wrong with this tour. Well worth the ticket price!

OK it rained all day. It was still a great tour! Dina our tour guide made sure we were stocked up with ponchos and paper towels so we could enjoy the city she calls her own as much as she does. She also made sure to share how she maintains a sunny attitude on a dreary day by showing us how perspective changes everything in a look at the ceiling murals in the Rockefeller Center. From a biblical perspective this is also true “The eye is the lamp of the body, when it is healthy the whole body is filled with light”. Thanks Gina for a great sunny look at NYC on a gloomy day!

Great tour and guide!! Wonderful way to get familiarized with the city!
It was a rainy day, but still a great tour!!

Our tour guide introduced himself at the end of the day when he was looking for the tip he did not earn. We saw all the great sights you want to see to get your bearings in a very comfortable coach. The captain failed to go under the Brooklyn bridge , just came close and turned around again and headed home. The driver did a remarkable job in New York traffic. I would not recommend this company

This helped us knock out some stops but we also got information on numerous places we drove through, allowing us to pick and choose where we wanted to visit for the remainder of our vacation. Gil had so much info on places to eat, list of celebrities that lived in any building, shows, history and trivia. We had 3 boys (ages 10, 8 and 2) that were entertained the entire 6 hours.

Brilliant tour and great way to see New York, we got to see all the sights and the boat trip out to the Statue of Liberty, Brooklyn bridge and more is awesome. We did this on our first day in New York, we got to know our way around so much quicker by doing this trip and it saved us time when later visiting and touring around. Gill our tour guide was excellent, really knowledgeable and great fun and Gerry the driver is pretty cool too he'll keep the cool-box filled and squeeze the bus through the tightest of gaps to get you to the sights. I thought this trip was one of the best things we did in New York, you get to see the sights on the bus, get off and explore and a boat trip and to keep 2 teenagers entertained for the day it must of been good.This is a real full on day and I thought definitely value for money.
Gil was an amazing tour guide - so knowledgeable and engaging. And he really cared about us as members of the tour!

Really awesome tour Rachel was great showed us a lot on this tour got a lot out of it. She taught us how to get around the city and good deals I really recommend this tour on your first full day in the city.

Comfortable bus and nice, knowledgeable guide (Mrs Tyler). well done
Got to do this one day tour that touches most places of NY. Dana our guide was a star and gave us all some good tips to follow for our trip in NY.
Brooklyn Jim was the best tour guide ever! He was so knowledgeable about all the areas we stopped at. We saw a lot and learned a lot about the city in 6 hours.

Great job, long day but well done.

Enjoyed the guide, his knowledge base and his love for his job.

Just finished a wonderful tour with Dina. She is so knowledgeable and fun. We never felt rushed but covered a lot of ground. Lots of suggestions for a return trip. She is an awesome ambassador for NYC. We would definitely recommend this trip for all ages.

great tour of city by bus and boat. able to see much of nyc in 6 hour tour. guide was very knowledgable and personal. should be first trip for any first timers because all areas of city are discussed .

Tyler, our guide was great! The tour was well organized from beginning to end. For our first visit to New York we thought that this combination bus and boat tour was the way to go. Tyler was very personable and informative. It was 6 hours very well spent.
Mark our tour guide was great! Highly recommend this tour for the amazing amount of information about NYC. Thoroughly enjoyed the experience.

If you have little time of want to get oriented in Manhattan, take this tour.

Our guide Mike was great! We thoroughly enjoyed the tour. It was our first time to NYC, so this allowed us to see a lot and gave us the opportunity to see where we would want to spend more time. Driver Jerry got us around safely to every stop. Thank you Mike and Jerry for a great day!

Hard to put into words how well The tour with Rachael was. She was funny, personable and knowledgeable (I’ve been to NYC 3 previous visits and still learn something new. We were very lucky to get Mike our tour guide and Toni our driver for this amazing tour. We saw and enjoyed bits and pieces of all there is to see in Manhattan...and with Mike’s wonderful knowledge of this city nothing was left unturned. It’s the perfect tour for the perfect price.

It was amazing! It’s a huge city so unfortunately there’s a lot of traffic, so everywhere they stop has to be fast. Considering the time, you can see a lot! I suggest to do it on the first day in the city, so you would have time to visit the places you really liked after.

Rachel is a fantastic tour guide. She is very informative. She gives lots of information on how to get around in NYC. Arlis was the bus driver and he did an amazing job driving the bus through the city. I am so glad we took this tour.

Had a wonderful day touring the city. Rachel was a fantastic guide that made our day truly memorable! Arlis was a great driver, despite all the traffic!

What a way to spend a day in the Big Apple. I absolutely loved all of the stops and had ample time to take pictures and take in sights. I so appreciated Rachel our tour guide. This Experience was great. Very informative and Exciting. I would advise anyone going to NYC for Vacation, they should definitely do this!!!!

Excellent tour! Rachel was fantastic, as was the driver. The tour may seem long but never felt that way! So much incredible info was gained on this tour & we had an amazing time. Dina our tour guide was so friendly and knows her city. We were so happy to have chosen this tour. She answered every question with ease. Her knowledge of the history of New York City was impressive. The driver was always waiting for us and was very friendly as well. We highly recommend

On Sunday, September 29, at 11:00 AM, we boarded the bus with tour guide Rachel and driver Arliss for the best NYC tour I’ve ever taken. The trip was informative, fun and perfectly paced thanks to Rachel.

I was in NYC Sept. 2-6, Sept. 3 was my birthday; I thought it would be fun for my daughter and I to take this tour. I booked for Tuesday, 11:00. Yes, the fact that we were late was our fault, but come on, there's NOTHING you can do? I was so disappointed we sat on a planter box and I cried. I had wasted $178 AND I didn't get to go on this NYC tour with my daughter on my b-day.

Later, I called to ask if we could join the tour late and got a different guy, Adrian. I explained my situation to him, and he told me "I can just reschedule you for tomorrow on the 10:00 tour. There's plenty of room." Really? I was just so appreciative that Adrian was actually willing to help and we would get to go!
