We went during the heat wave and it was really hot. Cliff was a great tour guide and we learned a lot about Central Park.

This was a great way to see a lot of the major highlights of the city with a knowledgeable person to walk you through it. Tyler was great, she was very compassionate, learned our names and was very considerate of our kids. We had fun, learned some things and they even gave us water bottles (it was hot that day).

I highly recommend if you have a short amount of time in the city to see the majors.
It was great. The guide was friendly and engaged! Had a nice time! We saw important attractions for the city! Taylor the guide was knowledgeable and had a sense of humor.
Dina was a wonderful tour guide that was full of information and Gary was an excellent driver. Fun!!!
On time, comfortable bus, good driver but Rachel turned a good experience into a great one. Knowledgeable, entertaining and excellent getting us to each site with enough time to enjoy the landmarks.

IT WAS AMAZING. We had Dina as a guide and she was remarkable. Very knowledgeable and patient. We actually missed the bus and had to catch the tour a block away. She was patiently waiting for us. There is ALOT to see and a lot of neat sights. Land and sea, Empire State Building, Statue of Liberty, the footprints from 9/11, and so much more. Worth every penny.

This was a terrific tour that seemed to cover lots of key points. Terrific overview of the City. Rachel and the van driver were terrific. They made everything perfect. Rachel’s knowledge of the City was superb.

Our driver, Jhonny and our guide, Mike, were both excellent! Our driver navigated streets and traffic in a professional manner yet got us where we needed to be on time! Mike was awesome, his history was spot on, his banter kept us all engaged (including 3 teenagers) and he made the day a truly special event for myself, my brother and his family...

I recommend this tour to everyone. Take it early in your stay so you can focus later on what you what to see in the city. The tour guide was fantastic, funny and very knowledgeable. There were a few families with young children and they could follow without a problem. Lunch is not included but the lunch stop is close to many very good and affordable places to chose from. The boat is a definite plus. Overall well organized. Excellent choice for an overview of the city.

Our tour guide, Tim, did an excellent job taking care of us! He has an impressive knowledge of the city and shared so many, many interesting facts about the buildings, the people, and the history. So personable and enthusiastic! We are so glad we took the tour and learned so much about NYC!

Had a great time during this guided tour! Dana, our tour guide was amazing. She got contagious energy and is very knowledgeable bout the city and best attractions or restaurants if you want to explore on your own.

This was a great way to see so many sights and learn fun facts about the city. Our tourgide Rachel gave some great insider tips and tricks about how to shop, use the subway and places to eat. Jerry was a fantastic driver. Our teen girls were not bored on the tour at all and learned a lot. Even though the Big Red Bus tours look fun to sit on top, severe thankful to not be sitting in the hot sun. This was a great choice for us and I highly recommend.

Our guide, Dana, was very personable and knowledgeable. She shared interesting information about the city and its history as well as about places we visited or places we passed. She did a great job keeping track of everyone and moving us along.

Absolutely the best experience seeing NYC. Tim was extremely knowledgeable and kept the tour moving and fun.

Roy is a master navigator of that tour bus through the chaos that is New York City. We never felt jostled or shaken.

Highly recommended.
We had a great time on our tour! Very informative and excellent for our first day on our first trip to NYC...our tour guide Rachel was the best!

Exceeded expectations. Our guide, Ronda, was fantastic. She was very informative and her narration was great. No problem hearing or understanding even on noisy streets and traveling through traffic. Also enjoyed the cruise portion of the tour, although the top deck was quite crowded. I would highly recommend this tour for someone that has only one day and wants to experience the major sights. Its also a great overview so that one can decide what they may want to tour in more detail at a later time.
Tyler our guide was fantastic, very knowledgeable and very passionate. The tour is a brilliant way to take in the main points New York has to offer in a short time.

Pros - We all boarded an air conditioned shuttle bus for this tour. Johnny was our driver and Mike was the tour guide. The driver was a safe driver and our tour guide was very knowledgeable about NY since he grew up there. Many things to see and do, very imformative!
Cons - shuttle bus air wasn't very cool (we were there in July) and I would have chosen a better lunch area than the seaport area.
I absolutely loved the tour! I highly recommend this to anyone visiting New York City. I have been on many tours and the service is by far my favorite

We had the one day tour! We love the arrangement of the day. Our tour guide Tim was really nice and energetic and helpful! He really put in a lot of effort to make sure we had a good time and we’ve been to all the sightseeing areas that are on the schedule. I really think this tour is a very efficient and nice way to explore the city. Definitely recommend!

I did this tour with my nieces-13 and 15. I think they were a little young to appreciate it, but this was an excellent overview of the city. Very comprehensive. Our guide, Gil, was very informative, and our driver, Kon (so?) did a great job navigating the streets and keeping us safe. I highly recommend!

The best tour ever! Our guide, Dana, was very knowledgeable, enthusiastic, funny , helpful and just made the trip so fun. Can’t say enough about how worthwhile this trip is if your coming to the big apple. We took our friends from Indiana, who have never been to Nyc and they just loved it. Best tour I’ve ever been on! Ever !
Also our bus driver was the best!!!!!

I had the day on my own so this was a great way to get around on my first day in NY. The guide was entertaining and informative. It was well paced and helped me learn about how to get around for the rest of my visit and I found the places I wanted to revisit.

It was a great tour. I would definitely recommend it to enyone that wants to see as much as possible in one day. It covers the main attractions in NYC. It’s a lot of walking so wear comfortable shoes.

Loved the tour. Rachel our guide turned us into experienced New Yorkers while showing us all the sites. My companion had just had knee surgery and Rachel made sure he was comfortable. So glad we took this comprehensive tour! A beautiful intro to the city

I enjoyed the tour. It was a great way to see some great highlights of the city. It gave me ideas to visit different places in the city where I could visit on a different day and take my time to enjoy it.

My friend and I went on this tour and i cant say we were disappointed. I thought Rachel was really knowledgeable and got us the most out of the tour and gave us helpful tips on being a tourist in NY. Arliss was a excellent driver. They made a great team actually.

Family 5 day holiday in New York from England.
Firstly many thanks to the driver and Tim our excellent guide - a thoroughly knowledgeable and nice guy. Tough day and schedule for them as extremely busy (July 4th). Very hot day but bus had air conditioning and endless supply of water bottles.
Loads of really interesting stops and opportunities to use toilets if required. Lunch stop ideal - Market, pizza, street food and even McDonald's for those inclined.
Finished with boat trip to statue of liberty - great photo opportunities.
We would definitely recommend this tour!

A great way to see some of the best sights in New York. Rachel, our guide, was knowledgable and bubbly. The driver, Alseus, was excellent. A good balance of driving and walking with plenty of photo opportunities. Included boat trip was interesting and lunch stop well chosen. Rachel's "money saving tips" on the way back got a little tedious but overall a well planned tour.

The tour was worth the price. We were in New York for a short time with our 2 teenage kids and wanted to see many of the major places. Our driver Betty did an awesome job navigating around Manhattan and our tour guide Rachel was fabulous! She had many nice, helpful suggestions to assist us in enjoying New York. We should have done the tour the first day so we were a little more New York smart. She was also very accommodating to an oder gentlemen on the tour that had knee problems (there is a moderate amount of walking on stops). The boat ride included that goes out to the statue of liberty was a pretty cool experience! Would recommend this tour to others.

We had a great tour with Mike as our guide and Danny as our driver! It was our children’s’ first time in NYC and this tour was a great way for them to get an overview of the city in one day! I really liked that it included the boat so we could see the Statue of Liberty and the skyline of the city. The information should let people know there is a lunch stop on the way as well as a bathroom stop (very helpful). Mike was very knowledgeable and Danny had to drive through some tight spots and did it flawlessly!
Tour Bus was not “luxury” but the guide and driver gave a luxury experience. Guide was from NYC and had great knowledge of the city. Would take tour again no question.

The highlight was definitely our tour guide, Gil. He was incredibly knowledgeable about the city, high energy, always willing to take a picture, and ensured bathroom accessibility (which is an underestimated and important thing).
We had to make a last minute adjustment because of a flight and they were more than accommodating to push our tour back by the hour we needed. The key is definitely to communicate as soon as possible beforehand.
We hit every landmark that I was familiar with and beyond. Gil had a wealth of knowledge and kept the pace to get through everything in a timely manner.
The two points that we had to endure was the hyper focus on the Beetles in Central Park (which many of you will be more keen on) and the boat got a little crowded, but my patience was not what it should have been due to the long travel day we had just had. I would recommend going into it after a nights’s sleep and use it as an overview of the city on a first day there.
It was a wonderful tour and let us get a good taste of the city.

Highly recommend this tour. Tim was our guide and Arlis( hope I'm spelling this correctly) our driver were wonderful! Very informative and was just an overall great experience. If you want a relaxing and enjoyable tour of New York sign up for this the tour groups are not large and Tim did a great job remembering everyone. Very impressive.

Although I've been to the Big Apple in the past, I thought we needed to see and hear more about the city. We had an absolutely amazing guide, Tyler. She was so passionate about her city and shined from the inside out! Her smile was contagious! This tour allowed you to see a little of everything so you knew what you wanted to go back and see more thoroughly on your own. We took a bus for part of the time, walked and then ended with a wonderful boat ride seeing the Brooklyn Bridge and Lady Liberty. I am a photographer and have so many beautiful shots from our tour! Cannot say enough about this tour...a highlight of our trip for sure!

This was our first trip to the big apple and taking this tour with Rachel as our guide was by far one of the best decisions we made.
Rachel and Jerry(driver) took us to all the must see places in NYC and the history and funny stories that Rachel shared made the tour that much better, she really knows her stuff!
In the end she taught us how to be a real New Yorker and we used her tips the rest of our stay.
I highly recommend this tour to all but especially first timers to the city :)

Great Rachel very knowledgeable of area and events. Great information on how to find way around and the many facts about the area. Will definitely recommend to friends going to NewYork. Very glad took tour.

We had an amazing tour with Gil! He is so knowledgeable about NYC! We learned history, facts and figures and so much background information at every sight. Gil also offered advice and recommendations for restaurants etc. We appreciated his kindness as well.
This tour is well worth the cost. It was so nice to be on an air-conditioned bus with comfortable seats. Our stop for lunch was at a wonderful deli with a wide variety of foods. All in all, this tour is top notch!
Gil was our tour guide and Ron was our bus driver, they were great. Gil is very very informative about the city and doesn't hesitate to answer questions.

Rachel was our tour guide and it was an amazing experience. It’s a great idea to go on the first few days of your trip. It was the perfect amount of time, we saw everything we wanted to, and the tips she gave to navigate NYC were awesome and prepped us for the rest of the trip. Not typically into bus tours but can’t recommend enough.
Gill was a great guide so enthusiastic and tried hard to cover everything.Also helped with taking pictures.Roy did a great job driving.

I would highly recommend this tour for New York City (NYC). Our tour guide was Rachel and the driver was Jerry and they did a great job. Rachel was very knowledgeable of NYC and you could tell she had done her homework. She provided a wealth of information about the buildings and the evolution of NYC including the architecture and structures, including the bridges. She also provided very helpful info about getting around NYC and some do's and don'ts in the city. There is some walking involved, but that is minimal and is a nice change to riding. There are photo opportunities and Rachel served as the photographer at several locations for a photo of you and your group.

If I was to find anything subpar about the tour, it would be he boat ride. It was nice getting out in the water and seeing the Statue of Liberty up close, but that part was only average. That was put on by the ferry company and could have been more informative.

Rachel is a take charge type person and keeps the tour moving. She stays on task. One guest on the tour wanted to share her experiences, which none of us cared to hear, and she knew how to shut her down nicely and keep us on track. I really appreciated that as I wanted to hear about NYC. Rachel is very polite and ensures all of her guests are safe and have a good tour. Overall, I would give the tour an A+ and give Rachel an A+++++. WELL DONE!!!!

If you want to see as much of NYC as you can in a short amount of time, this is the tour for you. We had one day in the city and knew we weren’t going to be able to spend the time we wanted at each site, so just wanted some highlights of as many things as we could. Didn’t know what to expect, but Rachel the tour guide was exceptional!! She was fun, informative, kept us on track with the schedule, and gave us pointers on how to navigate the city like a local while also sharing interesting facts about the different areas we drove by. The bus is enclosed, not the double decker type, which was perfect for the rainy morning we had! We got out at 4 locations for about 20 min each to take pics and see things up close (Central Park, 9/11 Memorial, Empire State Building from a distance to take pics, flat iron building). Had a 30 minute break for lunch before getting on the boat to see Ellis Island, Statue of Liberty, and Brooklyn bridge. For $89 it’s a great value for all that you get to see in 6 hours!

I highly recommend ANYONE visiting New York take this tour! The value of what you receive in return for your ticket price is worth twice as much! Tim was an outstanding tour guide. He was very knowledgeable on the city, extremely courteous, friendly and very funny! He made the entire tour amazing for everyone. Roy was our bus driver, and I must say...he has killer driving skills! I felt very safe and well taken care of. Thank you so much for being a part of making our 10th anniversary trip so memorable!
This was well worth the money. The tour guide was knowledgeable and was amazingly funny as well as personable. This was well worth the money!
Our guide Rachel, and driver Johnny were awesome. A great day trip! We had fantastic views of so many great sites.
We had a very short time in NYC. This tour hit the highlights. Rachel gave lots of tips for getting around, sightseeing and places to eat.

This was a great tour. We enjoyed a lot. Our guide Tim was the Best. He had so detailed knowledge of History, Cinema, Theatre, Music and the he describes any place or event was so lively. His always charming behavior moved us. Thanks.
Gil and Antonio were superb. Informative, helpful, wonderful hosts. Was rainy day but Gil and Antonio adjusted well and made it a memorial experience for all of us.
Our tour guide, Rachael, was amazing. She had a comprehensive knowledge of NYC and her back stories were particularly interesting. I highly recommend this tour and Rachael.

New York is not my 1st time I been here so many times I use to live in Long Island I never tired of being here. Our 5hrs tour bus is worth! our guide she is such amazing! We have a lots of fun thank you my TripAdvisor.my highly recommended 5 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

USA Tours was a highlight of our visit to New York. It was a 5 to 6 hour tour of the highlights of New York. We went to Central Park, the 911 Memorial, took a boat ride around the Statue of Liberty, and so much more. Our Guide, J was fantastic. Told us a lot about NYC and was hilarious too. Our bus driver, Gerry was great too. We loved every minute of this tour. I highly recommend this tour. Better than 5 stars!
Rita and Victor (from Texas)
Our guide, Mike, did an outstanding job of introducing us to Manhattan. It was well worth our time. He was very knowledgeable and helped us get our bearings for the rest of our vacation.
Great tour. Tour guide Neil was great! Very informative tour of New York. Gives you a good overview of New York landmarks.
We had a wonderful tour and learned so much about the city! It's a great way to see the highlights and I would highly recommend it.

Great way to see a lot if your time is limited.
Rachel was excellent, lots of knowledge about the city

"J" Alan was our tour guide, he was amazing, organized, funny and kind. . so attentive to our group. at stops he would use our phones to take picture of us. . knew more than I can remember about NYC. . . my sister who's lived in NY for 25 years even found out new stuff, and she loved it. . our driver, sorry I forgot his name was fearless, I would never had seen and learned so much on my own. .I felt so comfortable going back to places I wanted to spend more time at a few days later. .

I highly recommend this tour. We did this on our first day in New York, and it gave us a great overview. Tyler was our guide, and she was was packed with information. She also had a fun personality and a great sense of humor.

New York in One Day Guided Sightseeing Tour Tour operator: USA Guided Tours NY - The bus used for this sightseeing tour is really not suitable for sightseeing in New York, where so much to be seen is way above street level - even the tour guide thought so! We covered a good bit of Manhattan and got out at a few spots which was good.

My husband and I really enjoyed the tour. I think that the main reason for our enjoyment is the information the tour guide provided. She was very pleasant and very knowledgeable of the New York City history and current events. She also helped us understand how the streets were numbered so that we could find our way in the city.

We went on a tour with Tim and Garry and had a wonderful tour. Tim was very informative and enthusiastic.

Could not have expected a better tour This was a brilliant start to our NYC holiday and i would strongly recommend to any 1st timer as a comprehensive orientation of NYC
This tour was a great tour and a great value. I highly recommend it! The tour guide was as highly knowledgeable of the City and really went above and beyond for her guests.

We went on a tour today with Tim and Arliss and had a wonderful tour. Tim was very informative and enthusiastic. He kept us entertained and Arliss was a very good driver. Could not have expected a better tour and great weather. Thank u the Rochester Girls.

Our fantastic guide Debbie and our skilled driver Raymond zipped us around NY for the better part of a day. A day filled with interesting and quirky facts, humour, a boat trip out to the iconic Statue of Liberty, and of course some pathos at ground 0 that we would not have wanted to miss. Well worth the money.

Very informativeIt’s just that you can’t really see the buildings he’s talking about while inside of the bus. Lunch was very quick and can be expensive depending on what you buy. The boat tour was OK you don’t get as close as I thought you would to the statue of liberty and the boat can be Very crowded.
Fantastic trip! J is outstanding! I would highly recommend!! I would not recommend this for people who have trouble keeping up with a fast paced walk.

Michael was a wealth of knowledge including the historic buildings, people and trivia. Well orchestrated with the driver. Very enjoyable.
The boat voyage at the end was fun to see the bridges Nan’s city from the wade. Lady Liberty up close was amazing .

Great guide and driver!! Was glad to be safely on the bus and boat for this whirlwind and packed tour.
We were able to see the nyc highlights ithis 6 hour tour, and also heard a lot of great stories which added a lot of depth and character to this experience!! Also got tips on how to use the subway for our other days, district and restaurant backgrounds, and where to get discount show tickets. It was a great way to start our trip to nyc and get ourselves grounded.

Our tour guide from Brooklyn (not naming her, intentionally) was - IS - totally AWESOME! Her energy, knowledge of all-things NYC and easy/approachable demeanor won me over. She’s top-notch, enjoys her job and LOVES her City. She’s the BEST. 5-Stars!

The physical bus, itself? It’s ‘OK’ but inadequate for touring a City of SKY SCRAPERS. Didn’t seem to bother anyone else; just something I observed. A more open, airy tour bus/coach would be a welcomed-improvement. The coach was clean, easy to board/de-bus, and always nearby.

The tour? Pretty cool; hits all the major spots, albeit briefly, from Times Square and Midtown to 5th Avenue, The Village, SOHO, FIDI, Tribeca and more. A short walk into Central Park before heading Downtown via 5th was a nice surprise. Day concludes with a boat ride passing Statute of Liberty. Views of NYC, Jersey City, Brooklyn and Hudson Yards - AMAZING!

Highly recommend the tour. Are there better options? Perhaps, depending on ‘what’ you want to see and do. Research, research, research!

Seeking a relatively quick overview of some major NYC attractions? This tour won’t disappoint. And if you score “Brooklyn Girl” as your guide - you are in for a special day. The solo guy from California, who walked the High Line 2x thanks to her, won’t forget her hospitality. 5-stars!

A fabulous way to see some of the main attractions in New York City. J. Alan was our guide and he was very knowledgeable and funny. The time went by quickly and enjoyed the entire day!
Thanks J. Now we know why you’re the best tour guide in NYC.
We highly recommend this tour!

Our first morning in NY and we booked the 11am tour - such a great start to our NY trip. Tim our guide was excellent, knowledgeable, inclusive and all round great guy (thank you!)! He told us the best places to dine, was brilliant at answering everyone’s questions & gave a truly New Yorkers view of this fabulous city. Our 5 year old Bella said ‘Tim was so nice and kind & thinks you’re her best tour guide ever’ (we have had a few so top of the list in her book & ours too). Our 12 year old Josh found it hugely entertaining & was not once bored (thanks Tim an unusual positive day with a pre-teen!). This tour was super, took us to the key destinations, giving us ideas for the next few days as well as taking all to the places we wanted to see, was flexible and bonus was the boat - top deck seats as Tim knew ‘his people’ needed to be there on time. If you get Tim on your trip you’ll have a great day! Shout out to Arlo our driver for the day too, such a kind and friendly guy. Thanks to you both. Very best from the London family of 4! PS thank you also for the great photos you too :o)

Tour guide was J and driver was Anthony. Both were excellent!! Anthony was amazing at maneuvering thru crazy Manhattan traffic to get us to destinations on time. J was very knowledgeable, friendly & a great guide full of historical and current information. So much to learn in 1 day. The boat cruise was the highlight. So amazing to see the statute of liberty up close on a beautiful day. Highly recommend this tour for a first time trip to NY.

This tour was so amazing and insightful, I did not expect it to be so fun. Super thanks to Tim for entertaining us for over 5 hours showing us this amazing city.

Much love,
Romania

Just the right amount of waking and riding. Would have liked to go further into Central Park. Boat ride was not fun. Rude other tours and the cheesiest host that asked for tips aggressively. Stood at the exit to the boat with money fanned out and a big cheesy smile.
What a great Tour! Our guide Jay was a wealth of knowledge. I learned so much, it was fantastic! I definitely recommend this tour.

Pedro, our driver and Tim, our tour guide were both excellent! Tim’s detail knowledge and relatability to our group were phenomenal. The info provided and opportunities to walk around Strawberry Fields in Central Park, Rockefeller Center, the ferry ride past Ellis Island, the Statue of Liberty and under the Brooklyn Bridge were priceless views! Walking around the 9/11 Memorial was extremely moving. I would recommend this tour for anyone who is visiting the city for the first time, or if it has been many years since they were last in town. Very memorable and well worth it. Kudos and well done to Tim and Pedro!

I took this tour yesterday and it was lovely. I got to see A LOT of new york city, that otherwise would have been hard to see on my own. The tour guide Neal and driver Arles were just fantastic! You could really tell Neal loved this city of his. After the boat ride, he said "you know you tell yourself someday I'm going to see the statue of liberty and today you guys did that," and I just thought that was really something :)

My wife and I had a full day to wait for our flight after we returned to NYC. Although we visit NYC often and have many favorite spots, the rainy day and our being tired seemed to indicate the tour. We enjoyed it and the guide and driver were very good. Dropped us at JFK at the perfect time.

Our guide was Neil and the driver was Jerry. These guys are true professionals and know the city. The flow of the tour was well thought out and coordinated. Highly recommend this company for your tour of NY!

Our tour guide Jay was excellent! He was absolutely hilarious, as well as knowing everything worth knowing about NYC :) He was also very attentive in making sure of it that everyone got their photos taken in all the right places. The driver was very good as well, and since I sat up front I could see that they worked very well together as a team. The only complaint I have is the bus, as the passengers would SO have enjoyed the tour better with a full front window and glass roof (at least partly), especially in this city with all its skyscrapers, do NOT sit in the front. Very well organized tour, and very sufficient duration of the boat tour, just right. Highly recommended! Especially for people with little time to stop.
Thanks, Neil and Larry, for a wonderful day! We had a great time exploring the city. This tour is the perfect way to see so much of New York.

Booked this tour prior to going to New York. What a good day it is our guide was Tim & driver Roy. Tim was an excellent guide with a wealth of knowledge, funny & a lovely man. We visited an area of Central Park opposite Yoko Ono’s apartment block, then on to Rockerfella centre saw the ice rink outside & NBC news& radio city buildings. Then on to Ground Zero, riverboat to see the Statue of Liberty & Brooklyn Bridge. Lunch is a pit stop we’re you can grab a hotdog or burger. Well organised & informative tour would definitely recommend.

The tour was great and our guide Mike, was very knowledgeable. This was my second tour with USA Tours and both have been very good. I enjoy having all the little extra information and being able to ask questions with a live guide (as opposed to recorded audio).

We were recommended this tour at our hotel. It was me and my dad’s first time in NYC (my mom went once before) and we were pleasantly surprised with how nice the tour was. We stayed at a hotel in Newark and Johnny our bus driver (who was excellent) picked us up directly from the hotel and dropped us off after the tour was finished. Jack was our tour guide and was very friendly, funny, and knowledgeable about NYC. Our small group had a total of 28 people and we got to visit most major monuments in Manhattan and we also went on a boat tour to see the Statue of Liberty and the Brooklyn Bridge. One critique I can make is that the tour guide occasionally narrated under the assumption that everyone had a good knowledge of US History but for us non-Americans it was sometimes hard to follow. Other than that, the tour was great! Highly recommend for first-timers that would like to become familiar with the Big Apple before doing exploring yourself!
This was an awesome tour, Tyler was amazing and so knowledgeable. Must do in NYC. Rained but she made the best of it. Was awesome

Neil and his driver were extremely knowledgeable about New York City and its history.
Very accommodating and pleasant to all of us and the rest of our group.
Highly recommend them!

Rachel was awesome, informative, fun, relatable, clear, and protective.
The tour was great, caught a glimpse of so much. I would love to go back to NYC again.

Excellent tour with a very knowledgable guide called Debbye. We visited all the main sights and Debbye was very informative - we learnt so much that we wouldn’t know if we went alone! I would highly recommend :) very well organised and good value for money!
This guided tour was amazing. It was comfortable ride, pleasant driver and tour guide. Bus was clean and on time. You see so many wonderful sights.

Tyler was the best guide for a tour of New York City. She gave us
Practical information as well as many lesser known facts about the city. We saw many more spots in the city than expected, we stopped at the financial district, Central Park,the 911 memorial along with several more. She had plenty of time for questions and interaction with the 32 person group. We left and came back to the same spot which was very conveniently located. The tour around the harbor was filled with more knowledge about the city and was a pleasant ride. Having had many tours in various cities, I was very impressed with the overall experience of this tour especially with the with this guide.

What a great way to see NYC, our tour guide Jay an driver Raymond were great. Jay new all the history of the city. He made sure everyone stayed together so Raymond could pick us up an move to the next stop. I would highly recommend this tour, if you are lucky you will get these two. What a great trip, will do the night one soon.

This was a great tour. Tim our guide made it extra special with his wonderful knowledge of the city. Anthony did a great job of driving us around. Would highly recommend this for all couples and Families.

Wow! Gil (tour guide) and Anthony (driver) were fantastic! We took this 6 hour tour our first day in NYC and it was helpful for the rest of our week there. Gil is unbelievably knowledgeable, delivers the message well, and is willing to speak with individuals who have private questions. Anthony got us around the city very well, in spite of big traffic and the relationship of the two was one of friendship and respect. He was also fun to talk with ahead of time, and has a great sense of humor.

We made several stops in which we deboarded the bus, including a quick but good lunch. The stop where Yoko Ono still lives (and John was shot) was especially informational to us - information we probably would not have received just visiting the area on our own. The 9-11 stop was enough time to be reverent and other stops let us see the downtown and other areas from a sidewalk view.

Gil barely took a breath, he had so much information to impart. This is not a complaint at all, but I felt sorry for his 'voice' and we would not have minded it he took a break here and there from his speech. Both men were fantastic and the tour is well worth your time. Do it....and ask for Gil and Anthony.

JBL and LLH from SC and MT

I had the great pleasure to have Mike as a tour guide and Tony the driver. My tour was on april 15th. I absolutely loved the tour and could not have been more happier with the tour guide. Mike was very knowledgeable and friendly. I strongly recommend the tour. Do keep in mind that this is a 6 hours tour. You do get off the bus quite often but it is on a tight schedule. This schedule is perfect for you if you want to explore a lot in a short period of time. All in all, great experience!

Really thoroughly enjoyed the tour with guide Neal and driver Jose and it is was a fantastic experience. The cruise was a lot of fun also. If you are looking for a tour to see a little of everything this is for you.
Guide was very knowledgeable! We got to see most of the highlights of the city and got some guided history lessons along the way. Well worth the time and money!

After a short search we decided to join the one day sightseeing tour. When we arrived at the location the busses were already waiting and there was enough room in the bus. We had Rhonda as guide and she is so friendly. She has a lot of experience as a guide in New York City and she knew all the little details about all the buildings and places.

There was enough time to have a lunch and we saw everything they promised. And probs to Rhonda!

We had a great guide by the name of Rachel. She was very informative & gave us lots of good tips about New York City. We made several stops on our tour which was very welcome. Rachel was very personable and interested in all her passagers.

Recent reviews have gone into detail of this excellent tour. I can only add a few comments that might help people decide. We really needed a tour like this because we had only one clear day to see things, and it didn't disappoint. Our tour had mostly US citizens - we and one other couple were from UK. We thoroughly enjoyed the six hours which passed all too quickly. Good value for money too with a great lunch stop in a food market - perfect place.
The bus was one like the typical US school bus shape, and it was difficult to see forwards - for us and the guide. Why do they go for this odd design? One other small observation/criticism - we waited a long time to get on the boat, and it seemed like we were lucky to get on at that time. In the end, all was well. Thank you the tour organisers. Tim is a treasure.
We were horrified to hear the tragic news of killings just a few days after our visit. We have absolute sympathy with all those caught up in it. This is a rare event and it would not put me off coming again to this vibrant and exciting city.

Tour guide Tim was great. From start to finish this is what you would expect from a true New Yorker. Interesting details of the city and lots of great destinations- He made the 5 hour tour fun and exciting. We visited locations that I may have not gone to on my own and enjoyed being able to get off the bus and walk the city and see the sights while still having Tim give us backstories and valuable facts. A must do for the first time in NYC!

Growing up in Philly, I have been to NYC many times. I learned more on this trip than all of those trips combined! I was travelling with my cousin from Germany and was looking for a stress free tour where she could see as much could and this surely delivered. Our trip started off on a high note with thoughtful planning with Pedro Hidalgo who helped me arrange trips to both NYC and Washington DC with their company.

Our driver Anthony navigated the streets with ease and our guide, Tyler, was an amazing font of knowledge who made everything interesting. What I loved about this tour was that every detail was taken care of--no more worrying about what subway stop was closest, where to park the car, how much $$ to park the car, etc.

This tour is much better that open top and/or hop off and on bus because our guide, Tyler, would get off at the stops WITH US and continue to give info, just as she did on the bus. There was no waiting for the "next bus" as our bus was always right there to pick us up immediately after we were finishing checking out each of the stops. This tour does not mess around and there is no wasted time (love that!).

I don't think there is any way I could have visited all of the stops on my own AND given my cousin as much info. In the span of 6 hours we visited:
1. Rockefeller Center (were able to see Radio City Music Hall, 5th avenue with all it's flagship stores such as Saks) and go into St Patrick's Cathedral
2. See Flatiron building/Empire State-check out Mario Battaglia's "Eataly" market
3. Travel through Wall Street (see the bull!) and Greenwich Village
4. Stop at the World Trade Center Memorial
5. Water Taxi down the Hudson past Statue of Liberty with views of three bridges (BMW to you and me, thanks, Tyler- I will never forget "Brooklyn, Manhatten and Williamsburg" bridges)
6. Dakota building
7. walk through Central Park via Strawberry fields.

The only down side (if this was even a down side) is that lunch seemed a bit rushed. We only had 30 min to eat and that included getting our food and walking back to the bus. We stopped in a neighborhood with multiple options (fast food, pizza and local market). We chose to eat at the Fulton Market and the food was fantastic. Actually ended up taking some back on the bus because we could not finish in time).

Highly, highly recommended. I will never forget Tyler's stories, bubbly personality. and her love for "MS BBQ"- Burroughs that make up NYC--Manhattan, Staten Island, Brooklyn, Bronx and Queens. Just fantastic. I would do this first when arriving in NYC as an overview, allowing return to places of interest.

We wanted to pack in as much as possible as we were only staying in NY for 3 days. On day one we booked this all day tour of New York. Our tour guide Rachel was brilliant, knowledgeable about all key buildings and super local knowledge from a real New Yorker! High lights of this tour are too many to mention but a real highlight for me was an unexpected gem, The Oculus, the state of the art World Trade centre Transportation Hub, it was breathtaking.
Highly recommend this tour, worth every £/$.

The tour was great! We got an overview of all New York City has to offer and then some! The tour guide, Rachel, was very knowledgeable and also had a keen sense of humor. She made the tour an experience to remember. We were given a look at all the prominent sights so we could decide where we wanted to spend more time. The boat tour offered a wonderful opportunity to take photos of The Statue of Liberty and a close-up look at the bridges of the area. This is a definite must-do if you have limited time and are a new visitor to NYC!
